tours.title: Half-Day Tour Conical Hat Making, Cooking Class And Cycling
tours.summary: You will be warmly welcomed by the host with a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea inside an ancient house, a perfect showcase of Northern Delta architecture. You will be captivated by the wooden structure, adorned with in
tours.contentHtml:
9:30 You will be warmly welcomed by the host with a cup of traditional Vietnamese tea inside an ancient house, a perfect showcase of Northern Delta architecture. You will be captivated by the wooden structure, adorned with intricate carvings and traditional furnishings that give the house a deeply venerable and timeless atmosphere.
10:00 You will move inside the Tonkin conical hat workshop to begin your journey of discovery and hands-on experience. You will meet local artisans who have dedicated decades of their lives to this craft.
  • Making a conical hat is a multi-step process that requires immense patience and skillful hands, utilizing simple, natural materials like bamboo and palm leaves brought from forests hundreds of kilometers away. First, you will receive a clear introduction to the materials and the step-by-step hat-making process. After that, you will observe the artisans at work and receive their personal guidance to challenge your own hands-on skills – from flattening the palm leaves to stitching and painting your own imaginative designs onto the hat. This is a truly special experience, as you will get to take your custom hat home as a meaningful souvenir of your journey.
  • Throughout the visit and workshop, you will also have the chance to interact with the warm-hearted, authentic local people. Don’t forget to capture beautiful photos with our impressive displays made from conical hats and familiar countryside items like bamboo carrying poles, an ancient water well, and a traditional water tank... all creating a nostalgic, rustic ambiance set within a lush green garden.
  • Though it takes only about 1 to 2 hours, I am certain you will feel completely satisfied with your wise choice. You will gain a genuine insight into the Vietnamese countryside, connect with passionate artisans, and enjoy an experiential journey that is truly hard to find anywhere else.”

11:30 You join a cooking class to learn how to make a delicious food called “Nem Ran”. You will be introduced ingredients mixed together and guidance to roll the Vietnamese spring rolls and fry the spring rolls.
12:00 A delicious, home-cooked meal will be served you inside the traditional house. You have a short rest after lunch.
You continue taking a leisurely bike ride to soak in the scenic countryside and rustic villages and lush green rice and vegetable fields. Say good bye to the family to go back your hotel.

tours.title: Nha Trang To Dalat Private Car Transfer
tours.summary: Nha Trang to Dalat private car transfer is a high-quality door-to-door service for travelers from the beach city to the “city of love” Dalat. By booking transport with A/C private cars and English-speaking drivers, vacat
tours.contentHtml:
Nha Trang to Dalat private car transfer is a high-quality door-to-door service for travelers from the beach city to the “city of love” Dalat. By booking transport with A/C private cars and English-speaking drivers, vacationers will have easy, hassle-free trips to Dalat from Nha Trang.

Nha Trang To Dalat Distance

Dalat and Nha Trang are two popular destinations among holidaymakers coming to Vietnam. While Nha Trang is famous for its exquisite beaches, Dalat appeals to visitors thanks to dreamy views of hills and valleys.

The distance from Nha Trang to Da Lat is ~212 km (132 miles). It is expected to take approximately 4,5 hours by car, following the CT01 route that connects to QL27, which is currently the fastest route. However, bad weather and heavy traffic can prolong your trip by 1 to 2 hours longer than expected.

How To Get To Dalat From Nha Trang

So, how to go from Nha Trang to Dalat? Transfers by bus, taxi, private car, or motorcycle are several of the most commonly chosen ways. However, we believe private car transfers bring the most conveniences and comfort.

It’s door-to-door, private, customizable, and flexible. You can get pick-ups and drop-offs right at your hotels in the cities without worrying about tickets, scams, extra costs, finding stations, changing vehicles, etc.

NHA TRANG TO DALAT PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Travel Briefing

  • Distance: 212km (~132 miles)
  • Travel Time: 4,5 – 5 hours

You will cross Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, Binh Thuan, and Dong Nai before Saigon. If you’re fed up with a direct transfer from Nha Trang to Saigon, we can arrange a sightseeing trip with interesting tourist venues, such as:

Cam Ranh Bay (Khanh Hoa Province)

Apart from being a strategic spot, Cam Ranh Bay appeals to visitors as an untouched landscape. Unlike the modern appearance of Nha Trang beaches, the bay seems more rural, idyllic, and poetic.

You can drop by to admire the views and taste some signature seafood dishes made out of fresh squid, lobster, or crab.

Mui Ne (Binh Thuan Province)

If you’re interested in “beach heavens” in Vietnam, you must have heard of Mui Ne. It’s a national tourism area, boasting the best highlights, including dream-like beaches and impressive dunes.

If you’d like to take a look at Mui Ne Beach, our driver can make a brief stop at one of the most beautiful coastal viewpoints in the area.

Known as the oldest temple in Binh Thuan, Po Sah Inu Towers will give visitors a sacred and mysterious atmosphere. It’s part of the Cham tower ruins collection, so it holds great significance in Vietnamese history and culture.

If you’re keen on ancient relics, historical constructions, and architecture, this site is worth your time.

tours.summary: Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) to the Cu Chi Tunnels by private car is a convenient and flexible travel option. The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground.
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) to the Cu Chi Tunnels by private car is a convenient and flexible travel option. The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground. These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The Ho Chi Minh to Cu Chi Tunnels distance is 45km and it takes an hour and 30 minutes to transfer by car. Unlike other transports to travel to Cu Chi Tunnels such as taxis, and grab cars. By booking our Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi Tunnels private car, you will have a door-to-door transfer service with a basic English-speaking driver to explore the Cu Chi Tunnels.

SAIGON TO CU CHI TUNNELS PRIVATE CAR

Following your request, our Saigon private car and driver will pick you up at your desired pickup location in Saigon Center, such as your hotel, Tan Son Nhat International Airport, or any other convenient spot in the city.

If you request to be picked up at Saigon Airport, please tell us your flight number, landing time as well as the number of people so we can send a proper car such as a sedan, an SUV, or a minivan to pick you up.

Our driver will wait for you at the Tan Son Nhat airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can recognize him. After greetings and loading the luggage, he will transfer you to visit Cu Chi Tunnels. After all, our driver will drop you off at your hotel in Saigon center.

If you stay at a hotel in Ho Chi Minh city, our driver will pick you up at your hotel and transfer you to Cu Chi Tunnels to visit. You can choose the pick up time and our driver will wait for you to explore Cu Chi Tunnels until you finish.

The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground. These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The tunnels served multiple purposes, including hiding from American and South Vietnamese troops, launching surprise attacks, storing food and supplies, and serving as a communication and transportation network.

You can explore a section of the tunnels, learn about their history, and gain insights into the life and tactics of the Viet Cong during the war. Travelling to Cu Chi Tunnels, you will learn more about the tunnels’ history, construction, and usage. You can also see various traps and booby traps used during the war.

There are museums and exhibits on-site that display weapons, equipment, and artifacts from the Vietnam War era. These exhibits offer a deeper understanding of the conflict. Plus, You will have the opportunity to try shooting firearms used during the war at an on-site shooting range for an additional fee.

After all, our driver will transfer you back to your hotel in Saigon and we finish the private car Saigon to Cu Chi Tunnels transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great experience with us.

Travel Thoughts:

Respect the Site: The Cu Chi Tunnels are a historical and cultural site. Show respect for the history and the people involved in the Vietnam War while visiting. Avoid making inappropriate jokes or disrespectful comments.

Stay Hydrated: The tunnels can be hot and humid, so it’s essential to stay hydrated. Bring bottled water with you and drink regularly to avoid dehydration.

Use Sun Protection: The tropical sun can be intense. Apply sunscreen, wear a wide-brimmed hat, and use sunglasses to protect yourself from sunburn.

Crawling in the Tunnels: If you choose to crawl through the tunnels, be prepared for a tight and dark space. It’s not suitable for those with claustrophobia or physical limitations. Go at your own pace and take your time.

Photography: Ask your guide about the rules regarding photography. Some areas may not allow photography due to the sensitivity of the site. Respect these restrictions.

Leave No Trace: Do not litter or leave trash behind. Use designated trash bins for disposal.

Learn About the History: Before your visit, take some time to learn about the history of the Cu Chi Tunnels and the Vietnam War. This will enhance your understanding and appreciation of the site.

  • This is a door to door private car with an experienced driver.
  • We provide nice, comfortable car with a strong A/C.

  • Our Saigon to Cu Chi Tunnels price is compatitive and reasonable without hidden costs.

Not only that, but a high-quality private car will conveniently pick you up and drop you off door-to-door at the hotel address you specify.

HANOI TO HA GIANG BY PRIVATE CAR

Ha Giang is a province located in the northernmost region of Vietnam. It is known for its stunning natural landscapes, rugged mountains, and diverse ethnic cultures.

Moreover, Ha Giang is renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, including the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, which is a UNESCO Global Geopark. The region features towering limestone peaks, deep valleys, terraced rice fields, and picturesque winding roads.

To meet all your diverse travel requests, Vietlook Travel creates some travel options such as

  • Day 2: Explore Quan Ba Heaven Gate, Yen Minh, Meo Vac districts, and Ma Pi Leng Pass.
  • Day 3: We will visit Dong Van town and Lung Cu flag tower – the palace of the Hmong King.
  • Day 4: Ha Giang- Tuyen Quang City- Hanoi City hotel with the distance is about 372km, and it takes about 9 hours to transfer.

After all, we will drop you off at your hotel in Hanoi city center or Noi Bai International Airport. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great journey with us.

Travel Thoughts

Ha Giang is a destination that offers a unique blend of natural beauty, cultural diversity, and adventure. It’s a place where you can escape the hustle and bustle of urban life and immerse yourself in the tranquil charm of northern Vietnam.

  • Best time to visit: Ha Giang experiences a temperate climate, with cool winters and warm summers. The best time to visit is from September to November when the weather is pleasant, and the rice terraces are lush green.
  • Local Homestays: Staying with local families in traditional homestays is a great way to immerse yourself in the local culture and experience the warmth and hospitality of the people.
  • Local Cuisine: Besides, Ha Giang offers a chance to savor delicious local dishes, which often include fresh ingredients from the region. Don’t miss the opportunity to try traditional dishes like thang co (a hotpot of various meats) and banh cuon (steamed rice rolls).
  • Trekking and Hiking: The province offers excellent trekking and hiking opportunities. You can explore remote villages, terraced fields, and pristine natural beauty on various trekking routes.
  • Ethnic Diversity: The province is home to a variety of ethnic minority groups, including the Hmong, Dao, Tay, and more. Moreover, each group has its own unique traditions, clothing, and way of life. Therefore, visitors have the opportunity to learn about these cultures through homestays and interactions with local communities.
  • Lung Cu Flag Tower: This tower is located at the northernmost point of Vietnam and is a symbol of the country’s sovereignty. Visitors can climb to the top for panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.
  • Ma Pi Leng Pass: Often referred to as the “King of Passes,” Ma Pi Leng Pass offers some of the most spectacular views in the region. It’s a popular spot for motorbike enthusiasts and adventurers.

tours.title: HANOI’S INSIDER GOOD MORNING – AFTERNOON TOUR
tours.summary: Our team takes guests to sample the best dishes that Vietnam has to offer! This is a great way to see parts of the city that most tourists don’t have the chance to see or even hear about. We’ll take you to the most popul
tours.contentHtml:
Our team takes guests to sample the best dishes that Vietnam has to offer! This is a great way to see parts of the city that most tourists don’t have the chance to see or even hear about. We’ll take you to the most popular street stalls, hidden alleyways, and, of course, to where the locals love to hang out with their friends.

ITINERARY

  • We pick you up and drive through narrow streets to the meeting point to join the group at the historic Old Quarter. Our first stop is the French Quarter to visit the Hanoi Opera House, where you will learn about French colonial architecture and history.
  • Next, we head to our second destination: Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built more than a hundred years ago. It spans the Red River and connects the Hoan Kiem and Long Bien districts. The bridge provides shelter to locals living on boats underneath, and only motorbikes and bicycles can traverse it so off we go!
  • Our next attraction takes you along the riverside to the Red River Island to visit a Hidden Gem Village. Here, you will see the poorer part of local life, observe farming activities, and have the chance to meet and chat with the people living on the island. Our guide will also take you to visit a local family to learn about their daily life.
  • Then we drive through the Banana Farm to admire the beautiful green vegetable fields along the way. We will also visit a Kumquat Farm these small trees are traditional gifts during Tet, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year, symbolizing luck, health, wealth, fertility, and peace.
  • Our next ride takes us to visit Tran Quoc Pagoda, located on West Lake one of the largest lakes in Hanoi. At certain points, you will have a panoramic view of the city with beautiful homes and stunning scenery, as well as see parts of the wealthy residential area.
  • We then drive to Thanh Nien Street next to West Lake and Truc Bach Lake, where we stop at the Monument of John McCain. Here you will see the site where he was shot down and learn the story behind it.
  • Continuing the ride, we pass by the Botanical Garden and small alleys with narrow houses to visit Huu Tiep Lake and the B-52 crash site. This U.S. bomber was shot down during the 1972 bombing raids over Hanoi a poignant reminder of recent history.
  • After a short scooter ride toward Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, our riders will stop at a viewpoint where you can see the Presidential Palace, Parliament Building, and other government offices. Our guide will share stories and history about Hanoi.
  • Our next stop is to enjoy Vietnamese coffee, including the famous Hanoi specialty Egg Coffee.
  • We then get back on the scooter and head to a local restaurant for you to enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. After lunch, our riders will take you back to your hotel or drop you off anywhere you prefer. Just let us know goodbye

Included

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet

  • Experienced professional riders

  • English-speaking guides

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

tours.title: HANOI BICYCLE BACKSTREET TOUR 4.5 HOURS
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary 8:00 AM (or 1:00 PM): Your tour guide will pick you up from your hotel lobby and transfer you to our bicycle shop to choose a suitable bike. Once you meet your local guide, you’ll get comfortable with
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary

8:00 AM (or 1:00 PM): Your tour guide will pick you up from your hotel lobby and transfer you to our bicycle shop to choose a suitable bike. Once you meet your local guide, you’ll get comfortable with your bicycle and receive a safety briefing. Then we’ll begin our ride!

We will cycle to see the amazing alley where the train passes through the residential area. Riding along the train track, you will explore part of the French Quarter with its old French colonial architecture. We will continue cycling through Ngoc Ha Flower Village, passing small narrow alleys and dark roads, seeing tall and narrow houses, and experiencing lively backstreets with chances to meet the friendly local people of Hanoi.

After a long ride through narrow streets, you will visit the site of an American B-52 aircraft that was shot down during the Christmas Bombing in 1972, now known as B-52 Lake. We then continue biking to one of the most beautiful areas of Hanoi West Lake where you can stop to enjoy a panoramic view of the city.

Next, we will cycle back into the narrow roads to visit a local market and ride through the narrowest streets in Hanoi so you can see and feel how local people live. We then ride up to the Red River to visit a hidden village where locals grow their own crops such as vegetables, corn, bananas, and many types of fruits. You will have a chance to visit a local family living on the island in simple houses, yet always friendly and welcoming. This experience will help you learn and understand more about local life in different parts of the city.

After that, we continue cycling along the Red River bank to see the green farmlands and head to Long Bien Bridge the historic and oldest bridge in Hanoi where you can enjoy the views, history, and take photos.

To end the tour, we will take you to enjoy street food and a traditional egg coffee, then drop you off back at your hotel.

  • Special backstreet bicycle experience

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

tours.title: War Tour Of Hanoi
tours.summary: An Insight Into The Vietnam War War is a memory that peace lovers do not wish to recall, but it happened on the beautiful land of Vietnam. While there is an abundance of information available, this tour focuses on a sele
tours.contentHtml:
An Insight Into The Vietnam War

War is a memory that peace lovers do not wish to recall, but it happened on the beautiful land of Vietnam. While there is an abundance of information available, this tour focuses on a select few key locations that offer an intimate and personal look into the war’s impact on Hanoi.

2 Time Slots Every Day

  • 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM

  • 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Itinerary

  • 8:00 AM: Pickup at your hotel

  • 8:30 AM: Visit Hoa Lo Prison, built and used by French rulers in Vietnam for political prisoners, and later by the government of North Vietnam for war prisoners. This building is also known as “Hanoi Hilton” and “hosted” some American prisoners, including Senator John McCain and Pete Peterson, the United States’ first post-war ambassador to Vietnam in 1997.

  • 10:00 AM: Continue to the B-52 Victory Museum, which displays relics of the B-52 Stratofortress, an aircraft that played a major role in the American War. On the way back, you will also see a small lake that contains the wreckage of a B-52 bomber shot down over Hanoi in 1972 (now called B-52 Lake).

  • 11:00 AM: Visit the Back Market, a bustling market that became notorious during the Vietnam War. The Hanoi bazaar is a chaotic maze of zigzagging alleyways, filled with local vendors selling everything from food to wartime relics. This is a place where history comes alive, and you will be fascinated by the stories it holds.

  • 11:30 AM: Have lunch at a local restaurant

  • 12:30 PM: Return to your hotel

Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

16:00: Our tour guide will pick you up and transfer you to our bicycle store, where you will choose a suitable bike. After a short briefing about the itinerary, we will start riding along the Red River bank, passing the Opera House and the Ceramic Road.

We then visit Long Bien Bridge and a quiet island where farmers grow vegetables and fruits, followed by a visit to a local market. After that, you will enjoy an amazing ride to West Lake, where we can admire the panoramic view of the sunset. This is a great place for beautiful photos.

From there, we continue riding to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the 1,000 year old Citadel and B52 Lake, where a military aircraft was shot down and has remained in the lake since the war. We also cycle past some of Hanoi’s most famous landmarks such as Train Street, the French Quarter, and the Old Quarter.

After the ride, we return to the Old Quarter to enjoy dinner at a famous local street food restaurant, where you will taste traditional Vietnamese dishes. Then you will try the iconic egg coffee before being transferred back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Mountain bikes

  • Experienced English-speaking cycling tour guide

  • Street food dinner

  • All entrance fees and bottled water

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Rain poncho (if needed)

tours.title: Hanoi Coffee Tour
tours.summary: Dive into the coffee culture of Hanoi with our Hanoi Coffee Tour and learn traditional coffee-making techniques while creating three local favorites: creamy egg coffee, unique salt coffee, and refreshing coconut coffee.
tours.contentHtml:
Dive into the coffee culture of Hanoi with our Hanoi Coffee Tour and learn traditional coffee-making techniques while creating three local favorites: creamy egg coffee, unique salt coffee, and refreshing coconut coffee.

What You Will Do In The Workshop

  • Discover the rich history of Vietnamese coffee and its cultivation across the country.

  • Gain hands-on experience brewing coffee using a phin, the traditional Vietnamese coffee filter.

  • Taste the distinctive flavors of pure Vietnamese coffee, learn how to identify differences among the beans, and recognize high-quality coffee.

  • Master the art of making three iconic Vietnamese coffee drinks: egg coffee, salt coffee, and coconut coffee, while learning the stories behind each recipe.

  • Enjoy the coffee drinks you’ve crafted during the workshop.

  • Receive a Vietnamese coffee filter (phin) and detailed recipes to recreate the delicious drinks at home.

Inclusions

  • All ingredients and tools necessary for the workshop.

  • Bread with condensed milk to accompany the coffee.

  • Coffee recipes (provided as a PDF file).

  • A Vietnamese coffee filter (phin).

  • An English-speaking local guide.

Exclusions

  • Additional food or drinks at the host location.

  • Pick-up and drop-off service.

tours.title: Discover Vietnam’s Culinary Culture Experience
tours.summary: Cooking is a key part of culture, and through this experience, participants will gain valuable insights into the history, rituals, and values connected to various cuisines. It’s a delicious way to explore cultural legaci
tours.contentHtml:
Cooking is a key part of culture, and through this experience, participants will gain valuable insights into the history, rituals, and values connected to various cuisines. It’s a delicious way to explore cultural legacies.

The experience provides a communal setting where people can bond over food. Participants will connect with fellow learners, chefs, and instructors, creating a sense of community and shared experience.

Exploring diverse cuisines broadens horizons and fosters an appreciation for global flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques. This encourages tolerance and understanding of different cultures.

Itinerary

  • 9:00 AM: Pickup at your hotel

  • 9:30 – 10:00 AM: Walkthrough the local “wet” market to purchase ingredients and experience a fascinating glimpse into Vietnamese culture with the guidance of our Cultural Storytellers.

  • Learn useful Vietnamese phrases for daily communication.

  • 10:15 AM: Arrive at the kitchen

    • Enjoy the Kitchen’s signature welcome drink made from 100% natural herbs.

    • Discover the Vietnamese words and cultural beliefs behind each ingredient.

    • Learn how to prepare authentic Vietnamese traditional dishes under the guidance of our Cultural Storytellers.

    • Decorate your dishes creatively.

    • Celebrate your cooking achievements with a toast of local wine.

  • 12:15 PM: Enjoy your delicious creations in a beautiful garden villa.

  • 1:15 PM: Return to your hotel.

Our Menu

  • NỘM HOA CHUỐI | BANANA FLOWER SALAD: A special appetizer made with fresh banana flowers, vegetables, and herbs.

  • BÚN CHẢ | OBAMA NOODLES – BBQ (PORK) WITH DIPPING SAUCE: A sweet and sour dipping sauce served with flavorful marinated BBQ pork, enjoyed by Chef Anthony Bourdain and former US President Barack Obama.

  • NEM | VIETNAMESE FRIED SPRING-ROLLS: Crispy spring rolls paired with Bun Cha for the perfect flavor combination. Imagine dipping the spring rolls into sweet and sour sauce for an unforgettable taste experience

tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of the Tour

The adventure begins as we cycle through the French Quarter, admiring the beautiful French architecture.

  • We then continue cycling through the Old Quarter, passing narrow roads and alleys, to reach the Railway Train Track. Here, you will cycle along the tracks, observing the houses built next to the railway, offering a glimpse into the daily lives of locals living close to the train line.

  • On this short tour of Hanoi, we will visit key landmarks such as Le Nin Park and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. You will stop outside the mausoleum to take pictures and learn about the history of Vietnam’s beloved leader.

  • We will cycle along Thanh Nien Road, passing West Lake and Truc Bach Lake, two of Hanoi’s most beautiful lakes. You will also visit the John McCain Monument before heading to Tran Quoc Pagoda, one of the oldest pagodas in Hanoi.

  • Next, we will cycle through a small alley to visit a local market, where you will see fresh food sold by vendors and get an insight into the daily life of the locals. You will also have the chance to sample some tropical fruits.

  • Continuing along the Red River Island, we will explore the countryside, cycling past banana farms and corn farms along the riverside. We will then visit the Floating Village and meet a local family to learn about their life on the island.

  • We will cycle along the riverbank to visit the Long Bien Bridge, a historic structure built by the French during the colonial era (1898-1902). tours.title: Hanoi Bicycle Tours Explore The Red River Delta

tours.contentHtml:

  • Our guide will lead you as we leave the busy city and head onto the back roads, dirt trails, and rural countryside paths. The first stop will be Long Bien Bridge, where you will enjoy stunning panoramic views of Hanoi city and the Red River.   • Our next stop will be a local market, where you can experience the vibrant atmosphere, followed by a visit to a fruit farm where you’ll have the chance to pick and enjoy tropical fruits.

tours.title: HA GIANG EASY RIDER – 4 DAYS
tours.summary: This 4 day Ha Giang Easy Rider adventure is designed for travelers who want to fully explore the most spectacular landscapes of Northern Vietnam. From the clay-house villages of Nam Dam to the iconic Lũng Cú Flagpole, th
tours.contentHtml:
This 4 day Ha Giang Easy Rider adventure is designed for travelers who want to fully explore the most spectacular landscapes of Northern Vietnam. From the clay-house villages of Nam Dam to the iconic Lũng Cú Flagpole, the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass, the hidden waterfall of Du Già, and countless remote villages this journey offers unmatched scenery, culture, history, and unforgettable local experiences.

Ride safely with professional Easy Riders and enjoy authentic stays, ethnic cuisine, and breathtaking views throughout your trip.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus)

Pick-up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transfer to Ha Giang by luxury private-cabin sleeper bus.

Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Nam Dam Village – Lung Tam Handicraft Village – Yen Minh

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30
Tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang. Safety briefing with your tour guide and Easy Riders.

After leaving the city, the landscape changes dramatically as you move deeper into the mountains. Highlights include:

  • Bac Sum Pass – panoramic viewpoint, tea break

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate – stunning mountain panorama

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Continue to:

  • Nam Dam Village – an authentic Dao ethnic village

    • Learn about clay-house architecture

    • Explore the village for ~2.5 hours

    • Enjoy local specialties in Quan Ba

After lunch, continue riding through small hidden valleys and back roads only locals know, offering untouched landscapes seldom visited by self-riders.

Visit:

  • Lung Tam Village – famous for hemp weaving and ethnic handicrafts

    • Visit a local family to see the traditional weaving process

Continue to Yen Minh Town for dinner and overnight stay.

Day 2: Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Lung Cu Flagpole – Lo Lo Chai Village – Dong Van Town

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, ride to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – iconic 9-section winding road

  • Sủng Là Valley – ancient houses and preserved H’Mong culture

Visit:

  • Lung Cu Flagpole – the northernmost point of Vietnam

    • Spectacular views over China–Vietnam border

    • Explore Lo Lo Chai Village, home of the Lô Lô ethnic minority

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Continue to:

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vương Family Residence) – historical royal home

  • Arrive in Đồng Văn Town for homestay, dinner, and free night exploration

Day 3: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Lung Ho – Mau Due – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, begin the most iconic section of the Ha Giang Loop:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass – “King of Vietnam’s mountain passes”, 2,000m altitude

  • Sky Path Ride – overlook the Nho Que River valley and limestone cliffs

Take unforgettable photos from multiple viewpoints along the pass.

Continue riding through remote ethnic villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac Town (lunch stop)

In the afternoon, ride deeper into the mountains toward Du Gia Village, known for:

  • Amazing tiered rice fields

  • 7 ethnic groups living peacefully together

  • Rich culture and warm hospitality

Dinner and overnight with a Tay minority family. Enjoy “happy water” in the evening.

Day 4: Du Gia – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast:

  • Visit Du Gia Waterfall, a pristine hidden gem

  • Say farewell to the host family

  • Continue riding through dramatic landscapes

Highlights of the final day:

  • Duong Thuong Valley – wide open mountain panorama

  • Thai An Road – rugged mountain trail

  • Bac Me – scenic valley region

Arrive back in Ha Giang City in the afternoon.

16:00 – Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.

Trip ends upon arrival.

348 USD – Private Tour

    • Luxury private cabin sleeper bus (7:30–8:00 pm pickup)

    • Limousine bus (3:00–3:30 pm pickup)

  • Free night in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestays

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • All entrance fees

  • Motorbike, fuel

  • Protective gear: helmet, pads, raincoat

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

  • Border entry permit

  • Tips for guides and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, etc.)

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30

Tour starts at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and Easy Riders will brief you on safety before the ride.

As soon as you enter the mountain region, the scenery transforms dramatically. You will stop at:

  • Bac Sum Pass – famous winding pass overlooking valleys

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Continue through the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, a UNESCO-recognized landscape filled with limestone mountains, rice terraces, and remote ethnic villages. See locals farming, working the hillsides, and living their traditional lifestyle.

Lunch in Yen Minh Town.

In the afternoon, visit:

  • Tham Ma Slope – iconic winding slope

  • Vuong Family Residence (H’Mong King Palace) – former home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, enjoy dinner, and explore the town at night.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Lung Ho – Mau Due – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, head toward the most iconic section of the Ha Giang Loop.

Experience:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass – the “King of Passes” in Vietnam, with craggy cliffs and dramatic mountain walls

  • Sky Path Downhill Ride – offering panoramic views over the spectacular valley and emerald Nho Que River

This is considered the most breathtaking view in all of Ha Giang.

Continue riding through remote ethnic villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac Town (lunch stop)

In the afternoon, follow a scenic mountain trail toward Du Gia Village, home to 7 ethnic minority groups living harmoniously. This village is known for its peaceful ambiance, green rice fields, and preserved traditional culture.

Check in at a Tay ethnic homestay and enjoy dinner with “happy water”.

Day 3: Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast, walk to the Du Gia Waterfall, a hidden gem tucked into lush forest.

Continue riding through:

  • Duong Thuong Valley – dramatic mountain landscapes

  • Thai An Road – known for its rugged terrain and beautiful views

  • Bac Me area

Arrive in Ha Giang City in the afternoon.

Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.

tours.title: SAIGON MIDNIGHT SIGHTSEEING ADVENTURE
tours.summary: Saigon Midnight Sightseeing Adventure, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a late night city experience designed for international travelers who want to explore Ho Chi Minh City in a calm, atmospheric, and lively setting aft
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon Midnight Sightseeing Adventure, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a late night city experience designed for international travelers who want to explore Ho Chi Minh City in a calm, atmospheric, and lively setting after dark. When the city cools down and traffic becomes lighter, Saigon reveals a different charm filled with lights, local nightlife, and peaceful streets.

This tour combines iconic landmarks, historical sites, local neighborhoods, night markets, and street food, allowing travelers to see how the city transitions from day to night. It is an ideal choice for visitors who enjoy sightseeing, cultural stories, and local flavors while experiencing the unique energy of Saigon at midnight.

TOUR SCHEDULE

10:00 PM – 02:00 AM

Price: 44 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Ba Son Bridge

Admire Ba Son Bridge, a modern landmark spanning the Saigon River. At night, the bridge offers beautiful views of the city skyline and reflects the rapid urban development of Ho Chi Minh City.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Stop to enjoy one of the most famous Vietnamese street foods, banh mi. This crispy French style baguette is filled with a variety of meats, fresh vegetables, herbs, and sauces, creating a well balanced and flavorful local favorite.

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Visit the Thich Quang Duc Monument and learn about its historical and cultural significance. Your guide will explain the background of an important event in 1963 related to the Buddhist movement in Vietnam and why this monument remains meaningful today.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment and Sugarcane Juice

Explore Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, one of the oldest apartment complexes in Saigon, built in 1968. Experience the authentic atmosphere of local residential life and enjoy a refreshing glass of freshly pressed sugarcane juice.

Biggest Flower Market in District Ten

Visit the largest flower market in District Ten during its lively night hours. Learn about local customs of buying and using flowers and have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Vietnamese Coffee, Smoothie, or Fresh Fruit Juice

Relax at a local shop and choose between Vietnamese coffee, a smoothie, or a freshly prepared fruit juice. This stop offers a chance to enjoy popular local beverages while taking a short break.

Little French Town in the City Center

Walk through an area often referred to as the Little French Town in District One. Discover elegant colonial era architecture, charming streets, and buildings that reflect the lasting French influence on Saigon’s urban design.

Party Street, the Never Sleep Area

End the tour at the famous Party Street, known for its vibrant nightlife. Observe the lively atmosphere filled with bars, restaurants, and music, and experience how Saigon stays active and energetic late into the night.

tours.title: AMBASSADOR DAY CRUISE – HALONG BAY
tours.summary: Experience the Ambassador Day Cruise, one of the most luxurious day cruises in Halong Bay. The vessel offers spacious twin sundecks with 360 degree views over the bay, elegant lounges, two fine dining restaurants, two ba
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the Ambassador Day Cruise, one of the most luxurious day cruises in Halong Bay. The vessel offers spacious twin sundecks with 360 degree views over the bay, elegant lounges, two fine dining restaurants, two bars, and an open air Jacuzzi. Sightseeing, premium cuisine, and entertainment come together for a memorable journey through this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

ITINERARY

08:00 – Check-in and Transfer to Ambassador Day Cruise

Guests check in at the Ambassador’s Lounge located on the first floor of Halong International Cruise Port. After check-in, guests are transferred to the Ambassador Day Cruise vessel.

09:00 – Light Breakfast Onboard

Enjoy a light breakfast while the cruise departs the port and sails into the majestic landscape of Halong Bay and Bai Tu Long Bay.

10:30 – Visit Sung Sot Cave

Explore Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most remarkable cave in Halong Bay, with its dramatic stalactites and rock formations.

11:30 – Visit Titov Island

Arrive at Titov Island. Guests may swim in the clear turquoise water or climb to the top of the island for panoramic views of the bay.

12:00 – Premium Lunch at the Restaurant

Savor a premium lunch at the cruise restaurant while the vessel continues cruising through scenic parts of Halong Bay.

13:30 – Visit Luon Cave

Enjoy optional kayaking or a bamboo boat ride around Luon Cave to admire the cave’s interior and surrounding emerald waters. (*Kayaking and rowing boat services have additional charges.)

14:20 – Afternoon Tea

Relax with afternoon tea in the restaurant areas on the third and fourth floors while soaking in the views.

15:00 – Live Music Entertainment

Enjoy live music on the sundeck as part of afternoon entertainment (weather permitting).

16:00 – Disembarkation

Return to Halong International Cruise Port and disembark. The day cruise concludes.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

  • Full day cruise itinerary and program as described above.

  • One light breakfast onboard.

  • One premium lunch at the cruise restaurant.

  • Afternoon tea.

  • Onboard insurance, tax, and service charges.

  • Entrance and sightseeing fees for all scheduled visits.

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED

  • Airfare and airport transfers.

  • Visa arrangements and onboard cabins.

  • Transportation to and from Halong Bay.

  • Beverages (except those included in the meal set, if stated by operator).

  • Kayaking and bamboo boat rowing at Luon Cave (*charges apply separately).

  • Massage, spa treatments, and personal expenses.

  • Tips and gratuities.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The itinerary may be subject to change depending on weather and cruising conditions.

  • Internet access onboard may be limited due to geographical conditions of the bay.

HIGHLIGHTS OF AMBASSADOR DAY CRUISE

  • Stunning views of limestone karsts and emerald waters.

  • Elegant dining with premium cuisine.

  • Spacious sundecks and panoramic vistas.

tours.summary: This full day private tour combines the most outstanding attractions of both the South and North of Phu Quoc Island. On the way to the South, guests will visit a Pearl Farm to learn about the cultured pearl production pr
tours.contentHtml:
This full day private tour combines the most outstanding attractions of both the South and North of Phu Quoc Island.

On the way to the South, guests will visit a Pearl Farm to learn about the cultured pearl production process. The tour continues to a local Pepper Farm, where visitors can discover different types of peppercorns used in Vietnamese cuisine, followed by a visit to the Sim Wine Factory to learn how local fruit wine is produced.

The journey continues with a scenic drive up to Ho Quoc Pagoda, offering peaceful surroundings and panoramic views. Guests will then relax and swim at Bai Sao Beach.

In the afternoon, the tour includes a visit to the Coconut Tree Prison, a historical site related to wartime history, and a traditional Fish Sauce Factory to see how the famous “Nuoc Mam” fish sauce is made.

Guests may enjoy light trekking at Tranh Stream Waterfall (seasonal) or choose to visit Sunset Town, featuring the Clock Tower and Kiss Bridge (optional, entrance fee at own expense).

In the North of the island, the tour continues with a stop at a Bee Farm to taste local honey, followed by light walking inside Phu Quoc National Park. Guests will then relax and swim at Starfish Beach in Rach Vem Village, admire the view of Cambodia from Ganh Dau Cape, and unwind at Bai Dai Beach. The tour also includes a visit to the Grand World entertainment complex.

DETAILED ITINERARY

(Lunch included if the tour with lunch option is booked.)

(Not available during the rainy season from May to October.)

tours.title: SAIGON DISCOVER AND SHOP AT TRADITIONAL LOCAL MARKETS TOUR
tours.summary: Saigon Discover and Shop at Traditional Local Markets Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed for international travelers who want to explore the authentic commercial life of Ho Chi Minh City. This tour focuses on
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon Discover and Shop at Traditional Local Markets Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed for international travelers who want to explore the authentic commercial life of Ho Chi Minh City. This tour focuses on traditional markets that serve local communities and reflect the everyday lifestyle, culture, and trading habits of Saigonese people.

From fresh food markets and floating markets to specialized wholesale areas for flowers, fabrics, motorbike accessories, and traditional medicine, this tour offers a comprehensive look at how goods are bought, sold, and used in daily life. Along the way, travelers will enjoy local food and coffee while gaining insight into the cultural significance of each market.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

Partner Price: 39 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Traditional Local Wet Market

Begin the tour at a traditional local wet market, where fresh vegetables, fruits, meats, seafood, and daily necessities are sold. Experience the lively atmosphere and observe how local people shop for their everyday meals.

Little Floating Market in Saigon

Visit a small floating market where people live and work on boats. Many families earn their living by selling tropical fruits directly from the river, offering a unique glimpse into a traditional way of life that still exists in the city.

Biggest Flower Market in Saigon

Explore the largest flower market in Ho Chi Minh City and learn about local customs related to buying and using flowers. You will also have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam and holds deep cultural meaning.

Motorbike Accessories Market

Discover a busy market specializing in motorbike accessories. This area offers a wide range of helmets, spare parts, decorative items, and custom modifications, reflecting the importance of motorbikes in daily Vietnamese life.

Fabric Market and Ingredients Market

Visit the fabric market, where you can find a wide variety of textiles, from traditional fabrics to colorful modern designs. Continue to markets that sell ingredients and materials used in food production and small scale manufacturing, providing insight into local trade activities.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Stop to enjoy one of the best banh mi sandwiches. This famous Vietnamese dish features a crispy French style baguette filled with a flavorful combination of meats, vegetables, herbs, and sauces.

Binh Tay Wholesale Market

Explore Binh Tay Market, one of the largest wholesale markets in the city. This historic market plays an important role in supplying goods to smaller shops and traders throughout Ho Chi Minh City.

Chinese Medicine Market

Pass by the Chinese Medicine Market, where traditional herbal remedies and medicinal ingredients are sold. Learn about the long standing influence of traditional medicine in local culture.

Original Local Coffee Shop

End the tour at a traditional local coffee shop and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee. Learn about the traditional preparation method and savor the strong, rich flavor that makes Vietnamese coffee famous.

From the boat, enjoy a spectacular panoramic sunset view over the sea and coastline. As the sun sets, the boat moves to a suitable fishing area where guests will learn how to use traditional local fishing equipment and experience night-time squid fishing.

Any squid caught can be freshly prepared and cooked by our friendly crew. Enjoy a light dinner onboard while the boat slowly cruises back to the harbor, surrounded by the calm and peaceful night sea.

After the tour, guests may choose to return to their hotel or explore the lively nightlife of Duong Dong Ward on their own.

Light dinner onboard.

tours.contentHtml:

HIGHLIGHTS

Explore the pristine beauty of southern Phu Quoc through a full-day island-hopping and cable car adventure.

Begin your journey at Xuong Island, also known as Buom Island, an unspoiled island ideal for swimming and snorkeling in clear waters surrounded by colorful coral reefs. Continue to Gam Ghi Island, one of the largest coral reef areas in Phu Quoc, perfect for snorkeling among vibrant marine life.

Lunch is served on May Rut Trong Island. After enjoying a delicious meal, relax on the golden sandy beach, swim in turquoise waters, or unwind at the beach bar. Guests may also enjoy water sports, take a leisurely walk along the shore, or rest under the shade of coconut trees.

In the afternoon, board a speed boat to Thom Island to experience Aquatopia Water Park, featuring more than twenty themed water games across six creative zones. Conclude the tour with an unforgettable ride on the world’s longest three-wire cable car, offering spectacular panoramic views of islands, fishing villages, boats, turquoise sea, and Sunset Town from high above.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Arrive at An Thoi Harbor.

Xuong Island or Buom Island

Gam Ghi Island

Continue snorkeling in a natural and less crowded environment. Gam Ghi Island is known for having one of the largest coral reef systems in Phu Quoc with many different coral species.

May Rut Trong Island

Lunch, relaxation, and photo opportunities.

Swim in clear turquoise water, enjoy the cool ocean breeze, relax on a sunbed, and order drinks at the beach bar. The island offers many scenic spots for photography.

Lunch will be served at a beachfront restaurant.

Using an air-breathing helmet, guests can walk on the sea floor and observe schools of fish and colorful coral reefs. This activity is suitable even for non-swimmers.

Thom Island

Aquatopia Water Park experience.

Enjoy more than twenty themed water games and explore six uniquely designed zones, each offering vibrant scenery and exciting activities.

Cable Car to Thom Island

Ride the longest three-wire cable car in the world.

The cable car journey lasts approximately twenty-five minutes and offers breathtaking aerial views of the turquoise sea, surrounding islands, fishing villages, boats, and Sunset Town.

tours.title: PHONG NHA VILLAGES BIKING TOUR
tours.summary: The Phong Nha Villages Biking Tour is a unique adventure for travelers who want to explore the countryside, local culture, and scenic landscapes of Phong Nha by bicycle. Cycle along rivers, rice paddies, and unpaved vill
tours.contentHtml:
The Phong Nha Villages Biking Tour is a unique adventure for travelers who want to explore the countryside, local culture, and scenic landscapes of Phong Nha by bicycle.

Cycle along rivers, rice paddies, and unpaved village paths while participating in traditional farming activities, learning how Vietnamese rice wine is made, and enjoying local culinary experiences.

This Phong Nha Biking Tour combines outdoor adventure, cultural immersion, and delicious local food for a memorable day in the beautiful Phong Nha countryside.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30 – Pick up at your hotel in Phong Nha and transfer to the starting point for a briefing and road safety instructions.

08:45 – Start cycling along Son River to Bong Lai Village. Join local farming activities in rice paddies or peanut fields, or learn how Vietnamese-style popcorn is made.

Next, visit Gia Hung Village and explore a local rice wine shop. Learn how rice wine is made and taste some (non-alcoholic at this time).

Take a local ferry across the Son River and continue cycling on unpaved paths.

Descend into Bong Lai Valley, enjoy the view of Bong Lai River, and stop at the recently popular hilltop Pub for a cold beer or soft drink.

Lunch at Wild Boar Farm with pork cooked in bamboo. Tour the farm guided by the local couple who owns it.

After lunch, cycle back to Phong Nha town via off-the-beaten-track paths, crossing beautiful rice fields (Jan–Aug).

Tour ends around 16:30, returning to Phong Nha town.

TOUR PRICE

58 US dollars per person (minimum 2 travelers).

INCLUSIONS

  • English speaking cycling guide (escorted guide for groups of 9 or more)

  • Mountain bike with helmet (Trek/Giant or similar), mechanic support

  • Entrance fees and first-aid service

  • Boat on Son River

  • Daily seasonal fruits and snacks

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Cold drinks (Revive, coke) and water (unlimited)

EXCLUSIONS

  • Drinks with meals

  • Tourist insurance

  • Personal expenses and tips

  • Services not mentioned above

CHILD POLICY

tours.summary: The Phong Nha Cave Expedition by Kayak is an exciting adventure for travelers who love nature, exploration, and unique experiences. Paddle through the dark passages of Phong Nha Cave, hike to hidden underground lakes, an
tours.contentHtml:
The Phong Nha Cave Expedition by Kayak is an exciting adventure for travelers who love nature, exploration, and unique experiences.

Paddle through the dark passages of Phong Nha Cave, hike to hidden underground lakes, and discover ancient Cham writings in dry chambers.

This Phong Nha Tour offers a combination of kayaking, hiking, swimming, and cultural exploration, guided by experienced English-speaking guides for a safe and unforgettable adventure.

TOUR ITINERARY

09:00 – Pick up from your hotels in Phong Nha town.

09:30 – Tour guide introduces the program and prepares caving equipment.

10:30 – Practice kayaking at the cave entrance. Then start kayaking through the cave in darkness (first 3 kilometers).

12:00 – Finish kayaking and reach the hiking spot (1.5 km).

13:00 – Arrive at the secret underground lake and enjoy swimming in the dark water pool.

13:30 – Picnic lunch at the lunch spot.

14:00 – Hike and kayak back to the Phong Nha Cave entrance.

15:00 – Explore other dry chambers and see ancient Cham writings, remnants of the early human kingdom in Vietnam that followed Hinduism.

16:00 – Return to hotels, conclude the Phong Nha Cave Kayak Tour.

TOUR PRICE

70 US dollars per person (minimum 2 travelers).

INCLUSIONS

  • Transportation in Phong Nha town center

  • English speaking guide

  • Picnic lunch

  • Phong Nha Cave entrance fee

  • Boat and kayak equipment

  • Phong Nha caving gear

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips for guide/driver

CHILD POLICY

Children under 15 must travel under parents’ guidance.

tours.title: HUE – DMZ 1 DAY PRIVATE TOUR
tours.summary: Hue DMZ Tour is a private, full-day journey exploring the historic Demilitarized Zone in Quang Tri province. This tour offers a unique opportunity to visit iconic war sites, learn about Vietnam’s history during the Ameri
tours.contentHtml:
Hue DMZ Tour is a private, full-day journey exploring the historic Demilitarized Zone in Quang Tri province.

This tour offers a unique opportunity to visit iconic war sites, learn about Vietnam’s history during the American War, and experience the landscapes and relics of the DMZ with a knowledgeable local guide. Highlights include La Vang Holy Land, Rockpile Hill, Khe Sanh Combat Base, Vinh Moc Tunnels, and the historic Hien Luong Bridge and Ben Hai River.

Hue DMZ Tour combines history, culture, and local cuisine for an unforgettable private experience from Hue.

TOUR ITINERARY

07:30 – Pick up from your hotel in Hue by private car and experienced driver. Transfer to the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) in Quang Tri province.

09:00 – Stop at La Vang Holy Land, an important Catholic pilgrimage site in Hai Lang district. Learn about the apparition of Mary in 1978 and visit the grand church near the three banyan trees.

Meet your professional tour guide, possibly Ms. Thach, a renowned DMZ guide who hosted Anthony Bourdain on his Vietnam journey.

Travel along Highway 9 and admire Rockpile Hill, a former US military base. Stop for photos.

Visit Dakrong Bridge, the start of Highway 15 and a key branch of the Ho Chi Minh Trail leading to the A Shau Valley and “Hamburger Hill.”

Explore Khe Sanh Combat Base, the massive Marine base attacked by the North Vietnamese Army in 1968.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Dong Ha town (included in Option B).

14:00 – Visit Hien Luong Bridge and Ben Hai River, the historic demarcation line between North and South Vietnam during the Geneva Agreement.

15:00 – Explore Vinh Moc Tunnels, an underground village built to avoid bombardment from 1965 to 1966, including wells, kitchens, family rooms, meeting areas, and healthcare clinics.

16:30 – Begin return trip to Hue city. Arrive at your hotel around 20:00.

tours.title: NHA TRANG – DA LAT – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – HO CHI MINH
tours.summary: This 7 day private journey offers a well balanced exploration of Southern and Central Vietnam, combining coastal relaxation, highland scenery, desert landscapes, and river life in the Mekong Delta. Travelers will experie
tours.contentHtml:
This 7 day private journey offers a well balanced exploration of Southern and Central Vietnam, combining coastal relaxation, highland scenery, desert landscapes, and river life in the Mekong Delta. Travelers will experience the vibrant seaside city of Nha Trang, the cool climate and flower filled hills of Da Lat, the golden sand dunes of Mui Ne, and the cultural richness of the Mekong Delta before concluding in Ho Chi Minh City.

Price: USD 520 / pax (based on 2 persons)

DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR

Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private car to Nha Trang city.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, offering an introduction to the fresh and flavorful coastal cuisine of Nha Trang.

In the afternoon, begin a gentle city exploration:

  • Local Coffee Experience: Relax at a local café and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee, a key part of daily life in Vietnam.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral (Stone Church): A French Gothic-style church located on a small hill, reflecting the city’s colonial heritage.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham temple complex built before 781 A.D., representing the spiritual and architectural legacy of the Cham civilization.

  • Dam Market: The largest local market in Nha Trang, ideal for purchasing local specialties and souvenirs.

At 18:30, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Nha Trang.

DAY 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart at 08:30 for Da Lat, traveling through scenic mountain roads and highland landscapes.

En route and upon arrival, visit:

  • Cau Dat Tea Plantation: A vast tea farm surrounded by rolling hills, famous for its fresh air and green scenery.

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: One of Da Lat’s most impressive Buddhist temples, entirely decorated with intricate mosaic artwork.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: Built in 1932 by French architects Moncet and Reveron, this is the oldest railway station in Vietnam.

  • Stairway to Heaven (Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường): A popular viewpoint and photo spot overlooking Da Lat’s countryside.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Visit Xuan Huong Lake, Da Lat Square, enjoy coffee at Doha Coffee, and free time at Big C Supermarket.

  • Check in at your hotel in Da Lat.

Dinner at 18:00.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

Breakfast at the hotel.

At 08:30, begin a full day of sightseeing:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A lively natural attraction with multiple small waterfalls, surrounded by pine forest (optional adventure activities available).

  • Tuyen Lam Lake: A peaceful lake set among pine-covered hills, offering beautiful scenery and fresh air.

  • Happy Hills: A scenic lakeside area ideal for photography and relaxation.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Expansive hillside flower fields showcasing Da Lat’s most iconic blooms.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: One of Da Lat’s largest flower-growing villages, famous for roses and vegetables.

  • Hoa Son Dien Trang: A popular eco-tourism site known for its forest setting and unique photo spots.

  • Mê Linh Coffee Farm: Enjoy coffee while overlooking coffee plantations and countryside views.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

Breakfast at the hotel.

Check out at 08:30 and transfer to Mui Ne by private car.

Arrive around 12:00, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, then check in and relax.

At 15:00, join the Mui Ne sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A shallow stream surrounded by colorful sand formations in shades of red, white, orange, and pink.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe daily coastal life, fishing boats, and local fishermen at work.

  • Red Sand Dunes: Gentle slopes offering beautiful sunset views and excellent photo opportunities.

At 18:00, enjoy a BBQ seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Return to hotel.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 5: MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – HO CHI MINH CITY

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, depart at 07:30 for the Mekong Delta.

Arrive in My Tho and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Board a motorboat to Phoenix Island (Con Phung).

  • Take a horse cart ride to a cultural performance area to enjoy Đờn Ca Tài Tử, a traditional Southern Vietnamese folk music recognized by UNESCO, along with seasonal tropical fruits.

  • Cruise on a traditional hand-rowing boat through narrow canals shaded by coconut trees.

  • Visit a bee-keeping farm to taste honey tea.

  • Stop at a coconut candy workshop to learn about local handicrafts.

At 17:00, return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – FREE TIME / OPTIONAL EXPLORATION

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Free day at leisure for shopping, walking around the city, or optional tours.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 7: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport for your departure.

TOUR PRICE: USD 520 / PERSON (2 PAX)

Included:

  • Private air-conditioned transportation

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Meals: 5 lunches & 4 dinners

  • Entrance fees as mentioned

  • 5 nights in 3-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat trips

  • Airport transfers

Not Included:

  • Jeep ride at sand dunes

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

tours.title: HA GIANG – CAO BANG EASY RIDER – 5 DAYS
tours.summary: This 5 day Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking a deeper journey into Northern Vietnam. The route combines the world–famous Ha Giang Loop with the remote, untouched landscapes of Cao Bang,
tours.contentHtml:
This 5 day Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking a deeper journey into Northern Vietnam. The route combines the world–famous Ha Giang Loop with the remote, untouched landscapes of Cao Bang, including Ma Pi Leng Pass, Me Pia Slope, Nguom Ngao Cave, and the legendary Ban Gioc Waterfall – the largest and one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Vietnam.

Ride through dramatic mountains, ethnic minority villages, terraced rice fields, and UNESCO recognized geoparks. Enjoy authentic homestays, local culture, and travel safely with professional Easy Riders.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang.

Pick up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transfer to Ha Giang by luxury private cabin sleeper bus.

Overnight at a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Detailed Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – Tour starts from our homestay in Ha Giang City.
Safety briefing with your Easy Riders before departure.

Highlights of the day:

  • Ride into the mountains with dramatic scenery changes

  • Stop at Bac Sum Pass for panoramic views

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the spectacular landscape

  • See the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, continue to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – an iconic winding mountain road and popular photo spot

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – former royal residence of the H’Mong family

Arrive in Dong Van Town in the late afternoon.
Dinner and overnight in a local homestay.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, prepare for the most spectacular part of the Ha Giang Loop:

  • Ride along Ma Pi Leng Pass – known as the “King of Vietnam’s mountain passes”

  • Follow the Sky Path, overlooking the deep canyon and emerald Nho Que River

  • Stop at multiple viewpoints for unforgettable photos

Continue riding through rural villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac (lunch stop)

From Meo Vac, ride into the mountainous trail area of Cao Bang province and arrive at Bao Lac Town.
Dinner and overnight with a Tay ethnic family at a local homestay.

Day 3: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today’s 130 km ride takes you through some of the most breathtaking landscapes in Northeast Vietnam:

  • Remote mountains and limestone formations

  • Peaceful ethnic minority villages

  • Misty passes and hidden valleys

Main stop:

  • Me Pia Slope – a dramatic zig–zag mountain pass with spectacular viewpoints

In the afternoon, continue to Phia Thap Village, known for its traditional craft culture and beautiful surroundings.
Check in at a local homestay. Dinner and overnight with the host family.

Day 4: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Ban Gioc

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

A full day of natural wonders and scenic landscapes:

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, one of the most impressive caves in Northern Vietnam

  • Make scenic photo stops along forested roads and mountain viewpoints

  • Ride through terraced rice fields and rolling mountain passes

Continue to:

  • Ban Gioc Waterfall – Vietnam’s most magnificent waterfall, located on the Vietnam–China border

    • Take a bamboo raft ride to approach the falls closer

    • Admire the towering cliffs, emerald water, and lush green surroundings

Overnight in the Ban Gioc area at a local homestay.

Day 5: Ban Gioc – God’s Eye Mountain – Cao Bang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast:

  • Depart Ban Gioc and ride to Thung Mountain, home to the iconic God’s Eye Mountain (Nui Thung)

  • Enjoy final scenic stops and viewpoints on the way back to Cao Bang City

Lunch at a local restaurant in Cao Bang.

12:30 – Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.
End of tour upon arrival in Hanoi.

Price per Person

  • 440 USD / person – SIC Tour

Tour Includes

  • Transfer Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Cao Bang ↔ Hanoi

    • Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus

    • Limousine bus

  • Free overnight at homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private rooms in homestays during the tour

  • All meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English–speaking tour guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbike and fuel

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

  • Protective gear: helmet, pads, raincoat

  • Drinking water during the tour (1 bottle per person per day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, soft drinks, etc.)

tours.summary: Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City itinerary is one of our signature programs, carefully designed to showcase Vietnam’s diverse landscapes, from coastal beaches and highland retreats to desert dunes and vibra
tours.contentHtml:

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Vast flower fields thriving in Da Lat’s cool climate.

  • Stairway to Heaven: A popular viewpoint offering scenic photos of the surrounding landscape.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Robin Hill Cable Car: A scenic ride overlooking Da Lat’s highland scenery.

  • Truc Lam Zen Monastery: A tranquil monastery located near Tuyen Lam Lake.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Free evening at leisure.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

After breakfast, check out and travel from the Central Highlands to the coastal town of Mui Ne.

Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and check in at the hotel.
In the afternoon, join a sunset tour:

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe the daily life of local fishermen along the coast.

11:45 – 13:00

tours.summary: This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers will experience the vibrant city life of Ho Chi Minh City, the sand
tours.contentHtml:
This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers will experience the vibrant city life of Ho Chi Minh City, the sand dunes and fishing villages of Mui Ne, the unique waterways and local lifestyle of the Mekong Delta, and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. The tour includes private transportation, English speaking guides, local meals, and comfortable three-star accommodation.

HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – CU CHI TOUR

Price: 338 USD per person

Based on a group of two people

DETAILED ITINERARY

DAY 1: MUI NE SUNSET TOUR

Lunch included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the airport and transfer to Mui Ne.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Check in at the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Fairy Stream, a spectacular natural site with vibrant orange-red stream water and unique sand formations.

Observe the daily life of fishermen at the Mui Ne Fishing Village. Boats return from the sea, women sort the catch, and the atmosphere reflects traditional coastal life.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, which offer excellent photography opportunities with their striking red sand and gentle slopes.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant. Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 2: MUI NE SUNRISE TOUR – HO CHI MINH CITY

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour at White Sand Dunes. Optional activities include quad bike rides, ostrich riding, and sand sliding (at personal expense).

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time for swimming or relaxing at the resort.

Midday

Check out at 12:00 PM and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

Check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City at 05:00 PM. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

DAY 3: MEKONG DELTA TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:15 AM, depart from Ho Chi Minh City for My Tho city by private car.

Board a motorboat at the pier and cruise along the Mekong River. Observe floating houses and local fish farming activities.

Continue to Thoi Son Islet (Unicorn Island) and take a horse cart to a performance site to enjoy traditional Vietnamese music, “Đàn Ca Tài Tử,” recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Seasonal tropical fruits will also be served.

Take a small hand-rowing boat along a creek lined with coconut trees to experience the Mekong Delta lifestyle. Visit a local bee farm and enjoy honey tea.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Visit a coconut candy workshop and sample freshly made candies.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car. Free evening.

DAY 4: CU CHI TUNNELS – HO CHI MINH CITY CITY TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:30 AM, depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, approximately 60 kilometers from Ho Chi Minh City. Explore the extensive tunnel network used during the Vietnam War and learn about the history of the region. Optional shooting experience with rifles is available.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City and enjoy a city tour: visit Ho Chi Minh City Hall, Nguyen Hue Walking Street, and Coffee Apartment for local coffee.

Visit the Pink Church, famous for its unique architecture and striking pink color.

Continue to Saigon Central Post Office, one of Asia’s grandest post offices. Learn about Vietnam’s cultural history and try sending mail the traditional way.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

DAY 5: DEPARTURE

Breakfast included

Depending on your flight schedule, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport. The tour ends.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Private car pickup and drop off

  • English speaking tour guide

  • Four local lunches

  • Entrance tickets to all attractions

  • Four nights accommodation in three-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat ride

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • Jeep service at sand dunes

  • Value added tax

  • Personal expenses

  • Visa fees

tours.title: SAIGON WALKING FOODIE AND HISTORY TOUR
tours.summary: The Saigon Walking Foodie and History Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a cultural walking experience designed for international travelers who want to understand Ho Chi Minh City through its history, daily life, and
tours.contentHtml:
The Saigon Walking Foodie and History Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a cultural walking experience designed for international travelers who want to understand Ho Chi Minh City through its history, daily life, and local cuisine. This tour combines historical landmarks with authentic street food and traditional markets, offering a deeper look into the city beyond the main tourist attractions.

Walking through local neighborhoods, you will learn about important historical events, explore hidden wartime sites, and experience the everyday rhythm of Saigonese life. Along the way, you will enjoy iconic Vietnamese food and drinks that reflect the city’s diverse culinary culture. This tour is ideal for travelers who enjoy learning, walking, and tasting their way through a city.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

06:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Partner Price: 44 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Visit the Thich Quang Duc Monument and learn about the historical background of a significant event in 1963 related to the Buddhist movement in Vietnam. Your guide will explain the social and historical context of this moment and its impact on Vietnamese history.

Secret Weapon Bunker during the Vietnam War

Explore the hidden remains of a secret weapon bunker used during the Vietnam War. This discreet site once played an important role in wartime logistics and offers insight into the underground strategies used during that period.

Grilled Banana Wrapped in Sticky Rice with Coconut Milk

Taste a popular local dessert known as grilled banana wrapped in sticky rice and served with fresh coconut milk. This traditional sweet treat is widely loved by local people and represents classic southern Vietnamese flavors.

Original Vietnamese Coffee

Stop at a local coffee shop to enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee. Learn about the traditional brewing method and savor the rich, bold flavor that has made Vietnamese coffee famous around the world.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Enjoy the famous banh mi, a Vietnamese sandwich known globally for its crispy French style baguette filled with a balanced combination of meats, vegetables, herbs, and sauces.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, Built in 1968

Visit the Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, one of the oldest apartment complexes in Saigon, built in 1968. This location offers a glimpse into local residential life and the architectural style of the post war period.

Biggest Flower Market in District Ten

Walk through the largest flower market in District Ten. Experience the lively atmosphere and learn about the role of flowers in Vietnamese daily life, traditions, and celebrations.

Do It Yourself Lotus Pod Experience

Create your own lotus pod using the lotus flower, which is a national symbol of Vietnam. Learn about its cultural meaning, representing purity, calmness, and resilience.

Fresh Sugarcane Juice

Refresh yourself with a glass of freshly pressed sugarcane juice, a popular local drink enjoyed for its natural sweetness and cooling effect.

tours.contentHtml:
This five day, four night tour ( HCM – Mui Ne – Vung Tau Tour) offers a well balanced journey through southern Vietnam, combining vibrant city life, coastal landscapes, sand dunes, beaches, and cultural landmarks. Lunch included

Morning

Your tour guide will pick you up at the airport and transfer you to the city center of Ho Chi Minh City.

Noon

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant with Vietnamese beef noodle soup, known as pho.

Afternoon

Visit the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee building and walk along Nguyen Hue Walking Street. Stop at the Coffee Apartment to enjoy traditional Vietnamese coffee.

Continue to visit the Pink Church, one of the most famous architectural landmarks in the city, built in the mid nineteenth century in a European architectural style with its distinctive pink exterior.

Visit the Saigon Central Post Office, an outstanding example of European neoclassical architecture combined with Asian decorative elements.

View Notre Dame Cathedral, built in classical French architectural style and recognized for its cultural, historical, and religious significance.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 2: HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE SUNSET TOUR

Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the hotel and depart for Mui Ne. The journey takes approximately four hours.

Noon

Have lunch at a local restaurant. Check in to the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Suoi Tien, a popular photo location known for its colorful sand formations in red, white, orange, and pink.

Visit the fishing village to observe the daily life of local fishermen, including boats returning from the sea and families sorting the catch.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, where the gentle slopes and vibrant red sand create excellent photo opportunities, especially near sunset.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 3: MUI NE SUNRISE TOUR – HO CHI MINH CITY

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour.

Visit the White Sand Dunes to watch the sunrise. Optional activities such as quad bike riding, ostrich riding, and sand sliding are available at personal expense.

At 12:00 PM, check out and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Noon

Have an authentic Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Visit the Jesus Christ Statue by walking up eight hundred and forty seven steps to reach the thirty two meter tall statue.

Adventurous visitors may climb inside the statue’s arms to enjoy panoramic views of Vung Tau City.

Visit Thang Tam Temple, also known as the Whale Temple, which reflects the coastal belief in the whale as a protector deity.

Continue to Bach Dinh, a colonial era mansion built in the early twentieth century as a retreat for the French Governor of Indochina.

Visit Cape Nghinh Phong, a scenic cliff area offering wide views of the city and the East Sea.
