tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY TO MUI NE ONE DAY TOUR
tours.summary: Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne One Day Tour offers travelers a chance to explore some of the most beautiful natural landscapes in southern Vietnam within a single day. This tour is ideal for visitors who enjoy nature, photog
tours.contentHtml:
Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne One Day Tour offers travelers a chance to explore some of the most beautiful natural landscapes in southern Vietnam within a single day. This tour is ideal for visitors who enjoy nature, photography, and light adventure activities.

During the journey, you will discover white and red sand dunes, a peaceful lake in the middle of the desert, a unique stream flowing through colorful sand formations, and the authentic daily life of local fishermen. The tour combines scenic views, cultural experiences, and leisure time, making it a memorable getaway from the city.

ITINERARY

07:00 – 07:30

Pick up at the airport or hotel in Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

11:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Mui Ne and visit Bau Trang.

Bau Trang, A Mystical Lake among White Sand Dunes

Bau Trang is one of the most beautiful natural attractions in Mui Ne. The lake is famous for its clear turquoise water surrounded by vast white sand dunes, creating a peaceful and impressive landscape.

Visitors can enjoy the fresh air, admire panoramic views, and take memorable photographs. Optional activities such as boat rides on the lake are available. The contrast between the blue water and white sand makes Bau Trang an ideal destination for photography lovers.

13:00

Have lunch at a local restaurant.

14:30

Visit Suoi Tien.

Suoi Tien, A Turquoise Stream in the Sand Dunes

Suoi Tien is a unique natural site where a shallow stream flows through red sand dunes. The bright turquoise water contrasts beautifully with the warm red sand, creating a rare and striking landscape.

Walking along the stream allows visitors to enjoy the natural scenery and observe fascinating rock formations shaped by wind and water. The area offers a calm and visually impressive experience.

16:00

Visit Mui Ne Fishing Village

Stop at the fishing village to take photos and observe the daily life of local fishermen. This area provides insight into the traditional coastal lifestyle of Mui Ne.

16:30

Visit the Red Sand Dunes and watch the sunset.

Red Sand Dunes, A Land of Vibrant Colors

The Red Sand Dunes are one of the most famous attractions in Mui Ne. The dunes are known for their warm red and orange tones, which become especially beautiful during sunset.

Visitors can walk on the dunes, enjoy the scenery, and take photos. Optional sand sliding activities are available at personal expense.

17:00

Depart Mui Ne and return to Ho Chi Minh City.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive back at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

Private car pickup and drop off

English speaking tour guide

Local lunch

Entrance tickets to attractions

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

Jeep service at sand dunes

Value added tax

Personal expenses

  • NGHINH PHONG CAPE: Visit one of the top must-see spots in Vung Tau, known for its “front sea, back mountain” scenery. A popular place for photos and sightseeing.

tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour Vietlook Travel is perfect for travelers interested in Vietnam’s history and culture, as well as those who want to explore the Mekong Delta on a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City. The tour visits two main destinations: the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extraordinary historical site, and the Mekong Delta, known for its scenic rivers, islands, and traditional villages.

MORNING – CU CHI TUNNELS

7:15 AM: The bus and English speaking tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point and depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, located 70 kilometers west of Ho Chi Minh City.

The Cu Chi Tunnel system was built by the National Front for the Liberation of South Vietnam during the Indochina War and the Vietnam War. The network includes an infirmary, living quarters, kitchens, storage rooms, working areas, and over 200 kilometers of underground tunnels with bush-covered ventilation systems. During the 1968 Tet Offensive, the tunnels were strategically used for guerrilla attacks on Saigon.

During the visit, you will:

  • Learn how Vietnamese guerrillas built, lived, and fought in these tunnels.

  • Watch documentary footage showcasing the Vietnamese resistance during the war.

  • See primitive homemade weapons, bamboo traps, and other guerrilla tools.

  • Optionally crawl through safe tunnel sections to experience tunnel life.

  • Observe local people making rice paper and rice wine.

  • Optionally try shooting at the on-site AK-47 shooting range (extra fee).

NOON – MEKONG DELTA REGION

11:30 AM: Depart Cu Chi Tunnels and travel toward the Mekong Delta.

  • Arrive at My Tho Cruise Port and board a boat on the Tien River. Cruise along the river, passing the floating fish farms and Rach Mieu Bridge, and enjoy views of four islands: Long, Lan, Qui, and Phung.

  • Stop at Thoi Son Island (Lan Island) to explore village roads, visit local homes and fruit gardens, take souvenir photos, and see the honey bee farm and taste honey tea. Visit the coconut candy factory.

  • Enjoy Don Ca Tai Tu traditional music while sampling fresh fruit.

  • Use small rowing boats to explore narrow canals, admire rows of coconut trees and the peaceful riverine landscape.

  • Lunch at a local Vietnamese restaurant around 2:00 PM.

AFTERNOON – RETURN TO HO CHI MINH CITY

5:00 PM: Return to My Tho by boat and depart for Ho Chi Minh City.

7:00 PM: Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City. Drop off at Pham Ngu Lao Street or Ben Thanh Market. Tour ends with farewell from your guide.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Pick-up and drop-off at selected hotels in Central District One only

  • Air-conditioned bus transportation

  • Motor boat trip on the Mekong River

  • Small rowing boat exploration

  • Mineral water served on the bus

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Vietnamese cuisine lunch

  • All entrance fees

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • AK-47 shooting fee

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips (optional)

Price per person: 34$

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children from 1 meter to under 1.4 meters: 75% of the adult ticket price, with seats provided.

  • Children under 1 meter: free of charge, sit on parents’ lap (two adults may accompany one free child). From the second child onward, 75% of ticket price applies.

  • Children 1.4 meters and above: full adult ticket required.

tours.title: NHA TRANG DISCOVERY CRUISES (Day Cruise)
tours.summary: EMPEROR CRUISES Inspired by the luxurious life of Emperor Bao Dai, Vietnam’s last emperor, Emperor Cruises offers guests a unique and indulgent experience. Enjoy the perfect blend of music, fine arts, architecture, cultu
tours.contentHtml:
EMPEROR CRUISES

Inspired by the luxurious life of Emperor Bao Dai, Vietnam’s last emperor, Emperor Cruises offers guests a unique and indulgent experience. Enjoy the perfect blend of music, fine arts, architecture, culture, local cuisine, history, and outdoor activities, all included to ensure you are treated like royalty.

Our fleet offers two signature itineraries:

  • Nha Trang Discovery Day Cruise

  • Sunset Cocktail & Dinner Cruise

We guarantee daily departures, regardless of passenger numbers. If luxury is your language, we speak the same language.

HOW TO GET THERE

A scenic 40 minute drive from Cam Ranh International Airport brings you to the heart of Nha Trang City. From the city center, it’s approximately 15 minutes to the port where you will board Emperor Cruises.

Based in Nha Trang Bay, the cruise offers breathtaking white-sand beaches and pristine offshore islands, perfect for exploration and leisure.

DETAILED ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:00
Pick-up from your hotel and transfer to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port to board Emperor Cruises. Guests will be transferred from the port to the main boat via a tender or smaller boat.

08:30
Arrive on board and enjoy a welcome drink. Your Experiences Manager will introduce you to Nha Trang Bay, local culture, cuisine, history, the emperor’s legacy, and safety precautions. Begin cruising through the stunning Nha Trang Bay.

08:45 – 09:15
Cruise past Tam and Mot islands while listening to classical music performed by a live guitarist. Enjoy drinks and fresh fruits as you approach the fish farm.

09:15 – 10:00
Explore the fish farm and its surroundings on a traditional basket boat. Admire the scenic landscapes around the floating village.

10:00 – 12:00
Arrive at Sỏi Beach. Guests can swim, kayak, or snorkel (weather permitting). Alternatively, relax under the trees and enjoy the panoramic views of the bay. Optional activities such as diving, jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides are available at an additional cost.

12:00 – 13:30
Return to the boat for a sumptuous lunch on board, including local beers, soft drinks, fine wine, or premium spirits. The boat anchors near Hon Tre Island in its tranquil lagoon. After lunch, relax and enjoy the boat’s facilities.

14:00
Cruise back to Vinh Truong Island Waterway Port, passing Vung Ngan Floating Village and Vinpearl Island. Guests are transferred by tender to the port, where the shuttle bus will take you back to your hotel.

Note: Itinerary and timings may vary by ±30 minutes depending on weather and sea conditions. Final pick-up time will be confirmed one day before the cruise.

PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 48

BENEFITS INCLUDED

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in central Nha Trang

  • Welcome drink on board

  • Experiences Manager on board (English, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese)

  • Snorkeling kit, basket boat, kayaking, fishing

  • Sumptuous lunch on board

  • Free Wi-Fi

  • Unlimited drinks: house wine, cocktails, spirits, local beer, soft drinks, fruit juice, tea, coffee, mineral water

  • Seasonal fruits

  • All sightseeing tickets

  • Bath towels and tissues

EXCLUSIONS (Optional Activities)

  • Diving: VND 750,000/person

  • Sea Walking: VND 1,050,000/person

  • Jet Ski: VND 800,000/person

  • Parasailing: VND 800,000/person

  • Banana Boat: VND 1,500,000/boat (for 5 people)

  • Personal expenses and other fees not mentioned above

WHAT TO BRING

  • Camera or video recorder

  • Swimsuit for sunny days

  • Comfortable shoes (for trekking) and sweater (for cooler days)

  • Hat or cap

  • Suntan lotion

  • Extra t-shirt in case you get wet

tours.contentHtml:

Travel by private car with the Vietlook Travel team, including a professional photographer, lighting assistant, and interpreter. Transportation between locations is fully arranged for your convenience.

All original photos will be delivered within one day. Guests can then select their favorite images for editing. The edited photos will be delivered within five to seven days.

tours.title: DISCOVERY PHONG NHA – TU LAN CAVE TOUR 1 DAY
tours.summary: The Tu Lan Cave Tour 1 Day is a thrilling adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, designed for travelers seeking a mix of trekking, swimming, and cave exploration. Explore Hang Chuot (Rat Cave), the dramatic Hung
tours.contentHtml:
The Tu Lan Cave Tour 1 Day is a thrilling adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, designed for travelers seeking a mix of trekking, swimming, and cave exploration. Explore Hang Chuot (Rat Cave), the dramatic Hung Ton Cave, and the picturesque To Mo Valley, finishing with a delicious BBQ beside a waterfall.

This tour is perfect for those who want a full-day adventure in the Tu Lan cave system. For a longer experience, consider the Tu Lan Cave Encounter (2 Days) or Wild Tu Lan Cave Explorer (3 Days).

This tour is suitable for physically active travelers aged 16 and above.

ITINERARY

Phong Nha – Tan Hoa – To Mo – Tan Hoa – Phong Nha

07:00 – 07:30 – Pick up from your hotel/guesthouse in Phong Nha. Drive 70 km over the Da Deo Mountain Pass to reach Tan Hoa ethnic minority village and Oxalis Headquarters. Store extra luggage at the office.

08:00 – Safety briefing, gear check, and sign the Release Form.

08:30 – Trek 2 km across peanut and buffalo fields to reach the Rao Nan River.

09:00 – Cross the river and explore Hang Chuot (Rat Cave), discovering its massive formations for up to 280 meters.

10:30 – Trek through Hung Ton Valley to Hung Ton Cave. Descend a 15 m ladder with a safety rope, swim 50 m through the cave, and follow an underground river to To Mo Valley.

12:30 – Enjoy a BBQ lunch beside a scenic waterfall and optional swimming.

13:30 – 16:00 – Trek over Hung Ton Mountain (1 km), across Hung Ton Valley (500 m), and a small hill to return to Rao Nan River (500 m). Cross back over peanut and buffalo fields (2.5 km) to Oxalis Headquarters. Refresh with a cold drink and shower.

17:00 – 18:30 – Drive back to Phong Nha and drop off at your hotel/guesthouse.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Operating Period: November – September (closed in October)

  • Duration: 1 day

  • Adventure Level: Easy/Moderate, 8 km (swimming required)

  • Group Size: 2 – 8 pax (small-group tour)

  • Minimum Age: 16 years old

  • Start Time: 07:00 – 07:30 from any hotel in Phong Nha

  • End Time: 18:00 – 18:30 at any hotel in Phong Nha

  • Price: 90 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Private car transfers

  • Trekking equipment

  • BBQ lunch

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips

CHILD POLICY

  • Only travelers aged 16 years and above can join this tour

tours.contentHtml:
Experience the Mekong Delta with Vietlook Travel immerse yourself in rivers, culture, and Southern Vietnamese cuisine on this 3 day journey from My Tho to Ca Mau, guided by experienced professionals.

Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Can Tho – Ca Mau

Duration: 3 days 2 nights

Departure time: 7:10 AM (Day 1)

Return time: 19:00 PM (Day 3)

Transportation: Air-conditioned bus

Price/pax: 135$

DAY 1 – SAIGON – MY THO – BEN TRE – CAN THO

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Pick-up at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market (6:50 – 7:20 AM). Depart for My Tho and Ben Tre.

  • Mekong Restop: Enjoy typical Southern Vietnamese breakfast (Hu Tieu My Tho, Com Tam), restrooms available, and optional snacks.

  • Vinh Trang Pagoda: 19th-century architectural relic combining European and Asian styles.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Boat trip along Tien River, visit four islets (Long, Lan, Qui, Phung), floating fish rafts, and Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Walk through village roads, local houses, fruit gardens; visit honey bee farm, enjoy honey lemon tea.

  • Cultural Experience: Southern folk music (Don Ca Tai Tu Xu Dua), fruit tasting, rowing through canals, visit coconut candy workshop.

Noon: Lunch at a local restaurant. Optional activities: fishing for crocodiles, walking on the monkey bridge, resting in hammocks, cycling along village roads.

Afternoon (2:30 PM): Return to My Tho by boat, then depart for Can Tho (2–3 hours drive). Check-in at city center hotel.

Evening (6:30 PM): Dinner on a luxury yacht at Ninh Kieu Wharf with Western cuisine and Southern folk music.

9:30 PM: Yacht docks. Free time to explore Can Tho city nightlife. Return to hotel.

DAY 2 – CAN THO – CAI RANG FLOATING MARKET – CA MAU

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Breakfast at hotel. Visit:

  • Cai Rang Floating Market: One of the largest floating markets in the Mekong Delta. See local trade and Hu Tieu craft village.

  • Soc Trang: SomRong Temple – largest reclining Buddha temple in Vietnam with Khmer architecture.

  • Bac Lieu: Tac Say Church – Gia Rai Bac Lieu, grave of Father Truong Buu Diep.

Noon: Depart for Ca Mau. Lunch at Anh Nguyet Restaurant.

Afternoon: Explore Ca Mau Cape:

  • Mangrove forest, National Coordinate Landmark – GPS 0001, panoramic view of Ca Mau Cape

  • Visit the museum, Au Co’s mother statue, flagpole, and take souvenir photos

  • Return to hotel to rest

Evening (6:00 PM): Dinner and free time to explore Ca Mau city nightlife.

DAY 3 – CA MAU – BAC LIEU – SAI GON

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

Morning: Breakfast at hotel and check-out. Depart for Bac Lieu:

  • Cong Tu Bac Lieu House: Built in 1919 by a French engineer with imported materials.

  • Nam Hai Buddha: Pray for good luck for yourself and family.

  • Soc Trang: Visit Quang Tran Pia Cake Factory (since 1950).

Noon: Lunch in Hau Giang with Southern specialties (Hotpot, garden chicken, Linh fish, fried cod fish).

Afternoon: Return journey to Ho Chi Minh City. Rest stop at Cai Be station.

Evening (7:00 PM): Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City. End of tour.

tours.title: SAIGON SLUM TOUR
tours.summary: Saigon Slum Tour operated by Vietlook Travel, offers international visitors a deeper and more realistic understanding of Ho Chi Minh City through strong contrasts and meaningful local stories. This tour is not only about
tours.contentHtml:
Saigon Slum Tour operated by Vietlook Travel, offers international visitors a deeper and more realistic understanding of Ho Chi Minh City through strong contrasts and meaningful local stories. This tour is not only about sightseeing, but also about learning how different communities live side by side in a rapidly developing city.

You will explore areas rarely visited by tourists, where daily life takes place behind the modern skyline. From luxury hotels and pedestrian boulevards to old neighborhoods, riverside houses, and floating markets, the tour highlights the social, historical, and cultural layers of Saigon. With the guidance of knowledgeable local guides, travelers gain insight into the resilience, lifestyle, and traditions of local people while enjoying authentic food and coffee experiences.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 AM – 12:00 PM

01:00 PM – 05:00 PM

Partner Price: 35 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Modern Central Saigon and Walking Street

Begin the tour in the modern center of Ho Chi Minh City. Walk through the famous pedestrian street and see five star hotels, luxury restaurants, and artistic buildings that represent the image most tourists associate with Saigon. This area sets a strong contrast with the neighborhoods visited later in the tour.

Slum Area in the Old Mafia District

Visit a slum area located in what was once known as an old mafia district. Your guide will share well known historical stories related to this area. Walk through narrow streets and observe small houses hidden behind large modern buildings, offering a closer look at local daily life.

Little Floating Market in Saigon

Discover a small floating market where people live and work on boats. Many families spend their entire lives on the water, earning a living by selling tropical fruits and other goods.

Riverside Slum Area

Explore a slum area along the river where people live in stilt houses. Your guide will explain the living conditions and daily routines of the residents. This location also offers striking photo opportunities, showing the contrast between small riverside homes and large luxury buildings in the background.

Biggest Flower Market in Saigon (Pass By)

Pass by the largest flower market in the city and learn about local traditions of buying and using flowers. You will also have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Original Local Coffee Shop

Stop at a traditional local coffee shop to enjoy typical Vietnamese coffee and experience its original and rich flavor.

Slum Area in the Oldest Neighborhood

Visit one of the oldest residential areas in Saigon, where small and old houses still remain. You may have the chance to interact with elderly residents who have lived here for many decades and hear stories about the past.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

End the tour by tasting one of the best banh mi sandwiches. This famous Vietnamese sandwich features a crispy French style baguette filled with a variety of meats, vegetables, and flavorful sauces.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Board a boat on the Tien River, admire the four islets of Long, Lan, Qui, and Phung, and learn about local fish farming. See Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Walk along village roads, visit local houses and fruit gardens, take photos, visit the honey bee farm, and enjoy honey lemon tea.

tours.title: ICONIC CHILL SPOTS IN SAIGON TOUR
tours.summary: The Iconic Chill Spots in Saigon Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed especially for international visitors who would like to explore Ho Chi Minh City from a local and cultural perspective. This tour brings you
tours.contentHtml:
The Iconic Chill Spots in Saigon Tour, operated by Vietlook Travel, is designed especially for international visitors who would like to explore Ho Chi Minh City from a local and cultural perspective. This tour brings you beyond the well known attractions and introduces you to hidden corners, historic neighborhoods, and relaxed city spaces where local people live, work, and socialize.

Throughout the journey, you will experience the contrast between modern urban development and traditional daily life. From scenic river views and contemporary architecture to old residential areas, floating markets, and authentic street food, this tour offers a balanced combination of sightseeing, culture, and leisure. It is an ideal choice for travelers who want to understand the story, lifestyle, and spirit of Saigon in a comfortable and enjoyable way.

TOUR SCHEDULE

08:00 PM – 12:00 AM
01:00 PM – 05:00 PM
06:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Partner Price: 42 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Saigon River Tunnels

Visit a newly developed urban area along the Saigon River, where you can enjoy spectacular views of District One. This location is well known for its beautiful cityscape and is an excellent place for photography, especially in the evening.

Thu Thiem Bridge – Little Singapore of Saigon

Experience the modern skyline of Thu Thiem and learn why this area is often referred to as Little Singapore. Your guide will explain the history, planning, and development that have shaped this part of the city.

Nguyen Hue Walking Street

Walk along Nguyen Hue Street and discover its transformation over more than one hundred and fifty years. Your guide will share stories about how it changed from a canal into a boulevard and later became the main pedestrian street in the heart of the city.

Old Gangster Area in District Four

Explore District Four, once known as the old gangster area of Saigon. Learn about its historical background, social changes, and how it has evolved into a vibrant local community.

Vietnamese Baguette, Banh Mi

After exploring District Four, stop at a well known local banh mi shop to enjoy one of the best Vietnamese baguettes in the area.

Little Floating Market and Fresh Coconut

Visit a small floating market where local people trade directly from boats. Enjoy a fresh coconut while observing daily life and business activities on the river.

Flower Market Experience

Visit a traditional flower market and learn about Vietnamese flower culture. You will also have the opportunity to create a beautiful lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Oldest Apartment Building Built in 1968

Enter one of the oldest apartment buildings in Ho Chi Minh City, built in 1968. Experience the authentic atmosphere of local life and gain insight into the daily lifestyle and culture of Saigonese residents.

Original Local Coffee Shop

End the tour at a traditional local coffee shop where you can enjoy Vietnamese coffee and experience its original and distinctive flavors.

tours.title: SAIGON ICONIC SIGHTSEEING TOUR
tours.summary: Explore the heart of Saigon with Vietlook Travel and immerse yourself in the city’s rich history, culture, and local lifestyle. This tour combines architecture, iconic landmarks, and authentic experiences that give you a
tours.contentHtml:
Explore the heart of Saigon with Vietlook Travel and immerse yourself in the city’s rich history, culture, and local lifestyle. This tour combines architecture, iconic landmarks, and authentic experiences that give you a real sense of Saigonese life. Perfect for first-time visitors or anyone wanting to understand the city beyond the usual sights.

PARTNER PRICE: 35 USD / person

Duration: Half-day / 4 hours | Schedule: Morning 08:00 – 12:00 | Afternoon 13:00 – 17:00

Transportation: Walking and Vehicle

Highlights / Itinerary

Jade Emperor Pagoda – “Chua Ngoc Hoang”

Step into one of Saigon’s most vibrant and spiritually significant temples. Built in 1909 and dedicated to the King of Heaven, the pagoda impresses visitors with intricate statues, detailed carvings, and a mystical atmosphere reflecting Vietnamese religious culture.

Pink Church – “Nha Tho Tan Dinh”

Marvel at the stunning Romanian-style architecture and the unique pink exterior of this iconic Catholic church. It’s a favorite photo spot and a symbol of the city’s diverse cultural influences.

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Learn the poignant story of the monk who self-immolated in 1963 to defend Buddhism, an event that shaped modern Vietnamese history. Our guide will explain the significance of this act and its impact on Saigonese society.

Vietnamese Coffee – One of the Oldest Coffee Shops in Saigon

Enjoy a cup of authentic Vietnamese coffee in a historic coffee shop, where you can experience the original taste and learn about the local coffee culture that has been part of Saigon life for decades.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment – Oldest Apartment in Saigon

Step inside one of the oldest residential buildings in the city, built in 1968. Here you can see traditional living spaces, meet local residents, and feel the authentic atmosphere of Saigonese daily life.

Nguyen Hue Walking Street

Take a leisurely walk along this iconic pedestrian street, the heart of modern Saigon. From its transformation over 150 years from a canal to a bustling boulevard you’ll gain insight into how the city has evolved while enjoying the lively street ambiance.

This tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine sightseeing, culture, and local experiences in just a few hours. With Vietlook Travel, you’ll discover Saigon’s hidden gems, take stunning photos, and enjoy authentic moments that go beyond a typical city tour.

tours.title: MEKONG DELTA 1 DAY TRIP
tours.summary: TOUR OVERVIEW This short day trip offers a peaceful escape from the busy city of Ho Chi Minh, allowing you to immerse yourself in the natural beauty and tranquil lifestyle of the Mekong Delta. You will explore local vill
tours.contentHtml:
TOUR OVERVIEW

This short day trip offers a peaceful escape from the busy city of Ho Chi Minh, allowing you to immerse yourself in the natural beauty and tranquil lifestyle of the Mekong Delta. You will explore local villages, rivers, islands, and traditional crafts while enjoying southern Vietnamese folk culture.

MORNING – MEKONG DELTA AND VINH TRANG PAGODA

7:30 – 8:30 AM: Pick-up from hotels near Ben Thanh Market by bus and English-speaking tour guide. Depart for the Mekong Delta (My Tho – Ben Tre).

  • Stop at Mekong Restop for snacks and restroom break.

  • Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, built in the 19th century by Mr. and Mrs. Bui Cong Dat. This pagoda is an important architectural and artistic site in southern Vietnam, blending European and Asian styles.

My Tho River Cruise:

  • Board a boat at My Tho Cruise Port to travel along the Tien River, admiring the four islets of Long, Lan, Qui, and Phung. Learn about local fish farming on floating fish rafts and see Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Explore Thoi Son Island (Lan Island) by walking village roads, visiting local houses and fruit gardens, taking souvenir photos, and visiting the honey bee farm to enjoy honey lemon tea.

  • Enjoy traditional Don Ca Tai Tu southern Vietnamese folk music, sample fresh fruit, and use small rowing boats to explore narrow canals lined with coconut trees. Visit the coconut candy shop to see how candies are made and local handicrafts.

NOON – LUNCH AND RELAXATION

Around 12:30 PM: Lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, enjoy optional activities:

  • Fishing for crocodiles

  • Walking across the monkey bridge

  • Relaxing in hammocks

  • Cycling along village roads

AFTERNOON – RETURN TO HO CHI MINH CITY

2:30 PM: Return to My Tho by boat and depart for Ho Chi Minh City.

5:00 PM: Arrive at Pham Ngu Lao Street or Ben Thanh Market. End of tour, farewell from the guide.

tours.title: HA GIANG JEEP TOUR – 3 DAYS
tours.summary: Ha Giang Jeep Tour is ideal for travelers who want to discover the full beauty of the Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike, you will travel by open–air jeep with an experienced local driver,
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Giang Jeep Tour is ideal for travelers who want to discover the full beauty of the Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike, you will travel by open–air jeep with an experienced local driver, passing dramatic mountain passes, limestone peaks, ethnic minority villages, rice terraces, and the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass and Nho Que River valley.

You will also stay in a peaceful village in Du Gia, experience a local Tay family homestay, and travel back to Hanoi by limousine bus.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Night Transfer)

  • Pick–up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter.

  • Travel to Ha Giang by luxury private–cabin sleeper bus or limousine bus (depending on your booking).

  • Free overnight at a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Detailed Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – The tour starts from our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your English–speaking guide and jeep driver will give you a short safety and route briefing before departure.

As you leave Ha Giang, the scenery quickly transforms into towering mountains and deep valleys. Along the way you will:

  • Stop at Bac Sum Pass to enjoy panoramic views and a drink break

  • Continue to Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the spectacular landscape

  • See the iconic Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, the jeep continues deeper into the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark:

  • Drive over Tham Ma Slope, a famous winding mountain road with great photo spots

  • Visit the historic H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence), former home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town in the late afternoon.
Check in at the homestay, have dinner, and enjoy free time to explore Dong Van Old Quarter in the evening.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, depart Dong Van and follow one of the most stunning mountain roads in all of Vietnam:

  • Drive along the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known for its craggy cliffs and breathtaking views

  • Stop at the Volunteer Youth Monument and several viewpoints along the pass

  • Take the Sky Path road to admire the full panorama of the valley and the emerald Nho Que River far below

  • Enjoy many opportunities for photos of dramatic rock formations and deep gorges

Continue by jeep through remote mountain areas and villages:

  • Pass Lung Ho, Mau Due, and Meo Vac, where you will stop for lunch and rest

From Meo Vac, keep driving through a mountain–trail road to Du Gia Village, a peaceful valley surrounded by rice terraces and home to several ethnic minority groups.

  • Check in at a local Tay minority homestay

  • Enjoy a homemade dinner and “happy water” with the host family

Overnight in Du Gia Village.

Day 3: Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast at the homestay:

  • Visit the hidden Du Gia Waterfall, where you can relax and enjoy the peaceful nature

  • Say goodbye to your host family and continue the jeep journey

On the way back to Ha Giang, you will still enjoy impressive landscapes:

  • Drive through Duong Thuong Valley with its beautiful mountain scenery

  • Follow Thai An Road, a scenic route with great viewpoints

  • Pass through the Bac Me area before returning to Ha Giang City in the afternoon

From Ha Giang, you will board the limousine bus at 16:00 back to Hanoi.
The tour ends upon your arrival in Hanoi.

Contract Rate – Group Size & Price

  • 2 pax: 368 USD / pax

  • 3 – 5 pax: 355 USD / pax

  • 6 – 8 pax: 340 USD / pax

Tour Includes

  • Round–trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang:

    • Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus (pick–up 19:30–20:00 in Hanoi Old Quarter)

    • Limousine bus (pick–up 15:00–15:30 in Hanoi Old Quarter)

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestays during the tour

  • All meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Experienced jeep driver

  • Jeep, fuel, raincoat

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

  • Free drinking water during the tour

tours.title: SAIGON ICONIC FOOD TOUR
tours.summary: Discover the authentic flavors and culture of Saigon with Vietlook Travel on this iconic food tour. Explore local markets, taste signature dishes, and experience the vibrant lifestyle of Saigonese people through their cu
tours.contentHtml:
Discover the authentic flavors and culture of Saigon with Vietlook Travel on this iconic food tour. Explore local markets, taste signature dishes, and experience the vibrant lifestyle of Saigonese people through their cuisine and streets.

Morning / Afternoon Session

  • Cơm Tấm – Broken Rice with BBQ Pork: Start your journey with the Saigonese specialty “Cơm Tấm.” Served with barbecue pork, vegetables, pickles, and fish sauce, this dish reveals the true flavors of Southern Vietnam.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment: Visit one of the oldest apartments in Saigon (built in 1968) and immerse yourself in the local daily life and culture.

  • District 10 Flower Market: Experience the largest flower market in Saigon. Make your own lotus flower – Vietnam’s national flower – and learn about local traditions for buying and using flowers.

  • Bánh Mì – The World’s Best Sandwich: Try the famous Vietnamese baguette filled with a variety of meats, vegetables, and sauces, a true Saigon street food classic.

  • Original Local Coffee Shop: Enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee with its unique aroma and strong flavor.

  • Chinatown (Cho Lon): Drive around Saigon’s Chinatown to explore the diversity of nations and cultures in the city.

  • Bánh Xèo – Vietnamese Rice Pancake: Visit a local restaurant and learn how this “sizzling cake” is made. Taste it the authentic way, just like the locals.

  • Local Fashion Street: Stroll or drive along Saigon’s fashion street, experiencing the city’s vibrant shopping culture.

  • Delicious Dessert: End your session with a popular local dessert before returning to your hotel.

Night Session

  • Cơm Tấm – Broken Rice with BBQ Pork: Begin your evening with the same Saigonese specialty, freshly prepared.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment & Flower Market: Visit the old apartment and district 10 flower market to enjoy Saigon’s evening ambiance.

  • Cambodia Market Street Food: Explore this famous local food area. Try “Banh Trang Nuong” (Vietnamese Pizza) and enjoy Peach Tea, a local favorite.

  • Bánh Xèo – Vietnamese Rice Pancake: Taste the iconic crispy rice pancake prepared by local chefs.

  • Local Fashion Street & Old Mafia Area: Drive through the historic fashion street and alleys of the old mafia district, witnessing authentic local traffic and lifestyle.

  • Bánh Mì – The World’s Best Sandwich: Enjoy another version of the famous crunchy baguette stuffed with various fillings.

  • Delicious Dessert: Conclude the night with a local dessert stop before returning to your hotel.

tours.title: DISCOVERY PHONG NHA – HANG TIEN CAVE TOUR 1 DAY
tours.summary: The Hang Tien Cave Tour 1 Day is an unforgettable adventure for nature and cave enthusiasts. Known as “Fairy Cave,” Hang Tien is the largest cave in the Tu Lan cave system, featuring spectacular limestone formations, rim
tours.contentHtml:
The Hang Tien Cave Tour 1 Day is an unforgettable adventure for nature and cave enthusiasts. Known as “Fairy Cave,” Hang Tien is the largest cave in the Tu Lan cave system, featuring spectacular limestone formations, rimstone pools, and high chambers that showcase Vietnam’s wild jungle beauty.

This one-day tour is perfect for travelers who want to explore a pristine jungle environment, experience a river cave, and enjoy adventure without staying overnight in the wild. Suitable for both seasoned adventurers and first-time explorers, Hang Tien Cave offers a unique blend of trekking, caving, and natural swimming opportunities.

TOUR ITINERARY

07:00 – 07:30 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha. Drive 1.5 hours to Tan Hoa office, passing through lush jungle, fields, and the historic Da Deo pass. Safety briefing by your experienced guide during the journey.

09:00 – Arrive at Tan Hoa office, sign the Release Form, and collect equipment including jungle boots, lights, helmets, and water bottles. Extra luggage can be stored safely.

09:30 – Drive to the trailhead and start trekking into the forest at 10:00. Hike over a hill and rocky terrain to reach Hang Tien Cave.

12:00 – 12:30 – Enjoy a BBQ lunch near the cave entrance with fresh pork, spring rolls, and vegetarian options available.

12:30 – 16:00 – Explore Hang Tien Cave. Marvel at rimstone pools, lush ferns, high chambers, skylights, and spectacular rock formations. Take time to relax, swim in the natural jungle pool, and capture photos.

16:00 – 18:00 – Trek back to the drop-off point, take a shower at Tan Hoa office, and transfer back to Phong Nha.

19:30 – 20:00 – Arrive at your hotel in Phong Nha, completing the tour.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Duration: 1 day

  • Adventure Level: Moderate, 13.5 km, suitable for physically active guests

  • Group Size: 2 – 8 pax (small-group tour)

tours.contentHtml:
This half day afternoon tour offers a unique insight into Saigon’s cultural life. This tour is perfect for travelers who want a rich cultural experience in a short time.

AFTERNOON CITY TOUR

The bus and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point or selected hotels in Central District One. The afternoon program includes the following highlights:

CHO LON – BINH TAY MARKET

Visit Cho Lon, also known as Binh Tay Market, a famous wholesale market in Ho Chi Minh City. This area spans District Five to District Six and is home to the majority of Chinese-Vietnamese residents. The market is rich in historical and cultural significance and offers a lively glimpse into local commerce and daily life.

THIEN HAU PAGODA

Continue to Thien Hau Pagoda, one of the oldest places of worship for the Chinese community in Saigon. The pagoda plays an important role in the spiritual life of locals and is dedicated to Thien Hau, the Goddess of the Sea. Nearby, you can also see the Tue Thanh Assembly Hall of Cantonese Chinese. During holidays, the pagoda attracts a constant flow of visitors throughout the day.

EVENING EXPERIENCE

BACH DANG WHARF AND WATER BUS

Head to Bach Dang Wharf to enjoy a relaxing Water Bus ride along the Saigon River. From the river, you will see the city from a different perspective, passing landmarks such as Landmark 81 and Thu Thiem Bridge. This experience allows you to explore the soul of Saigon and appreciate why it was once called the Paris of Indochina or the Pearl of the Far East.

At around 18:00, the bus will return you to your hotel or meeting point. End of tour.

tours.contentHtml:
This full day Ho Chi Minh city tour offers a comprehensive introduction to Ho Chi Minh City, also known as Saigon. Throughout the day, you will explore historical landmarks, cultural sites, local markets, and enjoy a relaxing water bus experience on the Saigon River. This tour is ideal for travelers who want to understand the city’s history, culture, and daily life in one complete journey.

MORNING CITY TOUR (7:45 – 8:00 PICK-UP)

The bus and tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point in District One. The morning program focuses on the most famous historical landmarks of Saigon.

INDEPENDENCE PALACE

Visit the Independence Palace, a well-known architectural complex and an important historical site of Viet Nam. This landmark played a significant role in modern Vietnamese history and represents a key moment at the end of the war in 1975.

NOTRE DAME CATHEDRAL (OUTSIDE VISIT ONLY)

Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, one of the most iconic symbols of Ho Chi Minh City. Construction began in 1877 and was completed in 1880. The cathedral is not only a symbol of Catholicism in Viet Nam but also a remarkable example of French colonial architecture.
Please note: The cathedral is currently under restoration, so guests can only visit and take photos from outside.

HO CHI MINH CITY POST OFFICE

Continue to the Ho Chi Minh City Post Office, built between 1886 and 1891 by the French architect Gustave Eiffel. This building is famous for its classic design, elegant details, and distinctive yellow color. It is one of the most popular photo stops in the city.

WAR REMNANTS MUSEUM

Next, visit the War Remnants Museum, which displays valuable historical artifacts from the Nguyen Dynasty through the two Indochina wars. The museum provides deeper insight into the impact of war on Viet Nam and its people.

NOON: LUNCH BREAK (AROUND 11:30)

The bus will take you to a local restaurant for lunch. After lunch, enjoy a short break before continuing the afternoon program.

AFTERNOON CITY TOUR (12:30 – 13:00)

After lunch, the bus and tour guide will pick you up again at the meeting point to begin the afternoon city tour.

CHO LON – BINH TAY MARKET

Visit Cho Lon, also known as Binh Tay Market, one of the largest wholesale markets in Ho Chi Minh City. This area extends from District Five to District Six and is rich in historical and cultural value. It is home to a large Chinese-Vietnamese community and is a lively center for trade and daily life.

THIEN HAU PAGODA

Continue to Thien Hau Pagoda, located in Chinatown. This is one of the oldest and most important places of worship for the Chinese community in Saigon. The pagoda plays a significant role in the spiritual life of local residents and is dedicated to Thien Hau, the Goddess of the Sea. During holidays, the pagoda is especially lively with visitors coming throughout the day.

EVENING EXPERIENCE

BACH DANG WHARF AND WATER BUS

In the evening, head to Bach Dang Wharf for a relaxing water bus experience on the Saigon River. From the river, you will see the city from a different perspective, passing famous landmarks such as Landmark 81 and Thu Thiem Bridge. This journey offers a peaceful way to explore the soul of Saigon and appreciate why it was once known as the Pearl of the Far East.

At around 18:00, the bus will take you back to your hotel or meeting point.

End of the tour.

tours.title: DISCOVERY PHONG NHA – HANG TIEN CAVE 2 DAY TOUR
tours.summary: The Hang Tien Cave 2 Day Tour is an ultimate jungle and cave adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park. Combining trekking, caving, and outdoor camping, this tour takes you deep into the Vietnamese jungle to explore
tours.contentHtml:
The Hang Tien Cave 2 Day Tour is an ultimate jungle and cave adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park. Combining trekking, caving, and outdoor camping, this tour takes you deep into the Vietnamese jungle to explore Hang Tien, or “Fairy Cave,” the largest cave in the Tu Lan cave system.

Highlights include rimstone pools, lush ferns, swimming in natural cave lakes, a lagoon pool, and cave-side waterfalls. Spending a night under the stars beside a jungle pool gives travelers a unique opportunity to experience Vietnam’s wilderness up close.

This tour is suitable for adventurous travelers aged 16 and above who enjoy moderate trekking and immersive nature experiences.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Phong Nha – Tan Hoa – Hang Ruc

07:30 – 08:00 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha. Drive to Oxalis’s Tan Hoa office, passing through scenic jungle and fields. Receive safety instructions, collect gear, and sign the Release Form.

10:30 – Begin trekking into the jungle. First section includes a 1-hour uphill trek, followed by a downhill path along the river.

13:00 – 13:30 – Stop for lunch in the jungle.

14:00 – Cross the river and continue to Hang Ruc, a picturesque stream cave with short swims and flowstone cascades.

16:00 – Trek upriver to the campsite next to a natural jungle pool. Swim, take photos, and relax. Porters prepare a BBQ dinner for the night.

Day 2: Hang Tien 1 – Hang Tien 2 – Tan Hoa – Phong Nha

08:00 – Breakfast at the campsite.

09:00 – Explore Hang Tien 1, a large chamber featuring stunning formations and Gour pools. Climb ladders to reach the cave exit around 11:00.

11:30 – Trek into Hang Tien 2, exploring 300 meters of subterranean formations before exiting and enjoying a picnic lunch.

13:00 – 16:00 – Return trek to the road, with cold drinks waiting.

16:00 – 18:30 – Shower, change, and transfer back to Phong Nha. Tour ends at your hotel around 18:30.

  • Duration: 2 days / 1 night

  • Adventure Level: Moderate, 13.5 km

  • Group Size: 2 – 8 pax (small-group tour)

tours.summary: The Elephant Cave and Ma Da Valley Jungle Trek is a perfect one day adventure for nature lovers seeking peace, discovery, and a touch of adventure. Trek deep into Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, explore Elephant Cave,
tours.contentHtml:
The Elephant Cave and Ma Da Valley Jungle Trek is a perfect one day adventure for nature lovers seeking peace, discovery, and a touch of adventure.

Trek deep into Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, explore Elephant Cave, swim in the crystal-clear waters of Ma Da Valley and Tra Ang Cave, and enjoy a nutritious jungle BBQ lunch.

This tour is suitable for everyone over 9 years old under adult supervision. It offers a moderate trekking challenge while allowing you to experience the jungle, rivers, caves, and local culture of Phong Nha.

For travelers seeking more adventure, consider the Pygmy Exploration 2 Days 1 Night. For easier options, there are tours like Paradise Cave & Phong Nha Cave or Dark Cave and Paradise Cave, all part of our Phong Nha Tours.

08:45 – Depart for the trail to start the jungle trek.

10:00 – 11:00 – Trek to Elephant Cave. Explore the 60-meter-high, 300-meter-long cave and learn about its history from your guide.

12:00 – 12:45 – Trek to Ma Da Valley and Crystal Lake. Swim in the cool blue waters and enjoy a BBQ lunch with local dishes. Vegetarian options available upon request.

14:00 – 15:00 – Continue trekking to Tra Ang Cave.

15:45 – 16:30 – Swim 600 meters inside Tra Ang Cave, explore the cave’s interior, and enjoy the unique jungle experience.

17:00 – 17:30 – Trek back to the trailhead and enjoy a cold drink (beer or soda) before returning.

17:30 – Private car returns you to your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha.

tours.summary: This half day morning tour is a perfect introduction to Ho Chi Minh City. In a short amount of time, you will visit the city’s most famous historical and cultural landmarks, gaining insight into Viet Nam’s past, architec
tours.contentHtml:
This half day morning tour is a perfect introduction to Ho Chi Minh City. In a short amount of time, you will visit the city’s most famous historical and cultural landmarks, gaining insight into Viet Nam’s past, architecture, and daily life. This tour is ideal for travelers with limited time who still want to experience the highlights of Saigon.

MORNING CITY TOUR

The bus and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at the meeting point or selected hotels in Central District One. The tour then begins with visits to the most well-known landmarks of Saigon.

INDEPENDENCE PALACE

Visit the Independence Palace, an important architectural complex and historical site of Viet Nam. This landmark played a significant role in modern Vietnamese history and is closely associated with the end of the war in 1975.

NOTRE DAME CATHEDRAL (OUTSIDE VISIT ONLY)

Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, one of the most iconic symbols of Ho Chi Minh City. Construction began in 1877 and was completed in 1880. The cathedral represents Catholicism in Viet Nam and is a fine example of French colonial architecture.
Please note: The cathedral is currently under restoration, so guests can only visit and take photos from outside.

HO CHI MINH CITY POST OFFICE

Continue to the Ho Chi Minh City Post Office, built between 1886 and 1891 by French architect Gustave Eiffel. This historic building is well known for its classic architectural style, decorative details, and distinctive yellow color. It is a popular photo stop for visitors.

WAR REMNANTS MUSEUM

Next, visit the War Remnants Museum, which displays valuable historical artifacts from the Nguyen Dynasty to the two Indochina wars. The museum offers an informative and moving insight into Viet Nam’s wartime history.

END OF TOUR AND LUNCH

At noon, the bus will take you to a local restaurant for lunch (optional). After lunch, you will be transferred back to the meeting point, ending the tour.

tours.title: HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR AND CU CHI TUNNELS ONE DAY TOUR
tours.summary: This full day tour combines the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City with a meaningful visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels. In one day, you will explore important historical landmarks in the city and then travel to the famous undergro
tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour combines the highlights of Ho Chi Minh City with a meaningful visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels. In one day, you will explore important historical landmarks in the city and then travel to the famous underground tunnel system that played a vital role during the war. The tour is ideal for travelers who want a comprehensive introduction to Saigon and its history.

MORNING: HO CHI MINH CITY TOUR

Your guide and vehicle will pick you up at the meeting point in District One. The morning is dedicated to visiting some of the most famous landmarks in Ho Chi Minh City.

INDEPENDENCE PALACE

Visit the Independence Palace, a well-known architectural complex and a significant historical site of Viet Nam. This building played an important role during the country’s modern history and is a symbol of the end of the war in 1975.

NOTRE DAME CATHEDRAL (OUTSIDE VISIT ONLY)

Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, one of the most iconic landmarks of Ho Chi Minh City. Construction began in 1877 and was completed in 1880. The cathedral is a symbol of Catholicism in Viet Nam and a remarkable example of French colonial architecture.

Please note: The cathedral is currently under restoration, so guests can only visit and take photos from outside.

HO CHI MINH CITY POST OFFICE

Next, visit the Ho Chi Minh City Post Office, built between 1886 and 1891 by French architect Gustave Eiffel. This historic building is famous for its classic architecture, decorative details, and distinctive yellow color. It is one of the most popular check-in spots in the city.

WAR REMNANTS MUSEUM

Continue to the War Remnants Museum, where you will see valuable historical artifacts related to the Nguyen Dynasty and the two Indochina wars. The museum offers a deeper understanding of the impact of war on Viet Nam and its people.

NOON: LUNCH BREAK

The bus will take you to a local restaurant for lunch. After lunch, you will have a short break before continuing the afternoon program.

AFTERNOON: CU CHI TUNNELS EXPERIENCE

After lunch, the tour continues with a journey to the Cu Chi Tunnels, located approximately one and a half hours northwest of Ho Chi Minh City. This vast underground network was built during the 1940s and 1960s to resist French and American forces.

LAM PHAT LACQUERWARE WORKSHOP

On the way, stop at Lam Phat, a lacquerware workshop that employs people with disabilities, many of whom were affected by the long-term consequences of war such as Agent Orange. This visit offers a meaningful opportunity to learn about traditional craftsmanship and support local artisans.

BEN DINH SECTION – CU CHI TUNNELS

Upon arrival, explore the Ben Dinh section of the Cu Chi Tunnels. This area was part of the two-hundred-and-fifty-kilometer tunnel system used during the Resistance War Against America (1955–1975) and served as an important base for guerrilla operations in the Saigon region.

HIGHLIGHTS AT CU CHI TUNNELS

DOCUMENTARY AND EXHIBITS

Watch a short documentary about the history and role of the Cu Chi Tunnels during the war. You will also see displays of handmade weapons, bamboo traps, and tools used by the Viet Cong.

TUNNEL LIFE

Learn how guerrilla fighters dug the tunnels and lived underground, including daily life, medical care, and command operations under constant bombardment.

STRENGTH OF WILL

Discover how determination, creativity, and ingenuity helped the Viet Cong resist advanced American weaponry through hidden trapdoors, camouflage techniques, and booby traps.

TUNNEL CRAWLING (OPTIONAL)

Guests may crawl through a safe and widened section of the tunnels to experience the narrow and confined conditions faced by the fighters. This activity is optional.

SHOOTING RANGE (OPTIONAL, EXTRA FEE)

Try firing an AK-47 rifle at the on-site shooting range. The cost is approximately 26$, bullets are not included and this activity is not part of the tour price.

TASTE HISTORY

Sample steamed cassava, a simple staple food eaten by guerrilla fighters during the war, usually served with salt and peanuts.

END OF TOUR

At around 17:30, depart from Cu Chi and return to District One.
The tour ends upon arrival.

Please note: Drop-off time may vary depending on traffic conditions, weather, or other factors.

tours.title: CU CHI TUNNELS HALF DAY TOUR
tours.summary: Vietlook Travel is a local tour operator in Viet Nam, specializing in well organized tours for international travelers. We focus on reliable services, experienced tour guides, and friendly customer support to ensure a co
tours.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel is a local tour operator in Viet Nam, specializing in well organized tours for international travelers. We focus on reliable services, experienced tour guides, and friendly customer support to ensure a comfortable and meaningful travel experience.

Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour is carefully designed to help visitors gain a deeper understanding of Viet Nam’s history, resilience, and wartime ingenuity, while enjoying a smooth and informative journey.

A CAPTIVATING JOURNEY INTO A HIDDEN HISTORICAL MARVEL

Located approximately seventy kilometers northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, the Cu Chi Tunnels are among the most important historical sites in southern Viet Nam. This underground network stretches over two hundred and fifty kilometers and was constructed during the wars against French and American forces.

More than a military structure, the tunnels formed a complete underground living system that included hospitals, meeting rooms, kitchens, storage areas, and secret escape routes. Today, the Cu Chi Tunnels stand as a powerful symbol of determination, survival, and creativity.

TOUR ITINERARY

Your Vietlook Travel guide and vehicle will pick you up from selected hotels in District One. After pick-up, the journey to the Cu Chi Tunnels begins and takes approximately one and a half hours.

LAM PHAT LACQUERWARE WORKSHOP

Along the way, the tour stops at Lam Phat, a local lacquerware workshop that provides employment opportunities for people with disabilities, many of whom were affected by the long-term consequences of war, including Agent Orange. Guests can observe the traditional lacquerware production process and support meaningful local handicrafts.

BEN DINH SECTION – CU CHI TUNNELS

Upon arrival, you will explore the Ben Dinh section of the Cu Chi tunnel system. This area played an important role during the Resistance War Against America from 1955 to 1975 and served as a key base for guerrilla forces operating around the Saigon region.

HIGHLIGHTS AND EXPERIENCES

DOCUMENTARY AND EXHIBITS

Begin with a short documentary film introducing the history and strategic importance of the Cu Chi Tunnels. You will also see displays of homemade weapons, bamboo traps, and tools used during the war.

TUNNEL LIFE

Learn how soldiers lived, worked, and fought underground, including how the tunnels were dug, expanded, and maintained under extremely challenging conditions.

STRENGTH OF WILL

Discover how determination, creativity, and clever tactics helped Vietnamese fighters resist modern military technology.

TUNNEL CRAWLING (OPTIONAL)

Guests may crawl through a safe and widened section of the tunnels to experience the narrow and confined living space once endured by the fighters.

SHOOTING RANGE (OPTIONAL, EXTRA FEE)

Visitors can try firing an AK-47 rifle at the on-site shooting range at an additional cost. This activity is not included in the tour price.

TASTE HISTORY

Enjoy steamed cassava served with salt and peanuts, a simple but essential daily food for guerrilla fighters during the war.

END OF TOUR

After the visit, the bus will return to Ho Chi Minh City and drop guests off at the original pick-up point in District One.

Please note that return times may vary depending on traffic conditions and public holidays.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Air-conditioned bus or van

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Mineral water

  • Entrance fees

  • Steamed cassava

tours.contentHtml:
This full day tour takes you to two of Central Vietnam’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites. Explore the mystical My Son Holy Land, the ancient religious sanctuary of the Champa Kingdom, and then stroll through the charming streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, famous for its well preserved architecture, cultural heritage, and peaceful atmosphere.

tours.contentHtml:

Continue to Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula) – the largest and most impressive spiritual site in Da Nang. Admire the 67-meter high Lady Buddha statue and enjoy a panoramic view of the city, coastline, and mountains. You may also see the friendly brown monkeys living in the area.

tours.summary: Operated by Vietlook Travel, this full day Hue City Tour is specially designed for international travelers who wish to explore the cultural, historical, and spiritual highlights of Vietnam’s former imperial capital in ju
tours.contentHtml:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, this full day Hue City Tour is specially designed for international travelers who wish to explore the cultural, historical, and spiritual highlights of Vietnam’s former imperial capital in just one day.

Travel comfortably from Da Nang to Hue through the scenic Hai Van Tunnel, visit iconic royal tombs, ancient pagodas, and the UNESCO-listed Imperial Citadel, while gaining deep insight into the Nguyen Dynasty and Hue’s rich heritage. With professional service, experienced English-speaking guides, and carefully selected attractions, Vietlook Travel ensures a memorable and authentic journey.

ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:30
Our driver and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Hue City via Hai Van Tunnel – the longest and most modern road tunnel in Southeast Asia.

09:15 – 09:45
Stop at Lap An Lagoon:

  • Enjoy a coffee break

  • Take photos of the peaceful natural scenery

  • Visit one of the largest pearl farms in Vietnam

11:00
Arrive in Hue and visit Khai Dinh Tomb – the most impressive and artistic royal tomb of the Nguyen Dynasty, featuring a unique blend of Asian and European architecture.

11:45 – 12:00
Lunch at a local restaurant and short rest.

12:45 – 13:00
Continue visiting:

  • Thien Mu Pagoda – the oldest and most beautiful pagoda in Hue, regarded as the spiritual symbol of the city.

  • Hue Imperial Citadel – a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site (since 1993). Here, you will learn about the 13 Nguyen Dynasty emperors who ruled Vietnam for over 140 years. Despite historical changes, the Citadel still preserves its remarkable historical value.

15:15 – 15:30
From the Citadel parking area, stop at a rest point for a short break before returning to Da Nang (approximately 2-hour drive).

Drop-off at your hotel.

tours.contentHtml:
Enjoy a full-day escape to the cool climate of Ba Na Hills ( Da Nang City ), ride one of the world’s most impressive cable car systems, walk on the legendary Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, and have fun at one of Asia’s top indoor theme parks.

ITINERARY

07:30–08:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Our English-speaking guide and driver pick you up from your hotel in Da Nang.

Depart for Ba Na Hills along one of the most beautiful seaside roads in Central Vietnam.

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na Hills – First Cable Car Ride

Reach Ba Na Hills and board the UNESCO record-holding cable car system, famous for its height and length.

On the way up, enjoy spectacular views of:

  • Mo Stream

  • Toc Tien Waterfall with its dazzling white spray

  • Lush forests and misty mountains

Golden Bridge And French Village Area

Visit the iconic sights on Ba Na Hills:

  • Golden Bridge – “Hands of the Gods” holding a curved golden bridge in the sky, one of the most famous landmarks in Vietnam.

  • L’Jardin d’Amour Zone with French-inspired architecture, including:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • The old French stable

    • Hundred-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ancient villas

  • Linh Ung Pagoda – with a 27m-high Buddha statue and peaceful gardens

  • Loc Uyen Garden – a beautiful landscaped garden perfect for photos

11:30 – Second Cable Car to Nui Chua Peak & Lunch

From Debay Station, take the second cable car line to Nui Chua Peak – the rooftop of Da Nang City.

Enjoy a buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills.

Afternoon – Fantasy Park And Summit Attractions

Continue your exploration with:

  • Linh Chua Linh Tu Temple – Visit this spiritual site and enjoy a panoramic view of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often seen through a romantic layer of mist from Ba Na’s peak.

Take the cable car back down the mountain and board the coach to return to Da Nang city center.

17:00–17:30 – Hotel Drop-off

Arrive back at your hotel.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again!

tours.contentHtml:
This afternoon tour brings you from Da Nang’s most sacred pagoda to the mystical Marble Mountains and the magical lantern town of Hoi An. It’s a perfect mix of culture, spirituality, and night-time charm.

ITINERARY

13:45–14:30 – Hotel Pick-up

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang.

Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula)

Visit Linh Ung Pagoda, the most important pagoda in Da Nang for Buddhist locals.

  • Admire the towering Lady Buddha statue watching over the sea.

  • Enjoy peaceful temple grounds, bonsai gardens, and panoramic views of Da Nang City and the coastline.
    This is a meaningful spiritual stop where many people come to pray for peace and good fortune.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

Continue to Marble Mountain, a famous spiritual and natural complex:

  • The mountain cluster consists of Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth), symbolizing the five elements of the universe in Asian culture.

  • Explore mysterious caves filled with Buddhist shrines and a sacred atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda (at Marble Mountain).

  • Stop by Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures made by skillful local artisans.

18:00 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

On arrival in Hoi An:

Dinner in Hoi An

Enjoy a special local dinner with unique dishes such as:

  • Cao Lau

  • Hoanh Thanh (wontons)

  • Banh Bao

  • Banh Vac (white rose dumplings)
    …and more.

Hoi An Ancient Town by Night

After dinner, explore the charming UNESCO World Heritage old town:

  • Visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, the last remaining symbol of Japanese culture in Hoi An and now a symbol of the town.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic and lively night atmosphere.

  • Admire countless colorful lanterns hanging across streets, shop fronts, and small alleys, creating a peaceful and dreamy scene that makes you want the walk to last forever.

Return to your hotel in Da Nang.

End of services. Goodbye & see you again!
