tours.title: HA GIANG – CAO BANG – BAN GIOC WATERFALL – BA BE LAKE
tours.summary: Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc – Ba Be Lake Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers who want to go deeper into Vietnam’s wild and mountainous Northeast. You’ll ride through the legendary Ha Giang Loop, conquer Mã Pí Lèn
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc – Ba Be Lake Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers who want to go deeper into Vietnam’s wild and mountainous Northeast. You’ll ride through the legendary Ha Giang Loop, conquer Mã Pí Lèng Pass and Mẻ Pia Slope, visit Ban Gioc – Vietnam’s most beautiful waterfall, explore Nguom Ngao Cave, and finish with a peaceful boat trip on Ba Be Lake.

Travel by motorbike with professional Easy Riders, stay in local homestays, and experience real ethnic minority culture along the way.

TOUR OVERVIEW

  • Type: SIC Easy Rider motorbike tour

  • Duration: 6 days / 5 nights (plus transfer night from Hanoi)

  • Route: Hanoi → Ha Giang → Dong Van → Meo Vac → Bao Lac → Cao Bang → Ban Gioc → Ba Be → Hanoi

  • Highlights:

    • Hà Giang Loop & Đồng Văn Karst Plateau Geopark

    • Mã Pí Lèng Pass & Nho Quế River viewpoint

    • Mẻ Pia Slope (Mã Pia) with iconic zig-zag road

    • Nguom Ngao Cave & Ban Gioc Waterfall

    • Ba Be National Park & Ba Be Lake boat trip

    • Authentic homestays with Tay and other ethnic families

DETAILED ITINERARY

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus)

  • 19:30–20:00: Pick-up around Hanoi Old Quarter.

  • Board a luxury private-cabin sleeper bus to Ha Giang.

  • Late evening arrival in Ha Giang City.

  • Check in to shared-room homestay (traditional house) and rest.

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast at the homestay, your Easy Rider team will brief you on safety and the route, then the adventure begins.

  • Ride out of Ha Giang into the mountains – the scenery changes quickly from town to towering limestone peaks.

  • Stop at Bac Sum Slope for panoramic views and a short drink break.

  • Continue through Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark – a UNESCO-recognized area full of rice terraces, rock formations and hidden valleys.

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills) – a classic Ha Giang viewpoint.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town.

  • In the afternoon, continue to Tham Ma Slope, a winding mountain road with impressive views.

  • Visit the historic H’Mong King Palace (Vuong family residence), an important cultural and architectural site.

  • Arrive in Dong Van Town, check into homestay, have dinner and free time to explore the Old Quarter (if time allows).
    Overnight in Dong Van.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

One of the most spectacular days of the trip.

  • After breakfast, ride from Dong Van towards Mã Pí Lèng Pass on the Happiness Road between Dong Van and Meo Vac.

  • Stop at the Volunteer Youth Monument and multiple viewpoints along the pass.

  • Ride the Sky Path to admire the full view of deep canyons and the turquoise Nho Quế River below. This is one of the most iconic sceneries in all of Vietnam.

  • Take time for photo stops and to soak in the mountainous landscape.

  • Continue through Meo Vac Town, then ride further into Cao Bang province along remote mountain trails.

  • Reach Bao Lac Town, home to many ethnic groups (including Tay, Nung, H’Mong, etc.).

  • Check in to a Tay family homestay, enjoy a home-cooked dinner and “happy water” (local rice wine).
    Overnight in Bao Lac.

Day 3: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today you ride approximately 130 km through some of the best scenery in Northeast Vietnam.

  • Depart Bao Lac towards Phia Thap Village.

  • Ride through vast forests, limestone mountains, valleys and small local villages.

  • Stop at Mẻ Pia Slope (Ma Pia) – a spectacular zig-zag mountain pass with dramatic views perfect for photos.

  • Enjoy the cool, fresh air of Cao Bang province, with scenic stops along the way.

  • Lunch en route at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon ride to Phia Thap Village, known for its charming geo-cultural landscape and traditional life.

  • Check in at a local homestay, relax, and enjoy dinner with the host family.
    Overnight in Phia Thap.

Day 4: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Cao Bang City

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Nature day with cave and waterfall highlights.

  • Leave Phia Thap and head to Nguom Ngao Cave – one of Northern Vietnam’s most beautiful caves, featuring impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at viewpoints along the way to appreciate Northeast Vietnam’s hidden charm.

  • Continue riding to Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam–China border – the largest and one of the most stunning waterfalls in Vietnam.

  • Enjoy the sight of emerald water cascading over terraced rock formations surrounded by forested cliffs.

  • Optional: short bamboo raft ride to get closer to the falls (if available, at extra cost).

  • In the afternoon, ride back towards Cao Bang City.

  • Check in to accommodation in Cao Bang, dinner and free time.
    Overnight in Cao Bang.

Day 5: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Pac Ngoi Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

  • After breakfast, depart Cao Bang for Ba Be National Park – famous for its combination of mountains, rivers, caves and one of Vietnam’s largest natural freshwater lakes.

  • Ride through mountain passes and rural villages on the way to Ba Be.

  • Arrive in Ba Be Lake area, set among high limestone ranges. The lake never runs dry, even in the dry season.

  • If time permits, you may take a short boat trip on Ba Be Lake or walk around the village.

  • Continue to Pac Ngoi Village, a peaceful Tay ethnic village beside the lake.

  • Check in at a traditional stilt house homestay, dinner and relax in the quiet countryside.
    Overnight in Ba Be.

Day 6: Ba Be – Boat Trip on Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

  • After breakfast, enjoy trekking in Ba Be National Park – visit hidden villages, traditional Tay houses and explore the surrounding nature.

  • Later, take a boat trip on Ba Be Lake (if not done the previous day) to experience the calm water, limestone cliffs and lush forest.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Ba Be.

  • Tour ends in the early afternoon.

13:00 – Departure to Hanoi

  • Board a limousine bus from Ba Be at around 13:00.

  • Evening arrival back in Hanoi.
    End of tour.

PRICE PER PERSON (USD)

  • 520 USD / person – SIC Tour

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Ba Be ↔ Hanoi:

    • Sleeper bus luxury private cabin (pick-up in Hanoi Old Quarter 19:30–20:00)

    • Limousine bus (pick-up around Hanoi Old Quarter 15:00–15:30 for some routes / return from Ba Be at 13:00)

  • Free shared homestay night in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestays during the loop (except first shared night in Ha Giang)

  • All meals during the tour: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide(s)

  • Experienced Easy Rider motorbike drivers

  • Motorbikes & fuel

  • All entry fees to indicated sites (caves, waterfalls, viewpoints…)

  • Protective gear: helmet, raincoat, basic protective equipment

  • Drinking water during the riding days (1 bottle/day)

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Border entry permit for restricted areas (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, soft drinks, etc.)

  • Personal expenses and anything not clearly mentioned in “Tour Includes”

tours.title: HANG EN CAVE ADVENTURE CAMP – 2 DAYS / 1 NIGHT
tours.summary: The Hang En Cave Adventure is one of Vietnam’s most spectacular cave experiences. Hang En is considered the world’s third-largest cave and is a must-see natural wonder. Its massive size, 300-million-year-old fossils, pri
tours.contentHtml:
The Hang En Cave Adventure is one of Vietnam’s most spectacular cave experiences. Hang En is considered the world’s third-largest cave and is a must-see natural wonder. Its massive size, 300-million-year-old fossils, pristine jungle, and river crossings make it an unforgettable adventure.

This 2-day, 1-night tour includes camping inside Hang En Cave beside a lazy river, visits to Ban Doong Village, and exploration of Hang Lanh (“Cold Cave”). Featured in National Geographic, The New York Times, Lonely Planet, Daily Mail UK, Good Morning America, and the Hollywood film Pan (2015), Hang En is a natural and cultural highlight of Phong Nha.

The tour combines trekking, river crossings, jungle exploration, cave adventure, and overnight camping for physically active guests seeking a moderate but thrilling challenge.

TOUR ITINERARY

Day 1: Phong Nha – Ban Doong Village – Hang En

07:30 – 08:00 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha and transfer to Oxalis Headquarters. Gear up, receive a safety briefing, and sign the release form.

10:00 – Start trekking into the jungle via a steep hill and rivers. Hike through primary forest to reach Ban Doong Village, an ethnic minority village, for tea and cultural experience.

12:30 – 13:00 – Picnic lunch near the river.

Continue trekking through rivers and jungle valleys toward Hang En Cave.

15:00 – Arrive at Hang En. Camp is set up on the cave’s beach by the porter team. Explore the cave, walk to the viewpoint above camp to see 300-million-year-old fossils, relax or swim in the natural pool, and enjoy a grilled dinner with rice wine under the sounds of swifts overhead.

Day 2: Hang En – Hang Lanh – Phong Nha

08:00 – Breakfast and pack belongings.

09:00 – Depart Hang En and trek 1 km along the riverside to Hang Lanh (“Cold Cave”).

10:00 – 12:00 – Explore Hang Lanh, a 4 km-long wet cave with cold rivers, magnificent formations, and rare fossils.

12:00 – 13:00 – Lunch with the group.

13:00 – 14:00 – Trek through the river valley and jungle paths back toward the trailhead.

14:00 – 16:00 – Final uphill trek to the pickup point.

16:30 – 17:30 – Return to your hotel in Phong Nha.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Operating Period: 24th Dec – August (closed September – late December)

  • Duration: 2 days / 1 night

  • Adventure Level: Moderate, 25 km for physically active guests

  • Group Size: 10 – 16 pax (minimum 2 pax)

  • Minimum Age: 16 years old

  • Start Time: 08:00 – 08:30 from local hotel in Phong Nha

  • End Time: 17:00 – 17:30 at local hotel in Phong Nha

  • Price: 405 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Private car transfers

  • Camping and trekking equipment

  • Breakfast, lunch, and dinner

  • English-speaking local tour guide

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips

CHILD POLICY

  • Only guests aged 16 years and above can join this tour

tours.title: MARBLE MOUNTAIN – COCONUT FOREST – HOI AN ANCIENT TOWN
tours.summary: This afternoon evening tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine nature, culture, and fun in one go: explore the sacred Marble Mountains, enjoy a basket-boat experience in the Coconut Forest, and fall in love wit
tours.contentHtml:
This afternoon evening tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine nature, culture, and fun in one go: explore the sacred Marble Mountains, enjoy a basket-boat experience in the Coconut Forest, and fall in love with the lantern lit beauty of Hoi An Ancient Town by night.

ITINERARY

14:00 – Pick-up from your hotel

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang and depart for Marble Mountain.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

  • Visit the famous cluster of five limestone mountains representing the five elements:

    • Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth)

  • Explore mysterious caves with a sacred Buddhist atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda on the mountain.

  • Stop at Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures crafted by local artisans.

16:00 – Coconut Forest (Bay Mau Coconut Forest)

Head to the famous Coconut Forest and explore the waterways on a traditional basket boat.

You will:

  • Take a basket-boat ride through the peaceful coconut forest.

  • Learn how to cast a fishing net, catch crabs, and join fun basket-boat races.

  • Watch locals perform impressive basket-boat skills and enjoy a mini show of Quang folk melodies.

  • Try making small accessories from coconut leaves with local guidance.

17:30 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

18:00 – Dinner & Hoi An Night Stroll

  • Enjoy a special dinner with local Hoi An dishes such as:

    • Cao Lau, Hoanh Thanh, Banh Bao, Banh Vac and more.

  • Visit Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming UNESCO World Heritage site.

  • Stop at the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge – the most famous symbol of Hoi An.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic atmosphere of the old town at night.

  • Admire colorful lanterns hanging along streets, alleys, and houses – a magical and peaceful scene you’ll never forget.

21:00–21:30 – Drop-off at your hotel

End of services. Goodbye and see you again!

TOUR PRICE

30 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Dinner with special local dishes in Hoi An.

  • English-speaking guide.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water on the coach.

NOTES AND CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (share dinner with parents).

  • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion dinner).

  • From 10 years old and above: Charged as an adult.

tours.title: DISCOVER PHONG NHA – CYCLING ON THE HO CHI MINH TRAIL
tours.summary: The Phong Nha Ho Chi Minh Trail Cycling Tour offers an adventurous and immersive way to explore the stunning landscapes and historic trails of Phong Nha. Cycle through rice paddies, peanut fields, rivers, and jungle path
tours.contentHtml:
The Phong Nha Ho Chi Minh Trail Cycling Tour offers an adventurous and immersive way to explore the stunning landscapes and historic trails of Phong Nha.

Cycle through rice paddies, peanut fields, rivers, and jungle paths while discovering Vietnam’s history along the legendary Ho Chi Minh trails.

This tour is ideal for travelers who love physical challenges, outdoor adventure, and learning about local culture and wartime history, all while enjoying breathtaking mountain views and pristine nature.

WHAT TO BRING

  • Sunglasses

  • Sun cream

  • Cycling shoes

  • Swimming gear

We provide:

  • Bottles of water, soft drinks, seasonal fruits, and snacks

  • International standard mountain bikes (Trek/Giant or similar) and helmets

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30 – Pick up from your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha. Receive a briefing on cycling traffic rules and safety before starting the tour.

08:45 – Cycle from Phong Nha town toward Phong Nha National Park. Pass through corn and rice fields along the Son River to Na Village, a floating fishing farm. Learn about local culture, rice farming, and fish feeding from your guide.

Visit Ho Khanh’s house, the jungle man who discovered Son Doong Cave, the world’s largest cave. Opportunity for photos if available.

Cycle through peanut fields and explore the original Ho Chi Minh trails, historically used to transport soldiers and supplies during the Vietnam War. Cross muddy paths and peanut fields along the Chay River to reach HCM HW (West Wing).

Enjoy lunch at Chay Lap Homestay or Nuoc Mooc Spring, with an option to swim in the pristine jungle spring.

Cycle across Chay River via a wooden bridge to explore the Wine Cave, where rice wine was historically made during wartime. Learn about its significance and peace symbol.

Return to Phong Nha town by 16:30, with an optional ice-cream break.

INCLUSIONS

  • Entrance fees

  • First-aid service

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Boat on Son River and local ferry fees

  • Cold drinks (Revive, coke) and water (unlimited)

  • Mountain bike with helmet (Trek/Giant or similar) with mechanic support

  • English-speaking cycling guide (escorted guide for groups of 9 or more)

  • Pick up and drop off at your hotel in Phong Nha

EXCLUSIONS

  • Tourist insurance

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips for guide/driver

  • Services not mentioned above

CHILD POLICY

  • Children from 9 to 11 years old: half price

tours.title: Cao Bang 3 Days 2 Nights
tours.summary: This 3 day, 2 night journey takes you deep into the majestic landscapes and historical sites of Cao Bang in the Northeast of Vietnam. Visit sacred revolutionary sites in Pac Bo, admire the breathtaking Ban Gioc Waterfall
tours.contentHtml:
This 3 day, 2 night journey takes you deep into the majestic landscapes and historical sites of Cao Bang in the Northeast of Vietnam. Visit sacred revolutionary sites in Pac Bo, admire the breathtaking Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam – China border, walk through the stunning Nguom Ngao Cave, check in at the unique God’s Eye Mountain (Nui Mat Than), and unwind amidst the tranquil beauty of Ba Be Lake.

With comfortable accommodation, local cuisine, and a knowledgeable tour guide, this program is perfect for travelers who want to experience both nature and culture in a short but meaningful trip.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Hanoi – Cao Bang – Pac Bo

  • Morning pick-up in Hanoi and drive to Cao Bang.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon visit to Pac Bo Historical Site – including Lenin Stream and Karl Marx Mountain, where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked in the early days of the revolution.

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner.

  • Overnight at hotel in Cao Bang.

Day 2: Cao Bang – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Nguom Ngao Cave – Nui Mat Than – Cao Bang

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Depart for Ban Gioc Waterfall, one of the most spectacular waterfalls in Vietnam. Free time for sightseeing and photos. (Optional bamboo boat ride to get closer to the falls – at your own expense.)

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, famous for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at Nui Mat Than (God’s Eye Mountain / Nui Thung) for photo opportunities of this unique mountain with a natural “eye” in the rock. (Motorbike taxi to the viewpoint available at your own expense.)

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner and overnight at hotel.

Day 3: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

  • Breakfast at hotel, then depart for Ba Be National Park.

  • Enjoy a boat trip on Ba Be Lake, surrounded by limestone mountains, forests, and peaceful villages.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant or homestay area (depending on timing).

  • Afternoon drive back to Hanoi.

  • Evening arrival in Hanoi. End of tour.

PRICE

From 250 USD / pax – SIC Tour (seat-in-coach)

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Transportation by tourist coach (7–45 seats) according to group size and itinerary.

  • Accommodation:

    • 2 nights at 2–3* hotels in Cao Bang (twin/double sharing).

  • Meals:

    • 5 main meals (set menu), valued at 120,000 VND / meal / person.

  • Breakfast:

    • 2 breakfasts at local restaurants or hotel.

  • English/Vietnamese-speaking tour guide throughout the itinerary.

  • Drinking water in the bus: 1 bottle per person per day.

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • VAT (10%) if an official tax invoice is required.

  • Foreign guest surcharge at Ban Gioc Waterfall: 50,000 VND / person.

  • Single room supplement (for solo travelers or guests requesting a single room).

  • Drinks during meals, minibar, and other personal expenses.

  • Optional bamboo boat ride at Ban Gioc Waterfall.

  • Motorbike taxi to access/viewpoint at Nui Mat Than (if used).

  • Any other services and expenses not clearly mentioned in the “Tour Inclusions” section.

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – SAPA
tours.summary: This tour 6 day, 5-night Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa package is designed for travelers who want to experience the very best of Northern Vietnam in a comfortable, time-efficient way. From the cultural heart of Hano
tours.contentHtml:
This tour 6 day, 5-night Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa package is designed for travelers who want to experience the very best of Northern Vietnam in a comfortable, time-efficient way. From the cultural heart of Hanoi to the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay, the majestic limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh, and the misty mountain terraces of Sapa, this journey seamlessly combines nature, culture, and local life.

You’ll explore ancient temples and historic streets in Hanoi, cruise through thousands of limestone karsts in Ha Long Bay, row between towering cliffs and hidden caves in Trang An, and trek charming ethnic villages in Sapa, including Ta Van and Cat Cat.

Tour Itinerary

Day 1: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour

Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our representative will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel for check-in and relaxation.

In the afternoon, your guide will pick you up for a 4 hour Hanoi city tour, including:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, supported by rows of square columns, with the words “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH” prominently displayed. The surrounding grounds are planted with trees and flowers from across Vietnam, making this one of the capital’s most meaningful historical and cultural symbols.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on West Lake’s southeastern shore, this 1,500-year-old pagoda is considered the oldest in Thang Long – Hanoi and was once the Buddhist center during the Ly and Tran dynasties. Its architecture harmoniously blends solemnity, antiquity, and natural lakeside beauty.

  • Train Street
    A unique 200-meter-long street tightly flanked by residential houses. When the train passes, you will experience the thrilling feeling of being just about one meter away, making it one of Hanoi’s most iconic photo and experience spots.

  • Water Puppet Show
    A traditional Vietnamese art form performed entirely on water. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, with wooden puppets as the “actors”, accompanied by live music, sound effects, and lighting, creating a lively and captivating performance.

After the tour, you will enjoy a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage package.

Day 2: Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

07:00 – Pick-up from your hotel in the Old Quarter or the Hanoi Opera House and depart for Ninh Binh.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit the former capital of Vietnam in the 11th century. The ancient ruins, partly reclaimed by nature, create a mystical atmosphere. Explore the temples of Kings Dinh and Le, restored in the 17th century but believed to be on the original foundations of the royal palaces from the 11th–12th centuries.

After local lunch (around 13:30) – Depart for Trang An, a UNESCO-recognized eco-tourism complex:

  • Explore a 250-million-year-old limestone system with flooded forests, towering karst peaks, and cultural relics.

  • Enjoy a peaceful boat trip through caves and along emerald rivers, passing spectacular limestone cliffs and lush landscapes.

15:30 – Mua Cave

Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the summit. At the top, a tower in traditional Vietnamese style crowns the mountain. From here, take in the panoramic view of rice fields, winding rivers, and karst mountains – one of the most beautiful viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

Return to Hanoi.

Day 3: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise

08:00–08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

Your English-speaking guide will collect you from various hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter (timing approximate due to traffic).

11:45–12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, board the cruise from our private pier where the crew will warmly welcome you.

12:00–13:30 – Lunch on Board

Cruise out into the heart of Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Sail past iconic limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and Thumb Rock, a tall islet shaped like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a variety of seafood and Vietnamese dishes.

13:30–14:30 – Explore Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island and walk up around 200 steps under the forest canopy to the entrance of Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay. Spend about 45 minutes exploring its impressive chambers.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can stay on board and relax on the sundeck or in the jacuzzi.)

14:30–15:30 – Kayaking / Rowboat

Head to Luon Cave. Here you can:

  • Go kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by locals to admire the limestone cliffs and peaceful water.

15:30–16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island, where you can climb halfway up for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay. This viewpoint offers one of the most stunning vistas of the bay.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit, and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sky change colors as the sun sets over the bay.

18:00 – Disembark and return to Hanoi by limousine bus.

You will be dropped off in the Old Quarter to have dinner or explore by yourself.

Around 21:00, a sleeper bus will pick you up to depart for Sapa.

Overnight on the sleeping bus.

Day 4: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Ta Van Village

05:30 – Arrive in Sapa, early check-in at your pre-booked hotel and rest.

10:00–10:30 – Your guide will pick you up to visit Fansipan:

  • Transfer to the Cable Car Station and take a 20-minute cable car ride, enjoying breathtaking views of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range.

  • Reach an altitude of about 2,800 meters, where you can:

    • Explore the pagoda complex and spiritual sites.

    • Climb around 600 steps to the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina”.

    • Spend about 1.5 hours for photos and sightseeing.

After that, visit Ta Van Village, about 12 km from Sapa town:

  • This is home to the Black H’Mong and Red Dao ethnic minorities, each with distinct languages, houses, and customs.

  • The village lies in Muong Hoa Valley, the largest valley in Sapa along the Hoang Lien Son range.

  • While Sapa town is lively and busy, Ta Van offers a peaceful, rural atmosphere with:

    • Vast terraced rice fields covering hillsides

    • The sound of flowing streams and singing birds

Day 5: Cat Cat Village – Hanoi

Morning: Breakfast at the hotel, then your guide will take you to Cat Cat Village:

  • Take a short walk to Cat Cat, a village of the Black H’Mong people located in a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

  • Observe daily life, traditional handicrafts, and local culture.

  • Trek down to the waterfall and old French Hydraulic Power Station, stop for photos at the bridge and waterfall.

  • Trek back uphill to Sapa with beautiful scenery along the way (trekking distance approx. 2.5 km, about 2 hours).

After the tour, you will return to Hanoi by sleeper bus.

Upon arrival in Hanoi, check in to the hotel and enjoy free time.

Day 6: Departure from Hanoi

After breakfast, free at leisure until your private car picks you up and transfers you to the airport for your onward flight.

tours.title: HANOI – BAT TRANG – CHUONG CONICAL HAT VILLAGE – QUANG PHU CAU – HA LONG – NINH BINH
tours.summary: The 6 Days 5 Nights HANOI – BAT TRANG – CHUONG CONICAL HAT VILLAGE – QUANG PHU CAU – HA LONG – NINH BINH package is perfect for travelers who want to explore both Vietnam’s famous landscapes and its traditional craft vil
tours.contentHtml:
The 6 Days 5 Nights HANOI – BAT TRANG – CHUONG CONICAL HAT VILLAGE – QUANG PHU CAU – HA LONG – NINH BINH package is perfect for travelers who want to explore both Vietnam’s famous landscapes and its traditional craft villages at a relaxed pace.

Start in Hanoi with a half-day city tour, visiting Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Tran Quoc Pagoda, the iconic Train Street and enjoying a traditional water puppet show. Then discover three of the Red River Delta’s most unique villages in one day: Bat Trang Ceramic Village (handmade pottery and a fun hands-on experience at the wheel), Chuong Conical Hat Village (learn to cook with a local family and make your own “nón lá”), and Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, where thousands of colorful incense sticks create dreamlike photo spots.

You’ll then cruise the UNESCO World Heritage site of Ha Long Bay on an overnight cruise, with kayaking, caves and sunset on deck, before heading to Ninh Binh – often called “Ha Long Bay on land” – to explore Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, the peaceful boat trip through Trang An cave system, and the panoramic viewpoint at Mua Cave.

Tour Itinerary

Day 1: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour

Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to your hotel for check-in and rest.

In the afternoon, your guide will pick you up for a 4-hour Hanoi city tour:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside) – admire the solemn grey-granite building and the large parade square planted with trees and flowers from all regions of Vietnam.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda – the oldest pagoda in Hanoi, located on a small island on West Lake. Discover its 1,500-year history as a Buddhist center of the ancient Thang Long citadel and enjoy the tranquil lakeside setting.

  • Train Street – feel the unique atmosphere of this narrow residential street where the train passes just meters from the houses.

  • Water Puppet Show – enjoy a traditional Vietnamese art form performed on water with live music, sound effects and colorful lighting (45–60 minutes).

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage package.

Day 2: Hanoi – Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise

Breakfast at the hotel.

  • The guide picks you up at the hotel lobby and you transfer by SIC bus to Ha Long Bay.

  • 11:30 – 12:00: Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor, check in at the waiting lounge.

  • 12:00 – 12:10: Board the tender to your cruise, enjoy a welcome drink, meet the captain and crew, and receive a safety and itinerary briefing. Check in to your cabin.

  • 13:00 – 13:15: Enjoy a Vietnamese seafood & vegetarian lunch while cruising among the magnificent limestone karsts of Lan Ha – Ha Long Bay.

  • 15:00: Relax on the sundeck or explore the Ba Trai Dao / Tra Bau area and natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay with kayaking.

  • 17:30 – 18:00: Return to the cruise for a sunset party – take photos and relax.

  • 19:00: Dinner on board. After dinner, you can try squid fishing, relax on the sundeck or enjoy a drink at the bar.

Overnight on the cruise.

Day 3: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi

  • 06:00 – 06:15: Join a Tai Chi session on the sundeck.

  • 06:15 – 07:00: Light breakfast with tea/coffee while enjoying the morning scenery.

  • 07:00: Visit Dark & Light Cave by bamboo boat to explore the tranquil lagoon and limestone formations, or swim in the clear water (depending on weather and tide).

  • 08:10: Return to your cabin, relax and pack your luggage.

  • 10:00: Check out of the cabin. Enjoy an early lunch while the cruise heads back to the harbor.

  • 11:00: Take a high-speed canoe back to Tuan Chau Port and return to Hanoi by SIC bus.

Check in to your hotel and enjoy free time.

Day 4: Bat Trang – Chuong Conical Hat Village – Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

08:00: Your guide and driver pick you up from the Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House.

Bat Trang Ceramic Village

  • Drive to Bat Trang, the most famous ceramic village in Vietnam (since the 11th century).

  • Visit the village temple, dedicated to the tutelary god who helped reclaim the land and develop the pottery craft, located beside the Red River.

  • Stroll through narrow alleys in the old quarter of Bat Trang, see ancient houses and talk with elderly artisans about the village history and pottery traditions.

  • Visit a ceramic workshop and learn step-by-step how to make pottery. You can create your own piece using traditional methods.

    • If you’d like to bring your product home, inform the guide; it will need about 3 days to dry and be fired before being delivered to your hotel.

  • If time permits, walk through the local market and visit another family workshop to see how traditional and modern techniques are combined.

Chuong Conical Hat Village

  • 11:30: Depart for Chuong Village, famous for over 300 years of conical hat making.

  • Visit a family with a long tradition in the craft, in one of the few remaining wooden houses built in traditional Northern Delta style – a vivid picture of rural Vietnam decades ago.

  • Join a cooking class with the host, enjoy a home-cooked lunch, green tea and relaxation.

  • After lunch, learn about and practice making the iconic Vietnamese conical hat (nón lá) with local artisans.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

  • 14:30: Continue to Quang Phu Cau Village, renowned for its centuries-old incense-making craft.

  • Visit the largest family-run workshop, see workers preparing incense at different stages of production.

  • Outside, the yard is covered with thousands of colorful incense bundles – perfect for photography.

  • Talk with friendly locals and try making incense yourself.

16:00: Finish the tour and drive back to Hanoi.

Day 5: Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

  • 07:00: Pick-up from the Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House and depart for Ninh Binh.

  • 10:00: Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel, Vietnam’s capital in the 11th century. Explore the atmospheric ruins surrounded by dramatic karst scenery and visit the temples of Kings Dinh and Le, rebuilt in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

  • After local lunch (around 13:30), continue to Trang An – a UNESCO-listed eco-tourism complex famous for its limestone mountains, flooded forests and cave systems.

    • Take a boat trip through caves and along tranquil rivers, surrounded by towering cliffs and lush greenery.

  • 15:30: Visit Mua Cave. Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the summit and the tower with traditional Vietnamese design. From the top, enjoy a panoramic view of Tam Coc, rice fields and karst mountains – one of the most spectacular viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

Return to Hanoi and drop off at your hotel.

Day 6: Departure from Hanoi

Breakfast at the hotel. Free time until your driver picks you up for the airport transfer for your flight home.

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – DA NANG – PHU QUOC
tours.summary: The 10 Days 9 Nights HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – DA NANG – PHU QUOC package is a full North Central South journey that blends world-class scenery, culture and beach relaxation in one itinerary. Start in the thousand-ye
tours.contentHtml:
The 10 Days 9 Nights HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – DA NANG – PHU QUOC package is a full North Central South journey that blends world-class scenery, culture and beach relaxation in one itinerary.

Start in the thousand-year-old capital Hanoi with a charming city tour and traditional water puppet show, then cruise through the UNESCO-listed Ha Long Bay, kayaking among thousands of limestone islands. Continue to Ninh Binh, often called “Ha Long Bay on land”, where you explore Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, the Trang An boat caves and the panoramic viewpoint at Mua Cave.

From the North, fly to vibrant Da Nang to visit Ba Na Hills & the Golden Bridge, Marble Mountains, the Coconut Palm Forest and the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Ancient Town. The last days are for pure relaxation on the tropical paradise of Phu Quoc Island, with a cable car ride to Hon Thom, island-hopping by speedboat, and a fun-filled day at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari.

Throughout the trip you stay in carefully selected 3–5* hotels, enjoy guided sightseeing, entrance fees as per program and convenient transfers. As a special bonus, you’ll receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing treatment or body massage in Hanoi, making this tour not only a discovery of Vietnam but also a truly pampering holiday.

DAY 1: WELCOME TO HANOI – HALF DAY CITY TOUR – PRIVATE TOUR

Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative and transferred to your hotel for check-in and rest.

In the afternoon, the tour guide will pick you up for a 4-hour Hanoi city tour. You will visit Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Train Street, and enjoy a Water Puppet Show.

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, surrounded by rows of square granite columns. In the centre stands the inscription “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”. The grounds are planted with trees and flowers brought from all regions of Vietnam. This is one of the most important cultural and historical symbols of the capital.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on the south-eastern shore of West Lake, Tran Quoc Pagoda is nearly 1,500 years old and considered the oldest pagoda in Thang Long – Hanoi. During the Ly and Tran dynasties, it was the Buddhist centre of the citadel. Its architecture harmoniously combines solemnity and antiquity with the elegant landscape of the lake.

  • Train Street
    This narrow 200-metre street is lined with residential houses right next to the railway. When the train passes, you can feel the excitement and thrill as it rumbles by just about one metre from where you sit. That unique experience makes Train Street a must-see spot in Hanoi.

  • Water Puppet Show
    An indispensable traditional art form in Vietnam. The stage is a pool of water; the puppets are the main “actors”, controlled by skilful artists behind the curtain. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, combining puppetry, live music, sound effects, and colourful lighting to create lively, captivating performances.

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 2: HA LONG BAY DAY CRUISE

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Transfers & SIC Cruise

08:00 – 08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

English-speaking guide picks you up from hotels in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Pick-up time is approximate due to traffic; please be ready in the lobby.

11:45 – 12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina by 22-seater limousine. Check in at our pier where the crew warmly welcomes you on board.

12:00 – 13:30 – Lunch on Board

The cruise departs Tuan Chau Harbor to discover the beauty of Ha Long Bay – a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Along the way, admire thousands of limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and especially Thumb Rock, a limestone islet rising from the sea like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a wide variety of Vietnamese dishes and seafood.

13:30 – 14:30 – Explore Surprise (Sung Sot) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island. The guide leads you to Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay.

After about 200 steps under the forest canopy, the cave entrance appears and a spectacular “underground paradise” opens in front of you. Explore the cave for about 45 minutes.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can remain on the cruise, relaxing on the sundeck or soaking in the jacuzzi.)

14:30 – 15:30 – Kayaking

The cruise heads to Luon Cave area. Here you can:

  • Enjoy kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by local people to admire the peaceful scenery of Luon Cave.

15:30 – 16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island. Climb partway up the mountain for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay – a stunning 360° vista of limestone peaks and emerald waters.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sunset painting the sky with beautiful red, purple and yellow hues.

18:00 – Disembark – Limousine Back to Hanoi

Return to the harbor, board the limousine and travel back to Hanoi via the expressway (with a short break on the way).

20:30 – 21:00 – Drop-off at your hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 3: HANOI – NINH BINH (HOA LU – TRANG AN – MUA CAVE)

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

07:00 – Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam in the 10th–11th centuries. The remaining ruins lie amidst dramatic karst scenery, creating a mystical atmosphere. Nearby are the temples of the Dinh and Le emperors, restored in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

13:30 – Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex

After a local lunch, depart for Trang An, a famous eco-tourism area:

  • 250-million-year-old limestone mountains

  • Flooded forests, rivers and caves

  • Archaeological and cultural relics

Take a sampan boat trip through tranquil waterways, limestone karsts and caves, fully immersed in peaceful nature.

15:30 – Mua Cave (Hang Múa)

Climb nearly 500 steps to the summit. At the top, a beautiful tower in traditional Vietnamese style awaits you alongside a breathtaking panorama of mountains and rice fields – one of the most iconic viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

After the tour, return to your Hanoi hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 4: HANOI – DA NANG – DRAGON BRIDGE & SON TRA NIGHT MARKET

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel, then transfer to Noi Bai Airport for your flight to Da Nang.

  • Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel for check-in and rest (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

In the evening, the driver will take you (no guide) to visit:

  • Dragon Bridge – famous for its dragon-shaped design and colourful lights at night.

  • Son Tra Night Market – a lively local market with food stalls, souvenirs, and entertainment.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 5: MARBLE MOUNTAIN – COCONUT FOREST – HOI AN NIGHT MARKET

Meals: Breakfast, Local Dinner – SIC TOUR

Morning: Breakfast and free time.

13:50 – 14:00 – Pick-up for Marble Mountains

Visit Ngu Hanh Son (Marble Mountains) – a group of five limestone hills named after the five elements: Metal, Water, Wood, Fire and Earth. Over the centuries, the peaks have been revered as a spiritual site by the Cham people, Vietnamese emperors and generals. Explore caves, pagodas and viewpoints overlooking Da Nang.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Continue to the Coconut Forest, lying along the banks of the Hoai, Thu Bon and De Vong rivers. Take a basket boat ride into the mangrove forest:

  • Enjoy fresh air along quiet waterway channels lined with nipa palms.

  • Watch locals casting fishing nets – like a live folk performance.

  • See exciting basket-boat spinning shows and fun “boat racing” on the water.

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market
Head to Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming trading port preserved from the 15th–19th century:

  • Wander lantern-lit streets, old houses and narrow alleys.

  • Take photos and shop for local handicrafts.

  • Experience lantern releasing or small candle-lit boats on the river.

  • Enjoy a local dinner with delicious Hoi An specialities.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 6: BA NA HILLS & GOLDEN BRIDGE

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

08:30 – Depart to Ba Na Hills along the Nguyen Tat Thanh coastal road. See Thuan Phuoc Suspension Bridge, Thanh Beach and Red Beach (where the French first landed in Da Nang).

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station. Take the cable car to DeBay Station, passing Mo Stream waterfalls, primeval forest and red-leaf trees.

09:30 – Visit:

  • Golden Bridge – the world-famous pedestrian bridge supported by giant stone hands.

  • Le Jardin d’Amour area with:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • Old French horse-stable area

    • Nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ruins of French villas

  • Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27-metre Shakyamuni Buddha statue, Loc Uyen Garden and Quan Am Pavilion.

Continue to Gare DeBay to take the second cable car to the summit of Ba Na.

11:30 – Lunch at restaurant.

12:30 – 14:00

  • Conquer Nui Chua Peak (1,487 m) – the “roof” of Da Nang.

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often floating in a sea of white clouds.

  • Walk along forest trails to see ruins of ancient villas, the outdoor opera house and Debay Suspension Bridge.

Then visit Fantasy Park, one of the world’s largest indoor amusement parks, with games such as: Love Wheel, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Cars, Haunted House, Mortar games, Spider-Man, Free-Fall Tower, etc.

16:30 – Take the cable car down.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 7: DA NANG – PHU QUOC

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc Island.

  • Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel for check-in and relaxation (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 8: PHU QUOC – THOM ISLAND & 4 ISLANDS BY SPEED BOAT

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Local Buffet) – SIC TOUR

Cable Car + Aquatopia Water Park & Three Islands by Speed Boat

09:00 – Guide picks you up and transfers to the harbour.

Board the speed boat to explore islands in southern Phu Quoc:

  • Gam Ghi Island – Snorkel among coral reefs and relax on the beach.

  • Xuong (Mong Tay) Island – More colourful corals and clear waters for snorkelling.

  • May Rut Island – White-sand lagoon, chill-out spots and photo corners.

Optional: Sea Walker (extra cost)
Walk on the seabed with a special helmet, surrounded by fish and vibrant corals.

Arrive at Thom Island:

  • Enjoy Aquatopia Water Park with more than 20 modern water games from world-class manufacturers.

Return via Hon Thom Cable Car (around 25 minutes):

  • Admire panoramic views of islands and the Sun Kiss Bridge at sunset (weather permitting).

~17:00 – Back to hotel.

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 9: FULL DAY VINWONDERS & VINPEARL SAFARI

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – PRIVATE TOUR

After breakfast, transfer to discover:

Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc

  • Vietnam’s largest wildlife conservation park and the only open semi-wild safari in the country (about 380 hectares).

  • Take a bus tour inside the safari to see animals roaming freely in natural-style habitats: giraffes, zebras, rhinos, lions, tigers and many rare species such as Arabian oryx, cranes, white-necked swans, etc.

  • Enjoy various animal shows (time-dependent).

Note: Safari closes at 16:00 daily. Bus inside the safari park is not included in the ticket price and is paid on spot.

VinWonders Phu Quoc (Afternoon)

Explore Vietnam’s largest theme park (approx. 50 hectares) with 6 themed zones and 12 sub-themes:

  • Thrilling rides & roller coasters

  • Water park slides

  • Indoor games

  • Street performances & musical fountain shows

  • 5D cinema and many other attractions

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 10: PHU QUOC – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Free at leisure until check-out.

  • Driver transfers you to Phu Quoc Airport for your flight home.

End of services.

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG – SAPA – DA NANG – HO CHI MINH
tours.summary: 10 Days 9 Nights journey takes you through Vietnam’s most iconic destinations: cruising Ha Long – Lan Ha Bay, exploring ancient capitals and limestone landscapes in Ninh Binh, conquering Fansipan in Sapa, strolling lante
tours.contentHtml:
10 Days 9 Nights journey takes you through Vietnam’s most iconic destinations: cruising Ha Long – Lan Ha Bay, exploring ancient capitals and limestone landscapes in Ninh Binh, conquering Fansipan in Sapa, strolling lantern-lit Hoi An, riding the cable car to Ba Na Hills, discovering Cu Chi Tunnels, and boating through the Mekong Delta.

You’ll enjoy a mix of SIC (join-in) tours and private services, comfortable hotels, and a special complimentary Vietnamese hair-wash experience or body massage in Hanoi.

TOUR ITINERARY

DAY 1: HANOI ARRIVAL – HA LONG BAY OVERNIGHT CRUISE

Meals: Lunch, Dinner – SIC Transfer, Shared Cruise

  • Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport (Hanoi), our representative will meet and assist you, then transfer you to the meeting point.

  • Board the SIC bus and depart straight to Ha Long Bay.

11:30 – 12:00

  • Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor, check in at the waiting lounge.

12:00 – 12:10

  • Take a tender boat to the cruise.

  • Welcome drink, meet the captain and crew, and listen to safety briefing.

  • Check into your cabin.

13:00 – 13:15

  • Enjoy a Vietnamese seafood & vegetarian lunch while cruising through the magnificent Ha Long – Lan Ha Bay, admiring fascinating rock formations.

15:00

  • Relax on the sundeck or

  • Explore Ba Trai Dao – Tra Bau area and the natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay by kayak.

17:30 – 18:00

  • Return to the cruise, join sunset party, take photos and relax.

19:00

  • Dinner at the restaurant on board.

  • After dinner: join squid fishing, relax on the sundeck, or enjoy a drink at the bar.

Overnight on the cruise.

DAY 2: HA LONG BAY – HANOI – HALF-DAY CITY TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Transfer & Cruise / PRIVATE City Tour

06:00 – 06:15

  • Join Tai Chi on the sundeck.

06:15 – 07:00

  • Breakfast while enjoying the morning view of the bay with tea or coffee.

07:00

  • Visit Dark & Light Cave:

    • Option 1: Take a bamboo boat to explore the karst and lagoon.

    • Option 2: Swim in the cool, clear blue water (if allowed by cruise & weather).

08:10

  • Return to your cabin, pack your luggage.

10:00

  • Check out of your cabin.

  • Enjoy an easy cruise back through the bay and have an early lunch at the restaurant.

11:00

  • Disembark, take speed boat back to Tuan Chau Port.

  • SIC bus back to Hanoi.

  • Check in at your Hanoi hotel.

Hanoi Half-Day City Tour (Private – ~4 hours)

You’ll visit:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    Grey granite monument with the inscription “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”, surrounded by lawns, trees, and flowers from all over Vietnam – a powerful national symbol.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    The oldest pagoda in Hanoi (nearly 1,500 years), on a small island in West Lake. A beautiful combination of solemn architecture, history, and tranquil lake scenery.

  • Train Street
    A narrow residential street with a railway running right through it. When the train passes, it’s incredibly close – an exciting and unique Hanoi experience.
    (Train schedule is not fixed by day. We will check and arrange as best as possible, but cannot guarantee the train passes exactly during your visit. You can return by yourself later if desired.)

  • Water Puppet Show
    A traditional Vietnamese art form performed on water. The show (45–60 minutes) combines wooden puppets, live music, and colorful lighting to recreate daily life and folk stories.

After the city tour, you’ll receive your complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 3: HANOI – NINH BINH (HOA LU – TRANG AN – MUA CAVE) – NIGHT BUS TO SAPA

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Tour

07:00

  • Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

  • Visit the former capital of Vietnam (10th–11th century).

  • Explore the temples of Dinh and Le emperors, restored in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

  • The ruins and surrounding karst mountains create a mystical, historical atmosphere.

13:30 – Trang An Boat Trip

  • After a local lunch, depart for Trang An – a world-famous eco-tourism complex.

  • Take a sampan boat through:

    • Limestone mountains (250-million-year-old formations)

    • Flooded forests & river valleys

    • Multiple caves and grottoes

  • Enjoy tranquil scenery, cliffs, forests, and emerald waterways.

15:30 – Mua Cave (Hang Múa)

  • Climb nearly 500 steps to the summit.

  • At the top, see the iconic stone tower and enjoy a panoramic view of Tam Coc, mountains, and rice fields – one of the best viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

  • Finish the tour and drive back to Hanoi.

  • Drop-off in Old Quarter – free time for dinner and walking around on your own.

~21:00

  • Pick-up for Sapa by sleeper bus.

Overnight on the bus.

DAY 4: SAPA – MUONG HOA MOUNTAIN RAILWAY – FANSIPAN

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE TOUR

~05:30

  • Early arrival in Sapa. Early check-in at pre-booked hotel & rest.

10:00 – Muong Hoa Mountain Railway & Fansipan

  • Take the Muong Hoa Mountain Railway, with a stylish classic–modern design and panoramic views of the Sapa valley.

  • Enjoy the feeling of the train winding along the mountainside, looking through large glass windows at the Northwest mountains.

Then transfer to Fansipan Cable Car Station:

  • 20-minute cable car ride through spectacular scenery to 2,800 m altitude.

  • Free time to:

    • Take photos

    • Visit pagodas and spiritual sites

    • Climb about 600 steps to the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina” (3,143 m).

  • Spend about 1.5 hours for sightseeing and photos.

Overnight in Sapa.

DAY 5: CAT CAT VILLAGE – HANOI

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE TOUR + SIC BUS

  • Breakfast at hotel.

Cat Cat Village Tour

  • Short walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong.

  • Located in a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

  • Visit local houses, see daily activities and traditional crafts.

  • Trek down to the waterfall and French-built hydraulic power station.

  • Photo stops at the bridge and waterfall.

  • Trek uphill back towards Sapa (approx. 2.5 km, about 2 hours).

  • After the tour, free time in Sapa until transfer.

  • Return to Hanoi by sleeper bus (SIC).

  • Upon arrival in Hanoi, you’ll be dropped at a hotel near the airport.

Overnight in / near Hanoi.

DAY 6: HANOI – DA NANG – MARBLE MOUNTAIN – COCONUT FOREST – HOI AN NIGHT MARKET

Meals: Breakfast, Dinner – SIC TOUR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Noi Bai Airport for flight to Da Nang.

  • Upon arrival in Da Nang: pick-up and drop-off at your hotel to leave luggage and relax.

13:50 – 14:00 – Marble Mountains

  • Visit the Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son) – five limestone hills named after the five elements: Metal, Water, Wood, Fire, and Earth.

  • Explore caves, pagodas, and viewpoints. This area has been a spiritual site for Cham people, Vietnamese emperors, and generals for centuries.

Coconut Forest (Bay Mau)

  • Transfer to the Coconut Forest, located along the Hoai, Thu Bon, and De Vong Rivers.

  • Take a basket boat ride through mangrove waterways lined with nipa palms.

  • Watch locals cast fishing nets and enjoy boat-spinning performances and fun “dancing” basket boats.

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market

  • Head to Hoi An Ancient Town – charming streets, old houses, temples, and colorful lanterns.

  • Walk through narrow alleys, take photos, shop local handicrafts.

  • Experience lantern releasing or small candle-lit boats on the river (optional).

  • Enjoy local dinner with famous Hoi An dishes.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 7: BA NA HILLS & GOLDEN BRIDGE

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

08:30

  • Depart along Nguyen Tat Thanh coastal road, see Thuan Phuoc Suspension Bridge, Thanh Beach, and Red Beach.

09:00

  • Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station.

  • Take cable car to De Bay Station, enjoy views of waterfalls, forests, and hills.

09:30 – Golden Bridge & Le Jardin d’Amour

  • Visit the famous Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands.

  • Explore Le Jardin area:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • Ancient French wine cellar & horse-binding area

    • Nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ruins of French villas

  • Visit Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27 m Shakyamuni Buddha statue, Loc Uyen Garden, and Quan Am Pavilion.

  • Take 2nd cable line up to the top of Ba Na (Nui Chua).

11:30

  • Buffet lunch at restaurant.

12:30 – 14:00

  • Conquer Nui Chua Peak (1,487 m) – the “roof” of Da Nang.

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay (sometimes under clouds).

  • Walk to ruins of old villas, outdoor opera house, and Debay Suspension Bridge.

  • Visit Fantasy Park – one of the biggest indoor amusement parks in the world, with:
    Love Wheel, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Cars, Haunted House, Spider-Man games, Free-fall Tower, etc.

16:30

  • Take cable car down.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 8: DA NANG – HO CHI MINH CITY

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Da Nang Airport, fly to Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon).

  • Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up and drop you at your hotel.

  • Free time to rest and explore the city.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 9: CU CHI TUNNEL – MEKONG DELTA

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

Morning – Cu Chi Tunnels

  • After breakfast, pick-up to Cu Chi Tunnels (~60 km from Saigon).

  • Explore over 200 km of underground tunnels – a symbol of Vietnamese resilience and ingenuity.

  • Watch a documentary, see self-made weapons, bamboo traps, hidden entrances.

  • Experience crawling inside the tunnels (optional).

  • See how locals make rice paper and rice wine.

  • Optional shooting range experience with AK-47 and other rifles (extra cost).

Afternoon – Mekong Delta (My Tho – Ben Tre)

  • Arrive in My Tho city.

  • Take a motorboat along the Mekong, passing Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Turtle Islands.

  • See fishing ports, Rach Mieu Bridge, stilt houses, and boat workshops.

  • Stop at Unicorn Island:

    • Walk to fruit gardens

    • Enjoy tropical fruits

    • Taste natural honey tea/wine at a bee farm

    • Listen to traditional Vietnamese music performed by locals

  • Take a rowing boat through small canals shaded by water coconut trees.

  • Continue by motorboat to Ben Tre Province, cruise through lush green canals before returning to the mainland.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 10: HO CHI MINH HALF DAY CITY TOUR – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast – SIC TOUR + PRIVATE AIRPORT TRANSFER

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Join a half-day city tour (SIC):

You’ll visit:

  • Independence Palace (Reunification Palace)
    Historic site and former presidential palace of South Vietnam.

  • Notre Dame Cathedral
    Built from 1877 to 1880, this red-brick cathedral is a symbol of Catholicism and French colonial architecture in Saigon.

  • Saigon Central Post Office
    Built from 1886–1891, designed by French architect Gustave Eiffel.
    Famous for its classical European architecture, arched windows, decorative details, and yellow façade.

  • After the tour, the SIC transfer drops you at the meeting point.

  • A private car will then take you to Tan Son Nhat Airport for your departure flight.

End of services.

tours.title: HA GIANG JEEP TOUR – 2 DAYS
tours.summary: Ha Giang Jeep Tour is perfect for travelers who want to experience the legendary Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike, you will travel by open–air jeep with an experienced local driver, enjo
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Giang Jeep Tour is perfect for travelers who want to experience the legendary Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike, you will travel by open–air jeep with an experienced local driver, enjoying panoramic mountain views, deep valleys, ethnic minority villages, and the iconic Ma Pi Leng Pass and Nho Que River.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Night Sleeper Bus)

  • Pick–up from your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter.

  • Overnight transfer to Ha Giang by luxury private–cabin sleeper bus.

  • Free overnight at a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Detailed Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – The tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and driver will give you a short safety briefing before you hop into the jeep and start the journey.

You will notice a dramatic change in scenery as you leave the city and drive into the mountains. Along the way, you will:

  • Stop at Bac Sum Slope to enjoy panoramic views and a refreshment break

  • Continue to Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the sweeping mountain landscape

  • See the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, the jeep takes you further along the Ha Giang Loop to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – a stunning zigzag mountain road and classic photo stop

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – the former home of the H’Mong royal family, rich in history and traditional architecture

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, have dinner, and enjoy free time to explore the old quarter in the evening.

Day 2: Dong Van Town – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast at the homestay, you will start one of the most beautiful driving sections in Vietnam:

  • Drive along the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known as the “Heaven Pass” of Ha Giang

  • Stop at viewpoints to admire the dramatic cliffs and turquoise Nho Que River flowing far below

  • Visit the Volunteer Youth Monument, a historical site along the pass

From Ma Pi Leng, continue by jeep towards Meo Vac, passing through impressive karst formations, terraced fields, and remote villages. You will:

  • Discover stunning mountain scenery and rural life

  • See various hill tribes, such as the H’Mong, in their colorful traditional clothing

  • Have lunch at a local restaurant on the way

In the afternoon, the route leads you back to Ha Giang City, passing equally beautiful landscapes as the first day.

The tour ends in Ha Giang around 17:00.
You will then have free time for dinner on your own before boarding the night sleeper bus back to Hanoi at 21:00.

Tour Price per Person (USD)

Group Size – Price per Person

  • 2 pax: 269 USD / pax

  • 3 – 5 pax: 255 USD / pax

  • 6 – 8 pax: 240 USD / pax

Tour Includes

  • Transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Hanoi:

    • Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus (pick–up in Hanoi Old Quarter from 19:30 to 20:00)

    • Limousine bus option (pick–up in Hanoi Old Quarter from 15:00 to 15:30)

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestay during the tour

  • All meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English–speaking tour guide

  • Experienced jeep driver

  • Jeep, fuel, raincoat

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

  • Free drinking water during the tour

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit

  • Tips for guide and driver

  • Personal drinks (beer, coffee, soft drinks, etc.)

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – DA NANG – HO CHI MINH
tours.summary: This 10 day journey is perfect for first-time visitors who want to see the very best of Vietnam in comfort. From the charm of Hanoi’s Old Quarter and the karst islands of Ha Long Bay, to the limestone landscapes of Ninh
tours.contentHtml:
This 10 day journey is perfect for first-time visitors who want to see the very best of Vietnam in comfort. From the charm of Hanoi’s Old Quarter and the karst islands of Ha Long Bay, to the limestone landscapes of Ninh Binh, the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, the cool mountain air of Ba Na Hills and the vibrant energy of Ho Chi Minh City – this program has it all.

You will travel with a mix of shared (SIC) and private services, stay in centrally located hotels, and enjoy a special complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing ritual or body massage during your stay in Hanoi.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

  • Discover Hanoi’s history, culture and unique Train Street

  • Cruise UNESCO-listed Ha Long Bay on a modern day cruise

  • Explore Ninh Binh: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, Trang An and Mua Cave

  • Experience traditional craft villages: Bat Trang ceramics, Chuong conical hats, Quang Phu Cau incense

  • Fly to Da Nang and visit Marble Mountains, Coconut Forest and Hoi An Ancient Town

  • Ride the cable car to Ba Na Hills and walk on the famous Golden Bridge

  • Fly to Ho Chi Minh City, visit Cu Chi Tunnels and cruise the Mekong Delta

  • Complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage in Hanoi

DETAILED ITINERARY

Day 1: Welcome to Hanoi – Half-Day City Tour

Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, our representative will greet you and transfer you to your hotel in Hanoi. Check in and relax.

Afternoon – Half-Day City Tour (around 4 hours):

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside):
    See the imposing granite structure that houses the preserved body of President Ho Chi Minh (viewed from outside), and admire the spacious, symbolic Ba Dinh Square around it.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda:
    Located on a small island in West Lake, this is the oldest pagoda in Hanoi (around 1,500 years). The combination of ancient architecture, tranquil lake views and spiritual ambiance makes it one of the city’s most beautiful sites.

  • Train Street:
    Walk along the narrow railway street where trains pass just a short distance away from local houses and cafes. Feel the unique atmosphere and see daily life unfolding right beside the tracks.

  • Water Puppet Show:
    Enjoy a traditional water puppet performance – a unique Vietnamese art form. Puppeteers stand in water behind a screen, bringing wooden puppets to life with stories from rural life and legends, accompanied by live music.

After the tour, transfer back to your hotel and free time.
Overnight in Hanoi.

Day 2: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise

Breakfast at the hotel.

08:00–08:45

Shared (SIC) limousine pick-up from your hotel in the Hanoi Old Quarter.

11:45–12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, check in and board your Ha Long day cruise.

12:00–13:30 – Lunch on Board

  • Cruise through the most beautiful parts of Ha Long Bay

  • Pass famous islets such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock and Thumb Rock

  • Enjoy a generous buffet lunch with seafood and Vietnamese dishes

13:30–14:30 – Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

  • Visit the largest and most impressive cave in Ha Long Bay

  • Walk up around 200 steps under the forest canopy to reach the cave entrance

  • Explore the spectacular chambers filled with stalactites and stalagmites

(Those who prefer to relax can stay on the boat and enjoy the sundeck or jacuzzi.)

14:30–15:30 – Luon Cave – Kayaking / Rowboat

  • Move to Luon Cave area

  • Choose between kayaking or sitting in a bamboo rowboat paddled by a local

  • Enjoy the calm lagoon surrounded by cliffs and greenery

15:30–16:30 – Titop Island

  • Climb up to the viewpoint for a panoramic view over Ha Long Bay

  • Or relax and swim at the small sandy beach

17:00 – Sunset Party

  • Enjoy tea, fruit, cakes and wine (complimentary) as the sun sets

  • Relax on the sundeck while cruising back to the harbor

18:00–20:30

  • Disembark at Tuan Chau

  • Shared limousine transfer back to Hanoi

  • Drop-off at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter
    Overnight in Hanoi.

Day 3: Bat Trang – Chuong Conical Hat Village – Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

Breakfast at the hotel.

08:00 – Pick-up from hotel (or Hanoi Opera House)

Bat Trang Ceramic Village

  • Visit the village temple, dedicated to the tutelary god who reclaimed the land and developed the pottery craft

  • Walk through old alleys, see ancient houses and talk with local artisans

  • Visit a ceramic workshop and learn the full process of making pottery

  • Hands-on experience: shape your own ceramic product (optional firing and shipping to your hotel at extra cost)

  • If time permits, explore the local market and visit another family that combines traditional and modern production methods

11:30 – Depart for Chuong Conical Hat Village

  • Visit a family with a long-standing tradition of making Vietnamese conical hats

  • See an old wooden house with classic Northern Delta architecture

  • Join a simple cooking class with the host and enjoy a home-style Vietnamese lunch

  • Sip green tea, relax and experience peaceful rural life

  • After lunch, learn how to make a traditional conical hat and try your hand at crafting one yourself

14:30 – Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

  • Arrive at the famous incense-making village

  • Visit the largest family-run workshop in the village

  • See the full process of incense production

  • Take photos among hundreds of bright, colorful incense bundles laid out to dry

  • Interact with friendly locals and try making incense sticks

Around 16:00 – Tour Ends in Hanoi

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package – a relaxing local-style gift from us.

Overnight in Hanoi.

Day 4: Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

Breakfast at the hotel.

07:00 – Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

  • Visit the former capital of Vietnam (10th–11th centuries)

  • See the temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le

  • Learn about early Vietnamese dynasties and enjoy the mountain scenery surrounding the old citadel

After local lunch – Trang An Boat Trip

  • Board a rowing sampan through the Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex

  • Enjoy the peaceful river, towering limestone cliffs and lush greenery

  • Pass through natural caves and admire the karst formations and tranquil scenery

Mua Cave and Viewpoint

  • Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the top of Mua Mountain

  • Visit the tower with traditional Vietnamese design

  • Take in the panoramic view of Tam Coc, rice fields and surrounding mountains

Return to Hanoi in the late afternoon.

Overnight in Hanoi.

Day 5: Hanoi – Fly to Da Nang – Dragon Bridge & Son Tra Night Market

Breakfast at the hotel.
Transfer to Noi Bai Airport by private car for your flight to Da Nang.

Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport:

  • Our representative will pick you up and transfer you to your hotel in Da Nang

  • Check in and relax (usual check-in time 14:00–15:00)

Evening (No guide):

  • Private car pick-up to see Dragon Bridge illuminated at night

  • Visit Son Tra Night Market to enjoy local street food and souvenirs

Overnight in Da Nang.

Day 6: Marble Mountains – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market

Morning: Breakfast and free time.

13:50–14:00 – Pick-up from hotel

Marble Mountains

  • Visit a cluster of five marble and limestone hills named after the five elements (Metal, Water, Wood, Fire, Earth)

  • Explore pagodas, caves and viewpoints once revered by Cham people, Vietnamese emperors and generals

Coconut Forest (Bay Mau)

  • Travel to the water coconut forest along Hoai, Thu Bon and De Vong rivers

  • Take a fun basket boat ride through the mangrove ecosystem

  • Watch local fishermen cast nets and see boat-spinning performances and basket-boat “races”

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market

  • Walk through lantern-lit streets, old houses, temples and riverside alleys

  • Experience the unique charm and preserved architecture of this UNESCO-listed town

  • Release paper lanterns on the river (optional)

  • Enjoy a local dinner with typical Hoi An dishes

Return to Da Nang.

Overnight in Da Nang.

Day 7: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge

Breakfast at the hotel.

08:30 – Depart for Ba Na Hills

  • Drive along the beautiful coastal road, see Thuan Phuoc Bridge, Thanh Beach, Red Beach

09:00 – Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station

  • Take the cable car to De Bay Station

  • Enjoy bird’s-eye views of forests, waterfalls and valleys

09:30 – Golden Bridge & Le Jardin Area

  • Visit the iconic Golden Bridge, held up by giant stone hands

  • Explore French-style gardens, old French wine cellar remains, ancient pomelo tree and Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27m-high Buddha statue

Take the second cable car line to the top of Nui Chua.

11:30 – Lunch at restaurant

12:30–14:00 – Top of Nui Chua & Fantasy Park

  • Reach the summit area (around 1,487m)

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay

  • Visit the remains of ancient villas and the Debay Suspension Bridge

  • Free time at Fantasy Park with many indoor games and attractions

16:30 – Take cable car down

Return to Da Nang.

Overnight in Da Nang.

Day 8: Da Nang – Fly to Ho Chi Minh City – Cu Chi Tunnels

Breakfast at the hotel.
Transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City.

Upon arrival:

  • Transfer to your hotel and check in

  • Later, join the shared (SIC) tour to Cu Chi Tunnels

Cu Chi Tunnels

  • Drive about 60 km from the city to Cu Chi

  • Watch a short documentary about the war period

  • See the underground network of tunnels used during the war (over 200 km)

  • Learn how guerrillas lived, fought and set traps

  • See homemade weapons, bamboo traps and hidden entrances

  • Try crawling inside a section of the tunnel (optional)

  • Visit a rice paper and rice wine workshop

  • Optional: experience firing an AK-47 or other weapons at the shooting range (extra cost)

Return to Ho Chi Minh City.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

Day 9: Mekong Delta – My Tho – Ben Tre

Breakfast at the hotel.

Drive to the Mekong Delta.

Around 10:00 – Arrive in My Tho

  • Take a motor boat on the Mekong River, passing Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix and Turtle Islands

  • See fishing ports, stilt houses and boat-building yards

Stop at Unicorn Island:

  • Walk to fruit gardens and taste tropical fruits

  • Enjoy honey tea, honey wine and traditional Vietnamese music performed by locals

  • Take a rowing boat through small palm-lined canals

Continue by motor boat to Ben Tre:

  • Visit a coconut workshop and observe local life along green canals

Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the afternoon.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

Day 10: Ho Chi Minh City Half Day Tour  + Private Airport Transfer

Breakfast at the hotel and check-out procedures (you can leave your luggage at reception if needed).

Half-Day City Tour (SIC)

  • Independence Palace (Reunification Palace):
    Former residence of the President of South Vietnam, an important historical site associated with the end of the Vietnam War.

  • Notre Dame Cathedral (outside, if under renovation):
    Built between 1877–1880 with French architectural style, a symbol of Catholicism and a city landmark.

  • Saigon Central Post Office:
    Designed by Gustave Eiffel, this colonial-era post office is famous for its vaulted ceilings, tiled floors and historic maps.

After the tour, the SIC vehicle will drop you at the meeting point.

A private car will then transfer you to Tan Son Nhat Airport for your departure flight.

End of services.

tours.title: HANOI – SAPA – CAT CAT – LAO CHAI – TA VAN – BAC HA
tours.summary: This tour is perfect for travelers who want to spend more time exploring Sapa’s most popular attractions, combined with a colorful cultural experience at the famous Bac Ha Market. Enjoy comfortable hotel stays, friendly
tours.contentHtml:
This tour is perfect for travelers who want to spend more time exploring Sapa’s most popular attractions, combined with a colorful cultural experience at the famous Bac Ha Market. Enjoy comfortable hotel stays, friendly services, and a much lower cost compared to night trains let Vietlook Travel take care of everything for you.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel on the highway toward Lao Cai with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue by mountain road to Sapa Town, passing stunning scenery of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrival in Sapa Town where local ethnic groups—H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay—wear their traditional colorful attire.

  • Welcome drink

  • Itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people. Visit traditional houses, observe daily life, and trek down to the old French-built hydro-power station and waterfall. Continue trekking uphill to return to Sapa with beautiful late-afternoon views.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km – approx. 2 hours

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.

Day 2: Sapa – Y Linh Ho – Lao Chai – Ta Van

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:45

Breakfast at the hotel. Prepare your light pack for a long trekking day.

08:00

A short drive to Y Linh Ho, then start trekking through rice terraces and along the Mường Hoa Stream toward Lao Chai Village, home of the Black H’Mong. Continue to Ta Van Village, inhabited by the Dzay ethnic minority.

Trekking distance: 9 km – approx. 4 hours

11:30

Bus pickup at Ta Van Bridge and return to Sapa.

12:00 – Evening

Lunch and free time to explore Sapa Town on your own (Church, Square, local cafés…).

Dinner and overnight at hotel.

Day 3: Sapa – Bac Ha Market – Lao Cai – Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

06:15 – 07:00

Breakfast at hotel. Prepare luggage and check out.

07:00 – 13:00

Drive 2.5 hours to Bac Ha Town, home of the Flower H’Mong ethnic people.

Visit Bac Ha Market, the most vibrant weekly ethnic market in Northwest Vietnam. Explore local products, handicrafts, traditional clothes, livestock areas, and colorful trading scenes.

Lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, visit:

  • Hoang A Tuong Palace (built in 1914 with French–Vietnamese architecture)

  • Pho Village of the Flower H’Mong people

Trekking distance: 4 km – approx. 2 hours

13:00

Drive 1 hour 45 minutes back to Lao Cai City.

15:00

Board the shuttle bus back to Hanoi with a comfort break.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive at Hanoi bus station. Trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Modern air-conditioned bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (no guide on bus)

  • Bus from Sapa – Bac Ha – Lao Cai

  • English-speaking local guide in Sapa and Bac Ha

  • Meals: 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 breakfasts

  • All entrance fees

  • Hotel accommodation (double/twin/triple sharing)

  • Bus insurance

Trip Excludes

  • Beverages, personal expenses, travel insurance, VAT

  • Items not clearly mentioned

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD/person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD/person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 25 USD/person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD/person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1m): Free of charge (sharing bed/berth with adult)

  • 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult rate (sharing bed with adult)

  • 9+ years old: Adult price

Notes

  • If you want to visit additional places in Lao Cai on the way back, transportation fees are at your own expense.

  • You can join this tour even if you depart for Sapa on Saturday at the same price.

  • Elderly guests should not join the long 9 km trek in case of rain.

  • Children under 6 years old and people with mobility challenges should not join the trek.

Surcharge Policy

  • Applicable on national holidays.

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, scarf, hat (Sapa is cold from September–March)

  • Be aware of fog from December–March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Vietnam Dong cash (ATMs may not work well; USD/EUR/AUD accepted)

  • Personal medicine

Tour Price per Person (USD)

124 USD / person (3★)

140 USD / person (4★)

184 USD / person (5★)
