tours.contentHtml:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days and 2 nights in Sapa, saving time while still visiting the most popular attractions. Guests will stay overnight in a comfortable hotel and conquer Fansipan Peak – “The Roof of Indochina.” Friendly and attentive service is provided throughout the journey.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:40

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road approaching Sapa Town, enjoying scenic views of valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay appear in colorful traditional clothing.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Take a short drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people and located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will introduce village activities and local culture as you trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the Hydroelectric Power Station built by the French. After some time for photos at the bridge and waterfall, trek uphill to reach the main road.

The driver will pick you up and transfer you back to Sapa.

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for night activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Sapa

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

08:00

After breakfast at the hotel, the driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Enjoy a 20-minute cable car ride with spectacular mountain scenery.

09:00

Reach 2,800 meters above sea level. Spend time sightseeing, taking photos, visiting the spiritual pagoda complex, and trekking up 600 steps to reach Fansipan Peak – the Roof of Indochina. (Approx. 1.5 hours for hiking and photography)

11:30

Return to the Cable Car Station and head back to Sapa Town.

12:00

Lunch at a local restaurant or at the hotel.

13:30

Begin your exploration of Dragon Cloud, Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Along the way, stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass (2,333 meters), one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes. This is a prime location for cloud hunting and panoramic photos.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you may:

  • Check in at the colorful staircase

  • Take the elevator to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge (three transparent sides)

  • Walk along the 768-meter glass walkway perched 1,000 meters above the mountainside

  • Enjoy free time for photos and explore optional activities within the tourist zone

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

Day 3: Sapa – Moana View – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:30

Have breakfast at the hotel, then take a short walk to Moana View, the latest check-in spot designed especially for young travelers who love unique photo settings.

Moana View highlights include:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café with views of Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

Prepare beautiful outfits and accessories to capture your best photos.

11:30

Return to the hotel for check-out.

12:00

Enjoy lunch and free time in Sapa.

13:00 – 14:00

Board the bus back to Hanoi with comfort breaks along the way.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive at Hanoi bus station. The trip ends.

tours.title: HANOI BIKING – EXPLORE RED RIVER DELTA COUNTRYSIDE (HALF DAY)
tours.summary: Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour 08:00 – Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and transfer you to our bicycle office, where you can choose the most suitable bike and receive a safety briefin
tours.contentHtml:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

08:00 – Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, or homestay and transfer you to our bicycle office, where you can choose the most suitable bike and receive a safety briefing. If your hotel is conveniently located, we can also bring the bicycles directly to your hotel.

After getting ready, we will start cycling from your hotel and head out for our countryside ride.

Crossing Long Bien Bridge

Our first highlight is crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge – the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built over 100 years ago during the French colonial period. From here, you can enjoy beautiful views of the Red River, watch boats passing underneath, and see the lush green vegetable farms on the river island.

Countryside and Local Life

We then cycle into the countryside, where local farmers live and work. Here, you will have the chance to visit a local family, learn more about daily life and traditions, and have meaningful conversations with them. Our guide will assist to make the interaction easy and insightful.

Co Loa Ancient Citadel

We continue cycling along dirt roads and through rural villages to reach Co Loa Ancient Citadel, originally built in 275 BC. Here, you will learn about Vietnam’s long tradition of establishing and defending the country, as well as the history of King Thuc Phan An Duong Vuong and his struggle against foreign invaders.

Fruit Garden – Lunch – Egg Coffee

After visiting Co Loa, we will stop at a fruit garden, where you can see how local fruits are grown. Then we cycle back to Hanoi for lunch at a local restaurant, where you will enjoy traditional Vietnamese dishes.

We finish the trip in the Old Quarter with a cup of egg coffee, a famous local specialty, before transferring you back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English–speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike

  • All entry fees and free bottled water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Pick up and drop off

  • Helmet

tours.title: HANOI BY NIGHT FOOD TOUR
tours.summary: ITINERARY Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama. Our next stop is the French Quarter to see the Ha
tours.contentHtml:
ITINERARY

  • Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama.
  • Our next stop is the French Quarter to see the Hanoi Opera House, where you will have the opportunity to take beautiful photos and learn some history of the area.
  • We then ride to Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built more than a hundred years ago. It spans the Red River, connecting Hoan Kiem and Long Bien districts, and provides shelter for locals living on boats underneath. Only motorbikes and bicycles can cross it—so off we go!
  • Back on the scooter, we continue along the beautiful Ceramic Road and Chuong Duong Bridge to reach our next food stop, where you will enjoy “Burned Garlic Siamese Duck” and “Liver Pâté Siamese Duck.”
  • The exciting ride through organized, chaotic Hanoi traffic brings you to another local restaurant for authentic dishes. Then we explore small alleys to try different versions of Pho, including Pho Chien Phong and Pho Cuon, along with many other famous Vietnamese dishes.
  • A ride around West Lake offers a romantic view of Hanoi that most travelers rarely get the chance to see—an experience filled with “wow” moments. Continuing the tour, we ride around the city and pass by Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum for a night-time photo stop.
  • A short ride later brings us to a traditional Egg Coffee shop, where you will enjoy Hanoi’s famous specialty.
  • We then ride you back to your hotel. Say goodbye

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet
  • Experienced professional riders
  • English-speaking guides
  • Dinner at local restaurants
  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour
  • Free pick-up and drop-off
  • Raincoat (if needed)

tours.title: EXPLORING THE NORTH OF THE RED RIVER
tours.summary: ITINERARY Vietlook Travel will drive you across the spectacular Long Bien Bridge that spans the Red River. We then ride our scooters along the riverbank toward the countryside, where you will see vast green rice paddies
tours.contentHtml:
ITINERARY

  • Vietlook Travel will drive you across the spectacular Long Bien Bridge that spans the Red River. We then ride our scooters along the riverbank toward the countryside, where you will see vast green rice paddies and rural villages hidden alongside the fields.
  • We continue riding through small alley roads in the middle of the rice paddies, enjoying an exciting off-road adventure. We will make some stops for you to learn how rice is grown and understand more about wet rice cultivation.
  • Back on the scooter, our authentic riders will take you to visit a 900 year old village that still preserves its ancient architecture. Here, you will learn about traditional culture and village life.
  • We then head to a local market to see how people buy and sell their daily essentials. You will also have the chance to try tropical fruits.
  • Next, we ride to visit the temple worshipping King An Duong Vuong. This ancient site dates back to 257 BC and was once the capital of Vietnam, known as Co Loa Citadel. It is the perfect place to learn about the history of Hanoi and Vietnam.
  • After visiting Co Loa Citadel, we take you to a local coffee shop to enjoy Vietnamese coffee and you can also try Hanoi’s famous Egg Coffee.
  • We then hop back on the scooter and head to a local restaurant for you to enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. After lunch, our rider team will take you back to your hotel or drop you off anywhere you prefer. Just let us know. Goodbye.

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet

  • Experienced professional riders

  • English-speaking guides

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Raincoat (if needed)

These are long-standing traditional specialties of Hanoi. Not only do local people love them, but international tourists and even world leaders visiting

Vietnam also look forward to having the chance to enjoy these dishes. They are not luxurious or expensive, but incredibly tasty and filled with the rich flavors of Vietnamese culinary culture.

13:30 Visit the Old Quarter with its ancient houses, hotels, restaurants, souvenir shops, and traditional market alleys. This is the busiest area of the city, where you will have the opportunity to learn about the daily life of Hanoi’s locals.

The next stop is the Ancient House at 87 Ma May Street. Built in the 19th century, this house represents Hanoi’s traditional architecture with an area of 157.6 m², along with many ancient artifacts still preserved inside, making it even more special.

14:30 Continue by car to visit the famous Train Track Coffee area. Enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the railway line running between rows of ancient houses and crowds of visitors.

tours.title: HANOI – HA LONG SONATA 5 STAR DAY CRUISE – NINH BINH
tours.summary: Ha Long – Ninh Binh 2 day, 1 night tour is an ideal journey for travelers seeking to explore the magnificent natural landscapes and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ha Long Bay, a UNESC
tours.contentHtml:
Ha Long – Ninh Binh 2 day, 1 night tour is an ideal journey for travelers seeking to explore the magnificent natural landscapes and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its emerald waters, limestone karsts, and enchanting caves.

Continue to Ninh Binh, known for its breathtaking scenery, sacred pagodas, historic temples, and peaceful river valleys. With a well-organized itinerary and attentive service, this tour promises an unforgettable experience.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Hanoi – Ha Long Sonata 5 Star Day Cruise – Ninh Binh

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

08:00 – 08:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

The bus and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel and depart for Ha Long Bay via the modern expressway.

11:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Island

Enter the private waiting lounge and board the Halong Sonata 5-Star Day Cruise. Begin your captivating 6-hour journey following the iconic overnight cruise route, offering stunning views of uninhabited islets and magnificent limestone formations.

Buffet Lunch Onboard

Enjoy a buffet lunch while the cruise glides through the scenic bay.

Ha Long Bay Highlights

14:00 – 16:30 – Explore Bo Hon Archipelago

  • Visit Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave) with extraordinary stalactites and stalagmites

  • Explore Luon Cave by kayak or bamboo boat

  • Stop at Titov Island to swim or climb to the panoramic viewpoint

16:30 – Sunset Party

Return to the cruise for a Sunset Party with live traditional music as the boat heads back to Tuan Chau Harbor.

18:00 – Transfer to Ninh Binh
Have dinner en route and continue to Ninh Binh.

21:00 – Check-in at Homestay or Bungalow
Relax and enjoy the night at your accommodation.

Day 2: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An or Tam Coc – Mua Cave – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – 09:00 – Breakfast at the Bungalow

09:30 – Pick-up for Day 2 Activities

Morning Options

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda

Visit the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex with highlights such as:

  • 500 Arhat statues

  • Two giant bronze bells

  • Thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Explore Vietnam’s former capital and visit Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple.

Lunch

12:00 – Lunch at Local Restaurant

Afternoon Options

Option 1: Trang An Boat Trip

Sampan ride through a network of caves and temples including Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave, and more.

Option 2: Tam Coc Boat Trip

1.5-hour sampan journey through “Three Caves,” surrounded by limestone mountains, rice paddies, and peaceful streams.

Mua Cave And Ngoa Long Mountain

16:00 – Visit Mua Cave

Hike to the viewpoint for a spectacular panoramic view of the rice valley.

17:00 – Return to Hanoi

19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at the original meeting point. The tour concludes.

tours.summary: Sapa sits at an altitude of 1,600 meters above sea level and enjoys a temperate climate with average temperatures ranging from 15°C to 18°C. Cool throughout the year and occasionally snowy in winter, Sapa was discovered
tours.contentHtml:
Sapa sits at an altitude of 1,600 meters above sea level and enjoys a temperate climate with average temperatures ranging from 15°C to 18°C. Cool throughout the year and occasionally snowy in winter, Sapa was discovered by the French in the early 20th century for its scenic beauty, fresh climate, and natural water sources.

Visitors can admire remnants of French architecture, ethnic minority villages and iconic attractions such as Silver Waterfall, Heaven’s Gate, Cloud Bridge, Wind Cave, and Ham Rong Mountain. This tour is perfect for nature lovers and travelers interested in local cultures and traditions.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road toward Sapa Town, passing stunning valley and terraced-field scenery.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay appear in colorful traditional clothes.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people, located at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your guide will introduce the culture, daily activities, and traditional crafts of the villagers.

Trek down to the waterfall and visit the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Take photos at the bridge and waterfall before trekking uphill back to Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

16:30

Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel. Free time for evening activities.

Day 2: Sapa – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Wake up to a beautiful sunrise over the Sapa mountains. Enjoy breakfast at the hotel.

08:00

Begin your exploration of Dragon Cloud, the Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Along the way, stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass, one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes, located at 2,333 meters above sea level. This is a famous spot for cloud hunting and panoramic photography.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you will:

  • Check in at the colorful staircase

  • Take the elevator to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge (three transparent sides)

  • Walk along the 768-meter structure perched 1,000 meters above the mountainside

  • Have free time to explore and take photos
    Optional activities inside the tourist area are available for purchase.

11:30

Return to the hotel for check-out.

12:00

Have lunch at the hotel.

13:30

Board the bus back to Hanoi with a comfort stop and a short shopping break.

Arrive at the Hanoi bus station. The tour ends.

tours.summary: Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ninh Binh, home to
tours.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Northern Vietnam. Begin your adventure in Ninh Binh, home to spectacular limestone landscapes, historic temples, and peaceful river valleys. Continue to Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where towering islets, shimmering waters, and fascinating caves create one of the world’s most iconic seascapes.

ITINERARY

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An or Tam Coc – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:40 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel or homestay. Begin the 110–kilometer modern bus journey through the verdant countryside. A short break will be made en route.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Situated at the foot of Dinh Mountain, it offers breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone karsts.

Highlights include:

  • 500 Arhat stone statues

  • Two giant bronze bells (27 tons and 36 tons)

  • The thousand–armed, thousand–eyed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Explore the historic capital of Vietnam, where you will visit Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring regional specialties.

Afternoon Choices

Option 1: Trang An Boat Trip

13:30 – Trang An Landscape Complex

Depart for the Trang An Grottoes, a UNESCO–recognized site renowned for majestic limestone mountains rising dramatically from rice fields.

Board a traditional sampan boat and glide through interconnected caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave, along with stops at Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

Option 2: Tam Coc Boat Trip

13:30 – Sampan Trip through Tam Coc

Enjoy a 1.5–hour boat excursion through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.” Sail past limestone cliffs, caves, peaceful streams, rice paddies, and serene countryside views. Tam Coc is often called “Ha Long Bay on Land” and offers excellent opportunities for photography.

Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

15:30 – Visit Mua Cave

Begin the climb to the top of Ngoa Long Mountain and enjoy a panoramic view of the vast rice valley and dramatic limestone landscapes.

16:30 – Check-in at Homestay/Bungalow

Relax, swim, or unwind before dinner at 19:00. After dinner, enjoy the peaceful nighttime atmosphere at the poolside bar.

Note: The tour guide will not be present again until the following afternoon.

Morning

Breakfast is served at the bungalow before check-out.

Depart for Ha Long Bay.

11:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Island

Enter the private waiting lounge before boarding the Halong Sonata 5–Star Day Cruise. Begin your 6–hour journey on the iconic two–day sleeper boat route, famous for its uninhabited islets and spectacular limestone formations.

Buffet Lunch on Board

Enjoy a buffet lunch as the cruise glides through the stunning seascape.

Explore the Highlights of Ha Long Bay

14:00 – 16:30 – Bo Hon Archipelago

Visit the Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave), known for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

Continue to Luon Cave, where you may choose between kayaking or a bamboo boat ride through the tranquil lagoon.

Finally, visit Titov Island, where you may relax on the sandy beach or climb to the peak for a breathtaking panoramic view of Ha Long Bay.

Sunset Party on Board

Return to the ship and enjoy live traditional music, a jacuzzi, and time on the sun deck as the cruise returns to Tuan Chau Harbor.

Return to Hanoi

Leave the cruise and board the bus for your return journey to Hanoi.

tours.contentHtml:
This sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days – 2 night in Sapa aiming at: Saving the time, visit the most popular travel sites in Sapa, stay overnight in a good hotel to be comfortable and visit Fansipan peak – “The roof of Indochina”, especially you can enjoy friendly services provided.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village – Sapa

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Departure from Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and begin the journey to Sapa via the Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway, the longest highway in Vietnam.

07:30 – 11:45 – Highway Journey

Travel to Lao Cai City with a comfort break along the way.

11:45 – 13:00 – Mountain Road to Sapa

Enjoy picturesque views of terraced valleys and highland landscapes as you approach Sapa.

13:00 – Arrival in Sapa Town

See ethnic minority groups in their colorful traditional costumes.

  • Welcome drink and tour briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Visit Cat Cat Village

Take a short drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people.

Your local guide will introduce village life, customs, and the daily activities of the locals. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Take photos at the waterfall and bridge before trekking uphill back toward Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

The driver will pick you up and return to Sapa Town.

16:30 – Return to Sapa

Have dinner and spend the night at the hotel. Free time to explore Sapa’s nightlife.

Day 2: Sapa – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – Sunrise & Breakfast

Enjoy the refreshing morning views over Sapa’s mountains, then have breakfast at the hotel.

08:00 – Visit Dragon Cloud, Glass Bridge & O Quy Ho Pass

A sightseeing bus will take you to the Dragon Cloud tourist area, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Your trip includes a stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass (2,333 meters above sea level), one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes, perfect for cloud hunting and panoramic photography.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you will:

  • Take photos at the vibrant outdoor staircase

  • Enjoy the thrilling elevator ride to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge

  • Walk across the three-sided transparent glass bridge (768 meters long, 1,000 meters above the mountain slope)

You may also join optional activities available within the tourist zone.

11:30 – Return to the Hotel

Check out of the hotel.

12:00 – Lunch

Enjoy lunch at the hotel.

13:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Board the bus and return to Hanoi. Stop along the way to rest and shop for local specialties.

Arrive at the bus station. The tour ends.

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu Or Bai Dinh – Cycling To Bich Dong And Thung Nham Bird Valley
tours.summary: Enjoy a full day exploring the cultural, historical, and natural highlights of Ninh Binh. This tour combines visits to ancient temples or a grand pagoda complex with countryside cycling, cave exploration, and the famous
tours.contentHtml:
Enjoy a full day exploring the cultural, historical, and natural highlights of Ninh Binh. This tour combines visits to ancient temples or a grand pagoda complex with countryside cycling, cave exploration, and the famous Thung Nham Bird Valley.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your guide meets you at your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Start the 110–kilometer journey through the peaceful countryside. A short break will be made along the way.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

10:30 – Bai Dinh Pagoda

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the foot of Dinh Mountain, the pagoda features breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone formations.

Highlights include:

  • 500 stone statues of Arhats

  • Two giant bronze bells weighing 27 tons and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:30 – Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Visit the historic ancient capital of Vietnam and explore the Dinh King Temple, dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the early dynasties and admire traditional Vietnamese architecture.

Lunch

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch featuring local specialties, served with a panoramic view of the Tam Coc region.

Cycling and Thung Nham Bird Valley

13:00 – Countryside Cycling to Bich Dong and Thung Nham

Begin an adventurous cycling journey through peaceful villages, green rice fields, and mountain landscapes. Continue to Thung Nham Bird Valley, one of Ninh Binh’s most beautiful natural areas.

Start with a relaxing boat trip to Fairy Water Cave. Then move to the opposite side of the island for another boat trip to observe the diverse bird species such as storks, pelicans, and herons. This is a wonderful opportunity for nature lovers and photographers.

Return to Hanoi

16:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Board the bus and head back to Hanoi.

18:30 – 19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

You will be dropped off at your hotel. The trip ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at a local restaurant with a panoramic view of Tam Coc

  • All entrance fees included in the itinerary

  • Cycling tour

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Electric car at Bai Dinh Pagoda (5 United States Dollars per person)

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19 seats): additional 5 United States Dollars per person

THE PRICE PER PERSON IN USD: 38 $/ PAX

tours.title: Ancient Village And Spiritual Journey
tours.summary: Discover the timeless beauty of Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore northern Vietnam’s spiritual heritage on this full-day cultural journey with Vietlook Travel. This experience takes you through ancient villages, hist
tours.contentHtml:
Discover the timeless beauty of Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore northern Vietnam’s spiritual heritage on this full-day cultural journey with Vietlook Travel. This experience takes you through ancient villages, historic pagodas, and the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam, offering a deep connection to history, culture, and spirituality.

Morning

Pick-up from Hotels in Hanoi’s Old Quarter or Opera House Area

Your private car and English-speaking guide will meet you at your accommodation to begin the day.

Khai Nguyen Pagoda

Visit one of the region’s most peaceful Buddhist sanctuaries. Dating back to the eleventh century, Khai Nguyen Pagoda combines traditional architecture with contemporary elements, creating a serene atmosphere for reflection.

Son Tay Ancient Citadel

Explore the only laterite stone citadel in Vietnam. Built in 1822 during the Minh Mang era, this historic fortress was constructed to protect the northwest approach to Hanoi and remains an important symbol of regional history.

Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese meal featuring fresh, local ingredients.

Afternoon

Đường Lâm Ancient Village

Discover one of the best-preserved traditional villages in Northern Vietnam. Walk through quiet alleyways, admire centuries-old houses, and experience the authentic rhythm of rural life. Key landmarks include:

  • Mong Phu Communal House — A cultural and architectural symbol of the village.

  • Ba Chua Mia Temple — Dedicated to a revered historical figure and known for its spiritual significance.

  • Giang Van Minh’s Tomb — Honoring a prominent Vietnamese diplomat who made notable contributions to national history.

Taste local specialties such as traditional rice wine and “che lam,” a famous countryside snack.

Mia Pagoda

Visit one of Vietnam’s oldest pagodas, home to hundreds of historically valuable Buddhist statues. Mia Pagoda is surrounded by tranquil countryside scenery, making it a meaningful spiritual stop.

Evening

Return to Hanoi and arrive at your hotel or designated drop-off point in the evening.

Tour Highlights

  • Walk through Đường Lâm Ancient Village and explore centuries old traditional houses.

  • Discover Vietnam’s only laterite stone citadel in Son Tay.

  • Visit sacred pagodas and historical landmarks with deep cultural significance.

  • Enjoy a countryside meal and experience authentic local traditions.

Who This Tour Is For

  • Travelers with an interest in history and traditional Vietnamese culture.

  • Visitors seeking a spiritual and cultural experience outside the busy city.

  • Individuals with limited time who want to explore an authentic Vietnamese village in one day.

Tour Includes

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Lunch at Đường Lâm Ancient Village

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

68 Dollars per person

Vietlook Travel is dedicated to offering immersive, meaningful, and authentic cultural journeys throughout Vietnam.

tours.contentHtml:
Discover the highlights of Ninh Binh with a perfect combination of spiritual sites, natural wonders, river grottoes, panoramic mountains, and Vietnam’s oldest national park. This two-day, one-night experience provides a memorable journey through culture, history, and untouched nature.

Itinerary

Day 1: Bai Dinh or Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up in Hanoi

Your tour guide meets you at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer drive through peaceful countryside landscapes. A short break will be made along the way.

Option 1: Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

10:00 – Bai Dinh Pagoda

Visit the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the foot of Dinh Mountain, Bai Dinh offers breathtaking views of river valleys and limestone formations.

Highlights include:

  • 500 stone statues of Arhats

  • Two massive bronze bells weighing 27 and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The majestic Gautama Buddha statue

Option 2: Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu
Explore the former capital of Vietnam and visit the Dinh King Temple, a historic site dating back to the seventeenth century.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese meal featuring regional specialties.

Trang An Grottoes

13:00 – Sampan Boat Trip

Travel to the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its dramatic limestone mountains, tranquil valleys, freshwater ponds, and lush jungle.

Ride a traditional sampan boat through caves such as:

  • Lam Cave

  • Vang Cave

  • Dai Cave

  • Thanh Truot Cave

Along the route, you will also see Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

15:30 – Climb to the Peak

Explore Mua Cave and begin the trek to the top of Ngoa Long Mountain. The summit offers breathtaking panoramic views of rice fields, mountains, and the surrounding nature.

17:00 – Check-In at Homestay or Bungalow

Relax, enjoy the swimming pool, read, or simply unwind before dinner at 19:00.

Note: The tour guide is not available again until the next afternoon.

Day 2: Cuc Phuong National Park – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

Morning

Breakfast is served at the bungalow. After checking out, your guide will take you to Cuc Phuong National Park.

Endangered Primate Rescue Center

Visit the Endangered Primate Rescue Center, home to langurs, monkeys, and gibbons. Here, professional conservation staff work to protect rare species and preserve their natural habitat. This meaningful visit provides insights into Vietnam’s wildlife protection efforts.

Lunch and Jungle Trek

After visiting the center, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant recommended by your guide.

In the afternoon, take a trekking trip deep into the forest to see:

  • The One-Thousand-Year-Old Tree

  • The Prehistoric Man’s Cave (if time permits)

Experience the cool jungle atmosphere and learn about the biodiversity of Vietnam’s oldest national park.

Return to Hanoi

16:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Leave Cuc Phuong and return to Hanoi.

18:30 – 19:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel. The tour ends.

tours.title: Hanoi – Hoa Lu – Cycling – Tam Coc – Mua Cave
tours.summary: Experience the best of Ninh Binh in one full day, combining ancient history, peaceful countryside cycling, a scenic sampan boat trip, and a spectacular viewpoint overlooking rice fields and limestone mountains. Itinerary
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the best of Ninh Binh in one full day, combining ancient history, peaceful countryside cycling, a scenic sampan boat trip, and a spectacular viewpoint overlooking rice fields and limestone mountains.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer bus journey through the beautiful countryside. A short break will be made along the way.

10:30 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Explore Vietnam’s former capital city and visit the Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century. Discover the stories of Vietnam’s early dynasties and admire traditional architecture.

11:30 – Countryside Cycling

Enjoy a leisurely cycling trip along rural paths, passing canal networks, rice fields, and small villages with impressive limestone mountains in the background. This is a wonderful way to experience the peaceful countryside.

12:00 – Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a buffet lunch at a local restaurant, featuring delicious Vietnamese dishes.

13:30 – Tam Coc Sampan Boat Trip

Board a small traditional sampan and begin a 1.5-hour journey through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.”
Admire majestic limestone cliffs, mysterious caves, calm rivers, rice paddies, and peaceful landscapes. This area is often compared to “Ha Long Bay on Land” and is ideal for photography lovers.

15:30 – Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Arrive at Mua Cave and begin an exciting trek up Ngoa Long Mountain. The summit offers breathtaking views of rice fields, rivers, and dramatic limestone formations.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus and begin the return journey.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

You will be dropped off at your hotel. The trip ends.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • A Vietnamese set-menu lunch

  • Entrance fees for Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

  • Shared sampan boat trip in Tam Coc

  • Biking activity

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19 seats): additional 5 United States Dollars per person

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: 100 percent adult price

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

tours.title: Duong Lam Ancient Village – Private Day Tour From Hanoi
tours.summary: Discover the timeless charm of Duong Lam Ancient Village with Vietlook Travel. Located just 50 km from Hanoi, this peaceful heritage village offers an immersive journey into Vietnam’s traditional countryside life. Wander
tours.contentHtml:
Discover the timeless charm of Duong Lam Ancient Village with Vietlook Travel. Located just 50 km from Hanoi, this peaceful heritage village offers an immersive journey into Vietnam’s traditional countryside life. Wander through red-brick lanes, admire ancient laterite houses, learn about local culture, and enjoy authentic rural cuisine prepared by local families.

Highlights Of The Tour

  • Visit traditional houses that are over 400 years old and learn about their unique laterite architecture.

  • Explore Mia Pagoda and several historic communal temples that reflect Vietnam’s spiritual life.

  • Experience daily farming activities or take a leisurely bike ride through picturesque rice fields.

  • Enjoy a countryside lunch prepared with fresh, local ingredients at a family home in the village.

Who This Tour Is Perfect For

This private day trip is ideal for travelers who appreciate culture, photography, history, and authentic local experiences. Families, couples, and small groups will especially enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and hands-on activities.

What’s Included

  • Private car with driver

  • English-speaking local guide

  • Lunch at Duong Lam Ancient Village

  • All entrance fees

Tour Price

55 USD per person

Let Vietlook Travel design a memorable journey for you to Duong Lam Ancient Village. This experience can be arranged as a half-day trip, full-day adventure, or combined with other cultural destinations for a multi-day itinerary.

tours.title: Hoa Lu – Cycling – Trang An – Mua Cave – Tam Coc
tours.summary: Experience the beauty of Ninh Binh with an exciting combination of history, cycling, river exploration, and breathtaking mountain views. This full-day tour offers an ideal blend of adventure and cultural discovery. Itine
tours.contentHtml:
Experience the beauty of Ninh Binh with an exciting combination of history, cycling, river exploration, and breathtaking mountain views. This full-day tour offers an ideal blend of adventure and cultural discovery.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through lush countryside in a modern, comfortable bus. A short break will be made along the way.

10:30 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Explore Vietnam’s ancient capital and visit the Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the history of the Dinh and Le dynasties while admiring traditional architecture.

11:30 – Cycling Experience

Enjoy a leisurely cycling trip along rural roads, passing alongside rivers, canals, rice fields, and small villages surrounded by spectacular limestone mountains. This is an excellent way to immerse yourself in local life and the natural landscape.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Savor a buffet lunch at The Long Restaurant, offering a panoramic view of Tam Coc. The meal features delicious regional Vietnamese cuisine.

13:30 – Explore Trang An Grottoes

Continue to the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its stunning limestone formations.
Board a traditional sampan boat and glide along the river through an enchanting system of caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave. You will also pass Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

15:30 – Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Arrive at Mua Cave and begin the trek up Ngoa Long Mountain. From the summit, enjoy one of the most impressive viewpoints in northern Vietnam, overlooking vast rice fields and dramatic limestone scenery.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus for your journey back to Hanoi.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel or accommodation. The tour concludes.

tours.title: Perfume Pagoda One Day Trip
tours.summary: Embark on a full-day spiritual journey to the Perfume Pagoda, a vast and sacred complex of Buddhist temples and shrines nestled within the limestone mountains of Huong Tich. This tour combines scenic waterways, mountain
tours.contentHtml:
Embark on a full-day spiritual journey to the Perfume Pagoda, a vast and sacred complex of Buddhist temples and shrines nestled within the limestone mountains of Huong Tich. This tour combines scenic waterways, mountain pathways, and a deep insight into Vietnam’s centuries old Buddhist culture.

Itinerary

08:00 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your guide and driver will meet you at your accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. After pick-up, enjoy a peaceful two-hour drive through the countryside toward the Perfume Pagoda.

Boat Trip on the Yen Stream

Upon arrival, board a traditional boat for a one-hour journey along the Yen Stream. The ride offers beautiful views of rice fields, limestone cliffs, and tranquil waterways as you make your way to Thien Tru Harbor.

Visit to Thien Tru Pagoda and Trek to Huong Tich Cave

Once you reach Thien Tru Pagoda, begin your trek toward the Perfume Pagoda complex. Continue your ascent to Huong Tich Cave, located at the top of the mountain. This sacred cave is known for its ancient legends and spiritual relics, including the symbolic “Golden Tree” and “Silver Tree.”

Travelers may choose to trek for approximately one hour or take the optional cable car (fee not included).

Lunch at a Local Restaurant

After your descent, enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant at the base of the mountain.

Heaven Kitchen Pagoda (Thien Tru Pagoda Complex)

Following lunch, visit the Heaven Kitchen Pagoda, an important historical site displaying Buddhist architecture from the Le Dynasty. Learn about its cultural significance before returning to your boat.

Return to Hanoi

Re-board the boat for the return trip, followed by a comfortable two-hour drive back to Hanoi.

The tour concludes with drop-off at your hotel at approximately 18:00.

What Is Included

  • Full transfers by air-conditioned private car

  • Boat trip on the Yen Stream

  • Entrance fees

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • English-speaking guide

Tour Price

68 USD per person

Vietlook Travel is committed to offering meaningful cultural experiences, combining comfort, authenticity, and expert guidance throughout your journey.

tours.title: Ninh Binh Discovery: Hoa Lu – Bai Dinh Pagoda – Mua Cave
tours.summary: Explore the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Ninh Binh on this full-day tour. From ancient temples to towering limestone mountains and serene river landscapes, this experience offers an unforgettable glimpse of no
tours.contentHtml:
Explore the natural beauty and cultural heritage of Ninh Binh on this full-day tour. From ancient temples to towering limestone mountains and serene river landscapes, this experience offers an unforgettable glimpse of northern Vietnam.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:40 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through the peaceful countryside in a modern, comfortable bus. A short break will be made en route.

10:00 – Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda Complex

Arrive at Bai Dinh, the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. Located at the base of Dinh Mountain, the complex offers breathtaking views of valleys, rivers, and limestone formations.

Explore several remarkable highlights of this impressive Buddhist complex:

  • 500 stone statues of “La Han” (Arhats)

  • Two giant bronze bells weighing 27 and 36 tons

  • The thousand-eyed, thousand-armed Quan Yin statue

  • The massive Gautama Buddha statue

This area is so large it requires a full day to explore in depth. During this tour, you will visit the most significant and culturally important landmarks.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a buffet-style meal featuring delicious regional Vietnamese cuisine.

13:30 – Explore Trang An Grottoes

Continue to the stunning Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This area features a majestic limestone mountain system covering 20 square kilometers. Hidden among the cliffs are serene valleys, freshwater ponds, and lush forests.
Board a traditional sampan boat and gently float along the river as you pass through impressive caves such as Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, and Thanh Truot Cave. You will also see Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, and Vu Lam Temple.

15:30 – Visit Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain

Start your trek up Ngoa Long Mountain, where the viewpoint offers one of the most spectacular views in northern Vietnam. From the summit, admire panoramic scenery of rice fields, rivers, and limestone peaks.

16:30 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus for the return journey.

18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

Drop-off at your hotel in the Old Quarter. The tour concludes.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at a local restaurant

  • All entrance fees listed in the itinerary

    • Hướng dẫn viên theo đoàn suốt tuyến tại Sài Gòn.
    • Khách sạn trung tâm, đầy đủ tiện nghi. Giờ nhận phòng sớm nhất từ 14h00, trả phòng muộn nhất 12h00. Tiêu chuẩn nghỉ 02 khách người lớn/ 1 phòng. Nếu lẻ nam hoặc nữ ngủ ghép 3 khách/ 1 phòng. Nếu quý khách không đồng ý ngủ ghép, yêu cầu đóng phụ thu phòng đơn.
      • Sài Gòn: Khách sạn 3* hoặc tương đương.
      • Vũng Tàu: Khách sạn 3* hoặc tương đương.
    • Ăn sáng 03 bữa theo tiêu chuẩn tại khách sạn.
    • Ăn chính: 06 bữa theo tiêu chuẩn:
      •  Mức ăn tại Sài Gòn: 180.000vnd/người/bữa
      • Mức ăn tại Vũng Tàu: 150.000vnd/người/bữa
    • Vé tham quan tại các điểm theo chương trình.
    • Bảo hiểm du lịch, mức đền bù 120.000.000đ/ 1 trường hợp.
    • Nước uống theo chương trình 01 chai 500ml/ngày/khách.
    • Mũ du lịch.

    • Chi phí cá nhân không nằm trong chương trình
    • Một bữa ăn tự túc vào tối ngày 3.
    • Các trò chơi tại KDL Đại Nam
    • Chi phí phòng đơn (nếu có).
    • Thuế VAT 8%
    • Tiền TIP cho hướng dẫn viên (nếu có)
    • Giá tour trẻ em: Áp dụng theo bảng giá. Độ tuổi sẽ được tính từ ngày sinh đến ngày khởi hành.

Trẻ em từ đủ 10 tuổi trở lên tiêu chuẩn như người lớn

    • Từ đủ 5 đến dưới 10 tuổi( cao dưới 1.2m) : Tiêu chuẩn ăn ½ suất, ngồi 1 ghế ô tô, ngủ ghép chung với bố mẹ.Gia đình 2 trẻ trong độ tuổi 5-10 tuổi, sẽ áp dụng chính sách:1 trẻ em suất 5-10 tuổi, trẻ thứ 2 tính 100% chi phí như người lớn. Vì tính chất đoàn ghép khách lẻ – để tránh ảnh hưởng tới chất lượng dịch vụ của đoàn, chính sách với trẻ em thứ 2 được nâng lên để phù hợp với các thành viên trong đoàn.
    • Từ đủ 2 đến dưới 5 tuổi: Giá tour chỉ bao gồm vé máy bay, bảo hiểm, nước uống. Các chi phí ăn uống, vé thắng cảnh nếu phát sinh, cha mẹ sẽ tự lo cho bé.
    • Dưới 2 tuổi: Giá tour chỉ bao gồm chỗ ngồi trên máy bay theo quy định của hàng không, bảo hiểm, nước uống.

tours.contentHtml:
Giá Tour: 5.290.000VND/Khách

Bao gồm:

    • Xe ô tô du lịch chất lượng tốt, máy lạnh, lái xe nhiệt tình
    • Hướng dẫn viên nói tiếng Việt kiến thức, nhiệt tình và chuyên nghiệp
    • 04 đêm khách sạn tiêu chuẩn 3 sao, ngủ 02 khách/phòng

    • 04 bữa sáng buffet hoặc tô ly theo tiêu chuẩn của từng khách sạn
    • Vé thăm quan: Đại Nội Huế, Hội An
    • Nước lọc tinh khiết: 01 chai 500ml / khách / ngày
    • Quà tặng: Mũ Liên Minh Tour Ghép
    • Quà tặng: Gói bảo hiểm du lịch mức đền bù tối đa 120 triệu đồng / người / vụ

Không bao gồm:

    • Hóa đơn thuế GTGT.
    • Vé cáp treo Bà Nà khứ hồi và bữa ăn trưa trên Bà Nà (ăn đồ ăn nhanh hoặc ăn buffet):
    • Riêng vé cáp treo: người lớn 600.000đ, trẻ em (1m-1m4) 500.00đ
    • Nếu đặt combo vé cáp + ăn buffet: người lớn 950.00đ, trẻ em (1m-1m4) 700.000đ
    • Trẻ dưới 1m miễn phí cả vé cáp và vé ăn buffet nếu đi cùng người lớn
    • Khách nước ngoài giá vé cao hơn khách Việt Nam 300.000đ/khách
    • Chi phí mua vòng hoa viếng mộ đại tướng Võ Nguyên Giáp (nếu có nhu cầu)
    • Chi phí đi thuyền rồng nghe ca Huế (nếu đăng ký)
    • Chi phí du thuyền sông Hàn (nếu đăng ký)
    • Chi phí chơi trượt cát
    • Các chi phí cá nhân, giặt là, điện thoại…
    • Phụ thu khách nước ngoài: 1.000.000đ/khách (nhận tối thiểu từ 2 khách)
    • Tiền tip cho lái xe và hướng dẫn viên

Trẻ em (cần đọc kỹ để nắm rõ về tiêu chuẩn của trẻ em):

    • Trẻ em từ 1-4 tuổi miễn phí (bố mẹ tự lo mọi chi phí cho trẻ, không chiếm chỗ trên xe). 02 người lớn chỉ được kèm theo 01 trẻ miễn phí, từ trẻ thứ 2 tính 75% giá tour (tiêu chuẩn như trẻ em tính phí). Nếu 01 người lớn đi kèm 01 trẻ từ 1-4 tuổi thì trẻ phải mua 50% giá tour của người lớn (được hưởng chỗ ngồi riêng trên xe ô tô, nửa suất ăn của người lớn và các dịch vụ khác bao gồm trong tour).
    • Trẻ em từ 5-9 tuổi tính 75% giá tour (ăn suất riêng, chỗ ngồi trên xe riêng).
    • Lưu ý: Đã là trẻ em (dù mua 50% hay 75%) đều không có tiêu chuẩn giường ngủ, phải ngủ ghép cùng gia đình. Hai trẻ hay nhiều trẻ cũng không được tính gộp lại tương đương với một người lớn để tính giường ngủ.
    • Trẻ em từ 10 tuổi trở lên: Giá tour tính như người lớn.

tours.contentHtml:
GIÁ TOUR TRỌN GÓI: 2.390.000Đ/ KHÁCH

(giá áp dụng cho khách ghép lẻ)

GIÁ TOUR BAO GỒM

    • Xe ô tô 16 đến 45 chỗ chất lượng cao (tùy số lượng khách thực tế) đưa đón theo chương trình.
    • Lưu trú: 02 đêm ngủ theo tiêu chuẩn đăng ký

    • (Quý khách có thể nâng hạng ở phòng riêng khép kín, có điều hoà tại khu sinh thái Ba Bể, phụ thu 100.000đ/khách.)
    • 05 bữa ăn chính theo chương trình, mức ăn tiêu chuẩn 130.000đ/suất
    • 02 bữa sáng theo tiêu chuẩn của khách sạn hoặc mức ăn 35.000đ/suất tại nhà hàng

    • Thuyền thăm quan Hồ Ba Bể
    • Hướng dẫn viên phục vụ nhiệt tình, thành thạo, chu đáo xuyên suốt tuyến du lịch
    • Nước uống phục vụ trên xe, mỗi ngày 01 chai 500ml.
    • Bảo hiểm Du lịch: Mức đền bù tối đa 30 triệu/người

DỊCH VỤ KHÔNG BAO GỒM:

    • Chi phí cá nhân (giặt là, nước uống trong các bữa ăn…)
    • Thuế VAT 8 %.
    • Chênh lệch tiền vé thắng cảnh (nếu có) tại thời điểm Quý khách đi tour so với thời điểm đặt tour. Điều này rất mong Quý khách hiểu, thông cảm và thực hiện theo quy định.
    • Tip lái xe + Hướng dẫn viên.

tours.contentHtml:
Khách sạn Havana Nha Trang đạt tiêu chuẩn 5 sao, tọa lạc ngay cạnh biển với sự thiết kế sang trong, tất cả các phòng có tầm view hướng biển, và có các dịch vụ giải trí, ẩm thực hấp dẫn, ngoài ra khách sạn Havana còn có bể bơi riêng, có phòng họp rộng rãi thoảng mát, du khách có thể tổ chức các buổi họp các sự kiện tất niên, hay buổi gladiner…

 

  

 

  

  

 

COMBO BAO GỒM:

    • Xe riêng đưa đón bay theo giờ Quý khách chọn (từ sân bay Cam Ranh đến khách sạn và ngược lại).
    • 2 đêm nghỉ tại phòng Deluxe khách sạn 5* Havana (2 người/ phòng)
    • Vé ngắm cảnh thành phố Nha Trang tại 360 Skydeck – Skylight Havana Nha Trang (buổi sáng).
    • Vé Tắm bùn khoáng nóng & công viên nước tại I resort (hoặc Vé Massage body 60p).
    •  2 bữa sáng buffet tại khách sạn 5 sao Havana.
    • Sử dụng bể bơi miễn phí
    • Nước suối, trà, café đặt trong phòng hàng ngày cho khách.
    • Miễn phí truy cập Wifi toàn khuôn viên.
    • Nhận phòng sau 14h00 và trả phòng trước 12h00.
    • Đã bao gồm thuế, phí tại khách sạn

DỊCH VỤ CHƯA BAO GỒM

    • Phí nhận phòng sớm và trả phòng muộn theo quy định của khách sạn.
    • Các chi phí cá nhân như điện thoại, giặt là, đồ uống.
    • Các chi phí khác không bao gồm trong chương trình.
    •  Phụ thu phòng đơn

GIÁ TRẺ EM

    • Dưới 02 tuổi:  Theo chính sách từng gói (ngủ chung phòng với bố mẹ).
    • Từ 2 – 5 tuổi: Theo chính sách từng gói (ngủ chung với bố mẹ).
    • Từ 6 – 11 tuổi: Theo chính sách từng gói combo.
    • Trên 11 tuổi:  Như người lớn.

posts.title: Must Try Local Specialties In Ninh Binh You Should Not Miss
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh is not only famous for its breathtaking landscapes but also for its rich and distinctive cuisine. Influenced by local ingredients, traditional cooking methods, and regional culture, Ninh Bin
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh is not only famous for its breathtaking landscapes but also for its rich and distinctive cuisine. Influenced by local ingredients, traditional cooking methods, and regional culture, Ninh Binh’s food offers a unique culinary experience that every traveler should explore.

If you are planning a trip, here are the must try specialties that will make your journey even more memorable.

Ninh Binh Goat Meat (Dê Núi)

Goat meat is the most iconic dish of Ninh Binh and a highlight of local cuisine. The goats are raised freely on limestone mountains, which gives the meat a firm texture and naturally rich flavor.

There are many ways to enjoy goat meat, including grilled goat, steamed goat, goat hotpot, and rare goat with lemon. It is often served with fresh herbs and a special dipping sauce made from fermented soybean paste, creating a bold and unforgettable taste.

Crispy Rice (Cơm Cháy)

Cơm cháy is another famous specialty that you should not miss. This dish is made from fried rice crust, creating a crispy and golden texture.

It is typically served with a savory sauce made from pork, beef, or goat meat. The combination of crunchy rice and rich sauce makes it a popular dish among both locals and tourists.

Cơm cháy is also a popular souvenir that travelers can take home.

Mountain Snails (Ốc Núi)

Mountain snails are a unique and seasonal delicacy found in limestone areas.

They are typically prepared by steaming with lemongrass or stir-frying with herbs. The meat is chewy and slightly sweet, offering a distinctive taste that reflects the natural environment of Ninh Binh.

Eel Vermicelli (Miến Lươn)

Eel vermicelli is a flavorful dish that combines soft glass noodles with well-seasoned eel.

The eel is usually stir-fried or served in a light broth, creating a balance between richness and freshness. This dish is both nutritious and satisfying, making it a great choice for a local meal.

Freshwater Fish Dishes

With its dense river system, Ninh Binh offers a variety of freshwater fish dishes. Fish can be grilled, braised, or cooked in soups, preserving their natural sweetness.

These dishes are simple yet flavorful, reflecting the local cooking style.

Fermented Pork Roll (Nem Yên Mạc)

Nem Yên Mạc is a traditional fermented pork dish originating from Yên Mạc village.

The pork is finely processed, mixed with spices, and wrapped in leaves to ferment naturally. The result is a mildly sour, aromatic dish often served with herbs and dipping sauce.

Burnt Fermented Pork (Thịt Cháy Cạnh)

This traditional dish features pork that is slightly charred on the outside, creating a smoky aroma while remaining tender inside.

It is often served with rice and dipping sauce, offering a rich and satisfying flavor.

Where to Enjoy Ninh Binh Cuisine

Local restaurants in Tam Coc, Trang An, and Ninh Binh city are great places to try these specialties.

For a more authentic experience, travelers can also dine at local eateries or homestays, where dishes are prepared using traditional recipes.

Travel Tips for Food Lovers

Try different cooking styles of the same dish, especially goat meat.

Choose reputable restaurants to ensure food quality and hygiene.

Combine food experiences with sightseeing for a more complete journey.

posts.title: Best Time To Visit Ninh Binh: A Complete Seasonal Guide
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh is a year-round destination, but each season offers a different experience in terms of landscape, weather, and activities. Choosing the right time to visit depends on what you want to see, f
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh is a year-round destination, but each season offers a different experience in terms of landscape, weather, and activities. Choosing the right time to visit depends on what you want to see, from golden rice fields to blooming lotus ponds or cool weather for exploration. Below is a detailed guide to help you decide the best time to travel to Ninh Binh.

May to June: The Most Beautiful Season (Golden Rice Fields & Lotus Bloom)

This is widely considered the best time to visit Ninh Binh.

During this period, the rice fields in Tam Coc turn a brilliant golden color as they reach harvest season. The scenery becomes incredibly picturesque, especially when viewed from a boat along the Ngo Dong River or from the top of Hang Mua.

At the same time, lotus flowers begin to bloom across the region, adding soft pink hues to the landscape. The combination of golden rice fields and lotus ponds creates one of the most iconic views in Northern Vietnam.

September to October: Pleasant Weather and Fewer Crowds

Autumn is another excellent time to visit Ninh Binh. The weather becomes cooler, drier, and more comfortable for outdoor activities.

Although the rice fields are not as vibrant as in early summer, the natural scenery remains beautiful and peaceful. This is an ideal time for travelers who prefer a quieter experience with fewer tourists.

November to April: Cool Climate and Cultural Exploration

From late autumn to early spring, Ninh Binh experiences cooler temperatures, making it suitable for sightseeing and exploring historical sites.

This is a great time to visit places like Hoa Lu Ancient Capital and Bai Dinh Pagoda, where the focus is more on culture and spirituality rather than seasonal landscapes.

However, the scenery may appear less vibrant compared to summer months.

July to August: Lush Green Landscapes

During mid-summer, the rice fields return to a fresh green color after planting season. The landscapes are full of life, and the vegetation is at its most vibrant.

However, this period can include occasional rain, so travel plans should be flexible. Despite this, it is still a good time for photography and nature lovers.

When Should You Visit Ninh Binh?

If you are looking for the most scenic and photogenic landscapes, May to June is the ideal time.

If you prefer cooler weather and fewer crowds, September to October is a great choice.

For cultural exploration and a quieter atmosphere, November to April is suitable.

Travel Tips for Choosing the Right Season

Check weather conditions before planning your trip, especially during rainy months.

Book accommodation early if traveling during peak seasons such as May and June.

Plan activities based on seasonal highlights like rice fields or lotus blooms.

Whether you are drawn to golden rice fields, peaceful boat rides, or cultural landmarks, Ninh Binh always offers something unique and memorable. Planning your trip at the right time will help you fully experience the beauty of this remarkable destination.

posts.title: The Best Lotus Viewing Spots In Ninh Binh
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh is not only famous for its limestone landscapes and rivers but also for its stunning lotus ponds that bloom beautifully during the summer months. From May to July, the region transforms into
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh is not only famous for its limestone landscapes and rivers but also for its stunning lotus ponds that bloom beautifully during the summer months. From May to July, the region transforms into a peaceful paradise filled with soft pink lotus flowers, creating a romantic and photogenic atmosphere.

If you are planning to visit Ninh Binh during lotus season, here are the most beautiful places to enjoy and capture this unique natural beauty.

Hang Mua Lotus Pond

Hang Mua is one of the most popular lotus viewing spots in Ninh Binh. Located at the foot of Mua Mountain, the large lotus pond creates a picturesque setting surrounded by limestone cliffs.

During blooming season, the pond is covered with pink lotus flowers, offering a perfect foreground for the iconic mountain backdrop. Visitors can combine lotus viewing with climbing to the top of Hang Mua for panoramic views of Tam Coc.

Tam Coc Lotus Fields

Tam Coc is well-known for its scenic boat rides, but in summer, it becomes even more attractive thanks to its vast lotus fields.

As you glide along the Ngo Dong River, you will pass through areas filled with blooming lotus, creating a peaceful and immersive experience. The combination of water, mountains, and flowers makes this one of the most memorable sights in Ninh Binh.

Trang An Lotus Areas

Although Trang An is primarily known for its caves and river system, some areas also feature lotus ponds during the summer.

While not as concentrated as in Tam Coc or Hang Mua, the lotus here adds an extra layer of beauty to the already stunning landscape.

Van Long Nature Reserve

Van Long offers a quieter and more natural setting for lotus viewing. During the blooming season, lotus flowers appear across parts of the wetland, blending harmoniously with the calm water and limestone mountains.

This is an ideal location for travelers who prefer a peaceful and less crowded environment.

Thai Vi Temple Area

Near Tam Coc, the Thai Vi Temple area is surrounded by natural landscapes where lotus flowers bloom in small ponds and fields.

This location combines cultural and natural elements, offering a serene atmosphere for both sightseeing and photography.

Bich Dong Pagoda Surroundings

The area around Bich Dong Pagoda features small lotus ponds that enhance the tranquil and spiritual setting of the temple.

Visitors can enjoy a quiet walk, admire the flowers, and explore the pagoda nestled in the mountains.

Best Time to See Lotus in Ninh Binh

The lotus season typically lasts from May to July, with peak bloom occurring in June.

Early morning is the best time to visit, when the flowers are fully open and the light is soft, creating ideal conditions for photography.

Travel Tips for Lotus Season

Wear light and comfortable clothing suitable for summer weather.

Bring a hat, sunscreen, and water to stay protected from the sun.

Respect the flowers by avoiding stepping into lotus ponds or picking them.

Visit early in the day to avoid crowds and heat.

From famous spots like Hang Mua and Tam Coc to quieter locations like Van Long, each destination offers a different perspective on the beauty of lotus flowers. Visiting during this season will give you a truly memorable and visually captivating experience.

posts.title: Travel Guide To Van Long Nature Reserve
posts.excerpt: Van Long Nature Reserve is one of the most tranquil and unspoiled destinations in Ninh Binh. Known as the largest wetland reserve in Northern Vietnam, Van Long offers a unique combination of limestone
posts.contentHtml:
Van Long Nature Reserve is one of the most tranquil and unspoiled destinations in Ninh Binh. Known as the largest wetland reserve in Northern Vietnam, Van Long offers a unique combination of limestone mountains, calm waterways, and rich biodiversity.

For travelers seeking a quieter alternative to more crowded attractions like Trang An or Tam Coc, Van Long is an ideal choice. Below is a comprehensive guide to help you plan a smooth and meaningful visit.

Why Visit Van Long Nature Reserve?

Van Long stands out for its peaceful atmosphere and natural beauty. The water here is exceptionally calm and clear, often reflecting the surrounding limestone mountains like a mirror.

Unlike more commercialized destinations, Van Long retains a sense of authenticity and simplicity. It is also home to rare wildlife, including the endangered Delacour’s langur, making it an important ecological site.

Best Time to Visit Van Long

The best time to visit Van Long is from May to June and September to October.

During late spring and early summer, the landscape is lush and vibrant, with lotus flowers blooming across the wetlands. In autumn, the weather is cooler and more comfortable for outdoor activities.

Late afternoon is highly recommended, as this is when birds return to the reserve, creating a lively and scenic atmosphere.

How to Get to Van Long

Van Long is located about 80 kilometers from Hanoi and around 20 kilometers from Ninh Binh city.

Travelers can reach the area by private car, motorbike, or bus. For convenience and safety, many visitors choose to join guided tours or hire a car with a driver.

The roads are relatively easy compared to mountainous regions, making the journey accessible for most travelers.

What to Experience at Van Long

Traditional Boat Ride

The highlight of Van Long is a peaceful boat trip through the wetlands. Local rowers guide visitors along narrow waterways, passing through caves and along towering limestone cliffs.

The calm water creates stunning reflections, making this experience both relaxing and visually impressive.

Wildlife Watching

Van Long is one of the best places in Vietnam to observe wildlife in its natural habitat. If you are lucky, you may spot Delacour’s langurs on the cliffs.

Birdwatching is also a popular activity, especially in the late afternoon.

Cave Exploration

Several natural caves can be explored by boat, each with unique formations and a mysterious atmosphere.

Travel Tips for Visiting Van Long

Wear comfortable clothing and bring sun protection, as there is limited shade during the boat ride.

Visit early in the morning or late in the afternoon to avoid heat and enjoy the best lighting for photography.

Bring cash for tickets and small purchases, as electronic payments may not be available.

Respect the natural environment by not littering and avoiding loud noise that could disturb wildlife.

Suggested Itinerary for a Half-Day Trip

Morning or afternoon visit to Van Long for a boat tour lasting about 1.5 to 2 hours.
Combine the trip with nearby attractions such as Bai Dinh Pagoda or Trang An for a full-day itinerary.

With the right preparation and timing, your visit to Van Long will become one of the most memorable highlights of your journey in Ninh Binh.

posts.title: Top Tourist Attractions In Ninh Binh, Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh, often referred to as “Halong Bay on land,” is one of the most captivating destinations in Northern Vietnam. Located just a few hours from Hanoi, this region is famous for its limestone kars
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh, often referred to as “Halong Bay on land,” is one of the most captivating destinations in Northern Vietnam. Located just a few hours from Hanoi, this region is famous for its limestone karst landscapes, winding rivers, ancient temples, and rich cultural heritage.

Whether you are interested in nature, history, or cultural exploration, Ninh Binh offers a wide range of attractions that cater to every type of traveler.

Trang An Landscape Complex

Trang An is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most iconic destinations in Ninh Binh. The area is known for its network of rivers flowing through limestone mountains and caves.

Visitors can take a traditional boat ride guided by local rowers, passing through caves, temples, and scenic valleys. The peaceful atmosphere and untouched beauty make Trang An a must-visit destination.

Tam Coc – Bich Dong

Often called “Halong Bay on land,” Tam Coc is famous for its picturesque river journey through rice fields and limestone formations.

A boat trip along the Ngo Dong River takes visitors through three natural caves, offering a unique perspective of the surrounding landscape. Nearby, Bich Dong Pagoda adds a cultural and spiritual element to the experience.

Mua Cave (Hang Mua)

Hang Mua is one of the best places in Ninh Binh for panoramic views. After climbing nearly 500 stone steps, visitors are rewarded with a breathtaking view of Tam Coc and its surrounding rice fields.

The viewpoint, marked by a dragon statue, is especially popular for sunrise and sunset photography.

Bai Dinh Pagoda

Bai Dinh is the largest pagoda complex in Vietnam and an important spiritual destination.

The site features massive Buddha statues, long corridors lined with stone statues, and impressive architecture that blends traditional and modern elements. It is a peaceful place for both sightseeing and cultural exploration.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Hoa Lu was the capital of Vietnam in the 10th and 11th centuries. Today, it remains an important historical site with temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le.

Visitors can explore ancient architecture and learn about Vietnam’s early dynasties while enjoying the surrounding mountainous scenery.

Van Long Nature Reserve

Van Long is the largest wetland nature reserve in Northern Vietnam and a perfect destination for those seeking tranquility.

A boat ride here offers a chance to see diverse wildlife, including rare langurs, as well as stunning reflections of limestone mountains on calm water.

Thung Nham Bird Park

Thung Nham is an eco-tourism area known for its rich biodiversity and bird sanctuary.

Visitors can explore caves, gardens, and especially the bird area, where thousands of birds return to nest in the late afternoon. It is an ideal destination for nature lovers.

Cuc Phuong National Park

As Vietnam’s oldest national park, Cuc Phuong is a great destination for trekking and wildlife exploration.

The park is home to diverse flora and fauna, ancient trees, and conservation centers for endangered species. It is especially popular for eco-tourism and educational trips.

Am Tien Cave (Tuyet Tinh Coc)

Often called “the hidden gem of Ninh Binh,” Am Tien Cave features a peaceful lake surrounded by steep limestone cliffs.

The area offers a quiet and scenic escape, with a mystical atmosphere that attracts visitors looking for unique photo opportunities.

Travel Tips for Visiting Ninh Binh

The best time to visit is from May to June (green rice fields) or September to October (golden harvest season).

Wear comfortable clothing and shoes for walking and climbing.

Bring sunscreen, water, and a camera to capture the stunning scenery.

Consider staying overnight to fully explore the region.

posts.title: Exciting Experiences At Silver Waterfall In Sapa
posts.excerpt: Located about 12 kilometers from Sapa town along the road to O Quy Ho Pass, Silver Waterfall is one of the most impressive natural attractions in the region. Cascading from a height of over 200 meters
posts.contentHtml:
Located about 12 kilometers from Sapa town along the road to O Quy Ho Pass, Silver Waterfall is one of the most impressive natural attractions in the region. Cascading from a height of over 200 meters, the waterfall creates a powerful stream that resembles a shimmering white ribbon flowing down the mountain.

For travelers exploring Sapa, Thác Bạc offers not only scenic beauty but also a range of memorable outdoor experiences.

Admiring the Majestic Waterfall

The first and most striking experience at Silver Waterfall is simply taking in its raw beauty. From a distance, the waterfall appears like a silver stream cutting through the lush green mountainside.

As you get closer, the sound of rushing water becomes louder, creating an immersive natural atmosphere. The mist rising from the falls adds a refreshing coolness, especially enjoyable during the summer months.

Climbing to the Viewing Points

A stone stairway leads visitors up along the waterfall, offering multiple viewpoints at different heights.

From these elevated spots, you can enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, valleys, and forests. The higher you climb, the more impressive the scenery becomes, making it a rewarding experience for those who enjoy light hiking.

Photography and Scenic Checkpoints

Silver Waterfall is a favorite destination for photography enthusiasts. The combination of flowing water, mountain landscapes, and mist creates dramatic and visually appealing scenes.

Early morning or late afternoon is the best time to capture photos, when the lighting is softer and the atmosphere is more tranquil.

Enjoying the Cool Mountain Climate

Even during summer, the area around Thác Bạc remains cool and refreshing. The waterfall’s mist and the surrounding forest create a natural air-conditioning effect.

This makes it an ideal stop for relaxation after exploring Sapa town or trekking through nearby villages.

Exploring O Quy Ho Pass Nearby

One of the highlights of visiting Silver Waterfall is its proximity to O Quy Ho Pass, one of the most famous mountain passes in Vietnam.

After visiting the waterfall, travelers can continue their journey along the pass to enjoy breathtaking views of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range. This route is especially popular for scenic drives and photography.

Experiencing Local Culture

Around the waterfall area, visitors may encounter small stalls run by local ethnic communities. These stalls offer handmade products, local snacks, and herbal items.

Engaging with local vendors provides a glimpse into daily life and adds a cultural dimension to the visit.

Travel Tips for Visiting Silver Waterfall

Wear comfortable shoes with good grip, as the steps can be slippery due to moisture.
Be cautious when climbing, especially during rainy days.
Bring a light jacket, as the area can be cooler than Sapa town.
Keep the environment clean and respect the natural surroundings.

Discover Sapa with Vietlook Travel

Vietlook Travel offers well-planned Sapa tours that include visits to Silver Waterfall along with other top attractions such as Fansipan Mountain and Muong Hoa Valley.

With professional service and carefully designed itineraries, Vietlook Travel ensures a smooth and enriching experience for travelers looking to explore the natural beauty of Sapa.

Silver Waterfall is more than just a scenic stop; it is a place where nature, fresh air, and mountain landscapes come together to create a memorable experience.

Whether you are seeking relaxation, photography opportunities, or a deeper connection with nature, Thác Bạc is a destination worth including in your Sapa journey.

posts.title: Sapa Summer Travel Guide: What To Eat, Where To Stay
posts.excerpt: Sapa in summer offers a refreshing escape with cool weather, lush green rice terraces, and rich cultural experiences. This is the perfect time to explore the natural beauty of Northern Vietnam while e
posts.contentHtml:
Sapa in summer offers a refreshing escape with cool weather, lush green rice terraces, and rich cultural experiences. This is the perfect time to explore the natural beauty of Northern Vietnam while enjoying local cuisine and authentic village life.

Whether you are planning a short getaway or a longer journey, understanding what to eat, where to stay, and how to plan your itinerary will help you make the most of your trip.

What to Eat in Sapa During Summer

Sapa’s cuisine reflects the lifestyle of ethnic communities, focusing on fresh ingredients and bold mountain flavors. Summer is an excellent time to enjoy both grilled dishes and light, refreshing meals.

Grilled Specialties

Grilled food is a signature experience in Sapa. Popular options include grilled pork skewers, chicken, and fresh vegetables cooked over charcoal. The smoky flavor combined with local spices creates a unique taste.

Salmon and Sturgeon Hotpot

Thanks to the cool climate, Sapa is famous for its fresh-water salmon and sturgeon. Hotpot dishes are a must-try, offering a rich yet balanced flavor, perfect even during cooler summer evenings.

Thang Co

A traditional dish of the Hmong people, Thang Co is a hearty stew made with meat and local herbs. While it may be unfamiliar to some travelers, it is an authentic cultural experience.

Sticky Rice and Local Dishes

Sticky rice, bamboo-cooked rice, and simple vegetable dishes are widely available. These meals highlight the natural flavors of the region.

Where to Stay in Sapa

Choosing the right accommodation can significantly enhance your travel experience.

Hotels in Sapa Town

Ideal for travelers who prefer convenience, easy access to restaurants, and modern amenities.

Mountain View Resorts

Resorts located on hillsides offer panoramic views of valleys and rice terraces. These are suitable for relaxation and a more premium experience.

Homestays in Local Villages

For a deeper cultural experience, staying in villages such as Ta Van, Lao Chai, or Ta Phin is highly recommended. Homestays provide a chance to interact with local communities and enjoy traditional meals.

Suggested Itinerary: Sapa 2 Days 1 Night

Day 1: Arrival and Exploration

  • Arrive in Sapa from Hanoi and check in to your accommodation.
  • Visit Cat Cat Village to explore local culture and traditional crafts.
  • In the afternoon, enjoy the scenic views of Muong Hoa Valley.
  • In the evening, explore Sapa town and try local street food.

Day 2: Nature and Departure

  • Start early and visit Fansipan Mountain via cable car for panoramic views.
  • Explore nearby attractions or local markets.
  • Return to Hanoi in the afternoon.

Suggested Itinerary: Sapa 3 Days 2 Nights

Day 1: Arrival and Town Discovery

  • Arrive in Sapa, check in, and explore Sapa town.
  • Visit the local market and enjoy local cuisine.

Day 2: Trekking and Village Experience

  • Trek through Lao Chai and Ta Van villages.
  • Enjoy rice terrace views and experience local daily life.
  • Stay overnight at a homestay for a more immersive experience.

Day 3: Nature and Relaxation

  • Visit waterfalls such as Silver Waterfall or Love Waterfall.
  • Enjoy a relaxed morning before returning to Hanoi.

Travel Tips for Sapa in Summer

  • Start your day early to avoid rain and enjoy clearer views.
  • Bring proper trekking shoes and rain protection.
  • Book accommodation in advance during peak travel periods.
  • Respect local customs when visiting ethnic villages.
