Ninh Van Bay offers a delightful culinary experience, combining fresh seafood with traditional Nha Trang flavors.

  • Jellyfish Noodle Soup (Bun Sua): A signature dish of Nha Trang, featuring fresh jellyfish, fish cake, fish roe, and a light, flavorful broth.

  • Fish Cake Thick Noodle Soup (Banh Canh Cha Ca): A comforting dish made with chewy noodles and naturally sweet fish cake.

  • Fresh Seafood: Lobster, crab, squid, clams, and fish are freshly caught and prepared to order—grilled, steamed, or stir-fried.

  • Anchovy Salad (Goi Ca Mai): A refreshing local specialty made with fresh anchovies, herbs, peanuts, and a tangy dipping sauce.

  • Nha Trang Grilled Fermented Pork Rolls (Nem Nuong): Served with rice paper, herbs, and signature dipping sauce, this iconic dish is a must-try.

Important Tips For A One Day Ninh Van Bay Trip

  • Best Time To Visit: March to September offers sunny weather and calm seas.

  • Book In Advance: Reserve speedboat transfers and water activities during peak seasons.

  • Pack Essentials: Sunscreen, swimwear, sunglasses, hats, and a camera are essential.

  • Protect The Environment: Do not litter, avoid touching corals, and respect marine life.

Final Thoughts

Ninh Van Bay Nha Trang is a true coastal paradise, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, adventure, relaxation, and culinary delights. Whether you are snorkeling among coral reefs, enjoying fresh seafood, or simply unwinding on a secluded beach, a one-day Ninh Van Bay tour will undoubtedly be a highlight of your Nha Trang journey.

posts.title: The Ultimate Self Guided Travel Guide To Monkey Island Nha Trang
posts.excerpt: Monkey Island Nha Trang, also known as Hon Lao Island, is a must-visit destination for travelers who love nature, wildlife, and unique island experiences. Famous for its fresh air, unspoiled scenery,
posts.contentHtml:
Monkey Island Nha Trang, also known as Hon Lao Island, is a must-visit destination for travelers who love nature, wildlife, and unique island experiences. Famous for its fresh air, unspoiled scenery, and thousands of playful monkeys, the island offers an unforgettable day trip just outside Nha Trang city.

This comprehensive guide provides everything you need to know for a self-guided trip to Monkey Island in 2026, including transportation tips, history, the best time to visit, exciting activities, essential travel tips, nearby attractions, and estimated costs.

Where Is Monkey Island Nha Trang And How To Get There?

Monkey Island, officially called Hon Lao Island, is located in Ninh Phu Commune, Ninh Hoa Town, Khanh Hoa Province. It lies about 18 kilometers north of Nha Trang city, within the picturesque Nha Phu Bay. Thanks to its natural beauty and unique ecosystem, Monkey Island is one of the most popular eco-tourism destinations in the region.

To reach Monkey Island, travelers must first get to Long Phu Tourist Wharf (also known as Da Chong Port), located in Vinh Luong Commune, around 15 kilometers from Nha Trang city center. From there, boats or speedboats take visitors to the island.

Transportation From Nha Trang City To Long Phu Wharf

  • Motorbike: A flexible and budget-friendly option for independent travelers. Motorbike rental costs around 100,000–150,000 VND per day. Follow Pham Van Dong Street northward, then turn onto National Highway 1A and follow signs to Long Phu Wharf.

  • Taxi Or Grab: Ideal for families or groups seeking comfort and convenience. One-way fares range from 200,000–300,000 VND.

  • Public Bus: Bus route No. 01 (Nha Trang – Ninh Hoa) passes by Long Phu Wharf and is the most economical option.

From Long Phu Wharf To Monkey Island

  • Tourist Boat: Travel time is approximately 20–30 minutes, with scheduled departures throughout the day.

  • Speedboat: Faster, taking only 10–15 minutes, suitable for groups who want to save time.

Boat tickets usually include both round-trip transportation and entrance fees to Monkey Island.

History And Development Of Monkey Island

Originally, Monkey Island was not a natural habitat for monkeys. In around 1975, Soviet scientists brought the first monkeys to Hon Lao for medical and biological research. Thanks to the island’s ideal natural conditions, abundant food sources, and clean environment, the monkeys thrived and multiplied rapidly.

Today, Monkey Island is home to more than 1,500 monkeys, mainly red-faced macaques and gray monkeys. They live freely in a semi-wild environment, creating a unique ecosystem that is both fascinating and educational. The island now serves not only as a tourist attraction but also as an important center for wildlife conservation and research.

Best Time To Visit Monkey Island Nha Trang

Monkey Island can be visited year-round due to Nha Trang’s mild climate. However, the best time to go is from April to September, when the weather is sunny, dry, and the sea is calm—perfect for outdoor activities and island exploration.

Travelers should avoid the rainy and stormy season from October to December, as boat transportation may be affected. For a quieter experience, visiting on weekdays rather than weekends or public holidays is recommended.

Top Experiences On Monkey Island Nha Trang

Monkey Island offers much more than just observing monkeys. It is a lively entertainment and eco-tourism destination suitable for all ages.

1. Interact With Thousands Of Playful Monkeys

This is the highlight of any visit. With over 1,500 monkeys roaming freely, visitors can easily encounter them throughout the island. You can purchase food such as corn, peanuts, or fruit on the island to feed the monkeys and take memorable photos. However, always follow safety guidelines and avoid teasing or feeding inappropriate food.

2. Enjoy Entertaining Monkey Shows

Visitors can also watch professionally trained monkey performances. These shows feature monkeys riding bicycles, balancing, and performing amusing tricks that delight both children and adults alike.

3. Explore Suoi Hoa Lan Ecotourism Area

Located next to Monkey Island, Suoi Hoa Lan is a beautiful nature reserve featuring a natural stream, colorful orchid gardens, and a mini zoo with animals such as bears, ostriches, and peacocks. The beach here is also ideal for swimming and relaxation.

4. Try Exciting Water Sports

Monkey Island offers various water activities, including parasailing, jet skiing, kayaking, and snorkeling. These activities are especially enjoyable on sunny days and add adventure to your island experience.

5. Discover Local Cuisine

After exploring the island, enjoy fresh seafood at local restaurants. Dishes are prepared from freshly caught seafood from Nha Phu Bay and can be grilled, steamed, or cooked in hotpot style. Snacks and refreshing drinks are also available.

Important Travel Tips When Visiting Monkey Island

  • Wear comfortable clothing and bring sun protection such as hats, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

  • Keep a safe distance from monkeys and avoid sudden movements or loud noises.

  • Secure personal belongings, as monkeys are curious and may grab items.

  • Follow all instructions from island staff to ensure safety and environmental protection.

  • Book tickets or tours in advance during peak seasons.

  • Bring cash, as some small vendors may not accept card payments.

Nearby Attractions Around Monkey Island

Visitors can easily combine Monkey Island with other attractions in Nha Phu Bay, such as:

  • Hon Thi Ecotourism Area: Featuring ostrich farms, deer gardens, and traditional folk games.

  • An Binh Beach: A quiet, unspoiled beach ideal for relaxation.

  • Ninh Thuy Fishing Village: Learn about local fishermen’s daily lives and enjoy affordable fresh seafood.

  • Ba Ho Waterfalls: A scenic trekking destination with three natural waterfalls, perfect for nature lovers.

Estimated Cost For A Self-Guided Monkey Island Trip

  • Entrance Ticket And Boat/Speedboat (Round Trip): 180,000–250,000 VND per person

  • Transportation To Long Phu Wharf:

    • Motorbike fuel: 30,000–50,000 VND

    • Taxi/Grab: 200,000–300,000 VND one way

  • Meals: 150,000–300,000 VND per person

  • Optional Activities: 200,000–500,000 VND per activity

  • Souvenirs: Depending on personal preference

Overall, a one-day trip to Monkey Island typically costs 500,000–1,000,000 VND per person, excluding accommodation and transportation to Nha Trang.

Photography Tips At Monkey Island

  • Capture natural moments with monkeys rather than forcing poses.

  • Use early morning or late afternoon light for warmer, more vibrant photos.

  • Experiment with different angles for creative shots.

  • Take advantage of the island’s beaches, greenery, and orchid gardens as scenic backdrops.

Monkey Island Nha Trang is truly a destination not to be missed when visiting this beautiful coastal city. With its lively wildlife, diverse activities, and stunning natural scenery, it promises an unforgettable experience. Hopefully, this detailed guide has provided everything you need to plan a memorable self-guided trip to Monkey Island in 2026.

posts.title: Diep Son Island And Doc Let Beach Nha Trang Travel Guide
posts.excerpt: Diep Son Island and Doc Let Beach are among the most fascinating destinations in Nha Trang, famous for their untouched beauty and the extraordinary sand pathway that emerges across the sea. This compl
posts.contentHtml:
Diep Son Island and Doc Let Beach are among the most fascinating destinations in Nha Trang, famous for their untouched beauty and the extraordinary sand pathway that emerges across the sea. This complete Diep Son – Doc Let travel guide for 2026 provides essential information on transportation, accommodation, activities, and important travel tips to help you plan a smooth and unforgettable journey.

With its pristine landscapes and authentic local culture, Diep Son Island has become a must-visit destination for travelers seeking unique coastal experiences in Vietnam. Let us guide you through everything you need to know before setting off on your adventure to this remarkable island.

Where Is Diep Son Island And When Is The Best Time To Visit?

Diep Son Island is a small archipelago located in Van Phong Bay, Khanh Hoa Province, approximately 60 kilometers north of Nha Trang city. The archipelago consists of three small islands Hon Bip, Hon Oc, and Hon Qua connected by a natural white sand pathway nearly one kilometer long, hidden beneath crystal-clear seawater.

This sand path only appears when the tide recedes, creating a magical scene where visitors can walk seemingly in the middle of the ocean. It is the island’s most iconic feature and one of the most unique natural phenomena in Vietnam.

The best time to visit Diep Son Island is from March to September, when the weather is sunny, dry, and the sea is calm. These conditions are ideal for sightseeing, swimming, and walking along the sand path. Visitors should avoid the rainy and stormy season from October to February, as rough seas may disrupt transportation. Checking the tidal schedule in advance is highly recommended, as the sand path is usually visible in the early morning or late afternoon.

How To Get To Diep Son Island And Doc Let Beach

From Nha Trang To Van Gia Port Or Diep Son Port

  • By Coach Or Taxi: Travel from Nha Trang city center to Van Gia Port in Van Ninh District. The journey takes approximately 1.5–2 hours. Coach fares range from 50,000 to 100,000 VND per person, while taxi fares range from 500,000 to 700,000 VND per trip.

  • By Motorbike: Renting a motorbike is ideal for travelers who enjoy freedom and scenic coastal routes. Rental prices range from 100,000 to 150,000 VND per day.

  • By Organized Tour: Many travel agencies offer full-day or overnight Diep Son – Doc Let tours, including transportation, boat transfers, meals, and guided activities.

From Van Gia Port To Diep Son Island

  • Wooden Boat: Local boats operate daily, usually departing in the morning and returning in the afternoon. Round-trip fares range from 150,000 to 200,000 VND per person.

  • Speedboat (Canoe): A faster option, taking only 15–20 minutes to reach the island. Prices range from 250,000 to 300,000 VND per person for a round trip.

Accommodation Options On Diep Son Island And Doc Let

Local Homestays

Staying with local families is the most popular and authentic option on Diep Son Island. The island’s residents are warm and welcoming, and this experience offers insight into daily life in a traditional fishing community.

Camping On The Beach

For adventurous travelers, camping overnight is a memorable experience. With permission from local authorities, visitors can set up tents on the beach or near the schoolyard. Nights on the island are peaceful, with star-filled skies and the sound of waves.

Hotels And Resorts In Doc Let

If you prefer modern amenities, Doc Let Beach offers a wide range of hotels, resorts, and guesthouses. Staying in Doc Let allows easy access to Diep Son Island for day trips while enjoying comfortable accommodation.

What To Do On Diep Son Island

Walk On The Iconic Sand Path Across The Sea

Walking along the sand pathway during low tide is the highlight of any Diep Son visit. Surrounded by turquoise water, the experience feels surreal and offers exceptional photo opportunities.

Kayaking And Coastal Exploration

Kayaking allows visitors to explore hidden corners of the island, rocky shorelines, and the clear waters of Van Phong Bay at a relaxed pace.

Swimming And Beach Relaxation

The island’s beaches feature soft white sand and emerald-blue water, perfect for swimming and peaceful relaxation away from crowds.

Discover Local Fishing Village Life

Visitors can explore the island’s fishing villages, interact with locals, and learn about traditional livelihoods such as net fishing and seafood preparation.

Enjoy Fresh Seafood

Seafood on Diep Son Island is freshly caught and simply prepared, enhancing its natural flavors. Grilled squid, steamed snails, grilled fish, and anchovy salad are highly recommended.

Important Travel Tips For Diep Son – Doc Let

  • Bring essential personal items, including sunscreen, hats, medicine, flashlights, and power banks.

  • Electricity on the island is available only at certain hours.

  • Freshwater is limited use it wisely.

  • Protect the environment by taking all trash back to the mainland.

  • Respect local customs and maintain quiet behavior.

  • Book boat transfers and accommodation in advance during peak season.

  • Always check tidal schedules for safety when walking on the sand path.

Suggested Diep Son – Doc Let Itinerary (2 Days 1 Night)

Day 1: Explore Diep Son Island

  • Morning: Travel from Nha Trang to Van Gia Port, then transfer to Diep Son Island.

  • Afternoon: Walk on the sand path, swim, kayak, and relax.

  • Evening: Enjoy a seafood barbecue and stargazing on the beach.

Day 2: Doc Let Beach And Return

  • Morning: Sunrise viewing, breakfast, and return to the mainland.

  • Midday: Visit Doc Let Beach, swim, relax, and enjoy lunch at a beachfront restaurant.

  • Afternoon: Return to Nha Trang.

Diep Son Island and Doc Let Beach are true hidden gems of Khanh Hoa Province, offering rare natural beauty, peaceful surroundings, and unforgettable experiences. With its iconic sand path, crystal-clear waters, and friendly local community, this destination is perfect for travelers seeking a meaningful escape close to nature. We hope this guide helps you plan a truly memorable Diep Son – Doc Let adventure in 2026.

posts.title: Bai Dai Beach Nha Trang Review: What Makes It So Special?
posts.excerpt: Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh, located not far from Nha Trang, is an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility and untouched natural beauty. This comprehensive guide to Bai Dai Beach Nha Trang in 2
posts.contentHtml:
Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh, located not far from Nha Trang, is an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility and untouched natural beauty. This comprehensive guide to Bai Dai Beach Nha Trang in 2026 covers everything you need to know from the best time to visit and transportation options to exciting activities and must-try local cuisine helping you plan a truly memorable beach getaway.

If you are planning a trip to Nha Trang in the near future, Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh is a destination you should not miss. Famous for its peaceful atmosphere, pristine coastline, and diverse recreational activities, Bai Dai Beach offers a perfect balance between relaxation and adventure.

Overview Of Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh

Bai Dai Beach is located in Cam Lam District, Khanh Hoa Province, approximately 20–30 kilometers south of Nha Trang city center. Although it is not situated in the bustling heart of the city, this is exactly what gives Bai Dai its unique charm an unspoiled, serene environment far removed from urban noise.

The beach is widely regarded as one of the most beautiful beaches in Cam Ranh Bay, featuring kilometers of soft white sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and rows of swaying coconut palms. With its calm atmosphere and breathtaking scenery, Bai Dai Beach is an ideal escape for travelers looking to unwind and reconnect with nature.

In addition to its scenic beauty, Bai Dai is also a paradise for water activities. The sea here is clean, warm, and shallow near the shore, making it perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and snorkeling. The combination of fresh ocean air and stunning coastal landscapes makes Bai Dai a must-visit stop on any Nha Trang itinerary.

Best Time To Visit Bai Dai Beach Nha Trang

Nha Trang enjoys a mild tropical climate with plenty of sunshine throughout the year, divided into two main seasons: the dry season and the rainy season.

The dry season, from January to August, is the best time to visit Bai Dai Beach especially between April and August. During this period, the weather is sunny and dry, the sea is calm, and temperatures range from 26°C to 30°C, creating ideal conditions for swimming, beach activities, and sightseeing.

The rainy season, from September to December, may bring occasional showers and rougher seas. However, this period offers fewer crowds and lower prices, making it suitable for travelers who prefer a quieter experience.

How To Get To Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh

Bai Dai Beach is easily accessible, with multiple transportation options depending on your starting point and travel preferences.

Motorbike

Renting a motorbike is a popular choice for adventurous travelers. From Nha Trang city center, the ride takes about 30–45 minutes via Nguyen Tat Thanh Coastal Road, offering spectacular sea views along the way. Motorbike rental prices range from 100,000 to 150,000 VND per day.

Coach Or Train

Long-distance buses and trains are suitable for travelers coming from major cities like Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi. Bus fares typically range from 250,000 to 500,000 VND, while train tickets cost between 400,000 and 1,000,000 VND depending on seat class.

Airplane

The fastest and most convenient option is flying to Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR), located just 10–15 kilometers from Bai Dai Beach. Direct flights operate daily from major cities in Vietnam. From the airport, travelers can easily reach Bai Dai Beach by taxi or shuttle bus.

What To Do At Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh

Swimming, Sightseeing, And Beach Photography

Bai Dai Beach is perfect for swimming thanks to its gentle waves and shallow shoreline. The beach is safe for visitors of all ages. Early morning and late afternoon are the best times for swimming and photography, offering soft lighting and cooler temperatures.

Snorkeling And Coral Watching

Snorkeling is one of the most popular activities at Bai Dai Beach. The surrounding waters are home to vibrant coral reefs and colorful marine life. Visitors can choose snorkeling, scuba diving, or even sea walking experiences, all guided by professional instructors with full safety equipment.

Water Sports And Adventure Activities

Adventure seekers can enjoy a variety of water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and banana boat rides. These activities are supervised by trained staff to ensure safety and fun.

Exploring Sealife Tourist Area

Sealife is a modern beach entertainment complex offering inflatable water parks, jet skiing, parasailing, and snorkeling tours. Entry is currently free, making it a popular spot for both relaxation and excitement.

Beach Picnics And Camping

Bai Dai Beach is an excellent location for picnics, team-building activities, and beach games. Camping overnight on the beach is also a unique experience, allowing visitors to enjoy bonfires, BBQ seafood, stargazing, and breathtaking sunrise views.

Enjoying Fresh Seafood At Bai Dai Beach

Bai Dai Beach is a seafood lover’s paradise. Fresh seafood is caught daily and served at beachfront restaurants at reasonable prices. Visitors can choose live seafood from tanks and have it prepared to their taste.

Must-try local specialties include grilled lobster, squid, sea snails, rabbitfish, and anchovy salad. You can also enjoy regional dishes such as jellyfish noodle soup, Ninh Hoa grilled pork rolls, banh can, and traditional Vietnamese desserts.

Recommended Resorts Near Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh

Vinpearl Resort Long Beach Cam Ranh

A luxury beachfront resort offering five-star accommodations, private pools, spa services, fitness centers, and world-class dining.

Champa Resort

Located closer to Nha Trang city, Champa Resort offers a peaceful riverside setting, spacious rooms, a large swimming pool, and spa facilities.

Diamond Bay Condotel Resort

A premium resort featuring modern architecture, panoramic sea and mountain views, infinity pools, golf courses, and upscale restaurants.

Important Travel Tips For Visiting Bai Dai Beach

  • Book flights, hotels, and tours early during peak season.

  • Bring sunscreen, hats, sunglasses, and swimwear.

  • Carry cash, as electronic payment options may be limited.

  • Check prices before using services to avoid overcharging.

  • Respect the environment and avoid littering.

  • Learn basic local customs to enhance your travel experience.

Final Thoughts

With its pristine beaches, clear waters, diverse activities, and peaceful atmosphere, Bai Dai Beach Cam Ranh is an ideal destination for travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure. Whether you are planning a romantic escape, a family holiday, or a beachside retreat, Bai Dai Beach promises unforgettable experiences and lasting memories in your Nha Trang journey.

posts.title: Top 6 Famous Water Parks That Attract Tourists In Nha Trang
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang water parks are among the top attractions for travelers during the summer travel season of 2025. When visiting this beautiful coastal city, water parks are experiences that tourists should n
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang water parks are among the top attractions for travelers during the summer travel season of 2025. When visiting this beautiful coastal city, water parks are experiences that tourists should not miss, especially for families, groups of friends, and adventure lovers looking to cool off and have fun.

Water parks in Nha Trang are well-known for their exciting rides, modern facilities, and scenic surroundings. Below is a curated list of the Top 6 most popular water parks in Nha Trang, highly recommended by travelers and local tour operators.

Vinpearl Land Nha Trang Water Park

Vinpearl Land Nha Trang is one of the most iconic attractions in Nha Trang and a highlight of many Nha Trang tour packages. Located on Hon Tre Island, just a few kilometers from the city center, the park is easily accessible by cable car or speedboat, offering visitors a scenic journey across the bay.

The water park features a wide range of thrilling water slides, wave pools, lazy rivers, and family-friendly play areas. In addition to water-based entertainment, Vinpearl Land also offers amusement rides, live shows, shopping areas, and a golf course, making it a complete entertainment complex suitable for all ages.

Phu Dong Water Park Nha Trang

Phu Dong Water Park is a popular recreational destination thanks to its spacious layout and diverse water attractions. The park includes water slides, large swimming pools, and dedicated children’s play zones, creating a lively and family-friendly atmosphere.

Visitors can also enjoy on-site dining services and relax in green, open spaces designed for comfort and leisure. Phu Dong Water Park is an excellent choice for families and groups looking for a full day of entertainment and relaxation in Nha Trang.

Wonder Park Nha Trang

Wonder Park Nha Trang is a vibrant entertainment destination located along the stunning coastline of the city. Designed as a modern water amusement park, it combines exciting water games with relaxing green spaces.

Highlights include crystal-clear water slides, interactive water attractions, and safe play areas for children. The park’s emphasis on nature-friendly design creates a refreshing and relaxing environment. With high-quality services and diverse entertainment options, Wonder Park Nha Trang is perfect for an energetic summer adventure.

Golden Peak Park Nha Trang

Golden Peak Park is a unique water park that blends modern technology with breathtaking natural scenery. Surrounded by fresh air and scenic landscapes, the park offers visitors an unforgettable water entertainment experience.

Key attractions include innovative water slides, infinity pools, and modern recreational areas. Golden Peak Park is not only a place for fun but also a destination where visitors can enjoy a festive atmosphere while staying connected to nature during their Nha Trang holiday.

SeaLife Floating Water Park Nha Trang

SeaLife Floating Water Park Nha Trang is a must-visit destination for thrill-seekers and water sports enthusiasts. Located directly on the sea, the park features large inflatable structures such as water trampolines, obstacle courses, floating bridges, and sea racing tracks.

The combination of exciting activities and fresh ocean air creates a truly unique experience in Nha Trang. This floating water park is ideal for young travelers and groups of friends looking for energetic and adventurous fun.

Suoi Hoa Lan Park And Monkey Island Nha Trang

Suoi Hoa Lan Park, located on Monkey Island approximately 15 kilometers from Nha Trang city center, is a hidden gem surrounded by lush natural scenery. The park is famous for its crystal-clear streams, wooden bridges, and vibrant orchid gardens featuring rare flower species.

Visitors can stroll through beautifully landscaped gardens, enjoy peaceful natural surroundings, and explore Monkey Island, home to thousands of monkeys living in a semi-wild environment. This destination offers a unique blend of nature, wildlife, and light recreation, making it a refreshing addition to any Nha Trang tour.

Conclusion

Nha Trang water parks are perfect destinations to beat the summer heat and enjoy joyful moments with family and friends. With a variety of themes from modern water amusement parks to floating sea playgrounds and nature-based attractions Nha Trang offers water park experiences for every type of traveler.

A visit to these water parks promises unforgettable memories and exciting adventures, making your Nha Trang journey truly complete.

posts.title: Robinson Island Nha Trang Tour Review
posts.excerpt: Robinson Island Nha Trang, a hidden gem tucked away in the Bich Dam Strait, is quickly becoming an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility and untouched natural beauty. With powdery white
posts.contentHtml:
Robinson Island Nha Trang, a hidden gem tucked away in the Bich Dam Strait, is quickly becoming an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility and untouched natural beauty. With powdery white sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a rich marine ecosystem, this small island promises unforgettable experiences for visitors in the summer of 2026.

Located approximately 10 kilometers from Cau Da Tourist Port, Robinson Island offers a peaceful escape from the bustling city. Surrounded by the vast blue ocean, the island feels completely secluded, allowing travelers to immerse themselves in pristine nature and slow-paced island life.

The moment you arrive, you will sense the calm atmosphere as gentle waves lap against the shore. As the sun sets, gathering around a beach bonfire with friends and fellow travelers creates memorable moments where stress and worries simply fade away. Robinson Island is not only visually stunning but also filled with exciting activities, making it a perfect addition to any Nha Trang travel itinerary.

What Makes Robinson Island Nha Trang Special?

Robinson Island is more than just a beautiful island; it is an ideal destination for both relaxation and adventure. Thanks to its prime location and diverse ecosystem, the island offers unique experiences rarely found elsewhere.

Unlike heavily commercialized islands, Robinson Island retains its raw, untouched charm. It is part of the Nha Phu Bay area one of the most beautiful bays in Khanh Hoa Province known for its biodiversity and scenic landscapes. Visitors can admire unspoiled beaches, explore colorful coral reefs, and gain insight into the daily life of local fishing communities.

Often referred to as a “mini Maldives of Vietnam,” Robinson Island has no luxury resorts or noisy entertainment complexes. Instead, it offers coconut-lined beaches, dramatic rock formations, and emerald-green seawater perfect for photography lovers and travelers seeking true peace and simplicity.

Best Time To Visit Robinson Island

Nha Trang enjoys warm and sunny weather year-round, but the best time to explore Robinson Island is from March to September.

  • March to September: Dry season, calm seas, clear skies ideal for swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, and island exploration.

  • June to August: Peak summer months with vibrant marine colors and excellent visibility underwater.

  • March and September: Fewer crowds, more peaceful atmosphere.

It is advisable to avoid the rainy season from October to December, as rough seas and heavy rain may affect transportation and activities.

How To Get To Robinson Island Nha Trang

Travelers can reach Robinson Island using several transportation options:

Speedboat

The fastest and most convenient option, departing from Cau Da Port. Travel time is approximately 45–60 minutes.
Price: Around 150,000 – 250,000 VND per person (one way).

Tourist Boat

Many tour operators offer daily boat tours that include meals and activities. This option is convenient and cost-effective for first-time visitors.

Private Boat Rental

Ideal for families or groups seeking privacy and flexible schedules. While more expensive, it offers comfort and customization.

Basket Boat Or Canoe

For adventurous travelers who want a closer connection to local fishing life, small boats from nearby fishing villages can be arranged for short-distance trips.

Robinson Island is often combined with nearby attractions such as Monkey Island or Hon Lao, making group tours a popular and economical choice.

Top Things To Do On Robinson Island

Kayaking And Exploring Fishing Villages

Kayaking is one of the most popular activities on the island. Paddle through clear waters, glide past rocky cliffs, and explore hidden corners of the coastline. Visitors can also visit nearby fishing villages to learn about traditional livelihoods and enjoy freshly caught seafood.

Swimming And Relaxing On White Sandy Beaches

Robinson Island boasts long stretches of soft white sand and calm, shallow waters perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Beach chairs and umbrellas are available in some areas, making it easy to relax and unwind.

Snorkeling And Coral Watching

The island’s marine ecosystem is rich and well-preserved. Snorkeling and diving allow visitors to explore vibrant coral reefs and colorful tropical fish. Equipment and professional guides are available, making this activity suitable even for beginners.

Beach Camping And Bonfire Nights

For nature lovers, overnight beach camping is an unforgettable experience. Sleep under a sky full of stars, enjoy a seafood barbecue, and wake up to a stunning sunrise over the sea. Evening bonfires add warmth, fun, and a sense of connection among travelers.

Exploring The Island’s Natural Ecosystem

Beyond the beach, Robinson Island features small forest trails, coconut groves, and mangrove areas. Walking through these paths offers opportunities to observe seabirds, native plants, and the island’s natural biodiversity.

Enjoy Fresh Seafood On Robinson Island

No island trip is complete without seafood. Robinson Island offers a variety of freshly caught seafood such as oysters, scallops, squid, shrimp, crabs, and fish. These dishes are often simply prepared to preserve their natural flavors.

Popular specialties include grilled lobster, steamed crab with beer, chili-garlic snails, and Nha Trang’s famous fish salad. Beachside BBQ dinners at sunset are a highlight, creating a memorable dining experience by the sea.

Estimated Travel Costs To Robinson Island

  • Transportation:
    Round-trip speedboat: 300,000 – 500,000 VND per person
    Private boat rental: 1,500,000 – 3,000,000 VND per boat

  • Food:
    Seafood meals: 200,000 – 500,000 VND per person

  • Activities:
    Kayaking: 100,000 – 150,000 VND per hour
    Snorkeling/Diving: 500,000 – 1,000,000 VND per session
    Camping tent rental: 150,000 – 300,000 VND per night

  • Accommodation:
    Homestays: 300,000 – 700,000 VND per night

A 2-day, 1-night trip typically costs 1,500,000 – 3,000,000 VND per person, depending on travel style and activities.

Important Tips For Visiting Robinson Island

  • Book services in advance during peak season

  • Bring sunscreen, swimwear, insect repellent, and personal medication

  • Carry cash, as electronic payments may be limited

  • Respect nature: do not litter or damage coral reefs

  • Follow safety instructions for water activities

  • Expect limited internet access embrace a digital detox

  • Engage with local communities to learn about island culture

Final Thoughts

Robinson Island Nha Trang is a perfect destination for travelers seeking serenity, natural beauty, and authentic island experiences. Whether you want to relax on untouched beaches, explore vibrant coral reefs, or enjoy peaceful nights by the sea, Robinson Island offers it all.

If you are planning a trip to Nha Trang and looking for a quiet escape away from the crowds, Robinson Island is an excellent choice one that will leave you with unforgettable memories of Vietnam’s coastal beauty.

posts.title: One Day Hon Tam Island Tour Review
posts.excerpt: Hon Tam Island, often referred to as the green gem of Nha Trang Bay one of the most beautiful bays in the world is a perfect destination for travelers seeking a relaxing yet exciting one-day island es
posts.contentHtml:
Hon Tam Island, often referred to as the green gem of Nha Trang Bay one of the most beautiful bays in the world is a perfect destination for travelers seeking a relaxing yet exciting one-day island escape. This guide provides a complete review of the Hon Tam Island one-day tour, including transportation, best time to visit, ticket prices, must-try activities, and essential travel tips to ensure an unforgettable experience in 2026.

Overview Of Hon Tam Island, Nha Trang

Hon Tam Island, also known as Thuy Kim Son Island, is one of the largest and most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay, covering an area of more than 110 hectares. When viewed from above, the island resembles a giant green silkworm resting peacefully in the middle of the sea this unique shape is the origin of its name.

The island is famous for its unspoiled natural beauty, featuring lush tropical forests, long stretches of soft white sand, and crystal-clear turquoise waters. With its tranquil atmosphere, Hon Tam offers an ideal retreat away from the hustle and bustle of the city. At the same time, modern resorts and well-developed tourism facilities make it suitable for both relaxation and entertainment.

Originally a pristine and little-known island, Hon Tam has been thoughtfully developed since the early 21st century, focusing on sustainable tourism that balances high-end services with environmental preservation.

How To Get To Hon Tam Island

To reach Hon Tam Island, travelers first need to go to Cau Da Port, located approximately 6 kilometers from Nha Trang city center.

Getting To Cau Da Port

  • Taxi or motorbike taxi: Convenient and time-saving, especially for groups or travelers with luggage.

  • Public bus (Route No. 4): A budget-friendly option with fares ranging from 7,000 to 10,000 VND per trip.

  • Motorbike rental: Ideal for travelers who prefer flexibility and independence.

From Cau Da Port To Hon Tam Island

  • Speedboat (canoe): The fastest option, taking only 7–10 minutes. This is usually included in one-day tour packages.

  • Wooden boat: A slower but more economical choice, with a travel time of around 20–25 minutes.

During peak seasons, booking transportation or a tour package in advance is highly recommended.

Best Time To Visit Hon Tam Island

Hon Tam Island enjoys a mild climate all year round, with an average temperature of around 26°C.

  • Best season: From March to September, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and conditions are ideal for water activities.

  • Low season: Late dry season or early rainy season, offering fewer crowds and more affordable prices.

For a lively atmosphere, weekends and holidays are ideal. If you prefer peace and relaxation, visiting on weekdays is a better option.

Hon Tam Island Ticket Prices (Updated 2026)

Ticket packages typically include round-trip speedboat transfers and access to island facilities.

  • Basic Island Package:
    From 400,000 – 500,000 VND per adult

  • Mud Bath Package:
    From 600,000 – 750,000 VND per adult

  • All-Inclusive Package (Most Popular):
    Includes speedboat transfers, mud bath, seafood buffet lunch, and beach activities
    From 900,000 – 1,200,000 VND per adult

Prices may vary depending on season and promotions, so advance booking is recommended.Top Experiences On Hon Tam Island

Relaxing On Hon Tam Beach

With over one kilometer of white sandy beach and clear blue waters, Hon Tam Beach is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and relaxing. Lifeguards are always on duty, ensuring a safe experience for visitors.

Visiting Hoang Hoa Village

Hoang Hoa Village is a traditional village with more than 100 years of history. Here, visitors can explore traditional wooden houses, learn about local culture, enjoy traditional music, and take part in handicraft experiences such as pottery making.

Mud Bath And Wellness Experience

Hon Tam is home to one of the largest mud bath complexes in Vietnam. The natural mineral mud helps improve skin health, reduce stress, and promote overall relaxation an essential experience for wellness lovers.

Water Sports And Adventure Activities

  • Flyboarding

  • Parasailing

  • Kayaking

  • Sea walking to explore coral reefs

  • Mini golf course

These activities offer a wide range of experiences, from calm and relaxing to thrilling and adventurous.

Check In At Hon Tam Pier

Hon Tam Pier is a popular photo spot and one of the best places to watch the sunset on the island. The golden light reflecting on the sea creates a truly romantic and memorable scene.

Final Thoughts

The Hon Tam Island one-day tour is an excellent choice for travelers who want to combine pristine beaches, luxury relaxation, and exciting activities in a short time. With stunning natural scenery, high-quality services, and diverse experiences, Hon Tam Island promises a memorable highlight in any Nha Trang travel itinerary.

posts.title: Where To Stay And What To Do On Hon Tam Island, Nha Trang?

posts.contentHtml:
When people think of Nha Trang, they often picture a vibrant coastal city with long stretches of white sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters. However, hidden within Nha Trang Bay lies a lesser-known gem Hon Tam Island, a destination that remains wonderfully pristine while still offering a wide range of exciting activities.

Hon Tam is not only an ideal place to relax, but also a paradise for fun, adventure, and cultural discovery. Let’s explore Hon Tam Island together and gather everything you need to plan a perfect Nha Trang getaway.

Hon Tam Island – Relaxation And Entertainment In A Tropical Paradise

Hon Tam, also known as Thuy Kim Son, is one of the largest and most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay. It captivates visitors with its natural beauty and the perfect balance between lively entertainment and luxurious resort experiences.

Located just 7 kilometers southeast of Nha Trang city center, Hon Tam can be reached by speedboat in only 10–15 minutes, offering a quick escape from the city’s hustle and bustle into a tranquil island retreat without sacrificing comfort or convenience.

Location And Natural Beauty Of Hon Tam

Situated in the heart of Nha Trang Bay, one of the world’s most beautiful bays, Hon Tam Island is blessed with untouched natural scenery. Covering an area of approximately 110 hectares, the island features lush green hills, over 1 kilometer of soft white sandy beaches, and calm, jade-colored waters year-round.

Hon Tam is also home to a diverse marine ecosystem, with colorful coral reefs and tropical fish, creating a vivid underwater world ideal for snorkeling and diving. Its semi-isolated location helps preserve its peaceful atmosphere while remaining easily accessible.

The Origin Of Hon Tam’s Name And History

The name “Hon Tam” comes from the island’s shape, which resembles a giant green silkworm resting in the sea. The island is also known as Thuy Kim Son, meaning “Golden Mountain in the Water,” symbolizing prosperity and natural richness.

According to local legends, Hon Tam once served as a shelter for fishermen and a trading stop in ancient times. Traces of traditional culture remain, adding a historical charm that enriches the island’s appeal.

Best Time To Visit Hon Tam Island

The best time to visit Hon Tam is during Nha Trang’s dry season (January to September). The most ideal months are April to August, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and outdoor activities are at their best. Temperatures range from 26–30°C, creating pleasant conditions for swimming and water sports.

Visitors seeking fewer crowds may prefer February or March, when the weather remains beautiful but tourism is less busy. The rainy season (October to December) is less recommended due to rough seas and limited activities.

How To Get To Hon Tam Island

From Nha Trang city center, travelers can reach Cau Da Port by taxi, motorbike, or bus. From there, several options are available:

  • Speedboat: The fastest and most popular option, taking 10–15 minutes. Round-trip prices range from 200,000–300,000 VND per person.

  • Wooden Boat: A slower, more economical option (30–45 minutes), costing around 100,000–150,000 VND per person.

  • Private Boat Charter: Ideal for groups seeking privacy and flexibility. Prices vary depending on boat type and rental duration.

Many resorts on the island also provide private transfer services for overnight guests.

Things To Do On Hon Tam Island

Relax On Hon Tam Beach

Hon Tam Beach boasts fine white sand and crystal-clear waters, perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Visitors can relax under palm trees, enjoy beach games, or simply listen to the soothing sound of waves. Facilities include sun loungers, umbrellas, and designated safe swimming areas for children.

Visit Hoang Hoa Village – A Traditional Island Hamlet

Hoang Hoa Village offers a journey back in time with five preserved traditional houses over 100 years old. Inside, you’ll find antique tools and household items that recreate traditional Vietnamese village life.

The village regularly hosts cultural festivals such as the Hung Kings’ Commemoration Ceremony, Cherry Blossom Festival, and Whale Worship Festival. Visitors can enjoy traditional music performances, handicraft demonstrations, pottery making, and rice wine brewing an immersive cultural experience.

Unwind At Hon Tam Mud Bath Complex

Hon Tam is home to Vietnam’s largest island-based mud bath complex, covering over 16,000 m². Surrounded by mountains and overlooking Nha Trang Bay, this wellness sanctuary offers natural mineral mud baths, herbal soaking pools, hydrotherapy, waterfalls, and Jacuzzi pools.

Ticket prices range from 400,000–600,000 VND, with premium packages including spa treatments and massages.

Have Fun At The Floating Inflatable Park

Spanning 4,200 m² and accommodating up to 750 guests, Hon Tam’s floating inflatable park is a massive playground on the sea. Activities include climbing walls, obstacle courses, slides, balance challenges, and giant inflatables perfect for families and groups of friends.

Try Thrilling Water Sports

  • Flyboarding: Experience the thrill of flying above the sea with water-powered jet boots. Price: 600,000–800,000 VND / 15 minutes.

  • Parasailing: Soar above Nha Trang Bay and enjoy panoramic views. Price: 500,000–700,000 VND per flight.

  • Jet Skiing: Speed across the waves and feel the adrenaline. Price: 300,000–500,000 VND / 30 minutes.

  • Kayaking: Paddle at your own pace and explore hidden corners of the island. Price: 100,000–150,000 VND per hour.

  • Mini Golf: Enjoy a relaxing game surrounded by lush greenery. Price: 200,000–300,000 VND per round.

Snorkeling And Diving

Hon Tam’s calm waters and shallow reefs make it ideal for snorkeling and scuba diving. Colorful coral formations and diverse marine life await beneath the surface.

  • Snorkeling: 200,000–300,000 VND per person

  • Scuba Diving: 700,000–1,000,000 VND per dive (includes instructor and equipment)

Enjoy Nightlife At Hon Tam Beach Bar

As the sun sets, Hon Tam’s beach bar comes alive with tropical cocktails, light bites, and energetic EDM music. Weekend DJ performances and beach parties create a lively atmosphere under the stars.

Suggested One-Day Itinerary On Hon Tam Island

Morning (7:30–11:30)
Speedboat transfer to the island, beach relaxation, swimming, kayaking, and photo sessions.

Lunch (11:30–13:00)
Seafood buffet at an island restaurant.

Afternoon (13:00–16:00)
Visit Hoang Hoa Village, enjoy mud baths, or try water sports like flyboarding or parasailing.

Evening (After 16:00)
Return to the mainland or stay overnight for a beachfront dinner, stargazing, beach bar entertainment, or resort activities.

Where To Stay On Hon Tam Island

Hon Tam Resort is the island’s flagship accommodation, offering luxury in harmony with nature. The resort features 114 rooms and bungalows with sea or garden views, modern amenities, infinity pools, beachfront restaurants, bars, and evening entertainment.

Room rates typically start from 800,000 VND per night, with higher-end villas costing several million VND per night. Booking in advance is highly recommended, especially during peak seasons.

Food And Dining On Hon Tam

Fresh seafood is the highlight, including grilled lobster, steamed crab, spicy grilled squid, and various sea snails. Visitors should also try local Nha Trang specialties such as:

  • Fish cake noodle soup

  • Ninh Hoa grilled pork rolls

  • Banh can (mini rice pancakes)

  • Mai fish salad

  • Seafood banh xeo (Vietnamese pancakes)

Popular Service Packages On Hon Tam

  • Mud Bath Package: 400,000–600,000 VND

  • Beach Fun Package: 350,000–500,000 VND

  • All-Inclusive Combo (Mud Bath + Beach + Lunch): 700,000–900,000 VND

  • Private Beach Huts: 200,000–500,000 VND per day

Important Travel Tips

  • Book tickets and services in advance during peak season

  • Bring sunscreen, swimwear, hats, and waterproof cameras

  • Protect the environment do not damage coral or litter

  • Follow safety instructions for water sports

  • Carry some cash for small expenses

  • Stay hydrated and avoid excessive sun exposure

Final Thoughts

Hon Tam Island is a rare destination where untouched natural beauty meets modern tourism services. From relaxation and wellness to adventure and culture, Hon Tam offers a complete island escape in Nha Trang.

We hope this guide helps you plan a memorable and fulfilling journey to this stunning tropical paradise.

posts.title: Hon Mun Scuba Diving And Sea Walking
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, often referred to as the “Pearl of the East Sea,” has long been a favorite destination thanks to its captivating natural beauty and wide range of unforgettable experiences. Among them, Hon
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, often referred to as the “Pearl of the East Sea,” has long been a favorite destination thanks to its captivating natural beauty and wide range of unforgettable experiences. Among them, Hon Mun Island stands out as a true underwater paradise, where visitors can explore vibrant coral reefs and take part in the unique Sea Walking experience.

As of February 2026, Nha Trang is in the dry season, offering ideal weather conditions for marine activities. Join us as we explore in detail these must-try underwater adventures in Hon Mun.

Hon Mun Island – The Ultimate Diving Paradise In Nha Trang

Hon Mun is not just a small island in Nha Trang Bay; it is a natural treasure recognized by UNESCO as Vietnam’s first and only marine protected area. The name “Hon Mun” comes from its distinctive black rock formations, resembling ebony wood, which create a dramatic and unique coastal landscape.

The island is home to an exceptionally rich marine ecosystem, with more than 1,500 species of coral and marine life, accounting for nearly 40% of the world’s known coral species. This living underwater museum attracts millions of visitors every year and is a top destination for ocean lovers.

History And Significance Of Hon Mun

Hon Mun was officially designated as a marine protected area in 2001, with the goal of preserving marine biodiversity and promoting sustainable tourism. Since then, it has played a crucial role in raising awareness about ocean conservation.

All activities around the island are carefully regulated to minimize environmental impact. Visitors not only enjoy the stunning underwater scenery but also gain a deeper understanding of the importance of protecting fragile marine ecosystems.

Scuba Diving Experience At Hon Mun

Scuba diving at Hon Mun is a must for anyone passionate about underwater exploration. Whether you are a beginner or a certified diver, the island offers suitable dive sites for all levels.

Professional diving centers in Nha Trang provide full equipment and experienced instructors, ensuring maximum safety throughout the experience. Equipped with air tanks and diving suits, you will descend to safe depths to admire soft corals, hard coral reefs, and schools of colorful fish swimming gracefully around you.

Available options include:

  • Discovery Dives for first-time divers

  • Certified Dives for licensed divers

  • Night Dives to explore the mysterious underwater world after dark

The best time for scuba diving in Hon Mun is during the dry season, from March to September. However, February 2026 still offers excellent conditions, provided the weather is stable. Prices typically range from 800,000 VND to 1,500,000 VND, depending on the dive type and service provider. Booking through reputable tour operators is highly recommended for a seamless Nha Trang travel experience.

Sea Walking – A Unique Underwater Walking Experience

For those who cannot swim or prefer not to dive deep, Sea Walking is the perfect alternative to explore the underwater world of Hon Mun. This innovative activity allows participants to walk on the seabed while wearing a specially designed helmet that supplies continuous oxygen—no swimming skills required.

Sea Walking is suitable for all ages, from children to seniors, making it an inclusive and family-friendly activity.

What Makes Sea Walking Special?

Participants are guided to a depth of approximately 3–5 meters, where they can walk comfortably along the ocean floor. The sensation of strolling beneath the sea, interacting with marine life, and observing corals up close is truly magical.

Highlights include:

  • Feeding fish and interacting with marine life

  • Taking unique underwater photos and videos

  • Enjoying a calm and immersive ocean environment

Each tour includes a full safety briefing and is accompanied by professional divers at all times. Prices usually range from 600,000 to 1,000,000 VND, depending on duration and service provider. Many tours also offer professional underwater photography services to help you capture unforgettable memories.

Scuba Diving Vs Sea Walking: Which One Should You Choose?

While both activities offer incredible underwater experiences, they differ in several ways:

Scuba Diving

  • Requires basic swimming skills

  • Includes short training and breathing techniques

  • Allows greater freedom of movement and deeper exploration

Sea Walking

  • No swimming skills required

  • Ideal for non-swimmers or those uncomfortable underwater

  • Focuses on shallow, relaxed exploration

Both experiences are unique and rewarding. The choice depends on your comfort level, physical condition, and personal preference.

Helpful Tips For Visiting Hon Mun Island

Best Time To Visit

The dry season from March to September offers calm seas and excellent underwater visibility. February 2026 can still be suitable, depending on weather conditions. Early mornings are the best time to start activities, when sunlight penetrates the water beautifully and marine life is most active.

How To Get To Hon Mun

Hon Mun can be reached by boat or speedboat from Cau Da Port, about 5 kilometers from Nha Trang city center. Options include:

  • Group tours (300,000–500,000 VND per person)

  • Private speedboat rentals (1,000,000–2,000,000 VND for small groups)

Booking in advance is highly recommended, especially during peak seasons.

What To Bring

  • Swimwear and towels

  • Reef-safe sunscreen, hat, and sunglasses

  • Waterproof camera or phone case

  • Motion sickness medication if needed

  • Cash for small expenses

  • Light snacks and water

Safety And Environmental Protection

Always follow instructions from guides and divers. Avoid touching corals or marine animals to protect the fragile ecosystem. If you have heart conditions, respiratory issues, or other health concerns, consult a doctor before participating. Children and elderly participants should be closely supervised.

Discover Nha Trang Cuisine After Your Hon Mun Adventure

After an exciting day exploring the ocean, treat yourself to Nha Trang’s famous cuisine. Fresh seafood such as lobster, crab, squid, and snails are widely available, along with local specialties like fish cake noodle soup, Nha Trang grilled pork rolls, and banh can. Night markets and beachfront restaurants offer a vibrant food scene worth exploring.

Conclusion

With its pristine waters, diverse marine life, and unforgettable activities, Hon Mun Island promises an extraordinary underwater adventure in Nha Trang. Whether you seek thrilling scuba dives or a gentle Sea Walking experience, Hon Mun offers something for everyone.

Plan your journey beneath the waves today and discover why Hon Mun is considered one of the top marine destinations in Vietnam’s central coast.

If you are looking for a hassle-free experience, many Tet Holiday Tours and Summer Tours include Hon Mun activities, helping you save time and enjoy a well-organized trip. Do not miss the chance to uncover the hidden beauty of Hon Mun and create lasting memories with family and friends.

posts.title: Po Nagar Cham Towers And Nha Trang Stone Cathedral
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, one of Vietnam’s leading travel destinations, is not only famous for its stunning beaches but also for its rich cultural and historical heritage. In November 2025, when the city transitions
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, one of Vietnam’s leading travel destinations, is not only famous for its stunning beaches but also for its rich cultural and historical heritage. In November 2025, when the city transitions from the rainy season to the dry season, the weather becomes more pleasant making it an ideal time to explore Nha Trang’s historical and spiritual landmarks.

This article invites you on a cultural journey to discover two iconic heritage sites: Po Nagar Cham Towers and Nha Trang Stone Cathedral, offering deeper insights into their history, architecture, and cultural significance to the local community.

Overview Of Nha Trang: The Pearl Of Vietnam’s Central Coast

Often referred to as the “Pearl of the Central Coast,” Nha Trang captivates visitors with its long stretches of soft white sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a mild climate throughout the year. Beyond its reputation as a beach paradise, the city is also a vibrant center of culture, cuisine, and entertainment.

From pristine islands and colorful coral reefs to ancient historical sites and diverse street food, Nha Trang offers a wide range of experiences for travelers seeking relaxation, adventure, or cultural discovery. During this season, the favorable weather further enhances outdoor exploration and sightseeing.

Po Nagar Cham Towers: A Timeless Legacy Of Cham Civilization

History And Architecture

Po Nagar Cham Towers is one of the most important remaining Cham architectural complexes in Nha Trang and Central Vietnam. Located on Cu Lao Hill (also known as Thap Ba Hill) in Vinh Phuoc Ward, approximately 2 kilometers north of the city center, this sacred site was constructed between the 8th and 13th centuries.

The towers are dedicated to Goddess Thien Y A Na (Po Nagar), revered as the Mother of the Land by both the Cham and Vietnamese people. The architecture reflects classic Cham style, featuring intricately stacked baked bricks forming towering structures adorned with carvings of deities, dancers, and mythical creatures. Each tower faces east, welcoming the sunrise and symbolizing spiritual renewal.

Cultural And Spiritual Significance

Po Nagar Cham Towers is not only an architectural masterpiece but also a vital spiritual center. Every year, during the third lunar month (around April), the Po Nagar Festival takes place, attracting large numbers of pilgrims and visitors. This important cultural event honors the goddess and preserves traditional rituals, music, and dance, and has been recognized as a National Intangible Cultural Heritage of Vietnam.

Visitor Experience

Visitors to Po Nagar Cham Towers can admire the ancient structures, explore Cham cultural artifacts, and enjoy panoramic views of Nha Trang City, the Cai River, and Nha Trang Bay from the hilltop. The best time to visit is early morning or late afternoon, when temperatures are cooler and the atmosphere is more serene.

Nha Trang Stone Cathedral: Gothic Elegance In The Heart Of The City

History And Architecture

Also known as Christ the King Cathedral, the Nha Trang Stone Cathedral is a remarkable Catholic landmark located on a small hill in the city center. Built between 1928 and 1933 by French priest Louis Vallet, the cathedral stands out for its construction entirely from stone and its distinctive Western Gothic architectural style.

Featuring pointed arches, stained-glass windows, and a tall bell tower, the cathedral’s solemn beauty creates a striking contrast with the modern urban surroundings, making it one of Nha Trang’s most recognizable architectural icons.

Significance And Activities

The Stone Cathedral serves as an important place of worship for the local Catholic community while also welcoming visitors interested in history and architecture. During major religious celebrations, the cathedral becomes especially vibrant, illuminated with decorative lights and hosting solemn ceremonies. It is also a popular location for photography, thanks to its classic and dignified appearance.

Visitor Experience

A visit to the Stone Cathedral typically takes 30 minutes to one hour, allowing time to explore the exterior, interior, and surrounding grounds. Visitors are advised to dress modestly and respectfully when entering the church. From this elevated location, you can also enjoy views of nearby city neighborhoods.

Practical Tips For Exploring Nha Trang’s Cultural Heritage

To make the most of your cultural journey in Nha Trang toward the end of 2025, consider the following tips:

  • Best Time To Visit: November offers cooler temperatures and minimal rainfall, ideal for sightseeing.

  • Transportation: Taxis, motorbikes, and local buses provide easy access to both sites from the city center.

  • Dress Code: Wear respectful and modest clothing when visiting religious and spiritual landmarks.

  • Combine Attractions: These sites are conveniently located near the city center and can be combined with visits to Dam Market or local food spots.

  • Plan Ahead: Consider exploring additional beach tours or cultural experiences to create a well-rounded Nha Trang itinerary.

Final Thoughts

Po Nagar Cham Towers and Nha Trang Stone Cathedral stand as powerful symbols of the city’s rich cultural diversity and historical depth. Whether you are passionate about history, architecture, or simply eager to understand the soul of a destination, these landmarks offer meaningful and memorable experiences.

Do not miss the opportunity to explore these cultural treasures during your journey to Nha Trang they provide a deeper connection to the city beyond its beautiful beaches.

posts.title: Beautiful Islands To Visit When Traveling To Nha Trang
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, the famous coastal city of Khanh Hoa Province, has long been a dream destination for millions of domestic and international travelers. Beyond its long sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, the famous coastal city of Khanh Hoa Province, has long been a dream destination for millions of domestic and international travelers. Beyond its long sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, Nha Trang is renowned for its collection of stunning islands, each offering its own unique charm and unforgettable experiences.

If you are planning a trip to Nha Trang and wish to explore pristine nature, turquoise seas, and authentic island life, this guide will introduce you to the most beautiful islands you should not miss.

Overview Of Island Tourism In Nha Trang

Located within one of the most beautiful bays in the world, Nha Trang boasts a diverse archipelago of islands that create a breathtaking and poetic seascape. These islands are not only ideal for water sports and marine activities but also perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, cultural discovery, and fresh seafood.

Island tourism in Nha Trang goes beyond swimming and sunbathing. It is a journey into fishing village life, marine conservation efforts, and the rich coastal culture of central Vietnam. Thanks to its diverse ecosystems and well-developed tourism services, Nha Trang remains a year-round island paradise.

The Most Beautiful Islands In Nha Trang You Should Not Miss

Diep Son Island – The Unique Sand Path In The Sea

Located in Van Phong Bay, Diep Son Island is famous for its natural white sand pathway stretching nearly 700 meters, emerging in the middle of the sea during low tide. The path connects three small islands and allows visitors to walk between them with clear seawater on both sides.

This rare natural phenomenon offers a once-in-a-lifetime experience and has become a favorite destination for adventurous travelers and photographers. Beyond the sand path, Diep Son charms visitors with its untouched beaches and peaceful fishing village atmosphere.

Best time to visit: December to June
Boat transfer: From Van Gia Port, approximately 150,000–200,000 VND per person (round trip)

Yen Island (Hon Noi) – Home Of The Precious Swiftlets

Yen Island, also known as Hon Noi, is considered one of the most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay. Its highlight is Vietnam’s only double beach, where one side has warm water and the other cool water.

The island is home to thousands of swiftlets and plays a vital role in Vietnam’s traditional bird’s nest harvesting industry. Visitors can explore caves, snorkel among coral reefs, and learn about this centuries-old craft.

Best time to visit: March to September
Tour price: Approximately 350,000–450,000 VND per person (limited daily visitors)

Binh Ba Island – The Lobster Paradise

Binh Ba Island, located in Cam Ranh Bay, is famous for its affordable, fresh lobster and pristine beaches such as Bai Nom, Bai Chuong, and Bai Bo De. Life on the island remains simple and peaceful, offering a perfect escape from city crowds.

Visitors can enjoy snorkeling, fishing, and especially seafood dining directly sourced from local fishermen.

Note: Binh Ba Island is currently open only to Vietnamese citizens
Best time to visit: March to September
Boat ticket: 30,000–50,000 VND from Ba Ngoi Port

Binh Hung Island – A Hidden Gem Of Cam Ranh

Binh Hung Island, part of the Tam Binh Islands, is known for its crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and untouched natural beauty. Often called the “mini Maldives of Vietnam,” this island offers excellent snorkeling right from the shore.

Visitors can explore the island by motorbike, visit Hon Chut Lighthouse, and enjoy fresh seafood such as grilled squid, sea snails, and seafood mini pancakes.

Best time to visit: Summer months
Boat transfer: 10–15 minutes from Da Bac Port

Hon Mun Island – Vietnam’s First Marine Protected Area

Hon Mun is the most famous snorkeling and diving destination in Nha Trang. Recognized as Vietnam’s first marine reserve, it is home to over 1,500 species of coral and marine life.

Visitors can enjoy scuba diving, snorkeling, glass-bottom boat tours, and swimming in crystal-clear waters while learning about marine conservation.

Best time to visit: April to September
Tour price: 250,000–500,000 VND per person (half-day tours)

Hon Tam Island – Luxury Resort Escape

Unlike other rustic islands, Hon Tam offers a premium resort experience. It features long white-sand beaches, hot mineral mud baths, spa services, water sports, and fine dining restaurants.

This island is ideal for travelers seeking relaxation, wellness, and upscale amenities in a tropical setting.

Best time to visit: March to September
Entrance packages: From 300,000 to over 1,000,000 VND depending on services

Monkey Island (Hon Lao) – A Kingdom Of Monkeys

Monkey Island is home to thousands of freely roaming monkeys. Visitors can interact with them, enjoy animal shows, and relax on shaded beaches. This island is especially suitable for families with children.

Best time to visit: March to September
Entrance ticket: Around 150,000 VND per person (includes boat transfer)

Hon Tre Island – Home Of VinWonders Nha Trang

Hon Tre is the largest island in Nha Trang Bay and home to VinWonders Nha Trang, a world-class amusement complex featuring water parks, roller coasters, aquariums, and live shows.

Accessible by one of the world’s longest oversea cable cars, Hon Tre is perfect for families and travelers seeking vibrant entertainment.

Best time to visit: January to September
VinWonders ticket: Approximately 800,000–1,000,000 VND per person

Important Tips When Visiting Nha Trang Islands

  • Bring sun protection: hats, sunglasses, sunscreen

  • Wear light, quick-dry clothing

  • Carry cash for small island services

  • Book island tours in advance during peak season

  • Respect marine life and coral reefs

  • Check weather forecasts before departure

  • Prepare motion sickness medication if needed

Nha Trang Island Cuisine – Fresh Flavors Of The Sea

  • Binh Ba lobster

  • Various sea snails

  • Grilled grouper and cobia fish

  • Raw Mai fish salad

  • Sea urchin dishes

  • Seafood pancakes and mini rice cakes

  • One-sun-dried squid

Suggested 3 Day 2 Night Island Itinerary

Day 1: Hon Mun snorkeling – Floating fishing village – Nha Trang night market
Day 2: Diep Son or Binh Hung / Binh Ba Island exploration
Day 3: Relax at Hon Tam or enjoy VinWonders on Hon Tre Island

With its stunning islands, diverse experiences, and rich coastal culture, Nha Trang is a true island paradise. Whether you seek relaxation, adventure, luxury, or authentic island life, the islands of Nha Trang have something for everyone.

Planning an island tour in Nha Trang is the perfect way to experience the beauty of Vietnam’s central coastline and create unforgettable travel memories.

posts.title: Should You Choose Binh Hung Island Tour Or Vinh Hy Bay Tour?
posts.excerpt: Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay are two hidden gems of Vietnam’s South Central Coast, located in Khanh Hoa and Ninh Thuan provinces. Each destination offers a distinctive charm, pristine landscapes,
posts.contentHtml:
Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay are two hidden gems of Vietnam’s South Central Coast, located in Khanh Hoa and Ninh Thuan provinces. Each destination offers a distinctive charm, pristine landscapes, and unforgettable travel experiences for nature lovers and sea explorers.

Both places are ideal for travelers seeking untouched beauty, crystal-clear waters, and authentic local culture. However, to choose the destination that truly suits your travel style, budget, and time, it is essential to understand their differences in depth.

This guide by Vietlook Travel provides a detailed comparison of Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay, helping you make the best decision for your upcoming Vietnam coastal journey.

Binh Hung Island – Untouched Beauty And Authentic Island Life

Where Is Binh Hung Island And What Makes It Special?

Binh Hung Island, also known as Hon Ty or Hon Chut, is a small island located in Cam Binh Commune, Cam Ranh City, Khanh Hoa Province. Nestled at the foot of the coastal road connecting Binh Tien – Vinh Hy, the island belongs to Cam Ranh Bay, one of the deepest natural bays in the world.

Binh Hung is famous for its silky white sand beaches, emerald-clear seawater, and colorful coral reefs visible even from the shore. As part of the “Tam Binh” island group, Binh Hung retains its peaceful fishing-village atmosphere, largely untouched by mass tourism. Thanks to its breathtaking scenery, it is often referred to as the “Maldives of Vietnam.”

This island is perfect for travelers who appreciate simplicity, tranquility, and close contact with nature.

How To Get To Binh Hung Island And Estimated Costs

Travelers can reach Binh Hung Island using various transportation options:

  • By Road: From Ho Chi Minh City, sleeper buses to Cam Ranh or Nha Trang take approximately 9–10 hours, with ticket prices ranging from 250,000–400,000 VND per way. From My Thanh junction, visitors continue by motorbike or taxi to the pier, then take a short boat ride to the island.

  • By Train: Trains from Ho Chi Minh City to Nha Trang take about 8 hours, with ticket prices between 300,000–450,000 VND. Overnight trains are recommended for convenience. From Nha Trang Station, travelers proceed to the Binh Hung pier.

  • By Air: Flights to Cam Ranh International Airport are the fastest option, especially from Hanoi or northern provinces. Round-trip airfare usually ranges from 1,000,000–3,000,000 VND, depending on the route. From Cam Ranh Airport, it takes a short drive to the pier, followed by a boat ride costing 10,000–20,000 VND per person.

Best Time To Visit Binh Hung Island

The best time to visit Binh Hung Island is from March to August, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and water visibility is excellent for swimming and snorkeling. Average temperatures range from 28–32°C, ideal for outdoor activities.

Travelers should avoid the rainy season from September to December, when rough seas may affect transportation and safety.

Accommodation Options On Binh Hung Island

  • Hotels and Guesthouses: Prices range from 300,000–700,000 VND per night, offering basic comfort and sea views.

  • Homestays: Ideal for cultural immersion, with prices from 200,000–500,000 VND per night.

  • Beach Camping: A favorite option for adventure lovers, offering a unique experience under the stars at minimal cost.

Must-Visit Attractions On Binh Hung Island

  • Bai Kinh Beach: The island’s main gateway and a perfect spot to watch sunrise.

  • Bai Chuoi Beach: Deeper waters and gentle waves, ideal for swimming lovers.

  • Freshwater Beach (Bai Nuoc Ngot): A rare natural blend of freshwater stream and seawater.

  • Hon Chut Lighthouse: Panoramic views of Cam Ranh Bay, perfect for sunset photography.

  • Bai Me Beach: A snorkeling paradise accessible only by boat.

  • Tau Cave & Lovers’ Cave: Unique natural formations with crystal-clear water.

  • Bird Nest Swing: A popular photo spot floating above the sea.

  • Long Hung Pagoda & Nam Hai Whale Temple: Cultural and spiritual landmarks.

Binh Hung Island Cuisine – Fresh Seafood At Its Best

  • Fish cake noodle soup

  • Squid mini pancakes

  • Seaweed drink

  • Spiny lobster (local specialty)

  • Sea urchin dishes

  • Green chili grilled squid

All seafood is freshly caught and reasonably priced compared to mainland cities.

Vinh Hy Bay – Majestic Nature And Cultural Discovery

Location And Natural Setting

Vinh Hy Bay is located in Vinh Hai Commune, Ninh Hai District, Ninh Thuan Province, about 40 km from Phan Rang City. It is considered one of the four most beautiful bays in Vietnam and lies adjacent to Nui Chua National Park, creating a rare ecosystem of mountains, forest, and sea.

Vinh Hy enjoys a dry, mild climate year-round and is less affected by storms, making it ideal for extended exploration.

How To Get To Vinh Hy Bay

  • By Train: From Ho Chi Minh City to Thap Cham Station, ticket prices range from 250,000–500,000 VND.

  • By Air: Flights to Cam Ranh Airport, then travel by road to Vinh Hy.

  • By Coach: Sleeper buses from Ho Chi Minh City to Phan Rang cost 150,000–250,000 VND.

Accommodation In Vinh Hy

  • Camping: Ideal for groups and nature lovers.

  • Guesthouses & Small Hotels: Prices range from 250,000–600,000 VND per night.

  • Luxury Resorts: Amanoi Resort offers world-class luxury and privacy for high-end travelers.

Best Time To Visit Vinh Hy Bay

The ideal period is from February to October, especially May to August, when the sea is calm and visibility is excellent for snorkeling and marine activities.

Top Experiences In Vinh Hy

  • Snorkeling and scuba diving

  • Glass-bottom boat tours

  • Banana boat rides

  • Hang Rai natural rock formations

  • Nui Chua National Park trekking

  • Cham cultural sites

  • Sheep fields and sand dunes

  • Grape farms and local wineries

Vinh Hy Seafood Specialties

  • Scallops

  • Blue swimmer crabs

Binh Hung Or Vinh Hy – Which One Should You Choose?

Travel Duration
