Atmosphere

  • Binh Hung: Peaceful, rustic, fishing village lifestyle

  • Vinh Hy: Grand landscapes, adventure combined with relaxation

Activities

  • Binh Hung: Swimming, snorkeling, seafood, cultural immersion

  • Vinh Hy: Water sports, trekking, Cham culture, photography

Budget

  • Binh Hung: More budget-friendly

  • Vinh Hy: Flexible, from budget to luxury

Your Perfect Coastal Escape With Vietlook Travel

Both Binh Hung Island and Vinh Hy Bay offer unforgettable seaside experiences, each catering to different travel styles. If you seek tranquility, authenticity, and simplicity, Binh Hung is the perfect choice. If you prefer dramatic landscapes, diverse activities, and deeper exploration, Vinh Hy will captivate you.

No matter which destination you choose, Vietlook Travel is here to help you craft the perfect journey with well-designed itineraries, reliable services, and local expertise.

posts.title: Detailed Review Of Nha Trang Four Islands Tour Prices
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, one of Vietnam’s most famous coastal cities, has long been a dream destination for travelers thanks to its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters. Among countless exciting activities, th
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, one of Vietnam’s most famous coastal cities, has long been a dream destination for travelers thanks to its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters. Among countless exciting activities, the Nha Trang Four Islands Tour is considered an essential experience, offering visitors a complete exploration of the bay’s natural beauty and vibrant marine life.

So, what makes the Four Islands Tour so special? How much does it cost, and when is the best time to go? Let’s dive into this comprehensive guide to help you plan the perfect island-hopping adventure in 2026.

Discovering The Nha Trang Four Islands Tour – A Fascinating Sea Journey

Nha Trang Bay is proudly recognized as one of the world’s most beautiful bays, featuring 19 islands of various sizes, with 14 islands developed for tourism. The Four Islands Tour is carefully designed to showcase the most outstanding highlights of the bay, combining pristine nature with exciting sea activities.

A typical itinerary includes visits to Hon Mun Island, Bai Tranh Beach, Tri Nguyen Aquarium, and a local Fishing Village. Each destination has its own unique charm—from vibrant coral reefs and white sandy beaches to traditional floating villages and fresh seafood experiences.

This tour is not just about sightseeing; it is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the rhythm of coastal life, explore local culture, and create unforgettable memories. With its ideal location and natural advantages, Nha Trang has become one of Vietnam’s leading marine tourism hubs, offering everything from snorkeling and water sports to luxury resorts and island retreats.

The Best Time To Experience The Nha Trang Four Islands Tour

Nha Trang enjoys a mild climate year-round, making it possible to visit at almost any time. However, choosing the right season will significantly enhance your island tour experience.

According to travel experts and locals, February to September is the best time to join the Four Islands Tour. During this period, the weather is dry, sunny, and calm, perfect for swimming, snorkeling, and outdoor activities.

The summer months (June to August) are especially lively, with vibrant beach atmospheres and seasonal events, making it an ideal choice for families and summer holiday travelers.

From October to December, Nha Trang may experience occasional rain and rougher seas. While not constant, sudden showers or waves may affect island activities. If traveling during this period, it is recommended to monitor weather forecasts and choose flexible tour options.

Highlights Of The Four Islands Tour In Nha Trang

Hon Mun Island – A Paradise For Snorkeling And Diving

Hon Mun Island is named after its black rock formations resembling ebony wood. Despite its small size, Hon Mun is the first marine protected area in Vietnam and home to more than 350 coral species, accounting for nearly half of the world’s known coral species.

Visitors can enjoy snorkeling or scuba diving to explore a colorful underwater world filled with coral reefs, tropical fish, and unique marine creatures. The island also offers peaceful spots to relax, swim, and enjoy the refreshing sea breeze. For photography lovers, bringing a waterproof camera is highly recommended.

Bai Tranh Beach – Endless Fun And Water Activities

Bai Tranh Beach is a popular stop on the Four Islands Tour, known for its long white sandy shore and clear turquoise waters. The beach offers a perfect balance between relaxation and adventure.

Here, visitors can sunbathe, swim, or participate in exciting water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and snorkeling. Small beachside restaurants also serve refreshments and light meals, making it easy to recharge after a fun-filled morning.

Fishing Village – Local Life And Fresh Seafood

The Fishing Village offers a glimpse into the daily life of local fishermen. Visitors can observe floating fish farms and learn about traditional aquaculture practices.

The highlight of this stop is the seafood experience. Guests can select freshly caught seafood such as grouper, lobster, squid, or shrimp, which is then prepared on the spot. The fresh, authentic flavors of the sea make this an unforgettable culinary experience. Visitors can also purchase dried seafood and local specialties as souvenirs.

Tri Nguyen Aquarium – A Unique Marine Museum On The Sea

Tri Nguyen Aquarium, also known as Tri Nguyen Marine Park, features a distinctive structure shaped like an ancient pirate ship. Inside, visitors can explore a variety of marine species through interconnected tanks and glass tunnels.

The aquarium showcases thousands of sea creatures, from colorful reef fish to rare marine species. This destination is especially suitable for families with children, offering both educational and entertaining experiences. Nearby cafés and souvenir shops provide convenient spots to relax.

Nha Trang Four Islands Tour Prices 2026 And Cost Factors

Tour prices vary depending on several factors, including tour type, transportation, included services, and travel season.

Group Tours

  • Wooden boat tours: approximately 250,000 – 400,000 VND per person

  • Speedboat tours: approximately 450,000 – 650,000 VND per person

These prices usually include transportation, lunch, entrance fees to selected islands, and basic travel insurance. Optional activities such as diving or water sports may incur additional charges.

Private Tours

Private tours are ideal for families or groups seeking flexibility and privacy. Prices depend on group size and service level but offer customized itineraries, extended island stops, and premium services.

Seasonal Factors

Prices may increase slightly during peak seasons such as summer holidays and public festivals. Off-season travel may offer better deals and promotions.

Essential Items To Bring For Your Four Islands Tour

  • Sunscreen, hat, sunglasses

  • Swimwear and lightweight clothing

  • Waterproof sandals or flip-flops

  • Phone, camera, power bank

  • Waterproof bags for electronics

  • Personal medication and seasickness pills

  • Cash and identification documents

  • Snorkeling gear (optional but recommended)

Should You Join A Tour Or Travel Independently?

Advantages Of Joining A Tour

  • Cost-effective and time-saving

  • Well-organized itinerary

  • Professional guides and safety assurance

  • Access to discounted activity prices

  • Ideal for first-time visitors

Advantages Of Independent Travel

  • Flexible schedule

  • Personalized exploration

  • Deeper local interaction

  • Suitable for small, experienced travel groups

Overall, guided tours are highly recommended for convenience, safety, and value, especially for first-time visitors to Nha Trang.

Final Tips For A Perfect Island Adventure

  • Book tours early during peak seasons

  • Choose reputable tour operators

  • Protect the marine environment

  • Try local specialties such as fish noodle soup and grilled fermented pork

  • Prepare backup plans for weather changes

Experience The Best Of Nha Trang With Vietlook Travel

The Nha Trang Four Islands Tour is more than a sightseeing trip—it is a complete journey into nature, culture, and coastal life. From vibrant coral reefs and exciting water activities to authentic fishing villages and fresh seafood, every moment is designed to leave lasting impressions.

Vietlook Travel proudly offers high-quality Four Islands Tours in Nha Trang, with transparent pricing, professional services, and itineraries tailored for international travelers, families, and private groups.

posts.title: Discover Nha Trang Street Food
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, the sparkling gem of Vietnam’s Central Coast, is famous not only for its pristine white-sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters, but also for its vibrant and flavorful street food c
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, the sparkling gem of Vietnam’s Central Coast, is famous not only for its pristine white-sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters, but also for its vibrant and flavorful street food culture. In November 2025, as the city transitions from the rainy season to the dry season, the weather becomes cooler and more pleasant perfect for wandering through the streets and indulging in local delicacies.

This article invites you to dive deep into the world of Nha Trang street food, featuring authentic eateries and must-try dishes beloved by locals. These culinary experiences promise to add unforgettable flavors to your journey in this beautiful coastal city.

An Overview Of Nha Trang Street Food

Nha Trang’s cuisine stands out for its fresh seafood and bold coastal flavors. Dishes are often prepared in a simple yet refined way, allowing the natural sweetness of the ingredients to shine through. The cultural influence of both Vietnamese and Cham heritage has also shaped a rich and diverse food scene.

Visiting Nha Trang during the dry season gives travelers the perfect opportunity to enjoy these specialties in a relaxed, open-air atmosphere under clear skies and gentle sea breezes.

Must Try Street Food Dishes In Nha Trang

Bun Cha Ca (Fish Cake Noodle Soup)

A traditional breakfast favorite, Bun Cha Ca features a light yet flavorful broth made from fish bones, springy fish cakes, and fresh herbs. It is considered a signature dish of Nha Trang. Locals often recommend Nguyen Loan Fish Noodle Soup, located at 123 Ngo Gia Tu Street.

Nem Nuong Nha Trang (Grilled Fermented Pork Rolls)

Fragrant grilled pork rolls served with crispy rice paper, fresh herbs, and a unique dipping sauce. This dish is widely available at street-side eateries and delivers a truly unforgettable taste. Dang Van Quyen Nem Nuong, at 16A Lan Ong Street, is a well-known local favorite.

Fresh Seafood

As a coastal city, Nha Trang is a seafood paradise. Shrimp, crab, squid, clams, snails, and lobster are prepared in various styles such as steaming, grilling, or tamarind stir-frying. Seafood restaurants along Bo Ke Street and Thap Ba Street are especially lively in the evenings.

Banh Can

Small savory rice flour pancakes cooked in clay molds, filled with shrimp, squid, or quail eggs, and served with a sweet and sour fish sauce. Banh Can 15 Thap Ba is a highly recommended spot.

Banh Xeo Muc (Squid Pancake)

A crispy Vietnamese pancake filled with fresh squid, served with herbs and dipping sauce. Banh Xeo Chao, at 87 Hoang Van Thu Street, is popular among locals.

Bird’s Nest (Yen Sao)

A nutritious specialty of Khanh Hoa Province. Visitors can enjoy bird’s nest sweet soup or purchase it as a premium local gift.

Experiencing Street Food Like A Local

To truly immerse yourself in Nha Trang’s culinary culture, consider the following experiences:

Explore Dam Market

Dam Market is the largest traditional market in Nha Trang, offering fresh seafood, local specialties, and a wide variety of street snacks. It is the perfect place to experience the city’s daily rhythm and authentic flavors.

Wander Through Food Streets

Evenings are ideal for exploring food-filled streets such as Ngo Gia Tu, Thap Ba, and areas near Tran Phu Beach. Street carts and small eateries serve everything from fish noodle soup and grilled pork to seafood and snails.

Enjoy Sidewalk Coffee

Sidewalk coffee is an essential part of Vietnamese culture. Sitting on a low plastic stool, sipping iced milk coffee, and watching daily life unfold is a relaxing and authentic local experience.

Local Tips

Do not hesitate to ask locals for recommendations. They often know hidden gems that offer the most authentic flavors at reasonable prices. Be open to trying unfamiliar dishes—this is the best way to discover the soul of Nha Trang’s cuisine.

Planning Your Street Food Journey

The best time to visit Nha Trang for street food exploration is during the dry season, especially from March to August. However, November 2025 remains an excellent choice, with mild sunshine and minimal rainfall. Getting around the city is easy with taxis, ride-hailing apps, or motorbike rentals, which allow you to explore food spots freely.

A trip to Nha Trang would be incomplete without a street food adventure. With insights from local residents and a spirit of culinary curiosity, your journey will be filled with unforgettable tastes and meaningful cultural experiences.

Discover Nha Trang With Vietlook Travel

Exploring Nha Trang street food is more than just tasting local dishes it is a journey into the heart of coastal Vietnamese culture. From sizzling street grills to bustling local markets, every flavor tells a story shaped by the sea, history, and daily life.

At Vietlook Travel we specialize in crafting authentic, experience-driven journeys for international travelers who want to go beyond the surface. Our curated Nha Trang experiences combine street food discovery, local insights, and seamless travel services to ensure you enjoy the city like a true insider comfortably, safely, and meaningfully.

posts.title: The Most Popular Tourist Attractions In Nha Trang
posts.excerpt: Nha Trang, often referred to as the jewel of Vietnam’s coastline, has long been one of the country’s most attractive travel destinations thanks to its perfect blend of unspoiled natural beauty and mod
posts.contentHtml:
Nha Trang, often referred to as the jewel of Vietnam’s coastline, has long been one of the country’s most attractive travel destinations thanks to its perfect blend of unspoiled natural beauty and modern tourism services. With long stretches of white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a pleasant climate all year round, this coastal city promises unforgettable experiences for every traveler.

In 2025, Nha Trang continues to strengthen its position as one of Southeast Asia’s leading beach destinations, with significant improvements in infrastructure and tourism services. From spectacular islands and world-class entertainment complexes to ancient Cham cultural relics and vibrant street food scenes, Nha Trang truly has something for everyone.

To make your journey truly complete, careful planning and a thorough understanding of the destinations are essential. Beyond its landscapes, Nha Trang is also loved for the warm hospitality of its people and its colorful cultural festivals. Let us explore 10 must-visit attractions, along with useful travel tips, to help you enjoy an unforgettable trip to Nha Trang in 2025.

1. VinWonders Nha Trang (Formerly Vinpearl Land)

Located on Hon Tre Island, VinWonders Nha Trang is a world-class entertainment and resort complex often described as a “tropical paradise.” In addition to pristine beaches, the complex features five-star hotels, infinity pools overlooking the sea, and a massive amusement park offering hundreds of thrilling rides.

What makes VinWonders truly special is the diversity of its attractions, including an expansive water park with high-speed slides, a large aquarium showcasing thousands of colorful marine species, and King’s Garden, a semi-wild zoo where visitors can interact with rare animals. Spectacular performances such as the Tata Show are also a major highlight.

Visitors reach VinWonders via one of the world’s longest overwater cable cars, offering breathtaking panoramic views of Nha Trang Bay. Entrance tickets range from approximately VND 800,000 to VND 1,200,000, depending on the season and package. To fully enjoy the experience, it is recommended to spend an entire day here and book tickets online in advance.

2. Hon Mun Island

Recognized by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) as one of Vietnam’s most biodiverse marine areas, Hon Mun Island is a paradise for ocean lovers. The island is famous for its pristine coral reefs and vibrant underwater ecosystem.

Hon Mun is ideal for snorkeling and scuba diving, suitable for both beginners and experienced divers. Visitors can swim among tropical fish, admire colorful coral formations, or enjoy glass-bottom boat tours for coral viewing without entering the water. Sea-walking with special diving helmets is also a popular activity.

The best time to visit Hon Mun is from April to September, when the sea is calm and visibility is excellent. As a protected marine reserve, environmental conservation is strictly enforced. Boat transfers from Cau Da Port typically cost VND 250,000–350,000, excluding diving fees.

3. Hon Tam Island

Located about seven kilometers southeast of Nha Trang city center, Hon Tam Island spans over 110 hectares and is known for its untouched beauty combined with premium tourism services. From the island, visitors can admire panoramic views of Nha Trang City to the north and the majestic Cam Ranh Peninsula to the south.

In addition to white sandy beaches and clear waters, Hon Tam offers a wide range of marine activities such as snorkeling, sea walking, parasailing, and jet skiing. A major highlight is the MerPerle Hon Tam Mud Bath, where visitors can relax in natural hot mineral mud baths while enjoying stunning ocean views.

The island also features luxury resorts, professional spa services, and diverse dining options. Entrance and service packages typically range from VND 300,000 to VND 800,000, including speedboat transfers.

4. Ninh Van Bay

Located approximately 60 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Ninh Van Bay is a hidden gem for travelers seeking tranquility and seclusion. Far from the bustling city, the bay offers a peaceful atmosphere, crystal-clear waters, and deserted beaches framed by lush coconut palms.

The area is home to world-renowned luxury resorts such as Six Senses Ninh Van Bay, offering private villas with personal pools, refined cuisine, and holistic spa experiences. Activities focus on reconnecting with nature, including kayaking, snorkeling near the shore, and simply relaxing on the beach.

Although accommodation costs are relatively high, the experience offers unparalleled privacy and exclusivity, making it ideal for couples, honeymooners, and wellness retreats.

5. National Oceanographic Museum Of Nha Trang

Founded in 1923, the National Oceanographic Museum of Nha Trang is one of Vietnam’s oldest and largest marine research institutions. Located near Cau Da Port, the museum houses over 20,000 specimens representing more than 4,000 marine and freshwater species.

Its most impressive exhibit is a fully restored whale skeleton measuring nearly 26 meters in length. The museum also features live marine displays, rare species conservation areas, and exhibits on the history of oceanographic research.

With affordable entrance fees, this destination is particularly suitable for families and travelers interested in marine science and environmental conservation.

6. Po Nagar Cham Towers

Situated just two kilometers north of the city center, the Po Nagar Cham Towers are one of the most important Cham architectural complexes in Central Vietnam. The site is dedicated to Goddess Po Nagar, revered as the Mother of the Land.

Visitors can admire intricate brickwork, ancient carvings, and learn about Cham beliefs and traditions. The annual Po Nagar Festival, held in the third lunar month, attracts thousands of pilgrims and tourists.

7. Hon Chong – Hon Vo Rocks

Hon Chong – Hon Vo is a unique coastal rock formation known for its massive boulders stacked naturally in dramatic shapes. Associated with romantic local legends, this site offers spectacular views of Nha Trang Bay, especially at sunrise and sunset.

The nearby cultural center often hosts traditional music and dance performances, enriching the cultural experience.

8. Van Phong Bay

Located about 40 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Van Phong Bay is often described as one of Vietnam’s most untouched coastal areas. With pristine beaches, scattered islands, and clear waters, it is ideal for eco-tourism and nature exploration.

Visitors can snorkel, kayak, fish with local fishermen, or visit traditional fishing villages. Mui Doi, Vietnam’s easternmost mainland point, is also located here, offering a unique sunrise experience.

9. Dai Lanh Beach

Approximately 80 kilometers north of Nha Trang, Dai Lanh Beach is famous for its powdery white sand, turquoise waters, and peaceful atmosphere. The beach is perfect for relaxation, seafood tasting, and visiting nearby fishing villages.

Fresh seafood, affordable prices, and scenic surroundings make Dai Lanh an excellent escape from the city’s crowds.

10. Dam Market

Located in the heart of Nha Trang, Dam Market is both a commercial hub and a cultural landmark. With its distinctive circular architecture, the market offers a lively glimpse into local life.

Visitors can shop for fresh seafood, dried specialties, local delicacies, and handcrafted souvenirs. The market is also a street food paradise, featuring dishes such as jellyfish noodle soup, grilled pork rolls, and traditional sweet desserts.

Useful Tips For Visiting Nha Trang In 2025

The best time to visit Nha Trang is from January to September, when the weather is sunny and ideal for sea activities. Motorbikes are the most convenient way to explore the city, while taxis and buses are suitable for longer distances or group travel.

Booking accommodation and tours in advance during peak seasons is highly recommended. Visitors should also pack sunscreen, swimwear, and cash for local markets. Exploring cafés with ocean views and participating in local festivals will further enrich your experience.

Final Thoughts

With its diverse attractions from stunning beaches and untouched islands to ancient heritage sites and vibrant markets Nha Trang offers something for every traveler. Whether you seek adventure, relaxation, cultural discovery, or culinary exploration, this coastal city will not disappoint.

Nha Trang is not only an ideal holiday destination but also a gateway to understanding Cham civilization and enjoying Vietnam’s rich coastal cuisine. Plan your journey today and prepare for unforgettable memories in one of Vietnam’s most captivating seaside cities.

posts.title: Should You Choose Binh Ba Island Tour Or Binh Hung Island Tour?
posts.excerpt: For first time travelers to Nha Trang, choosing between Binh Ba Island tour and Binh Hung Island tour is one of the most common questions. Both islands are stunning, peaceful, and rich in natural beau
posts.contentHtml:
For first time travelers to Nha Trang, choosing between Binh Ba Island tour and Binh Hung Island tour is one of the most common questions. Both islands are stunning, peaceful, and rich in natural beauty, yet each offers a very different travel experience.

In this article, Vietlook Travel provides a comprehensive comparison of Binh Ba and Binh Hung Islands to help you choose the destination that best suits your travel style when visiting Nha Trang.

Overview Of Binh Ba Island And Binh Hung Island – Two Hidden Gems Of Khanh Hoa

Both Binh Ba Island and Binh Hung Island are small islands located in Cam Ranh City, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. Although they are geographically close, separated only by a narrow strait, each island has its own distinct charm.

As both islands lie within a military-controlled area, tourism development has been limited. This has helped preserve their pristine landscapes, clear waters, and authentic local life, offering visitors a more genuine and less commercialized island experience.

Binh Ba Island – The Lobster Island

Often referred to as “Lobster Island,” Binh Ba covers an area of just over three square kilometers and is nestled along the scenic coastal road of Binh Tien, near Vinh Hy Bay.

The island is famous for:

  • White sandy beaches

  • Crystal-clear turquoise water

  • A peaceful and relaxing atmosphere

  • Fresh seafood, especially lobster at reasonable prices

Binh Ba is ideal for travelers who enjoy a balance between relaxation, beach activities, and vibrant local food culture.

Binh Hung Island – A Quiet And Untouched Paradise

Smaller in size, Binh Hung Island spans approximately two square kilometers and is located near Hon Chut Lighthouse. Often described as a “raw gem,” Binh Hung remains largely untouched by mass tourism.

The island is known for:

  • Egg-shaped stone beaches

  • Small, hidden coves

  • Traditional fishing village life

  • A calm, rustic atmosphere

Binh Hung is perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, nature exploration, and a slower pace of life.

Highlights Of Binh Ba Island – Beaches, Seafood, And Local Life

Bai Nom Beach – Swimming And Seafood Paradise

Bai Nom is the most popular beach on Binh Ba Island, featuring soft sand, calm waters, and rocky formations. Visitors can relax on hammocks, swim, and enjoy freshly caught seafood such as lobster, squid, sea urchin, and snails.

In the evening, the area becomes a lively seafood hub, offering grilled lobster, steamed seafood, and other local specialties.

Sa Huynh Beach – Mysterious Ancient Rock Formations

Located in a restricted military zone, Sa Huynh Beach is accessible only by boat. The beach is famous for its colorful ancient rock formations shaped over millions of years.

Early morning or late afternoon is the best time to visit for photography, when sunlight creates dramatic reflections on the rocks.

Bai Chuong Beach – Sunrise And Marine Ecosystem

Bai Chuong is known as the best spot to watch sunrise on Binh Ba Island. The beach features rich marine life near the shore, making it ideal for shell collecting, light snorkeling, and photography.

Hon Rua – The Iconic Turtle-Shaped Rock

Hon Rua is one of the most iconic landmarks on the island. From above, the rock resembles a turtle emerging from the sea. It is a favorite spot for photography and panoramic views of Cam Ranh Bay.

Binh Ba Floating Village – Local Culture And Fresh Seafood

The floating village offers a glimpse into the daily life of lobster farmers. Visitors can choose live seafood directly from the cages and have it prepared on the spot, enjoying the freshest flavors of the sea.

Hon Co Beach – Where History Meets Nature

Hon Co Beach holds historical significance, having witnessed conflicts during past wars. Today, it combines natural beauty with historical stories, adding depth to the island experience.

What Makes A Binh Hung Island Tour Special?

Egg Stone Beach – A Geological Wonder

Egg Stone Beach features large, smooth, egg-shaped rocks formed by natural erosion. It is a popular photography spot, though not suitable for swimming.

Cay Me Beach – A Natural Swimming Pool

Accessible only by boat, Cay Me Beach is famous for its crystal-clear water and vibrant coral reefs, making it perfect for snorkeling and underwater photography.

Hon Chut Lighthouse – A Century-Old Viewpoint

Built over one hundred years ago, Hon Chut Lighthouse offers panoramic views of Binh Hung Island and Cam Ranh Bay, making it one of the most scenic viewpoints in the region.

Binh Tien Beach – Luxury Amid Nature

Now developed into a resort area, Binh Tien Beach combines modern comfort with untouched natural beauty, offering white sand, clear water, and peaceful surroundings.

Sweet Water Beach – Where Fresh And Salt Water Meet

Sweet Water Beach is unique for its freshwater pool hidden inside a rocky cave, right next to the sea. Visitors can enjoy both saltwater swimming and freshwater relaxation in one location.

Accommodation Options On Binh Ba And Binh Hung Islands

Both islands offer budget-friendly accommodations such as guesthouses, homestays, and floating houses. Prices are affordable, and staying with local families provides an authentic cultural experience.

Camping on the beach and staying on floating seafood farms are also popular options, especially on Binh Hung Island.

Must-Try Local Dishes On Both Islands

Seafood lovers will be delighted with specialties such as:

  • Grilled lobster

  • Sea urchin with scallion oil

  • Grilled grouper with chili salt

  • Snails, squid, and fresh fish

  • Seafood banh canh and fish noodle soup

Best Time To Visit

The ideal time to visit Binh Ba and Binh Hung Islands is from March to September, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and outdoor activities are most enjoyable.

How To Get There

Travelers first reach Ba Ngoi Port in Cam Ranh, then take a boat or speedboat to the islands. On the islands, motorbike rental is the most convenient way to explore.

Travel Tips For A Perfect Trip

  • Book accommodation in advance during peak season

  • Bring cash, as card payments are limited

  • Respect military area regulations

  • Protect the environment and avoid littering

  • Foreign travelers need special permission to visit Binh Ba Island

Final Verdict: Binh Ba Or Binh Hung?

Both islands offer unique experiences:

  • Binh Ba Island is livelier, famous for lobster and developed services, ideal for travelers who enjoy vibrant island life.

  • Binh Hung Island is quieter and more untouched, perfect for nature lovers seeking peace and authenticity.

Your choice depends on your travel preferences. Either way, a Binh Ba – Binh Hung tour curated by Vietlook Travel promises an unforgettable island experience in Nha Trang.

posts.title: Specialty of Hanoi Com
posts.excerpt: Specialty of Hanoi Com, with a delicious and refreshing taste, and is a dish chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Hanoi. This is not only a delicious dish but also has a pro
posts.contentHtml:
Specialty of Hanoi Com, with a delicious and refreshing taste, and is a dish chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to visit Hanoi. This is not only a delicious dish but also has a profound cultural value that reflects the unique culinary culture of Hanoi.

Com is made from young sticky rice, and must be the fragrant and fragrant yellow sticky rice variety to bring delicious and sticky golden rice grains. To get delicious com grains, the person making com must carefully select the rice flowers, then bring them back to separate the rice grains, dry the rice until ripe and peel off the husk to make the green and fragrant rice grains look very attractive.

Many tourists when traveling to Hanoi enjoy com and buy it as a gift, even buy it as a gift with the specialty of com lang vong Hanoi, a famous specialty that has existed for generations.

Com has a light green color, which is the color of young rice, and com is wrapped in fresh lotus leaves, creating a unique delicious flavor that blends the aroma of com, the aroma of lotus leaves with com and the green season of lotus leaves, bringing a very unique delicious flavor of Northern cuisine.

Com is divided into early season com, late season com, young com, old com, rustic com, and lake com… in which early season com is around February – April, at this time the young rice grains have the aroma of rice milk, late season com is usually in July – October, at this time the rice grains are more fatty, com is most enjoyable to enjoy when the weather is cold, watching the scenery and enjoying young com in the autumn weather of Hanoi, there is nothing more enjoyable.

Com is not only enjoyed directly but also processed into many different delicious dishes such as: Com sticky rice, Com cake, Com sweet soup, Com stir-fried… bringing a very unique delicious flavor of Hanoi cuisine.

It can be said that Hanoi, in addition to the French village spaces, sidewalk shops, also has many local specialties. If you have the opportunity to travel  Hanoi, enjoy the sidewalk dishes, and admire the scenery of Hanoi, especially on the old streets when the night falls, visitors will be immersed in the vibrant music…

In addition, to have the most beautiful trip to Hanoi, from August to November and spring from March to April. Many tourists often choose Hanoi in autumn to walk and admire the scenery under the fallen yellow leaves, next to the blue sky with the cool breeze, the scent of milk flowers and many other colorful flowers.

Hanoi attractions

Tran Quoc Pagoda

One of the ancient pagodas, located right on the east side of West Lake, the majestic pagoda is surrounded by a clear lake, a peaceful scene.

Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam

As one of the first schools in Vietnam, visitors come here to visit the solemn campus or admire the lotus ponds, water lily ponds… inside the Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam still preserves valuable artifacts and documents, especially the 82 doctoral steles recognized by UNESCO as “World Documentary Heritage”.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum

For any tourist when visiting Hanoi for sightseeing, they cannot miss the attraction such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, in the morning visitors will attend the flag raising or lowering ceremony at 9pm every day in a solemn atmosphere.

Museum

Visitors come here not only to visit but also to learn more about Vietnamese culture, so most of the Hanoi tour itinerary cannot miss the destination such as: the Museum of Ethnology where 15,000 artifacts, 42,000 documentary films, pictures and other documents are preserved and displayed.

So it can be said that when visiting Hanoi, you not only enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as Com Lang Vong, but when coming to Hanoi, you also visit famous landmarks, historical sites, ancient temples, or traditional craft villages… will bring you the most enjoyable experiences.

posts.contentHtml:
Explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village for half a day, will bring you the most enjoyable experiences, Huong Quang Phu Cau village is located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, is one of the traditional craft villages, the village is currently the hottest check-in spot.

Coming to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you will be able to freely check in for yourself beautiful photos next to colorful bundles of incense, arranged in many different styles, which will bring you beautiful photos. posts.contentHtml:
Bai Tu Long Bay Cruise will take you to the islands, including many small islands and people living on the islands, surrounded by limestone ranges with beautiful scenery that looks like Ha Long Bay.

If you are a person who loves peaceful natural scenery, experience the cruise to visit Bai Tu Long Bay, which has its own wild beauty, this place is very suitable for resort tours during your holidays.

Experience Bai Tu Long Bay cruise, you will start from Hon Gai, northeast of Ha Long Bay, then go through Bai Chay bridge, sitting on the cruise you will admire the poetic scenery.

Currently, Ha Long cruise tours all depart from Hanoi, then visitors often choose to stay overnight on the cruise and then visit Bai Tu Long Bay.

For cruise schedules in addition to other locations, visitors do not have to depart from Hanoi, visitors need to choose the time to match the boat’s departure time.

The cruise itinerary departs from Hanoi as follows: Hanoi, tourists take Highway 5 to Bac Ninh, Highway 18 Pha Lai – Chi Linh – Dong Trieu – Uong Bi – Ha Long – Hon Gai / or Noi Bai – Bac Ninh, Highway 18A through Pha Lai – Sao Do – Dong Trieu – Uong Bi – Ha Long – Hon Gai, the distance you take is 4 hours to reach the bay.

Or you can choose the itinerary Hanoi – Hai Phong – Ha Long – Hon Gai with the same distance and time. However, if you take the highway, it will save you some time to visit.

The itinerary to Bai Tu Long Bay for 2 days and 1 night, please refer to it before having the opportunity to set foot here.

Day 1: You will depart from Hanoi to Hon Gai port, Ha Long city, go to the cruise waiting room, check in to board the ship.

On board, you will be given safety instructions, then check in, enjoy lunch and rest.

In the afternoon, depending on the ship’s schedule, you can join kayaking or bamboo boating with fishermen to visit the islands and see the scenery.

At the end of the day, you will return to the boat to rest or join a cooking class with the cruise’s professional chefs.

In the evening, having dinner on the boat and freely admiring the scenery from the deck will bring you the most unforgettable moments.

Day 2:

In the morning, you wake up early to admire the scenery from the boat, a fresh air of the sea and islands. Then enjoy breakfast and visit Thien Canh Son cave, one of the natural caves in Bai Tu Long Bay.

Return to the ship to check out, the boat takes you back to the mainland, before returning to the mainland you will have a light lunch on the boat, then take you back to Hon Gai, the car takes you back to the original pick-up point to end the 2-day 1-night Bai Tu Long tour.

The journey will bring you an exciting vacation, you will have the most interesting experiences in the island paradise during your vacation.

So if you are choosing a vacation, choose the Bai Tu Long Bay cruise tour today to experience the most interesting things, when sitting on a cruise gliding through the famous sights, or experience soaking in the cool water right on a 5-star cruise, enjoying delicious and attractive dishes, learning to cook with a professional chef will bring you the most enjoyable feeling during your vacation.

Ha Long climate in May

Ha Long is an ideal resort destination, Ha Long belongs to the climate of the North and is divided into 4 seasons, but usually has 2 main seasons, which are the rainy season and the dry season, however, visitors often travel to Ha Long all year round.

In particular, tourists often travel to Ha Long most beautifully in the summer, Ha Long resort tours tourists often come to Ha Long in spring and autumn. However, to have time to admire the beautiful scenery of Ha Long Bay, tourists often choose to go on Ha Long tours from March to May and from October to November. However, if you are a person who loves swimming in the sea and participating in games, you should travel to Ha Long in the summer.

Summer weather from December and lasts until January of the following year, the weather is foggy. This is the time when Ha Long is entering the winter, quite cold, many tourists want to choose economical Ha Long tours, so they should go at this time and cannot participate in games on the sea, or swim in the sea because at this time the weather is quite cold, only suitable for Ha Long resort tours.

Ha Long in May, visitors should experience the exciting games on the sea, at this time the weather is clear and there are sudden showers, short rains that will stop immediately so it will not affect the tourist’s itinerary.

If you are a person who loves to admire the scenery, participate in games and enjoy virtual life, do not forget to bring yourself bright-colored dresses to take pictures, next to the blue sea, white sand, and yellow sunshine.

Traveling to Ha Long in May, you should visit Tuan Chau Island, or take a 5-star Ha Long cruise tour, gliding through the famous landscapes, amazing caves, and through the islands in the bay to admire the poetic scenery, especially to welcome the sunrise rising above the sea, a beautiful scene that looks like a poetic painting.

Ha Long tourist attractions in May

Ha Long Bay

posts.title: Ninh Binh Tourism in April
posts.excerpt: Ninh Binh Tourism in April brings visitors to a peaceful land, where the pristine beauty is still preserved, with cool green rice fields, blue rivers, surrounded by mountains that look like a rustic c
posts.contentHtml:
Ninh Binh Tourism in April brings visitors to a peaceful land, where the pristine beauty is still preserved, with cool green rice fields, blue rivers, surrounded by mountains that look like a rustic countryside painting, in the distance are villages hidden next to the mountains.

In April, Ninh Binh begins to enter summer, bringing with it a changing climate, gradually from spring to summer, each season Ninh Binh brings visitors a unique beauty, but April is the season of lotus flowers blooming, visitors can take beautiful pictures of the blooming lotus season.

Ninh Binh’s weather in April is not as hot as in May and June. Therefore, Ninh Binh in April is still a destination chosen by many tourists, the temperature at this time is around 25 degrees Celsius, there is no rain, so traveling to Ninh Binh in April, the weather is quite nice for visitors to visit and sightsee.

Ninh Binh tourist attractions in April

1. Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Traveling to Ninh Binh in April, you should visit Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, which is not only known for its two temples of King Dinh Tien Hoang and King Le Dai Hanh, but also welcomes visitors with famous landmarks, natural scenery that blends together to create a poetic picture.

2. Trang An

Recognized by UNESCO as a heritage site in 2014, traveling to Trang An in April, you should take a boat to admire the scenery, surrounded by limestone mountains below is a clear blue stream, you take a boat to admire the charming scenery.

When the boat is gently on the lake, you will see each cave or ancient pagoda, you will feel like you are lost in a fairyland, with clear blue moss water, you can see all the way to the bottom.

3. Tam Coc

Coming here, visitors not only admire the natural scenery but also feel the scenery of a countryside, that peaceful scenery is an ideal destination for every tourist’s vacation tour when coming to Ninh Binh, many tourists still choose Ninh Binh vacation tour in April.

4. Thung Nham Bird Garden

As a world natural heritage site, surrounded by high mountains that look like a watercolor painting, especially when coming here, visitors also visit the caves, especially the scene of flocks of birds flying in the sky, you can save for yourself beautiful pictures, will definitely bring you the most unforgettable feeling, when you have the opportunity to set foot in Ninh Binh.

5. Bai Dinh Pagoda

The pagoda is located majestically with a unique design, and is very sophisticatedly sculpted, from here visitors can admire the peaceful scenery, and admire its own beauty and is an indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary.

What to eat when traveling to Ninh Binh in April?

Goat meat: One of the famous specialties in Ninh Binh, goat meat is processed into many different delicious dishes such as: raw goat with lemon, goat hotpot, or grilled goat… so when traveling to Ninh Binh in April, goat meat is a delicious dish that visitors must enjoy.

Crispy rice: A famous specialty in Ninh Binh, visitors not only enjoy but also buy as gifts.

Yen Mac sour sausage: The sausage here is made with fresh spices, creating a harmonious combination of sweet and sour flavors, if you travel Ninh Binh in April, don’t forget to buy sour sausage as gifts.

Eel salad: A famous specialty of Ninh Binh, with the softness of the eel fish combined with the spices mixed together to bring diners an irresistible aroma.

Mountain snails: A famous specialty in Ninh Binh, snails often live in mountain crevices, the snail meat is fragrant, chewy, sweet and very nutritious, chosen by many gourmets.

Kim Son wine: When talking about delicious dishes, we cannot help but mention delicious wine, this is one of the wines that Ninh Binh people naturally ferment, so it is very delicious.

Eel vermicelli: April is summer in Ninh Binh, so you should enjoy a bowl of eel vermicelli, which is not only delicious but also cool, and watching the scenery of Ninh Binh in the changing seasons is nothing more interesting.

Ant egg sticky rice: A special dish, the ants here are brought by people from the mountains, so it naturally brings a natural fragrance, which cannot be found anywhere else.

Fish braised in a hot pot: The fish are caught fresh, cleaned and braised in a hot pot, brought out to enjoy, giving off a natural fragrance. If you travel to Ninh Binh in April, you should not miss this dish of Fish braised in a hot pot.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Ninh Binh in April, hopefully it will help your trip, wish you a happy vacation with Vietlook Travel.

posts.title: Visiting craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Located about 25km from Hanoi, visitors will visit many traditional craft villages, with many unique products that represent the unique culture of the countryside. So let’s go with Vietlook travel to
posts.contentHtml:
Located about 25km from Hanoi, visitors will visit many traditional craft villages, with many unique products that represent the unique culture of the countryside. So let’s go with Vietlook travel to review the craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi in this article.

Thach Xa village makes bamboo dragonflies

Located right at the foot of Tay Phuong mountain where Tay Phuong Thach That pagoda is located, from Thach That, visitors travel about 10km to Tay Phuong pagoda, which is famous for making bamboo dragonflies, and the dragonflies are sold right at the souvenir stalls in Tay Phuong pagoda.

Bamboo bean craft in Dinh Cong

The craft village is located right in the capital of Hanoi, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should set foot in Dinh Cong and visit the traditional craft village, and meet the artisans of the craft village.

Silver-making means that when the silver has been melted, skilled craftsmen will pull the silver into the shapes of flowers, leaves, birds or jewelry with main products such as: bracelets, lapel pins, rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, silver souvenirs… when you come here you can buy them as gifts.

Chuong conical hat village

Located in Thanh Oai, Hanoi, when you come here, visit the market held on even days, on the 4th, 10th, 14th, 20th, 24th and 30th of the lunar month, the market usually opens from 6am to 8am, the market specializes in selling hats and hat-making materials.

It can be said that Chuong Village’s conical hats have long been famous for their durability and beauty. If you visit Chuong Village, you can buy them as souvenirs, or visit the village to learn how to make hats with the artisans in the village. You will make hats from the basics to the finished product, and you can draw patterns on the hats yourself and then bring them home as gifts.

Ha Thai Lacquer Village

Located in Thuong Tin, Hanoi. The craft village has long been famous for its unique lacquer products such as vases, bowls, plates, chopsticks… and unique and sophisticated wall decorations. Currently, Ha Thai lacquer paintings have spread to other countries, the paintings exude the beauty of Vietnamese countryside.

Chang Son Fan Village

Located in Thach That, Hanoi, the products have been exported to many countries, every day hundreds of fans of many types are produced such as: paper fans, bamboo fans, silk fans, picture fans…

Bat Trang Pottery Village

The craft village specializes in producing teapots, bowls, plates, and vases made of ceramic. There are also construction materials and insulating porcelain. Coming here, visitors can visit the season of ceramic products as gifts, and mold the products with their own hands with long-time artisans in the profession. Many foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam visit Bat Trang Pottery Village, to experience and admire the scenery of the traditional craft village in Vietnam.

Canh Hoach Bird Cage Village

Located in Vac Street, Thanh Oai and 30km southwest of Hanoi center, Vac Village was formerly known as Canh Village, a place famous for making products such as: Fans, hats, especially bird cages, many people who raise ornamental birds often choose to buy bird cages here. Especially when visiting the craft village, tourists also buy typical products here as souvenirs.

So above are the Vietnamese craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi, for any tourist when choosing to visit craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi, they cannot ignore the traditional craft villages, coming here visitors will encounter a peaceful scene, exuding the rustic beauty of a Vietnamese village.

posts.title: Cuc Phuong National Park
posts.excerpt: Visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, you will experience a wild space, but still exudes natural beauty. Cuc Phuong National Park is located in Ninh Binh and borders Thanh Hoa and Hoa Binh, a place with
posts.contentHtml:
Visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, you will experience a wild space, but still exudes natural beauty. Cuc Phuong National Park is located in Ninh Binh and borders Thanh Hoa and Hoa Binh, a place with its own beauty, especially the most beautiful place in the butterfly season, with butterflies fluttering and many colorful fireflies, a beautiful and poetic picture of the countryside.

If you have the opportunity to travel Ninh Binh, visit Cuc Phuong National Park and encounter a diverse nature reserve, this place not only develops eco-tourism but also brings cultural and historical values.

Cuc Phuong National Park stands out with its diverse eco-tourism and tropical forests. Coming here, you will admire the wild and peaceful natural scenery, in the fresh air surrounded by cool primeval forests, with many species of wild animals and plants, and there is also a museum of rich flora and fauna.

Visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, you will encounter ancient trees that are hundreds of years old, the forest is covered with cool shade, the most beautiful stop every summer.

In addition, when traveling to Cuc Phuong National Park, you will encounter rare animals such as langurs, civets, striped civets and rare animals or beautiful birds. You can walk and admire the peaceful scenery.

Many who travel Ninh Binh tour and visit Cuc Phuong National Park often choose to cycle and immerse themselves in nature, while walking and enjoying the scenery or recording the most beautiful moments as souvenirs.

Cuc Phuong National Park also has attractions such as the wildlife rescue center, from here you can learn about the protection of wildlife, or admire the scenery from the limestone mountains overlooking the entire national park.

So when you come to explore Cuc Phuong National Park, you will not only admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, but also bring visitors the most relaxing moments away from the hustle and bustle of the city, immerse yourself in a peaceful space, listen to the chirping of birds, watch rare animals, help you love nature more.

The most beautiful time to travel to Cuc Phuong National Park is the butterfly season, starting from April to the end of May, this is the butterfly and firefly season in the cool weather here, butterflies in Cuc Phuong National Park start to be beautiful from April 10 every year.

Many tourists who travel to Cuc Phuong National Park butterfly season often choose the evening when the fireflies flash, creating a beautiful space, along with colorful butterflies flying in the sky, making many tourists feel excited.

Especially children when traveling to Ninh Binh during butterfly season are very excited, in addition, this is also the season when Cuc Phuong National Park has many wildflowers blooming, so it is very suitable for butterflies to develop.

Cuc Phuong National Park has many species of butterflies such as white butterflies, star butterflies, swallowtail butterflies, phalaenopsis butterflies, … in the butterfly season, the butterflies fluttering like a beautiful summer painting, especially when the night falls, the fireflies fluttering create a magical picture, this is also the time when Cuc Phuong attracts the most visitors.

Camping in Cuc Phuong garden, and watching wildlife

If you travel to Cuc Phuong from September to December, this is the dry season, a good time for visitors to experience camping and explore the wildlife here, and bring flashlights, sleeping bags, cameras, binoculars, cameras, insect repellent and personal belongings to conquer the forest roads…

In addition, you should not go to Cuc Phuong in the rainy season when the weather is wet, making it more difficult to travel. Especially Cuc Phuong in the rainy season has a lot of insects.

Cuc Phuong cuisine.

When coming here, visitors will enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: mountain goat, Muong pig, hill chicken… In Cuc Phuong, there are many restaurants where visitors can enjoy dishes with local specialties.

posts.excerpt: Through the tectonic process with the formation of nature, Ha Long has many large and small islands, among which the most beautiful is Hon Chan Voi and the islands in Ha Long with a unique beauty, sur
posts.contentHtml:
Through the tectonic process with the formation of nature, Ha Long has many large and small islands, among which the most beautiful is Hon Chan Voi and the islands in Ha Long with a unique beauty, surrounded by majestic high rocky mountains, and poetic beaches, besides there are also mysterious caves creating a poetic picture.

Currently, Hon Chan Voi is one of the attractive destinations in Ha Long, located about 12km from Tuan Chau port, and about 10km from Bai Chay, this is an ideal destination every summer.

Hon Chan Voi is formed by a block of lifeless rock, but with a unique and cute shape, the island has increasingly attracted tourists to visit and admire, especially when viewed from afar on a cruise ship, visitors will admire an unusual beauty.

Many tourists when traveling to Ha Long visit Hon Chan Voi to admire the beauty of this very close and familiar animal, a check-in spot chosen by many young people.

With the name Chan Voi because the rocks standing up look like the footsteps of an elephant standing tall in the middle of the ocean, the beauty standing tall in the wind makes visitors to the bay feel more excited by this natural beauty.

After many years and changes of nature, Hon Chan Voi is still there with a unique and intact shape, there are many species growing on the cliffs, making this island more beautiful than ever.

The most beautiful time to travel Ha Long is in the summer and autumn, a general beauty and Hon Chan Voi in particular, when the sunlight begins to shine, it will exude a unique beauty that the island paradise brings to visitors.

In spring, Hon Chan Voi is covered with a lush green coat of conical trees clinging to the cliffs, budding in the cool weather, adding to the natural beauty, a picture that nature has bestowed upon Ha Long.

It can be said that Hon Chan Voi is a masterpiece bestowed upon Ha Long by nature, becoming an attractive destination for tourists. Besides Ha Long, it is also a destination with many famous islands. Let’s take a look at those islands in the article below.

Hon Trong Mai

Also known as Hon Ga Choi, from afar it looks like two chickens facing each other, a natural rock with a unique shape emerging on the water surface, looking like poetic paintings attracting tourists to visit and enjoy the scenery from nature.

Dinh Huong Islet

Looks like a large incense burner floating in the middle of the sea, according to the locals, Dinh Huong Islet is very important in the spiritual life of fishermen in the coastal area, when the tide goes down, it reveals a natural beauty, a sturdy and majestic incense burner, located majestically in the middle of the sea.

Con Rua Islet

A masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon this place, from afar it looks like a giant turtle floating on the sea surface, covered with a layer of green animals, many tourists often sit on a cruise to admire the poetic scenery.

Hon Yen Ngua

Located right in the center of Ha Long Bay, endowed by nature with a unique shape created by the rows of rocks, to fully admire the beauty of Yen Ngua Islet, many tourists when going on a tour Ha Long often choose a cruise to admire the scenery and record the most beautiful moments.

Finger Island

Hearing this, many tourists think it is in Phu Quoc, but Ha Long also has the beauty of Finger Island because the name is similar to Phu Quoc. Coming here in the summer, tourists will feel the natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Ha Long.

Toad Island

A naturally formed rock, from afar it looks like a toad sitting and praying for rain, located majestically in the middle of Ha Long Bay, creating a beautiful natural picture.

In addition, to increase the excitement of your tour, you can choose to experience night squid fishing, overnight stay on a cruise, all of which make your Ha Long trip more meaningful in the island paradise.

posts.title: Experience of traveling to Da Nang on April 30 for first-time travelers

posts.contentHtml:
The April 30-May 1 holiday is one of the longest holidays of the year, although not as long as the Tet holiday, but much longer than the summer holiday or other holidays of the year, many of you will choose the holiday time to travel, relax after a stressful working period, and Da Nang is the most ideal destination for you during this holiday, please refer to the experience of traveling to Da Nang on April 30 for first-time travelers below.

Note before traveling to Da Nang on April 30

  • If you travel to Da Nang on your own, the first thing you should do is book plane, train, or car tickets to avoid the situation where you book close to the date and the ticket price will increase, you should choose and consider to get the most reasonable price.
  • Book a hotel room: Usually close to the holiday, the ticket price increases or there are often no rooms available. So you should proactively book a room early to avoid the situation of no rooms available or not getting a room with the desired sea view.
  • Plan your trip with your friends, from dining spots, entertainment areas, or the most suitable camping sites.
  • What to bring when going on a tour to Da Nang: The weather in Da Nang in April is hot and sunny in the summer and there are occasional sudden showers, so you need to bring an umbrella, and don’t forget your swimsuit or dress to take beautiful pictures.
  • Bring cash so you can enjoy Da Nang street food, or buy souvenirs as gifts.

Da Nang Climate April 30

April Da Nang weather in the summer starts to get hotter from April to August, which is the ideal time for tourists to visit and explore the famous sights of Da Nang, the temperature at this time will fluctuate between 24 and 33 degrees Celsius, this is the ideal time for you to visit Da Nang.

Means of transportation to visit Da Nang during the April 30 – May 1 holiday, you should choose the following means:

  • Motorbike: Da Nang is very crowded during the holidays, so many tourists often choose to rent a motorbike in Da Nang to visit the famous sights very conveniently.
  • Taxi rental: On holidays, renting a taxi will cost a little more than usual, but the driver will show you the way to the famous sights faster.
  • Self-driving car rental: For those who are familiar with the roads of Da Nang, you can rent a car by the day. However, all of this is only for those who travel to Da Nang on their own. On the contrary, if you go on a Da Nang tour with a travel agency, there will be a full package in the tour itinerary, you just need to pack your backpack and go sightseeing.

What to do when traveling to Da Nang

Da Nang on April 30-May 1 is the summer season with blue sea, white sand, and golden sunshine, and is also home to many famous landmarks, especially poetic beaches such as: Lang Van Beach, Non Nuoc, My Khe, Bac My An… In addition, you can also participate in many recreational activities such as: Diving to see coral, surfing, fishing, jet skiing…

Sightseeing spots in Da Nang that you cannot miss when going on a Da Nang tour on April 30-May 1

  • Cham Museum: Where Cham cultural artifacts are still displayed.
  • Da Nang Museum: Where the city’s cultural history is displayed.
  • Asia Park: Coming here, you will be able to visit exciting games that will bring you the most exciting feeling.
  • Ba Na Hills: Where many exciting festivals and events take place, right on top of Ba Na.

Besides the bustling scenery of Da Nang City, there are also peaceful countrysides, which are also destinations chosen by many tourists such as: Tra Que vegetable village, Hoa Phong flower village, Kim Bong carpentry village … coming here, you will feel the peaceful scenery and experience the daily life of the people here.

The sacred pagodas in Da Nang must include Linh Ung Pagoda, Da Nang has 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, with a majestic statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara overlooking the East Sea.

In addition, when traveling Da Nang from April 30 to May 1, you can also visit places near Da Nang such as Hue, Hoi An, or experience taking a canoe to Cu Lao Cham island to soak in the cool water, or conquer the Hai Van pass, you can freely take virtual photos on the windy pass.

With the experience of traveling to Da Nang from April 30 to May 1 that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your trip, wishing you a happy holiday.

posts.title: Ninh Binh Tet travel experience
posts.excerpt: With just 3 days and 2 nights, you can fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous destinations and discover new things during the spring, and below is the Ninh Binh Tet travel experience that
posts.contentHtml:
With just 3 days and 2 nights, you can fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous destinations and discover new things during the spring, and below is the Ninh Binh Tet travel experience that Vietlook Travel wants to share with you.

Ninh Binh from January to March of the lunar calendar is the most beautiful time, the cool weather is very suitable for tourists to go sightseeing. Especially going to the temple to pray for luck.

Come with Vietlook Travel to Ninh Binh tour during Tet to experience the most interesting things, visit most of the tourist attractions in Ninh Binh.

When traveling to Ninh Binh during Tet, you should visit the ancient capital Hoa Lu where King Ly Thai To decided to move the capital, if you are a lover of ancient Vietnamese architecture history, you should visit once to visit and learn about Vietnamese culture.

The scenery of Ninh Binh is very poetic and charming with the quality of the Northern Delta, the air is fresh and cool all year round, a charming beauty of mountains and rivers.

Hang Mua Ninh Binh is the first destination that tourists cannot miss when coming to Ninh Binh, however, the most beautiful time to visit Hang Mua is at dawn or dusk, watching the sparkling scenery is especially suitable for spring travel.

Trang An World Heritage Site is a destination sought by many young people, visiting Co Vien Lau where the image of a simple and rustic village is almost intact.

 

Bich Dong Pagoda is famous for its majestic and poetic landscape, so when coming here, in addition to admiring the towering rocks, visitors can also admire the scenery, especially when traveling to Ninh Binh at the beginning of the year, visiting Bich Dong Pagoda is also an occasion for many tourists to come to worship at the pagoda.

Hoa Lu Ancient Town, visitors will feel like they are in Hoi An, because here visitors can also release lanterns, which will bring visitors the most enjoyable experience.

To explore the beauty of Trang An, visitors should spend a morning or afternoon to fully explore the beauty of Trang An, if going by boat, it will take 2 hours, in addition, you also have time to sit on the shore to enjoy the scenery to relax your soul.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital is a destination exclusively for visitors who love to explore ancient beauty and want to learn about Vietnamese culture. In addition, visitors can also visit Tuyet Tinh Coc with a clear lake and a vast green forest scene right below a peaceful scene.

An indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh Tet Tour is Bai Dinh Pagoda, a pagoda with a spacious design and a majestic location that will exude a peaceful beauty.

Festivals held in Ninh Binh during Tet

Truong Yen Festival (Hoa Lu Festival)

This is one of the major festivals held in Ninh Binh, the festival usually lasts from 8 to 10 days, in early spring, the festival takes place to commemorate the great contributions of King Dinh Tien Hoang and King Le Dai Hanh.

The ceremony includes two solemn rituals: the water procession and the sacrifice ceremony. The ceremony also includes activities such as the great memorial service, the lantern ceremony, folk games: human chess, boat racing, tug of war, cockfighting, swinging, attractive sports competitions such as: traditional wrestling, volleyball… or competitions of singing Chau Van, poetry reading, poetry contest, word pulling, stick dancing, dragon dancing, lion dancing…

Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple Festival

Born on October 15, 1065, he had great merit in curing the illness of King Ly and the people, and he was the inventor of bronze casting.

Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple is one of the ancient temples, and was ranked as a National Architectural and Artistic Monument in February 1989. The festival of Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple takes place in early spring. Attending the festival, visitors can also participate in many folk games such as tug of war, 32-piece chess, cockfighting, volleyball, soccer…

Thai Vi Temple Festival

The festival takes place in early spring, so if you go to Ninh Binh in spring, visitors will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival. On the day of the festival, people also offer the king a bowl of white rice to show their purity…

Trang An Festival

One of the unique festivals in Ninh Binh, and takes place in a clear blue water frame, with magical shimmering caves, surrounded by mountains and rivers.

If you are a lover of admiring the scenery of Trang An, you definitely cannot miss this festival, the festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, surrounded by poetic scenery.

With the Ninh Binh travel experiences that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will help your trip. We wish you the happiest Tet holiday.

posts.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel will share with you a complete and concise set of experiences of traveling to Da Nang during the New Year, about festival events or many fun activities taking place during the New Year in the coastal city of Da Nang, and visiting famous scenic spots during the early spring, please refer to have the most enjoyable trip during this New Year.

Weather in Da Nang during Tet

The temperature in Da Nang during Tet usually fluctuates between 19 and 28 degrees Celsius, there is light drizzle in the early morning, the afternoon is sunny, not as hot as summer, so it is very suitable for your tour.

Where to stay when traveling to Da Nang during Tet?

In Da Nang, there are many hotels and homestays for tourists to choose from, all services are fully equipped, but it all depends on your budget.

If you like affordable prices, you can choose a homestay and experience the life of coastal people. On the contrary, if you like space and a beautiful view, you should choose 5-star hotels with 4-season swimming pool balconies and sea views. If you travel to Da Nang on your own, you should book a room early to avoid being sold out. On the contrary, if you go on a package tour, it will be included in the itinerary you choose from the beginning. Da Nang attractions during Tet

Ba Na Hills

Ba Na is a place with 4 seasons in a day, and has many beautiful landscapes, virtual living spots, top entertainment areas in Asia, especially including entertainment areas such as: Golden Bridge, Debay Wine Cellar, French Village, Mountain Train, Slide, …

Cu Lao Cham

A place that still retains its wild beauty, when coming here, visitors should experience taking a canoe to the island, admire the scenery and experience fishing on the island, because going during Tet, visitors should not experience swimming in the sea, because the sea will be cold at this time.

Asia Park

When coming here, visitors should participate in the sun wheel game, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of the poetic Han River, in addition, in the park there are many games for children and food courts with delicious Asian dishes.

Linh Ung Pagoda

With a 67m high statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, from here you can enjoy the beauty of the sea and islands from above, a beautiful scene in the spring weather.

Hoi An Ancient Town

A place that not only attracts visitors with its peaceful scenery, the ancient town is lit up with lanterns, especially walking around to see the old town or releasing lanterns with many wishes. Especially when coming to Hoi An, you can also enjoy delicious dishes such as: Chicken rice, Cao Lau, Hen rice, Phuong bread, Adam Khanh, …

My Khe Beach

If you travel to Da Nang during Tet, take a walk along the beach to admire the peaceful scenery of the sea and islands, especially when coming to My Khe Beach in the summer, visitors can also participate in interesting games on the sea that will bring visitors the most unforgettable feelings.

What to eat when traveling to Da Nang during Tet?

Da Nang is not only a place with many beautiful stops, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, first of all, Quang noodles with soft and chewy noodles, served with vegetables to add delicious flavor.

Pork rice paper

A famous dish in Da Nang, for any tourist coming to Da Nang, this delicious dish cannot be missed, visitors can enjoy the dish right on the sidewalk or at roadside stalls or restaurants to feel the delicious flavor of Da Nang cuisine.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Da Nang during Tet, you should book yourself a tour to Da Nang right on this Lunar New Year to immerse yourself in festivals and events, visit famous places, participate in interesting games in the early spring of the new year, especially on the occasion of Tet, Da Nang also has a vibrant fireworks show.

posts.title: What is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January
posts.excerpt: What is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January is a question that many of you are interested in, because the climate in Da Nang in January is winter, but this is also the end of the rainy season i
posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January is a question that many of you are interested in, because the climate in Da Nang in January is winter, but this is also the end of the rainy season in Da Nang, so the rains have gradually subsided, and this is also the occasion for the New Year festivals to take place vibrantly.

You are planning to travel to Da Nang, you are wondering if Da Nang in January is beautiful and attractive, so to have your own answer like what is beautiful about Da Nang tourism in January, please find out the content below.

Da Nang’s climate in January has light sunshine, cold weather at night and a bit chilly during the day, the temperature ranges from 19 to 28 degrees Celsius, very suitable for tourists to walk around and sightsee.

However, if you travel to Da Nang in January, it will not be convenient for swimming or playing sports on the sea, the weather in Da Nang in January is the end of the rainy season, but there are still some late-season rains, but the short rains do not affect your tour.

Where should you visit when traveling to Da Nang in January?

The first destination you visit is the bridges, this is the pride of the people of Da Nang, with bridges spanning the poetic river, a beautiful check-in spot chosen by many young people.

Dragon Bridge is a bridge that breathes fire and water on weekends, when the night falls, the bridge lights up and many tourists choose to take pictures.

Han River Bridge with a unique design, is a rotating bridge at night, many tourists when coming here often admire the sparkling beauty of the bridge when rotating…

Love Bridge is a bridge chosen by many young people, especially those who choose this place as a place to take wedding photos on their big day, or couples come here and write their wishes on locks and hang them on the bridge, hoping that their dreams will come true.

It can be said that the bridges are unique symbols of Da Nang, will bring visitors unforgettable impressive experiences in the coastal city.

Temple in Da Nang

When coming to Da Nang in January, tourists should visit spiritual tourist attractions, pray for a healthy and peaceful new year for their family, and also admire the peaceful scenery.

Linh Ung Pagoda Da Nang has 3 pagodas in one city, and is located in 3 famous scenic areas: Son Tra, Ngu Hanh Son and Ba Na. Coming here, tourists not only come to pray for peace and health but also admire the peaceful scenery.

Nam Son Pagoda has a unique and modern space, is a spiritual tourist destination chosen by many tourists when coming to Da Nang.

Quan Am Pagoda is a peaceful space, and is a spiritual destination chosen by many tourists when coming to Da Nang. Coming to the pagoda, visitors not only feel the peaceful beauty but also feel their souls become more relaxed.

Markets in Da Nang

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Da Nang in January, visit the markets not only to sightsee or enjoy delicious food but also to buy souvenirs as gifts.

Con Market in Da Nang is a market that sells fresh seafood and many delicious dishes of Da Nang that exude the unique flavor of the Central region.

Han Market: As one of the traditional markets, the market has many items from clothes to jewelry, or souvenirs that visitors will be free to choose.

posts.title: Cao Bang tourism places to avoid the heat in the summer
posts.excerpt: Cao Bang is an ideal place to avoid the heat in every summer day, chosen by many tourists as a stopover during their vacation, where there are caves and clear streams, a relatively cool climate all ye
posts.contentHtml:
Cao Bang is an ideal place to avoid the heat in every summer day, chosen by many tourists as a stopover during their vacation, where there are caves and clear streams, a relatively cool climate all year round, and majestic natural scenery that is very suitable for tourists to avoid the heat.

Located about 300 km from Hanoi, Cao Bang is an ideal destination for every summer, if you are a lover of peaceful space, away from the hustle and bustle of the bustling city, travel Cao Bang in the summer to immerse yourself in the peaceful natural scenery.

Coming to Cao Bang, visitors not only admire the beautiful natural scenery, but also soak in the cool stream, experience the culture of the highlands or sit on the rocks watching the rivers of grass, trees and flowers and enjoy the local cuisine will bring you the most enjoyable vacation, dispelling the hustle and bustle of the bustling city.

The most beautiful sun-sheltering spots in Cao Bang you should visit at least once in your life

Pac Bo Cave

If you have the opportunity to visit Cao Bang, visit the Pac Bo Cave relic site, a beautiful stop every summer, when immersing yourself in the cool water, visitors will forget all the stuffiness in the bustling city, when visiting Lenin stream, visitors will see the clear stream surrounded by trees and grass, the chirping of birds will make your soul feel more relaxed than ever.

A masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon Cao Bang is Ban Gioc waterfall – Nguom Ngao cave, a destination sought after by many backpackers every summer, the waterfall becomes more crowded than ever, not only for sightseeing but also for coming here on a summer day, you can immerse yourself in the festival taking place right next to the waterfall.

Even on a hot summer day, when you come to the waterfall, the water from above pours down, emitting cool steam. In the distance are green grass carpets. Visitors can sit on the river and watch the waterfall, take souvenir photos and immerse themselves in the idyllic scenery in the middle of the forest.

Coming to Nguom Ngao cave, visitors can also encounter stalactites that look like terraced fields. When entering the cave, visitors will feel cool. Although it is sunny outside, the temperature inside the cave fluctuates around 20 degrees Celsius. The stalactites look like young trees, bamboo shoots and animals in a very unique natural way. Visitors can take beautiful photos next to Nguom Ngao cave. No matter what season of the year you travel to Cao Bang, Nguom Ngao cave is a destination you cannot miss.

If you are someone who wants to experience resort tours, visit the Kolia Organic Farm eco-tourism area, Phja Oac peak, Phja Den Salmon Farm… to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed on Cao Bang, the summer days here are quite cool and have a rich flora and fauna. In addition, there are azaleas, blue hydrangeas, orchids, beautiful roses… competing to show off their colors, which are beautiful check-in spots that many tourists come to. In addition, you can freely check in at the bamboo forest, flower garden, in the afternoon enjoy sticky rice, wild vegetables, roast pork, visitors can light a campfire at night to chat together and enjoy rustic cuisine.

Lung To Dam and Nam Ngua Waterfall are destinations that many tourists seek when traveling Cao Bang tour. If you are a person who loves to admire the wild natural scenery, Lung To Dam and Nam Ngua Waterfall are the destination for you. With a white waterfall winding around the deep green forest, visitors can soak in the cool water from nature to dispel all the daily fatigue and blend in with the natural scenery.

In addition, Cao Bang also has an interesting sun-avoiding spot at Kem Coong, Hong Nam commune, a camping spot chosen by many young people. There is a swimming pool next to the cliff, a majestic scene. The stream is not deep and the water flows slowly. You can see schools of fish swimming around, or experience catching natural snails next to the rock, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Ban Sa Waterfall, Thoong Sao Waterfall, Tien Waterfall, Thang Hen Lake are destinations chosen by many tourists to cool off in the summer. You don’t need to spend too much time exploring Cao Bang’s scenic spots. You just need to take a 3-day, 2-night Cao Bang tour to discover all the beauty and experience daily life with the local people.

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa during Tet
