posts.contentHtml:
What is beautiful about traveling to Sapa during Tet? This is a question that many people are interested in. To choose for yourself the most enjoyable trip to the foggy city or to enjoy hunting clouds and snow, you should visit Sapa during Tet to experience the most interesting things.

Sapa is a beautiful destination. Although each season Sapa brings its own beauty, but traveling to Sapa during Tet, visitors will be immersed in a more poetic scene, because of the clouds and white snowflakes covering the roads, visitors will be satisfied with the winter beauty of Sapa.

Destinations not to be missed when traveling to Sapa during Tet

Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda

A sacred place that many tourists visit during Tet or early spring, to offer incense to pray for peace, a healthy and peaceful new year, the pagoda is located on the top of Fansipan, in winter, this place is covered with white snow, you will think you are in Korea, not in Sapa, Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda brings visitors a pure beauty.

If you travel to Sapa during Tet, you should definitely visit Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda, to feel the pure beauty that this place brings to visitors, the pagoda has its own design exuding purity, the pagoda stands out in the middle of the green forest.

When visiting Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda, right in front of the pagoda you will see the Buddha altar, behind is the place to worship the Saint, so many tourists still call it the place to worship the Saint, right in the center of the pagoda is a majestic Buddha statue, coming here visitors feel peaceful, and admire the scenery at the Buddha’s door.

Trekking the villages during Tet

Going on a Sapa tour for Tet, visitors should visit the villages, and experience the culture of the ethnic minorities in the Northwest highlands to celebrate Tet, blending with the blue sky in the middle of the majestic mountains and forests will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Sapa Cloud Hunting

Every year, at the end of the year, visitors from all over the world come here to hunt clouds, and immerse themselves in the scenery of blooming flowers, especially when traveling to Sapa on cold days, visitors will be satisfied to see the white snow and play with the snow.

Many young people are excited to be immersed in the sea of ​​clouds, from the view of the hotel or cafes, visitors can admire the floating scene in the early morning mist, with clouds covering the hillsides, when noon comes, the clouds gradually dissipate, revealing rows of green trees, a peaceful and poetic scene.

The cloud hunting spot chosen by many tourists when traveling to Sapa is Fansipan peak, from above visitors can see the scenery of Sapa town, Ham Rong mountain hidden in the misty fog, you just need to spend time on a 3-day, 2-night Sapa tour to be satisfied with cloud hunting.

Experience life with the local people, you can choose to stay at a local house or homestay to experience the customs and daily life of the people here, especially the way they prepare the traditional New Year’s tray, which will make visitors remember forever.

When staying with the locals, you will feel the warm affection that the highland people have for visitors, the friendliness and hospitality and enjoy delicious dishes prepared by the locals.

Watch the sunrise and sunset at Sapa Heaven Gate.

Sapa is a place with a magical scene, when the sunset falls, covering the whole mountain town, creating a picture of the mountain town, early in the morning, Sapa seems to put on a new coat because of the dense fog, when the fog gradually clears to reveal a beautiful scene, if you are a nature lover who wants to get away from the dust, come to Sapa to admire the scenery and blend in with the nature of the land and sky in the Northwest mountains.

Conquering the top of O Quy Ho Pass, visitors will feel excited, when the cool weather in Sapa during Tet is very suitable for visitors to conquer the pass, this is one of the dangerous passes and has a beautiful view, a destination sought after by backpackers when traveling to the Northwest.

It can be said that Sapa has quite beautiful weather in winter, which will bring visitors a memorable adventure when conquering the pass or immersing themselves in the sea of ​​clouds, or experiencing the life of the people here, will bring you the most perfect Tet holiday.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Sapa during Tet, hopefully it will help your trip, if you are a person who loves to admire the natural scenery away from the hustle and bustle of the city, Sapa is the destination for you. Especially during Tet holiday, Sapa not only has a sea of ​​clouds but also white snow covering the hillsides or the houses are all covered in white.

posts.title: Top 5 coral diving spots you should know
posts.excerpt: The experience of diving to see corals under the sea is a sport chosen by many tourists, to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. So let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the top 5 coral divin
posts.contentHtml:
The experience of diving to see corals under the sea is a sport chosen by many tourists, to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. So let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the top 5 coral diving spots you should know right below.

Speaking of the sparkling and fascinating coral spots, we must mention Hon Mun Nha Trang coral, Phu Quoc coral, Con Dao coral and the indispensable coral diving spot is Da Nang coral, with colorful coral reefs that are chosen by many tourists.

Coral diving has the following forms:
Snorkeling
This is one of the popular forms of diving, chosen by many tourists. Before diving, you will be instructed and equipped with necessary tools such as life jackets, diving goggles, and underwater snorkels. You will be amazed to see the beauty under the sea, with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs.

Scuba Diving

This is a diving tool for tourists who want to explore the beauty deep under the sea. Tourists dive with oxygen tanks, fins, life jackets, and diving goggles and listen to the instructions of professional guides will bring you the most interesting experience.

In addition, you can also experience walking on the seabed of Nha Trang (Sea Walking)

Walking on the seabed is one of the most unique and beautiful experiences in every summer when the weather is hot, visitors walk on the seabed, immerse themselves in the clear blue water, watch the colorful coral reefs and schools of fish swimming around, which will bring visitors the most exciting feeling.

The beautiful Hon Mun Nha Trang coral captivates many hearts, many tourists come and experience diving to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Phu Quoc coral

Phu Quoc is famous for its coral reefs, including both hard and soft corals, growing close together in beaches with many brilliant colors. In particular, in An Thoi archipelago, there are many coral diving spots such as: Hon Thom, Hon Roi, Hon Dam, Hon Dua… the best time to experience coral diving in Phu Quoc is from May to July, when the sea is calm and the water is very beautiful.

Con Dao coral

Con Dao sea is so clear that visitors can see all the way to the bottom. When it comes to coral in Con Dao, we must mention Hon Bay Canh, Hon Tai, Hon Tre, Hon Trung, Hon Trac, Hon Cau… with different colors that will bring a unique beauty, making visitors feel excited.

To experience coral diving in Con Dao, visitors should rent a boat to the island, and rent coral diving services. The best time to dive in Con Dao is from March to September every year.

Coral diving in Da Nang

Da Nang has many beautiful coral diving spots. If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang in the summer, you should experience coral diving to feel the unique beauty of the seabed. The first coral diving spot in Da Nang is Son Tra coral with colorful coral reefs. It is a destination chosen by many tourists as a stopover during each summer vacation.

The most beautiful coral in Son Tra is Hon Sun, where the beautiful colors will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

Cua Lao Cham coral

A place where pristine beauty converges with magical sparkling coral reefs. The most beautiful time to travel to Cu Lao Cham is every summer when visitors can rent a canoe to go to the island and experience coral diving with magical sparkling coral reefs.

Cu Lao Cham Island has a spacious and airy conservation area with beautiful coral reefs of diverse colors. Visitors only need to dive about 3 meters or dive 6 meters below sea level to be amazed by the sparkling beauty.

Vinh Hy Bay Coral – Ninh Thuan

Vinh Hy Bay is a place that emerges like a pearl in the middle of the East Sea, with sparkling coral reefs. Visitors can both admire the beautiful natural scenery and experience scuba diving to see the sparkling coral.

Above are the beautiful coral viewing spots in the island paradise. If you are a lover of exploring the beauty of the ocean floor, come to this sea area once to see with your own eyes and admire the beauty of the sea floor with colorful sparkling coral reefs that will bring you the most exciting feeling.

In addition to the exciting experiences at sea, you can also enjoy fresh seafood such as lobster, king crab, and sea snails… bringing the delicious flavor unique to the island sea. To fully enjoy the beauty, visitors should come to the summer island paradise.

Top 9 traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated by Vietlook Travel right in the article are brilliant highlights, the unique culture of traditional Vietnamese craft villages is always preserved and promoted, transmitting cultural identity to the next generation.

1. Phu Lang Pottery Village

As one of the famous craft villages that any tourist when having the opportunity to set foot in Bac Ninh will visit, with products meticulously made by artisans of the craft village, exuding the pristine beauty of the land.

2. Ha Thai Lacquer Village

Visiting the Ha Thai Lacquer Village, you will see the peaceful and rustic countryside scenery, exuding the unique beauty of a traditional craft village, with skilled craftsmen creating exquisite works, visitors will be able to personally paint the works with their own creativity and bring them back as gifts.
3. Quat Dong Embroidery Village
As a craft village that has been around for thousands of years, with products that are not only used domestically but also exported abroad, when visiting the village, visitors will encounter mothers and sisters who often embroider at home with exquisite works, if you are someone who wants to learn about traditional craft villages, so Vietnamese culture, this is the destination for you.

4. Dong Ho Painting Village

As a National Intangible Cultural Heritage, when coming here, you will admire unique works, the quality of paintings from clay printing paper and coloring materials have created traditional works bearing the mark of Vietnamese culture.

Ha Dong Silk Village or Van Phuc Silk Village The name is no longer strange to tourists from all over the world, the silk village has many old patterns, coming here visitors will encounter very eye-catching display stalls that visitors can buy as gifts, with very sophisticated and beautiful soft products.

Sedge mats have long been indispensable in every Vietnamese family, and have become a mark in the national cultural identity, not only bringing income to the people here but also an indispensable tourist destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary.

As one of the traditional craft villages that bring beloved conical hats, Tay Ho Conical Hat has long been famous for its elegant beauty, slimness and lightness, further enhancing the beauty of women. If you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, visit Tay Ho Conical Hat Village to feel its own beauty, a rustic scene of the countryside.

This place is not only famous for its lacquer paintings, but also a destination that attracts tourists to visit, with valuable and diverse lacquer works that exude the beauty of the homeland.

One of the famous craft villages in Tay Ninh, visitors coming here can not only visit but also enjoy delicious rice paper, a famous specialty that visitors can buy as gifts when they have the opportunity to visit Tay Ninh.

posts.title: Da Nang Tourism and Weather in Each Month of the Year
posts.excerpt: Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or My Khe beach or the top entertainment area at Fantasy Park, and is surrounded by 3 cultural heritages su
posts.contentHtml:
Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or My Khe beach… or the top entertainment area at Fantasy Park, and is surrounded by 3 cultural heritages such as Hue, Hoi An, My Son. Not only that, Da Nang is also the place where many exciting festivals take place throughout the year, including special festivals such as fireworks festival, street festival, food festival taking place at Ba Na, summer festival taking place on the sea. So to have the most beautiful trip to Da Nang, please follow the weather of the months of the year right below.

The climate of Da Nang is divided into two distinct seasons: the rainy season from August to December, the dry season from January to July. To avoid storms affecting your trip, it is best to travel to Da Nang from February to July every year, because at this time the weather is clear and there is no rain, which is very convenient for tourists to visit, swim in the sea, and participate in sea sports.

Traveling Da Nang from January to April, the weather is sunny and mild, although it is the dry season, the temperature is not high, very suitable for tourists to choose camping tours or picnics with groups of friends, because the weather is cool so tourists can camp outdoors all day without fear of the sun.

Traveling to Da Nang in the low season of the rainy season, visitors should monitor the weather before going to avoid showers or storms that affect your tour. However, if you choose to travel to Da Nang on a budget, go in the rainy season, because this season the services are often softer than the high season, so it is very convenient for visitors to choose resort tours. In Da Nang, there are many luxurious resorts with beautiful views. From here, visitors can fully admire the scenery when the sunrise or sunset falls on clear days, revealing a poetic scene. Da Nang Weather and Months of the Year

Da Nang Climate in January

The temperature fluctuates around 18 degrees Celsius, not suitable for swimming, so tourists traveling to Da Nang in January should visit famous places such as Ngu Hanh Son, Linh Ung Pagoda or Cham Museum or admire the beauty of the city through bridges such as Han River Swing Bridge, Dragon Bridge, or Thuan Phuoc Bridge…

Da Nang Weather in February

Da Nang in February is in winter so it is quite cold, this is the Lunar New Year holiday and also in the weather gradually changing to spring, the temperature gradually increases at the end of the month, however, if traveling to Da Nang in February, it is not convenient for tourists to swim, only suitable for tourists to visit famous places.

However, February in Da Nang is also the time when many festivals take place such as Hoa My village festival or folk games such as singing opera or dramatic dances and art programs combining tradition and modernity will bring tourists the most enjoyable vacation.

Da Nang Weather in March

Da Nang in March the temperature gradually warms up, usually fluctuating around 28 degrees Celsius, this is the dry season of Da Nang and also the occasion of the Quan The Am festival on February 19 every year, this is a traditional festival and is becoming more and more abundant.

Da Nang Weather in April

This is the time when the weather in Da Nang is in and this is also the occasion of the holidays of January 30 and May 1, Da Nang holds many exciting programs, especially the Cau Ngu Festival with a strong traditional culture. In April, the weather in Da Nang is warm and sunny, very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in sports on the sea.

Da Nang Weather in May

At this time, there are showers, but the weather is still quite hot. The Central region’s summer weather is hot and sunny, with an average temperature ranging from 24.9 to 33.4 degrees Celsius, which is very suitable for tourists to swim and participate in beach games, or visit the Ba Na scenic area.

Da Nang Weather in June and July

June is the peak of summer, with temperatures ranging from 33 to 40 degrees Celsius. Many tourists choose to visit beaches such as Son Tra, My Khe, Cua Dai, Ghenh Bang beaches to swim and participate in summer festivals on the beach in Da Nang. This is also the peak season in Da Nang. If you are traveling to Da Nang on your own, you should proactively book tickets and leave early to avoid room shortages.

In addition, if you go on a full package tour to Da Nang, you just need to pack your backpack and go, because the services are included in the program and there is a tour guide with you, because June and July are the summer vacation time when many families often take their children out, so Da Nang is quite crowded at this time, many families with young children often choose vacation tours at luxury resorts right next to the sea to watch the fun scenery on the sea, or the vibrant fireworks festivals.

Da Nang weather in August and September

At this time, Da Nang enters autumn, the weather is clear and cool, but this is also the time when Da Nang enters the rainy season with the rains starting to appear, and there are storms, so visitors should check the weather before coming to Da Nang, you will still have a beautiful tour because this is the low season of Da Nang, so the services are often lower than the high season, so it still brings you a fun vacation on the island.

Da Nang Weather in October

At this time, Da Nang has quite nice weather with light sunshine, however, in the early morning and at night the weather starts to get cold, so it is not suitable for tourists to swim in the sea, tourists often choose resort tours in Da Nang and visit famous places.

Da Nang Weather in November

The weather in Da Nang in November gradually turns to winter, so it is not convenient for tourists to swim in the sea or participate in games on the sea, the temperature usually fluctuates between 28 – 30 degrees, and gradually decreases at night and early morning when the weather is cold. If you travel to Da Nang in November, choose resort tours, Da Nang has very luxurious resorts located right in the center, so it is very convenient for tourists to go sightseeing.

posts.title: Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages
posts.excerpt: Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages, visitors will feel the unique beauty, the unique culture that is preserved and increasingly developed, that is a unique beauty that Han
posts.contentHtml:
Traveling to Hanoi and visiting traditional handicraft villages, visitors will feel the unique beauty, the unique culture that is preserved and increasingly developed, that is a unique beauty that Hanoi brings to visitors from all over.

Traditional craft villages

1. Van Phuc silk village

As one of the famous craft villages, a place with its own beauty, a traditional craft village of the capital Hanoi, in the past Van Phuc silk village was also chosen to make costumes for the Royal Family, but until now this place still preserves and promotes the ancient beauty of the Northern countryside.

When visiting the silk village, tourists will encounter silk, la, gam, cham, to van, the, linh, bang, cinnamon, doan, sa, ky, cau, doi… all woven from natural silk materials. Currently, the silk village not only brings income to the people here but is also a tourist attraction for many tourists when traveling to Hanoi, visiting the silk village to visit and learn about the culture of the capital.

2. Bat Trang Pottery Village

The name is no longer strange to tourists from all over the world, thanks to the techniques and skillful hands of skilled craftsmen who have created sophisticated works, with beautiful green rice glaze from flower vases, flower pots, wind chimes, teapots, wall paintings… all exude elegance, looking very beautiful.

In addition, when visiting Bat Trang pottery village, visitors can also mold their own works according to their preferences, chat with the artisans of the pottery village, and indispensable is to buy products as gifts during the tour of the craft village in Hanoi.

3. Chang Son fan village

Located in Thach That, Hanoi, a place associated with many legends, Chang Son fan village is over 200 years old, because the famous fans are made by hand very delicately.

The fans look very simple but all require the skillful hands of skilled craftsmen, with types of silk fans, decorative wall fans, fans used as wedding invitations or high-class fans as souvenirs, visitors often buy fans as souvenirs of the trip, especially international visitors when coming here, they visit, take souvenir photos and buy souvenir fans.

4. Chuong Village Hats

A destination visited by many foreign tourists to visit and take pictures, especially young people. Here, there are hats such as: non quai thao, non doc pineapple, non no, non long, non toi, non dau for men, or conical bell hats for offerings…

5. Dao Thuc Water Puppet Village

As one of the traditional craft villages, located about 25km from Hanoi, it is a place that records the water puppetry profession from the Le Dynasty. Although it has gone through many historical ups and downs, the craft village is still preserved and promoted, chosen by many tourists as a stopover during their tour of Hanoi.

6. Phu Vinh Bamboo and Rattan Village

As one of the traditional bamboo weaving villages, with many different names such as Phu Hoa Trang village because of the skillful hands of the people here, with the traditional craft village, the children of Phu Vinh village grew up attached to bamboo and rattan trees and increasingly produced very sophisticated bamboo and rattan works, not only bringing income to the people but also being a tourist attraction for many tourists.

7. Thach Xa Bamboo Dragonfly Village

Speaking of Thach Xa, it is also the cradle of Lam tea and Banh Te. In addition, bamboo dragonflies are also known as popular products. When visiting here, visitors will see dragonflies made of bamboo very sophisticatedly, perched everywhere, looking very sophisticated.

8. Dong Ho Painting Village

With a variety of paintings, in the past, paintings were often produced and sold on the occasion of the Lunar New Year at rural markets, Dong Ho paintings are typical of the materials used to make and print paintings, and are combined with colors taken from nature.

Paper for making paintings is made from handmade tree bark, paintings are drawn according to artistic inspiration and are printed on boards, and have different distinct colors, many tourists when traveling to Hanoi often visit Dong Ho painting village, and learn how to make traditional paintings.

9. Quang Phu Cau Incense Stick Craft Village Hanoi

A place that preserves the traditional craft village of the Northern region, in the past, Hung village only supplied for domestic spiritual needs, but now it has been exported to other countries, and is a tourist attraction that many tourists come to, when there are bundles of incense arranged into flowers or the letter S spreading on social networking sites, from which Quang Phu Cau incense village attracts more and more tourists to visit.

It can be said that Quang Phu Cau Craft Village is famous for its high aesthetics. Coming here, visitors can visit and listen to artisans introduce how to make incense from the stages such as choosing bamboo, wrapping toothpicks, dyeing until creating sophisticated products.

10. Me Tri Com Village

Currently, there are many households making Com, and it has been included in the list of 17 national intangible cultural heritages. Com here is made through very elaborate stages, with types of Luong Phuong sticky rice, fragrant sticky rice, Tan sticky rice, Quyt sticky rice, Golden Flower sticky rice… will bring the famous delicious Com of Hanoi.

So, to see with your own eyes the beauty of traditional craft villages in Hanoi, visitors should follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of craft villages and countryside to learn more about Vietnamese culture.

posts.title: Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes
posts.excerpt: Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes chosen by many diners when they have the opportunity to visit Hue, these are famous dishes that you don’t need to go to fancy restaurants, but right at sidewalk eater
posts.contentHtml:
Top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes chosen by many diners when they have the opportunity to visit Hue, these are famous dishes that you don’t need to go to fancy restaurants, but right at sidewalk eateries you can enjoy bowls of noodles with Hue flavors.

Hue is a place with a rich and attractive culinary background, including the dishes that many tourists choose when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hue, we must mention the top 4 Hue specialty noodle dishes, let’s take a look.

1. Nam Pho noodle soup

As one of the quite familiar street foods in Hue, Nam Pho noodle soup is processed very elaborately, especially the broth that brings its own unique flavor, so the broth is often processed with fresh shrimp shells boiled with pork bones plus fish sauce to have a characteristic aroma.

Shrimp sprouts, soft and sticky noodle noodles of tapioca flour combined with the broth blend together to bring a delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang – Hue, visitors should enjoy Nam Pho noodle soup to feel the delicious flavor of Central cuisine.

2. Crab noodle soup

One of the traditional noodle soup dishes, and the main ingredients such as crab meat, crab cakes… the crabs here are carefully selected, the flavor must be fresh, the meat is firm. The broth is made from crab fat simmered with bones, bringing an irresistible delicious flavor.

The broth has a natural sweetness, made from crab fat, pork bones, enjoyed with noodles made from rice flour, cut into small strands, bringing toughness and elasticity. Especially when traveling to Hue in the fall, visitors should enjoy crab cakes to feel the delicious flavor.

3. Snakehead fish noodle soup

When processed, it is marinated with shrimp paste, mixed with spices to soak in for about 2 hours, then fried until golden brown, eaten with noodles made from chewy rice flour, snakehead fish bone broth, when enjoying, visitors will feel the rich flavor and sweetness.

Snakehead fish noodle soup with raw vegetables, in the autumn weather, there is nothing more interesting than enjoying a bowl of steaming snakehead fish noodle soup, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, visitors should enjoy this delicious and attractive dish.

3. Banh canh bot tron

Although the dish is simple, it has a rich flavor of the countryside, a typical dish of Hue, tapioca flour because of the mixture of pure white tapioca flour and black color, both eating and reducing the toughness of the cake.

The broth of tapioca flour noodles is very unique compared to other noodle dishes, because the broth is cooked from field crabs, cooked with pork bones to create the sweet flavor typical of Hue tapioca flour noodles.

If anyone has ever set foot in Hue, has enjoyed noodle dishes, then surely cannot ignore Hue tapioca flour noodles, this is one of the delicious and attractive dishes.

In addition, when coming to Hue, you can also enjoy vegetarian tapioca flour noodles, the ingredients include flowers, coriander, chopped clean milk, thinly sliced ​​fried tofu, and washed and drained straw mushrooms. Then stir-fry with spices until the onions start to turn yellow, add straw mushrooms, fried tofu, bean curd skin, black fungus…

Cook tapioca noodles with about 600ml, stir well, add noodles, cook for about 5 minutes, turn off the stove, scoop the noodles into a bowl, decorate with a few green onions, it looks very eye-catching, each noodle is soft, chewy and delicious, mushrooms are crispy with tofu and vegetables are delicious and attractive.

Young Com, a specialty of Hanoi’s autumn, is one of the famous specialties. In the autumn weather, you can enjoy the scenery while enjoying lemon tea, egg coffee and young Com, there is nothing more interesting.

Although Com is a rustic dish, it has a strong traditional flavor of Vietnamese culture. Unlike Com from the Northwest, Ha Thanh Com is often processed into many dishes such as sticky rice with lotus seeds and green beans, Com sausage, fried Com…

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Hanoi, you should visit the street food stalls or coffee shops in the corners of Hanoi to enjoy young Com while admiring the scenery of Hanoi.

Especially in the autumn weather, visitors can enjoy Com with glasses of lemon tea, kumquat tea or egg coffee… which is one of the Hanoi cuisines that has a strong traditional culinary background but is also very new to young people.

Many restaurants in Hanoi have caught up with the trend of young people, with young rice on their menus, such as dishes made from green rice, such as green rice, sticky rice or stir-fried green rice, a typical culinary background of Hanoi’s autumn.

Not only that, after enjoying the meal, customers can also buy green rice cakes as gifts, or enjoy green rice coconut smoothies, matcha green rice… which further enriches the culinary background, and diners also feel more excited.

So if you have the opportunity to visit Hanoi in the fall, enjoy green rice, a famous specialty, and don’t forget to buy some as gifts for friends and relatives.

posts.title: Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang
posts.excerpt: Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you the most exciting feelings, when you can fly in the sky of Da Nang to see the city from above, with bridges, statues of Bodhisattva Avalokitesva
posts.contentHtml:
Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you the most exciting feelings, when you can fly in the sky of Da Nang to see the city from above, with bridges, statues of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara located majestically overlooking the East Sea, and poetic beaches.

If you are a sports lover, want to experience adventure sports, then paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula is one of the sports for you, you will be flying with a guide in the sky to admire the beauty of Da Nang from above.

The experience of paragliding in the sky will bring you different emotions, the paragliding experience starts at an altitude of 700m above sea level in an ideal position for you to both parachute and experience flying in the sky to enjoy the scenery from above.

What is paragliding?

Paragliding is an adventure sport not for the faint-hearted, when participating, visitors will be flying in the sky looking like seagulls spreading their wings.

When flying, visitors are seated in the cabin, with safety belts, so they can feel completely secure and look out the window to see the beautiful scenery. Most visitors, after experiencing it, do not feel as scared as at first.

How long does it take to paraglide on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang, Vietnam?

If you calculate the travel time from the foot of Son Tra Peninsula to the take-off point, and when landing on the ground, it takes about 10 minutes, and the check-in procedures take about 20 minutes, then visitors will go to the flight point, which is the top of the chessboard, 15 – 20 minutes, visitors will take souvenir photos for about 5 minutes.

Son Tra Peninsula in Da Nang is a great destination and a suitable place to participate in paragliding, on the top is a gently sloping land surrounded by primeval forests. To participate in paragliding, you will fly with a pilot, you will see the whole view of Son Tra, Linh Ung Pagoda, My Khe beach and the whole view of Da Nang from above.

This is one of the adventure sports, so when participating you need to follow the instructions of the guide, and must ensure your health, to ensure your safety.

Son Tra Paragliding Which Season Is The Best

To have the best Son Tra paragliding experience, you should go from March to September, at this time the climate in Da Nang is relatively beautiful, sunny and windy, the sky is clear, very suitable for tourists to experience paragliding adventures in the sky of Da Nang.

Experiences when you paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula

  • Before flying, you often feel nervous, and somewhat excited to blend in with nature.
  • From above, you can admire the scenery of Da Nang, and the majestic Linh Ung Pagoda with the majestic statue of Quan Am facing the East Sea.
  • You can save for yourself the most beautiful moments in the sky of Da Nang

Can you paragliding on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang?

If this is your first time participating, you will definitely be hesitant, but according to Vietlook’s experience of traveling to Da Nang, you can absolutely participate in the flight, because there are also professional guides flying with you, and before flying you will be instructed very carefully so you can be completely assured.

Before flying, you will sign a commitment according to your health regulations.

However, paragliding is not suitable for pregnant women, and those with cardiovascular diseases, asthma, epilepsy, hypocalcemia, etc.

It can be said that when experiencing Son Tra paragliding from above, visitors can admire the beauty of Da Nang city, the city of festivals and events, and see the scenery from a completely new angle, which will bring you the most enjoyable experiences.

So if you are a sports lover, go on a tour to Da Nang today and participate in paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you exciting feelings.

posts.contentHtml:
When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, the answer is at the end of October to the beginning of November, when the flowers are in full bloom, making many travelers come to Ha Giang and not want to leave.

When is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang? This is a question that many people who love Ha Giang are asking, who want to learn and explore the beauty of the majestic rocky plateau, want to find out how beautiful Ha Giang will be at that time, is it really as beautiful as the paintings that journalists often mention, no matter what the scenery is, you should come once to explore the beauty of Ha Giang, and see with your own eyes the beauty of this buckwheat flower season.

Coming to Ha Giang at the end of the year, you will be immersed in the beauty of the buckwheat flower season, the most beautiful is at the end of October, the beginning of November, this is the time when the buckwheat flowers bloom, and this is also the most beautiful time of the year in Ha Giang.

If you are a person who loves to admire and take pictures of buckwheat flowers, then take a tour to Ha Giang in late October and early November. At this time, you will not only immerse yourself in the beauty of the flowers but also join the exciting buckwheat flower festival.

Traveling to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season, right from the beginning of the village along the roads, you will see the flowers competing to show off their bright colors, or on the top of the high mountains to the valleys are covered in a color of flowers, at first the flowers are white, then gradually turn pink and gradually become a deep purple color, very eye-catching.

Every year in October, Ha Giang begins a flower season, this is also the occasion to signal that winter will come to the plateau. When the flower season ends, it is also the occasion for people here to harvest buckwheat flower cakes, cook porridge, and make wine, a famous specialty of the Northwest mountains.

Besides the majestic mountain scenery, the winding and dangerous mountain passes have created the feelings of many tourists coming to Ha Giang tourism. Especially international tourists coming to Ha Giang are fascinated by the elegant beauty of this flower.

Every late autumn and early winter, Ha Giang is covered with a season of buckwheat flowers, a beautiful check-in spot. No matter what angle you stand from, visitors will capture beautiful photos, below are the flowers surrounded by towering rocky mountains, Ha Giang looks like a majestic picture.

Traveling in the buckwheat flower season, you will encounter barefoot highland children, carrying baskets of flowers on their shoulders with the innocent faces of children, or babies sleeping on their mothers’ backs, exuding a simple, rustic village picture, further urging the footsteps of travelers to come to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season.

In the past, buckwheat flower season was also a source of hunger relief for the people here, but now that life has developed, buckwheat flowers have become a tourist attraction, and that has also contributed to making Ha Giang’s economy stronger and stronger, because buckwheat flowers are indispensable to the people here.

When traveling to Ha Giang in the buckwheat flower season, visitors can rent traditional costumes to take beautiful pictures, next to the long flower season scene, surrounded by mountains with misty clouds, or rustic villages located right at the foot of the mountain.

In late autumn and early winter, the buckwheat flower fields stretch out, the flowers are swaying in the wind like a painting, making visitors not want to leave, so when coming here, visitors must have their own answer like which month is the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, and let’s follow Vietlook Travel to Ha Giang in this buckwheat flower season.

posts.title: Top 9 traditional craft villages in Hanoi
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlok Travel to check out 8 traditional craft villages in ancient Hanoi. If you are a tourist who loves to learn about traditional culture, here are some suggestions for those who are loo
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlok Travel to check out 8 traditional craft villages in ancient Hanoi. If you are a tourist who loves to learn about traditional culture, here are some suggestions for those who are looking for a place to learn about traditional craft villages and Vietnamese countryside scenery.

1. Bat Trang Pottery Village

Located in Gia Lam, Hanoi, famous for its ceramics, with sophisticated products that exude the unique beauty of a Hanoi ceramic village. If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, visit the pottery village and make pottery with artisans who create sophisticated products. You can buy ceramic items as gifts.

2. Chuong conical hat making village

A traditional craft village in Thanh Oai, with a thousand years of history, Chuong conical hats are still preserved and promoted, not only bringing income to the local people but also attracting tourists from all over the world to visit and sightsee, especially those who like virtual life can take beautiful photos.

Coming here, visitors can see the experienced conical hat artisans in person, and learn how to make hats from the rudimentary manual stages to the finished hats, especially the hats with eye-catching patterns, so Chuong conical hat village tourism is being chosen by many tourists when traveling to Hanoi.

3. Van Phuc silk village

A place famous for silk products imbued with the traditional culture of a Vietnamese village, when visiting, visitors will encounter shops selling products located close together, very sophisticated products that visitors can buy as gifts. Especially for foreign tourists when traveling to Vietnam, the destination that tourists cannot miss is Van Phuc Silk Village.

4. Vong Com Village

A famous place for making com and squid, although located right in the inner city of Hanoi, this place has a famous com village of Ha Thanh.

Green com grains, wrapped in lotus leaves, have the fragrant flavor of the countryside. In addition, when traveling to Vong village, visitors can also enjoy dishes such as: Fried com cake, sticky rice with com, contributing to enriching the autumn cuisine of Hanoi. Visitors can buy com as gifts.

5. Quat Dong Embroidery Village

Up to now, it still retains the traditional quintessence of a Vietnamese village, exuding a rustic peace but containing many interesting and sophisticated things with sophisticated embroidery works.

In the craft village, each house has a small workshop. When coming here, visitors can take a walk on the street and visit the mothers and sisters who are diligently embroidering eye-catching paintings.

6. Son Dong Sculpture Village

This is one of the traditional craft villages, the cradle of carving statues and worship objects on wood. Although it has gone through so much time, this place still retains traditional carving techniques, exuding a unique delicate beauty of a traditional craft village in Hanoi.

7. Nhi Khe Woodturning Village

At the beginning of the village, visitors can hear the bustling sound of spinning wheels, the meticulous chiseling and carving of craftsmen, the craftsmen create shapes from the blocks as if breathing life into each product that is both durable and beautiful.

The products here are very diverse, such as: bowls, plates, spoons, mortars and pestles, to sophisticated decorative items such as wooden statues, wooden paintings, and handicraft toys.

8. Chuon Ngo Mother-of-Pearl Inlay Village

A place that preserves the quintessence of Vietnamese culture, although it has gone through many years, this place still preserves and develops the mother-of-pearl inlay craft. Coming here, visitors will meet talented artisans who create exquisite works. Visitors not only visit but also chat and listen to the exquisite mother-of-pearl inlay of a traditional craft village in Hanoi.

9. Quang Phu Cau Incense Village Hanoi

Located about 35km from Hanoi, it is one of the traditional craft villages with the profession of producing aromatic incense. Coming here, visitors will meet incense artisans, visitors can make aromatic products by hand, and listen to stories about the formation of the incense village, from the way of making raw materials to the production of aromatic products, not only bringing income to the people here but also being a destination that attracts tourists to visit, especially young people who come to check in for themselves beautiful photos, or foreign tourists who come to visit and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages.

Currently, traditional craft villages are indispensable in the treasure trove of Vietnamese culture, where the humanistic values ​​of talented craftsmen are preserved and developed. Each craft village has its own nuances, creating diversity and richness for the Vietnamese national culture.

posts.title: Visiting Ha Thai Lacquer Craft Village
posts.excerpt: If you have the opportunity to visit Ha Thai Lacquer Craft Village, you will see colorful paintings, exuding the unique beauty of a traditional craft village in a peaceful setting. If you are a nature
posts.contentHtml:
If you have the opportunity to visit Ha Thai Lacquer Craft Village, you will see colorful paintings, exuding the unique beauty of a traditional craft village in a peaceful setting. If you are a nature lover who wants to learn about Vietnamese culture, let’s visit Ha Thai Lacquer Craft Village with Vietlook Travel today.

Ha Thai Lacquer Craft Village is located about 20km from Hanoi, but this place exudes a unique beauty, a peaceful beauty of a Vietnamese village and is one of the beautiful stops that many tourists come to visit and learn about the lacquer craft village.

It is one of the ancient craft villages that has been preserved and developed until today, and is a destination sought by many domestic and international tourists, especially those who love the peace of a rustic village.

The elders here do not remember when the craft village began to form, they only know through two lacquered and gilded parallel sentences worshiped in Ha Thai communal house, and were determined to be from the 17th century.

At that time, there was only the craft of painting and drawing, with many talented artisans, so the craft of making objects for the king and mandarins at that time was also called the village offering to the king.

Up to now, despite the passage of time, Ha Thai lacquer craft village has still developed and preserved the traditional beauty of a Vietnamese village.

Lacquer products represent the process of hard work, meticulousness, showing the talent of the craftsmen of the craft village, imbued with delicate artistry. To make a sophisticated product, the craftsman must do it entirely by hand, with each meticulous step to produce a sophisticated product.

According to the craftsmen here, lacquer products, whether small like cups, bowls, vases or “large” like paintings, are all made by the craftsmen very elaborately and meticulously, creating products that look very eye-catching.

When visiting and exploring the beauty of the products, visitors will feel the shimmering colors of the elegant beauty, the lacquer products with graceful shapes, the designs imbued with national culture such as: Ben nuoc cay banyan, con do la truc, Chua Mot Cot, Hanoi Old Quarter…

The products here are all inspired by nature, rustic, showing the characteristics of a traditional craft village, currently the lacquer paintings of Ha Thai craft village are used from traditional materials of the lacquer craft such as lacquer, lacquer, various types of lacquer, silver, mother-of-pearl, gold…

Currently, Ha Thai lacquer craft village is a tourist attraction, especially the Ha Thai lacquer craft village tour is chosen by many tourists when visiting the Vietnamese countryside during a tour to explore the suburbs of Hanoi.

In addition to visiting Ha Thai lacquer craft village, visitors also visit diverse eco-tourism areas and scenic spots here, but what makes visitors remember forever are the traditional craft villages. Currently, Thuong Tin has up to 126 craft villages, and 49 of them have been recognized as traditional craft villages and Hanoi craft villages, and have folk artisans…

Currently, Ha lacquer craft village has been preserved, created and developed by the local people until today, and is a destination chosen by many tourists, especially those who want to learn about the culture of Vietnamese villages.

Ha Thai lacquer paintings use traditional materials with colors such as cockroach wing lacquer, then lacquer, various types of vermilion, silver, mother-of-pearl, gold… and painted on a black background, along with unique painting techniques to create unique lacquer products that have preserved and created the very own Ha Thai lacquer brand.

Ha Thai lacquer craft village is located in Duyen Thai commune, Thuong Tin, Hanoi, coming here you not only visit the traditional craft village but also immerse yourself in unique festivals such as: Chu Dong Tu festival, Tu Van village festival, Mui Pagoda festival, Dau Pagoda, Bo Dau Temple…. will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

In addition, you can enjoy Thuong Tin’s snacks at small eateries located right on the roadside. When you have enjoyed your sightseeing, visit the snack shops to enjoy delicious and attractive dishes with Hanoi’s suburban cuisine, while enjoying and admiring the peaceful countryside scenery.

Exciting events during National Day 2/9, please refer to Vietlook Travel to choose for yourself a satisfactory vacation and experience the culture of each region during this holiday.

This year’s National Day lasts 4 days, so many places are holding exciting events, aiming to bring visitors the most enjoyable holiday, with exciting entertainment games. Especially in big cities like Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Ha Long…

In Hanoi

Welcoming the 79th anniversary of the August Revolution and National Day 2/9, all the streets of the capital Hanoi are decorated with flags, flowers, banners, slogans, propaganda paintings, large billboards… brilliant and exciting on the holiday.

If you travel to Hanoi on the occasion of National Day September 2, visitors should experience the double-decker bus, “Hanoi City Tour” to visit and explore Hanoi’s famous landmarks for 4 days from September 1 to 4, and visitors will also receive gifts on the day of visiting Uncle Ho’s mausoleum on September 2. Free ticket distribution time is from 12:00 to 17:00 from August 31 to September 3, 2024 at the 19/8 Flower Garden area opposite the Hanoi Opera House. Departure, pick-up and drop-off location: Parking lot next to the Opera House.

Along with that, there are art performances in Hoan Kiem District, Ha Dong District Cultural House, Nam Tu Liem District, Quoc Oai District, Dan Phuong, Me Linh, Dong Anh, Phuc Tho, Thanh Oai …

In Ho Chi Minh City

On the occasion of National Day, there is a ceremony to offer incense and flowers to President Ho Chi Minh and President Ton Duc Thang at the Ho Chi Minh Museum, City Branch. Ho Chi Minh City, Ton Duc Thang Museum, President Ho Chi Minh Monument Park.

In addition, when traveling to Ho Chi Minh City on September 2, visitors can also immerse themselves in the vibrant fireworks display at the Saigon River Tunnel and at Dam Sen Cultural Park, the fireworks display lasts about 15 minutes, from 9:00 p.m. to 9:15 p.m. on September 2.

In Da Nang

The venue for many exciting events during the National Day holiday on September 2, the boat racing festival takes place on the Han River, this is one of the vibrant cultural and sporting activities of Da Nang.

In addition, if you travel to Da Nang on the occasion of National Day September 2, visitors can also join street festivals, such as singing Bai Choi, performing Tuong, street music, visitors will be dressed up as funny characters in gorgeous costumes that will bring visitors unforgettable experiences, besides, visitors can also watch free movie screenings at famous landmarks or walking streets…

At Asia Park (Danang Downtown), there is a program to thank local people with the shows “Awaken River – The River Wakes Up” and Vietnamese Puppetry. Besides, visitors can also participate in the fireworks show that takes place every night during the holiday.

In Ha Long (Quang Ninh)

Hot air balloon festival, this is the first festival in Ha Long, traveling to Ha Long on the occasion of National Day September 2nd, visitors will be able to participate in flying with professional guides, and experience releasing festival lanterns to promote the image of tourism and people of Ha Long to international visitors and friends. This is one of the programs to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Ha Long Bay becoming a World Natural Heritage (1994 – 2024).

In addition, at Tuan Chau beach, Ha Long, there is also a parasailing festival, jet ski… with the participation of professional athletes, bringing visitors exciting feelings on the occasion of National Day September 2nd in Ha Long.

In Quang Binh September 2nd

Traditional boat racing festival, cultural and artistic activities, sports activities, fairs. In addition, music events and vibrant fireworks displays will also take place at scenic spots in Quang Binh.

In Mu Cang Chai (Yen Bai) September 2

On Independence Day September 2, in Mu Cang Chai, a golden paragliding festival will take place, flying in the air, admiring the golden terraced fields, with the participation of 6 street parade groups performing folk dances imbued with the culture of the Mong and Thai ethnic groups in Mu Cang Chai, along with parade cars carrying local fruits, Son Tra (apple) trees and other local specialties.

Along with the “Flying over the scenic spots” paragliding festival, visitors will also participate in the “Banh Day pounding festival”, and visitors will also visit the Vietnam Heritage Tree.

In Than Uyen (Lai Chau) 2/9

Celebrating Independence Day, there are also many exciting events such as: Youth Music, Walking Street Stage, 15/10 Street, and KOMOMO International Running Race and sports such as: Crossbow shooting, stick pushing, tu lu fighting, to ma le, tug of war… and Thai ethnic cultural exchange.

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to experience Vietnam tours to explore famous places, or immerse yourself in events and festivals, each location will have its own culture, especially the special events taking place during the holiday.

posts.title: Ba Na Tulip Festival

posts.contentHtml:
The Ba Na Tulip Festival takes place in the spring weather, with flowers competing to show off their colors, making Ba Na space light up to welcome a new spring. The tulip festival takes place throughout the spring, which is also the occasion for Da Nang to attract visitors to enjoy the spring, and the spring atmosphere on Ba Na in early spring is very vibrant.

The Ba Na Tulip Festival usually takes place from January to March every year, at Le Jardin d’Amour garden, the festival seems to bring the whole spring to visitors, a spring color covering the space of Ba Na.

This year’s Tulip Festival will bring visitors from one surprise to another, the brilliant scenes like a fairyland in Ba Na, which will be unforgettable memories for visitors when traveling Da Nang Ba Na in early spring.

Tulips are a symbol of love, prosperity and abundant life, bringing visitors a spring full of vitality with tulips competing to show off their bright colors, flowers of all colors from green, red, yellow, pink…

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na in early spring, visitors will be immersed in the festival scene, with many exciting events, the tulip festival is decorated very eye-catching, right at the gate, visitors will encounter harmonious decorations with funny mice, and flower carpets decorated very eye-catching.

Although held annually in early spring, this year’s Ba Na tulip festival will bring visitors many surprises, if you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na in early spring, visitors will be immersed in the tulip festival stretching with brilliant flowers that always captivate people’s hearts.

It can be said that this year’s Ba Na Tulip Festival takes place with the theme of the land of flowers, bringing visitors a sparkling flower forest, with brilliant colors. Besides the flower festival, visitors can also immerse themselves in the exciting events taking place on top of Ba Na, with music shows taking place from 09:30 to 15:00 at the Le Jardin d’Amour garden stage and the Du Dome Square stage.

In the joyful atmosphere of the early spring festival, with artists from Europe in splendid costumes, it seems like they are bringing a bustling flower carnival dance to Ba Na.

Although it is no longer strange, the tulip festival on top of Ba Na is still a flower paradise. This year’s festival takes place on a grander scale, more brilliant than many years ago, bringing visitors a new feeling.

With creativity and uniqueness, this year’s Ba Na tulip festival promises to bring visitors from one surprise to another, so don’t miss the opportunity to admire and check in at the Ba Na tulip festival.

Unforgettable experiences at the Ba Na Tulip Festival

 

Take virtual photos next to the blooming flowers, no matter which angle you stand at, you can capture beautiful photos for yourself, right during the tulip festival from the entrance, visitors will admire the beauty of the flowers exuding a sweet fragrance in the wind, and visiting the Le Jardin D’Amour garden, visitors will immerse themselves in the colors of the flowers.

Many visitors to the tulip festival are amazed by the beauty that this flower brings to visitors, the colorful flowers cover the path leading visitors to the top of Ba Na, and capture beautiful moments in the spring weather.

Especially when traveling to Da Nang in early spring, visitors can also enjoy the brilliant festival, including musical shows that will take place from 9:30 am and last until 3 pm, in the musical stages in the flower garden, the artists are in gorgeous costumes, visitors can also wear colorful traditional costumes to join the festival.

Visitors can participate in the Carnival dance with professional artists, a performance in the flower valley through colorful performances.

To fully participate in the beauty of the tulip season, sign up for a 1-day tour to Ba Na to admire the beauty of the flowers and participate in many vibrant festivals. Especially note that you should not step on the flowers.

Festivals taking place in Ba Na

Carnival

The festival usually takes place after the tulip festival, and takes place at Du Dome square located in the French village, in the air you feel like you are experiencing French culture.

Wine Festival

The festival usually takes place in May every year at Le Jardin D’Amour flower garden, you will enjoy glasses of wine in a vibrant atmosphere, watching the scenery full of flowers.

B’estival Festival

One of the big festivals taking place from June to September, and taking place right on the top of Ba Na, during the festival with many bottles of beer, visitors can enjoy free beer, the festival aims to recreate and honor the glasses of beer in Germany.

Halloween Festival

Taking place in October and lasting all month, this is the occasion when Ba Na attracts a large number of visitors, visitors can dress up as their favorite cartoon characters, looking very funny.

It can be said that at Ba Na, the tulip festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, attracting people from all over Da Thanh to visit and sightsee. If you have not had the opportunity to visit Ba Na during the festival, pack your backpack and go to Ba Na today.

posts.title: Where is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village
posts.excerpt: Currently, tourists are looking to learn and explore the beauty of Vietnamese craft villages, but do not know which craft village to visit, so follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese c
posts.contentHtml:
Currently, tourists are looking to learn and explore the beauty of Vietnamese craft villages, but do not know which craft village to visit, so follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese countryside. The most beautiful is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, however, many of you will wonder where is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, so let’s refer to this article.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, a virtual living spot on the outskirts of Hanoi, is being sought out by many tourists, especially those who like to live virtually or explore the peaceful and rustic Vietnamese countryside, away from the hustle and bustle.

Located about 35 km south of Hanoi city center, visitors will visit the beauty of a traditional craft village, Quang Phu Cau incense village. To get here, visitors can choose a bus from Yen Nghia bus station, visitors can take bus 91, or drive themselves along National Highway 21B or Provincial Road 429.

The incense village has been preserved by the people of Quang Phu for many generations, and has been passed down for many generations, from sister to sister, mother to children…

Currently, incense is an indispensable product in every family, and is an attractive destination for tourists to visit. The incense village develops not only as a tourist attraction but also as a source of income for the people here.

Quang Phu Cau incense village operates almost all year round, very bustling with the decoration that is constantly changed according to each season, and this is also a place for visitors to take beautiful pictures.

There are very eye-catching display areas, visitors can take beautiful photos and freely pose to take beautiful photos.

Traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, almost every season, visitors can take beautiful photos, with incense bundles arranged very eye-catchingly, looking from afar like flowers or funny letters.

It can be said that Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is not only famous for its aesthetics and uniqueness, but also for its craftsmanship of a traditional village.

In addition, when visiting the incense stick craft village, visitors can also visit the process of making incense bundles, from simple manual work to meticulous finished products.

The incense bundles are arranged with their heads together at the base like blooming flowers with a variety of colors such as red, yellow, pink, blue … looking very eye-catching. Currently, photographers and tourists come here to hunt for photos.

Throughout the village, visitors will also see incense yards drying bundles of green, red, yellow, purple, pink incense… that look like flowers. Visitors will want to take beautiful pictures of themselves, next to a traditional craft village.

Quang Phu Cau incense village is one of the traditional craft villages that has been promoted and preserved to this day, not only bringing income to the people but also being a tourist development point.

In addition, the development of Quang Phu Cau incense village also creates many jobs for workers, and attracts tourists to visit, check in and learn about Vietnamese village culture.

If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, and want to learn about craft villages but do not know which traditional craft villages to visit, and if you visit Quang Phu Cau incense village, where is the address to visit and take beautiful souvenir photos.

When visiting Quang Phu Cau incense village, take a walk around the village, to see with your own eyes the work of the people here through each stage of processing until bringing out aromatic products.

Until today, although Quang Phu Cau incense village has been mixed with modern features, the traditional culture has been mixed to exude the unique beauty of a village, a traditional craft village of Vietnam. If you want to fully explore the beauty, rent a bicycle and cycle around the ancient village in the suburbs of Hanoi to feel its unique beauty.

posts.title: What is beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in August
posts.excerpt: In August, the weather is gradually changing from summer to autumn, but this is also the time when Ha Long enters the cool weather, very suitable for tourists’ outdoor excursions, so if you are planni
posts.contentHtml:
In August, the weather is gradually changing from summer to autumn, but this is also the time when Ha Long enters the cool weather, very suitable for tourists’ outdoor excursions, so if you are planning to travel to Ha Long in August, let’s go through the points and experiences of traveling to Ha Long right below with Vietlook.

The weather in Ha Long in August is relatively cool, the temperature fluctuates between 29 degrees Celsius – 30 degrees Celsius, however, in August Ha Long has sudden showers so you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect the sightseeing journey of tourists, because the showers are usually short and not too long so they do not affect the tourists’ tour.

Ha Long tourist attractions in August

Bai Tho Mountain

Located at an altitude of 200m above sea level, and right next to Ha Long city, where nature has bestowed poetic beauty, from the top of the mountain visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, especially in the autumn weather.

Tuan Chau Sculpture Park

The park is called King Kong Park, famous for its interesting games, besides the exquisite sculptures, visitors can also admire the waterfalls, which are an interesting stop every summer or weekend, especially for families with young children.

Ha Long Bay

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ha Long tour itinerary, no matter what season of the year, Ha Long Bay always brings visitors a unique beauty. When coming here, visitors should visit Thien Cung Cave, Titop Island, Cua Van Fishing Village, Hang Luon, Hon Trong Mai, ….

Especially when visiting Ha Long Bay by cruise, sitting on the cruise, visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, a magical and poetic scene appears right before the eyes of visitors.

Titop Island

Located in the middle of Ha Long Bay, the island emerges like a crescent moon. Coming to the island, tourists can not only visit but also experience swimming, participate in games on the sea or conquer the top of the island to watch the beautiful sunset.

Sung Sot Cave

One of the pristine caves in Ha Long, inside the cave there are natural stalactites, a cool space, an ideal stopover in Ha Long.

Luon Cave

One of the most visited by tourists, especially foreign tourists, when they experience kayaking or bamboo boats deep inside to admire the beauty of the cave, from inside the cave visitors can admire the beauty of the curved stone arch, when the sun shines down, creating a beautiful scene, a destination for tourists who love nature.

Cuu Van Fishing Village

Hidden next to the sea, a small fishing village lies under the cool green coconut trees, with boats anchored next to the casuarina trees, every evening the scene of the fishing village is bustling with boats coming to shore, with gentle smiles, when the dawn comes, those boats follow each other to go out to sea, looking like a poetic picture of the sea and islands.

In addition, when traveling to Ha Long in August, visitors should participate in interesting games on the sea such as: kayaking, sleeping overnight on a boat, experiencing Ha Long by seaplane … all will bring visitors the most interesting vacation when coming to Ha Long.

Delicious dishes you should try when traveling to Ha Long in August such as: Ngan Bien, Cha Muc, Sam Bien, Tien Yen Hill Chicken, Bun Be Man… and many more delicious and attractive dishes are waiting for tourists to discover.

With the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in August that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, you probably have your own answer, and will no longer wonder what is beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in August, wish you a happy trip.

Ninh Binh is a destination that is attracting domestic and international tourists. When traveling Ninh Binh in August, visitors will be amazed by the beauty of lotus season, lotus flowers exuding a passionate fragrance. Visitors can take pictures of the fragrant lotus season. To admire the beauty of this place in August, let’s take a look at the beautiful things about Ninh Binh in August below.

The weather in Ninh Binh in August is not as hot and sunny as in summer. In August, Ninh Binh enters the autumn season with a relatively cool climate, the sky is clear, sometimes there are clouds drifting, and occasionally there are sudden showers, so when traveling to Ninh Binh in August, you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect your sightseeing itinerary.

Visiting Trang An in August

Trang An has long been a popular tourist destination, where the green mountains and blue water blend together to create a poetic picture.

In particular, when traveling to Trang An, tourists also visit mysterious caves, rich fauna, shimmering and magical water valleys, and many historical relics including temples, shrines, and ancient pagodas from thousands of years ago that still remain today.

Thach Bich – Thung Nang

Coming to Thach Bich – Thung Nang in August, the weather is in autumn, with cool breezes, and the rice fields are starting to turn yellow, next to the blue rivers. When the sun just rises, the rays of sunlight shine through the leaves, or next to the rustic thatched houses located right on the river, creating a poetic picture, inside are caves surrounded by undulating mountains, a fascinating beauty.

Tam Coc – Bich Dong

Located in the Trang An scenic area, Tam Coc has 3 main caves: Hang Ca, Hang Hai, Hang Ba… to get here, visitors can sit on a dugout canoe along the river =, on both sides are long rice fields, Tam Coc has a truly poetic scene.

If you are a person who loves to admire the natural scenery of clouds and sky, you can rent a bicycle to go sightseeing, the destination that tourists cannot miss when traveling to Tam Coc is Bich Dong Pagoda, only 3km from Tam Coc, on both sides of the road to the pagoda are blooming lotus ponds giving off a cool fragrance, traveling to Tam Coc – Bich Dong in August, visitors will enjoy the charming beauty of the ancient capital.

Hang Mua

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour, when coming here, visitors will visit the ancient fortress, and conquer 500 stone steps, but in return, visitors will fully admire the beauty of Ninh Binh from above, and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Thung Nham Bird Garden

August Thung Nham Bird Garden is very beautiful, in the cool weather, visitors can feast their eyes on the beauty, or take pictures of the lotus flowers spreading their fragrance in the wind, or enjoy a cup of lotus tea watching the peaceful scenery, enjoying the cool breeze, there is nothing more interesting. Besides, visitors also visit caves such as Hang But, inside there are beautiful stone slabs, which will bring visitors unforgettable memories when visiting Ninh Binh.

So it can be said that when traveling to Ninh, no matter what season of the year, visitors can feel its own beauty, a charming landscape of mountains and rivers, with vast rice fields, or the fragrant lotus season, or watching flocks of birds flying in the sky, especially going by boat to visit mysterious caves. Especially foreign tourists when traveling to Ninh Binh also experience cycling to see the scenery or enjoy fragrant lotus tea and delicious dishes that attract customers will bring tourists the most unforgettable vacation in Ninh Binh.

posts.title: Traveling to Ha Giang in buckwheat flower season

posts.contentHtml:
Every year, in late autumn and early winter, in Ha Giang, in the valleys or on the mountain slopes and mountain passes, there is a season of fragrant buckwheat flowers, a typical flower of the Ha Giang rocky plateau.

Ha Giang buckwheat flowers are usually beautiful in late October and early November, the flowers bloom in a purple color spread across the plateau, the majestic mountain and forest scenery, interspersed with beautiful pure buckwheat flowers that captivate people’s hearts.

Buckwheat flowers grow along the roads, at the foot of the mountains, on the hillsides, showing a strong vitality even on thorny cliffs. If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Giang in October, visitors will be immersed in the beauty of beautiful buckwheat flowers.

Buckwheat flowers bloom, signaling the arrival of winter on the plateau, all over the valleys of Ha Giang, everywhere is covered with a season of brilliant flowers spreading a fragrant scent in the wind.

The petals clustered in the middle are buckwheat seeds, the color of the flower changes over time, at first the flower is pure white, then gradually turns to light pink, and a deep purple and a black color and then gradually fades.

Flowers cover the valleys of Ha Giang, this is the time when Ha Giang attracts the most tourists to visit and sightsee in the year, if you are planning to travel to Ha Giang, choose the buckwheat flower season.

Currently, the flower has become a highlight for every tourist when talking about Ha Giang, especially in November every year, Ha Giang also holds the buckwheat flower festival, with many exciting events that promise to bring people and tourists the most enjoyable experiences.

If you are someone who likes to live in the flower season, then join Vietlook to travel to Ha Giang during the buckwheat flower season, and this is also an opportunity for you to freely check in, no matter which angle you stand at, you can capture beautiful pictures for yourself.

It can be said that the flower on the rocky plateau is a typical symbol of Ha Giang. To fully admire the beauty of the buckwheat flower season in Ha Giang, visitors should visit places such as: Ma Le, Pho Cao, Sung La, Lung Cu flagpole, …

To be proactive in the tourist itinerary when coming to Ha Giang, visitors should rent a motorbike to admire the beauty, and be proactive when traveling on the roads they love, they can stop to take pictures, or freely immerse themselves in the natural scenery and see with their own eyes the heart-stopping beauty of the rocky plateau.

In addition, when coming to Ha Giang, visitors can also conquer winding mountain passes with hairpin bends, admire the beauty of buckwheat flowers right on the mountainside, on high mountain passes with hairpin bends, all challenging the drivers, and feast their eyes on the beauty of the buckwheat flower season in the rocky plateau.

posts.title: Top 4 delicious and attractive dishes
posts.excerpt: Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the delicious and attractive dishes that you must try once in your life, including dishes such as: Bun cha, broken rice with pork ribs, grilled spring rolls, br
posts.contentHtml:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the delicious and attractive dishes that you must try once in your life, including dishes such as: Bun cha, broken rice with pork ribs, grilled spring rolls, braised pork belly…

Nem lui

A famous delicious dish in Hue, made from ground pork with minced pork, onions, garlic and wrapped around lemongrass stalks, and seasoned to create eye-catching colors, the spices are often made from fish sauce, oyster sauce, annatto oil, ground pepper, sugar or honey and grilled on a charcoal stove to bring out the delicious flavor of Central Vietnam cuisine.

Nem lui is often served with raw vegetables wrapped in rice paper, with a sauce made from ground sticky rice, stir-fried minced meat, crushed peanuts, sweet fish sauce, satay… mixed together to bring an irresistible delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, you should enjoy nem lui to feel the delicious flavor that this place has brought to visitors.

Bun Cha

When talking about Bun Cha, people immediately think of Hanoi. This is a dish that many tourists choose when traveling to Hanoi, especially foreign tourists. Bun is eaten with minced meat and sweet crab broth, along with lettuce, cucumber, chili, pepper, lemon… bringing a delicious flavor.

Broken rice with pork ribs

This is one of the quite famous dishes – broken rice is cooked into rice and served with grilled pork ribs, grilled pork, fried eggs, egg rolls, shredded pork skin… with chopped onions, tomatoes, cucumbers and pickled vegetables.

Eat with garlic and chili sauce kept separately in a bowl, when eating, pour it on the rice according to the taste of each diner, it will bring a delicious flavor, although the dish is available in every region, the best is still Saigon broken rice.

So to enjoy the delicious flavors, let’s travel across Vietnam with Vietlook Travel, to feel and enjoy the delicious dishes with the bold flavors of the Vietnamese countryside.

Discovering the beauty of Ti Top peak, visitors will catch an island from the high hill, from here they can see the whole beauty of the sea and islands, the vastness and majesty of Ha Long Bay opening right before their eyes.

Ha Long Bay has long been a famous tourist attraction that attracts visitors to visit and enjoy, especially in the summer when visitors from all over the world come here to visit and enjoy the scenery and participate in many interesting games on the sea.

When talking about Ha Long, visitors cannot help but mention beautiful stops such as: Dragon Eye Island, Tuan Chau Island, Hon Gai, Sung Sot Cave… in which Ti Top Island stands out with its own unique beauty.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ha Long, visitors should visit Ti Top Island to admire the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place, the island has a crescent-shaped sandy beach, the four seasons of high tides have washed it clean and white, visitors when coming to the island can walk barefoot on the sand.

Ti Top Island has left many memories, and Uncle Ho named the island Ti Top Island, so the island is a place that leaves many memories. If you set foot here, you will encounter an island with a steep bank. You should conquer Ti Top peak to admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above, a poetic landscape.

On the way to the top of the mountain, visitors will conquer a spacious stone embankment. Visitors will look down below to see the vegetation and ecosystem of Ha Long Bay. Currently, Titop Island is very suitable for visitors who like to participate in thrilling games such as parasailing, banana boating, etc.

On the top of the mountain is a beautiful stop, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay from above. On the top of the mountain, there is a watchtower.

From the observation tower, visitors can admire the scenic Bai Tho Mountain and Bai Chay Bridge across Cua Luc Bay, the Queen Cable Car and the Sun Wheel like a giant wheel high in the sky or the towering Bo Hon Island, in the distance is the mountain range of Hon Soi Sim, Hon Dam Nam, Hon Dai Thanh…

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long today to conquer the beauty of Ti Top Mountain, stop at the observation tower to admire the beauty of Ha Long from above, with clear blue sea water and boats connecting to the open sea, a truly beautiful scene, will bring visitors the most perfect vacation on the island.
