When is the best time to travel to Sapa?

Sapa has cool weather all year round, however, to avoid encountering stormy seasons, visitors should not go from late June to August, because Sapa is a mountainous area, so there will be flash floods and landslides. If you go during this time, visitors should listen to the weather in advance to have a convenient tour, because this is the rainy season, so the number of visitors to Sapa will be low, the services will not be as crowded as in the peak season. Therefore, visitors will go to the attractions and not have to queue and the services will be lower than in the peak season.

Traveling to Sapa from February to May, visitors will be immersed in the colors of flowers such as cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, plum blossoms… visitors can take beautiful pictures of Sapa’s flower season.

If visitors want to avoid the heat, travel to Sapa from June to August, because the weather in Sapa is relatively cool. However, visitors should check the weather in advance to make their trip more convenient.

 

Traveling to Sapa from September to November, visitors will be satisfied with the golden season of Sapa, a yellow color winding around the mountainside, bringing a poetic beauty, surrounded by cool green forests, and the yellow color of terraced fields, in the distance are the stilt houses hidden on the mountainside.

Traveling to Sapa in the winter from December to February of the following year, the winter in Sapa is quite cold, visitors will be able to play with white snow on the mountain top.

Transportation to Sapa

Tourists can choose to go by car or motorbike, if they want to rest on the bus, they can take a sleeper bus to Sapa. However, most backpackers and backpackers in Sapa often choose motorbikes to both travel and sightsee.

Where to stay in Sapa

Sapa has many accommodation services for tourists to choose from homestay, hotel, resort… however, it all depends on your budget, if you want to experience close to nature, choose homestay.

Where to visit when traveling to Sapa?

Ham Rong Mountain

Located at an altitude of 1,450m above sea level, from the top of the mountain, visitors can see the whole beauty of Sapa from above, a majestic scene is an indispensable destination in the Sapa tour itinerary.

Sapa Stone Church

An ancient church, most beautiful on Christmas nights, in the dim lights, visitors should take a walk to admire the beauty of the mountain town, a truly beautiful scene that this place brings to visitors.

Cat Cat Village

This place is mainly inhabited by Mong people, coming here visitors not only visit the scenic spots but also experience daily life with the people of the Northwest highlands such as weaving, silver carving, jewelry making… surrounded by Tien Sa stream, Vang stream and Bac stream.

Lao Chai – Ta Van

A peaceful scene, the people here are mainly Mong, Dao, Giay… surrounded by terraced fields, the most beautiful in autumn, the fields stretch out in a golden color, surrounded by peaceful streams.

Fansipan Peak

When coming here, visitors should experience the cable car, sitting in the cabin, visitors can see the beauty of Sapa from above, especially the season of blooming flowers stretching out…

Swing Sapa

A destination that many tourists come to, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to take beautiful pictures as souvenirs on their Sapa tour.

Séo My Ty Lake

To reach the lake, visitors must cross the forest to reach the lake with a calm water surface, looking from above the lake looks like a calm silk sheet.

Heaven’s Gate

Conquering the O Quy Ho pass, visitors will reach the Heaven’s Gate of Sapa, from above visitors can admire the vast scenery of the Northwest mountains and forests.

O Quy Ho Pass

This is a fairly long pass connecting the two provinces of Lao Cai – Lai Chau, the most beautiful is when the sunrise or sunset, the whole pass exudes a poetic beauty that looks like a beautiful picture.

The most beautiful place to hide from the sun in the Sapa summer tour, the higher the waterfall, the cooler it gets, in the rainy season the waterfall is even more beautiful, looking from afar like a long silk sheet, exuding a unique beauty in the mountain town.

What to eat when traveling to Sapa?

Sapa not only welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: pork, chicken, vegetable rolls to eggs, corn, potatoes, bamboo rice… all bring diners the delicious flavor of the Northwest mountains.

posts.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel shares with you the most complete and concise Cao Bang Travel Experience, please refer to it to have the most enjoyable tour during your vacation.

Cao Bang welcomes visitors with beautiful natural landscapes, surrounded by mountains, valleys, streams, and in the distance are stilt houses hidden on the mountainside, creating a beautiful natural picture.

Traveling to Cao Bang from August to September, Ban Gioc waterfall is the most beautiful season with a lot of water flowing in, the water is clear, and in the distance there are golden terraced fields.

Traveling to Cao Bang in the rainy season from June to September, Cao Bang has beautiful waterfalls, because the amount of water flowing in is quite large, travelling to Cao Bang from October to May next year, the weather in Cao Bang is quite cold, the water does not fall strongly, and from afar you can see a clear blue color.

If you want to immerse yourself in the beauty of the flower season or travel to Cao Bang in October, you will experience the wild sunflower season, buckwheat flowers, visitors go in November, December, or immerse yourself in the pear blossom season, go to Cao Bang in March.

How to travel to Cao Bang?

Cao Bang is located about 280 km from Hanoi, and to get to Cao Bang there are many sleeper buses for visitors to choose from at stations such as: My Dinh, Giap Bat, Gia Lam. However, if you travel to Cao Bang on your own, you can choose a motorbike, or backpackers often go by motorbike to see the scenery.

Where to stay when traveling to Cao Bang

On the way to Ban Gioc waterfall, visitors should stay at Trung Khanh, and when you get to Ban Gioc waterfall, you can choose Yen Nhi homestay, Khuoi Ky Homestay, Lan’s Homestay Ban Gioc for about 200,000 VND/night.

If staying in the city center, visitors should stay at Primrosé Homestay Cao Bang, Son Tung Hotel, Jodevi Homestay Cao Bang, Jeanne Hotel… with an average price of 300,000 VND per night.

On the contrary, if visitors have a little more money, they can choose high-class resorts such as 4-star resorts, resorts located near Ban Gioc waterfall, very convenient for visitors’ Cao Bang tour itinerary, the resort has a beautiful view.

Where to visit when traveling to Cao Bang?

Pac Bo Relic Site

Coming here, visitors will encounter many beautiful attractions, with a spacious campus, fresh air, very suitable for tourists’ vacations. To take a beautiful picture, visitors should go to milestone 0 opposite the Uncle Ho memorial area. To reach Lenin stream and Cac Mac mountain, Pac Bo cave, Cac Mac mountain and Lenin stream, not far away is the historical relic area such as the stone table where Uncle Ho sat and worked, Mr. Ly Quoc Sung’s house…

Milestone 108 where Uncle Ho set foot in Vietnam when he returned home, and visit the memorial area of ​​heroic martyr Kim Dong…

Ban Gioc Waterfall

To avoid having to queue, you should go to Ban Gioc Waterfall early in the morning. To reach the waterfall, visitors go through Ma Phuc Pass, Khau Lieu Pass, in the distance are cool green rice fields. If you travel to Ban Gioc waterfall in the afternoon, you should stay until 7:00 p.m. to admire the night lighting show, the program will last about 1 hour and 30 minutes, you will be introduced by the tour guide about the specific time, or ask the locals.

The river originates from Guangxi, China, with clear water on both sides of the beautiful scenery.

The pagoda is located very close to Ban Gioc waterfall, from the pagoda visitors can see the whole beauty of the Ban Gioc waterfall scenic area.

The village has 14 ethnic groups living, with stone stilt houses that have existed for hundreds of years, the stone house was formed when the Mac dynasty came to Cao Bang to build a citadel to protect the country.

This is mainly inhabited by Tay people, coming here visitors will experience the unique culture of the people in the Northeast mountains, the most beautiful is in the ripe rice season.

This is one of the large bamboo forests in Cao Bang, going down the road on both sides are straight bamboo trees like a fairy garden.

A place to see the immense pear blossoms, the most beautiful time to come here is in March, if you are planning to travel to Cao Bang in March, visit Xuan Truong Valley to admire this peaceful beauty

Located about 60 km from the center of Cao Bang city, this place is famous for Cao Bang chestnuts, when coming here, visitors will feel the fragrant scent of chestnut flowers in the wind, a famous specialty that is often harvested in late autumn and early winter, October and November.

is a 1,931 m high mountain, the most beautiful time to visit Phia Oac Mountain is in winter and spring from December to March of the following year, to hunt clouds, tourists travel to Phia Oac Mountain in February. posts.contentHtml:

Chicken or fish marinated with yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander and turmeric, then processed by talented chefs and cooked in a clay oven with a smoky, spicy taste and bright red color called tandoor.

A delicious cone of lentils, water, oil, onions, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and many spices such as cumin, mustard seeds, turmeric, and curry leaves… is one of the attractive dishes of Indian people.

Indian festive dish includes fragrant rice cooked with meat, vegetables, nuts, dried fruits and spices such as saffron, cardamom, cloves and bay leaves. Biryani has many options such as chicken, lamb or vegetables…

posts.title: Visiting Chuong Non Village
posts.excerpt: Chuong Non Village is a traditional craft village, up to now the craft village has been more than 300 years old, although not far from Hanoi, the Chuong Non Village still exudes a rustic beauty of Vie
posts.contentHtml:
Chuong Non Village is a traditional craft village, up to now the craft village has been more than 300 years old, although not far from Hanoi, the Chuong Non Village still exudes a rustic beauty of Vietnamese culture.

For a long time, the mountain has been a rustic symbol of Vietnamese culture, in which it is impossible not to mention Chuong Non Village which has brought that nostalgic beauty to many generations and to this day Chuong Non Village still exudes a unique beauty.

According to the elders in the village, it is not clear when the village started making conical hats, but in the past, the village also had Trang Thi Trung specializing in making different types of hats such as hats for village girls, conical hats, long hats, and conical hats for men…

It can be said that Chuong Non Village is a place to make traditional hats from conical hats, old leaf hats, suitable for all ages.

The hats are decorated by the skillful hands of the craftsmen of the village, when worn, they exude the unique beauty of Vietnamese women.

Up to now, Chuong conical hat village has not only brought income to the people here, but also been a tourist destination for domestic and international tourists to visit the traditional craft village that still preserves its own beauty to this day.

Currently, Chuong conical hat village is a tourist destination that many tourists come to visit, especially to experience how to make hats with the people here, which will bring visitors interesting experiences, watching the steps of making hats from the elderly to the young, adults teach children, and so on, the profession continues to pass on the profession and the profession of making hats silently preserves the conical hat, which is both a tradition and a unique cultural feature of a Vietnamese craft village.

Although times have changed, Chuong village still silently preserves the soul of Vietnamese conical hats day and night. Those conical hats, for generations, have been close and familiar to Vietnamese women. Every day, following the grandmothers, mothers and sisters not only protects them from the rain and sun, but also creates a very unique “charm”, becoming a cultural feature of the Vietnamese people, surprising many international tourists.

Fishing and visiting fishing villages: Visitors will learn about the lives of the people here, especially when dawn comes, the boats follow each other to go out to sea, when dusk comes, the boats have docked with boats full of fish and shrimp, with warm smiles…

posts.title: Complete set of latest Hanoi travel experiences
posts.excerpt: The best time to travel to Hanoi is in the fall from August to November, and in the spring from March to April, when the weather is clear and very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee. Autumn
posts.contentHtml:
The best time to travel to Hanoi is in the fall from August to November, and in the spring from March to April, when the weather is clear and very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee.

Autumn in Hanoi with rows of trees changing to yellow and red leaves and the faint scent of milk flower season, or spring when young trees are stirring and sprouting, from afar it looks like a poetic picture enough for tourists to take beautiful pictures.

To fully enjoy the beauty of the capital Hanoi, visitors should experience cycling to see the streets, with the fragrant smell of milk flower will bring visitors a perfect vacation when visiting the capital Hanoi.

Places to visit in Hanoi

Thang Long Imperial Citadel

A place recognized as a world cultural heritage located in the heart of Hanoi, is a place that contains unique relics, evidence of the history of Thang Long – Hanoi and the history of the Vietnamese people.

Hoan Kiem Lake

As one of the freshwater lakes emerging in the heart of the Capital, from here visitors will visit streets such as: Hang Ngang, Hang Dao, Cau Go, Luong Van Can, Lo Su… or the Western street planned by the French in the past, from here visitors can visit Bao Khanh, Nha Tho, Trang Thi, Hang Bai, Dinh Tien Hoang, Trang Tien, and visit Ngoc Son temples, the old town… or walk around the lake to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed upon the Capital.

Long Bien Bridge

The bridge crosses the pink lake, coming here visitors will feel the beauty between the present and the past, a destination dedicated to tourists who love Hanoi.

Tran Quoc Pagoda

Located right on the eastern island of West Lake, it is one of the pagodas that was once among the most beautiful pagodas in the world, the pagoda was recognized as a National Historical and Cultural Relic in 1962.

Van Mieu – Quoc Tu Giam

This is one of the first schools in Vietnam, when coming here, visitors can visit the stone stele, the campus or visit the lotus pond, this place will bring visitors a peaceful beauty and is one of the indispensable destinations in the Hanoi tour itinerary.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum

For any tourist when traveling to Hanoi, they come to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum to pay their respects to President Ho Chi Minh, and attend the flag lowering ceremony at 9pm every day, in a solemn atmosphere…

One Pillar Pagoda

As one of the ancient pagodas in Hanoi, visitors should take a walk to enjoy and admire the peaceful beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Old Quarter

When you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should take a walk around the Old Quarter and feel the unique beauty of the Old Quarter, especially when night falls, this place will bring a unique beauty.

Museum

The Museum of Ethnology is a place to preserve and display 15,000 artifacts, 42,000 documentaries, pictures and thousands of other documents about 54 ethnic groups in Vietnam. In addition, visitors should visit the Vietnamese Women’s Museum, Hanoi Museum, National History Museum or Hoa Lo Prison, Hanoi Flag Tower relic… to learn and experience the historical culture of the Capital.

Not only that, when coming to the Capital Hanoi, visitors can also enjoy art shows imbued with national identity such as: Water puppetry, listening to Ca Tru, live shows…

What to do when traveling to Hanoi?

Coming to the capital Hanoi, visitors not only visit the scenic spots but also experience interesting games such as: SUP rowing on West Lake, experiencing the walking street, beer street, going to Dong Xuan market, Quang Ba flower market and Long Bien wholesale market to buy souvenirs…

What to eat when traveling to Hanoi?

Coming to Hanoi, visitors cannot miss the delicious and attractive dishes such as: Pho bo, Bun cha, Bun thang, Bun oc, Bun moc, Bun doc mung… Cha ca La Vong, Ho Tay shrimp cake, Banh cuon, Banh ran,… or sit somewhere sipping a cup of coffee and watching the autumn scenery of the capital like a picture appearing before the eyes of visitors.

What season to buy gifts when traveling to Hanoi:

In addition to foods such as dried apricots, Banh com, lotus tea, visitors when traveling to Hanoi can also visit Van Phuc village or Bat Trang pottery to buy souvenirs for friends and relatives.

posts.title: Quang Phu Cau incense village tourism

posts.contentHtml:
Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a place with its own suburban beauty. Although it is located 35km from Hanoi, it exudes its own beauty. Coming here, visitors will visit a traditional craft village and is a check-in spot chosen by young people.

Right from the village gate, visitors will encounter bundles of incense drying along the road, the sound of bamboo sticks and the clicking sound of incense making machines, a rustic and familiar sound of a craft village.

When mentioning the incense village and conical hat village, you probably think of Hue. Few people know that Quang Phu Cau incense village brings visitors a unique beauty.

The incense village has existed for hundreds of years, initially a side job, but has gradually become a traditional craft village, not only an attractive tourist destination for visitors from all over the world but also brings income to the people here.

Previously, the craft village was handmade, but now it has developed with modern machines, producing good, beautiful products that many tourists visit when traveling to Hanoi, and this is also one of the most strongly developing traditional craft villages.

Currently, the incense village is an attractive tourist destination for many domestic and international tourists, so many factories have also arranged beautiful incense bundles for tourists to check in, thereby promoting the products of the craft village to domestic and international friends.

Many tourists share that although they have traveled everywhere to explore, when visiting the incense village, they will not be able to help but admire the photos of the incense stick production village of Quang Phu Cau, especially when the photos appear on social networks, further urging travelers to come to the incense village.

So to experience those interesting things, come with Vietlook Travel to visit the incense village to visit and experience the beauty of a traditional craft village through the stages of the craft village, and save for yourself unique, colorful photos.

posts.title: Tam Coc tourism in the ripe rice season
posts.excerpt: Tam Coc tourism in the ripe rice season is most beautiful in the summer, at this time you can take a boat along the Ngo Dong River to admire the scenery surrounded by undulating rocky mountains, below
posts.contentHtml:
Tam Coc tourism in the ripe rice season is most beautiful in the summer, at this time you can take a boat along the Ngo Dong River to admire the scenery surrounded by undulating rocky mountains, below is the clear blue water, on both sides are fragrant rice fields. Besides that, you can also visit the famous sights…

Tam Coc – Bich Dong is one of the famous scenic spots in Ninh Binh, each season here brings visitors a different beauty, but the most beautiful is the golden ripe rice season that looks like a long carpet from afar.

The most beautiful time to travel to Tam Coc in the ripe rice season is from May to June of the solar calendar, at this time the weather is clear, plus the beauty of the ripe rice color adds to the peaceful countryside picture, and is also the time to attract tourists from all over to Ninh Binh.

Coming to Ninh Binh tourism, visitors can also experience on boats, on both sides are brilliant golden rice fields, visitors can freely admire and record for themselves beautiful pictures.

Visitors go on boats to explore the beauty of Tam Coc surrounded by towering limestone mountains, below is a cool blue stream and mysterious caves, a natural beauty that cannot be found anywhere else.

When sailing on the Ngo Dong River to admire the vast scenery, continue the journey, visitors should visit Bich Dong Pagoda with its ancient design

If traveling to Tam Coc, visitors should go early in the morning to admire the sunrise, in the cool weather, the gentle sunlight exudes a unique beauty in Tam Coc.

It can be said that traveling to Tam Coc in any season of the year, whether you sail or walk on the shore, all bring a peaceful scene, a beautiful picture of the countryside, especially in the ripe rice season, looking from afar like a long carpet, at this time Tam Coc seems to put on a passionate cloak, a beautiful picture of the countryside that cannot be found anywhere else.

Tam Coc has its own beauty in each season, but in the summer, Tam Coc wears a unique beauty, a golden color of ripe rice fields stretching out, you can take a boat along the Parasol River to admire the scenery, under the sunlight of the summer, Tam Coc seems to shine, bringing a unique beauty among the mountains and rivers that look like a multi-colored painting.

Tam Coc includes 3 caves: Hang Ca, Hang Hai and Hang Ba on the gentle Ngo Dong River, you can sit on the boats along the river surrounded by high, steep rocky mountains creating a watercolor painting that nature has bestowed on Ninh Binh.

In the summer, Tam Coc stretches out in a golden color, the most beautiful is when sitting on the boats with the locals, you can admire the scenery, and listen to the thrilling stories that will bring you the most unforgettable vacation.

The image of the Ngo Dong River stretching like silk, and adding to it are the fragrant rice flowers in the wind, a rustic and peaceful countryside picture but containing many interesting things.

Places to visit in Tam Coc

Tam Coc – Thai Vi Temple – Thien Huong Cave is a journey chosen by many tourists when coming to Ninh Binh.

  • The destination you cannot miss when traveling to Tam Coc is Hang Ca, 127 m long, coming here you will see the stalactites hanging down like a beautiful picture, the climate is cool all year round, it is the most beautiful destination in the summer in Ninh Binh.
  • Hang Hai when entering the cave you can see the stalactites from the ceiling of the cave looking like the shape of strange animals.
  • Hang Ba is about 50m long, on the ceiling of the cave is a beautiful arched stone arch.
  • Thai Vi Temple is the place to worship Kings Tran Thai Tong, Tran Thanh Tong, Generals Tran Hung Dao, Tran Quang Khai and Queen Tran Thi Dung.
  • Thien Huong Cave is one of the dry caves, located halfway up the mountain facing the poetic river.

Bich Dong Pagoda is one of the ancient pagodas, located majestically on the rocky mountain, in the pagoda there is a large bell cast from the Le Dynasty, the pagoda has been restored and expanded to include Ha Pagoda, Trung Pagoda, Thuong Pagoda, spread over three mountain floors.

To admire the beauty of Tam Coc, take a boat on the Ngo Dong River, you only need 2 hours to admire the beauty here, the beautiful scenery changes with the color of the rice.

posts.title: Ha Long Travel Experience from A to Z
posts.excerpt: Vietlook Travel shares with you the complete Ha Long Travel Experience from A to Z with many unique activities, visiting famous places such as: Sung Sot Cave, climbing Titop Mountain, swimming, kayaki
posts.contentHtml:
Vietlook Travel shares with you the complete Ha Long Travel Experience from A to Z with many unique activities, visiting famous places such as: Sung Sot Cave, climbing Titop Mountain, swimming, kayaking,… so let’s learn about interesting things before coming to Ha Long below.

1. When is the best time to travel to Ha Long?

Many foreign tourists often like to visit Ha Long Bay in the winter months, starting from November until Lunar New Year. From May to July, this is the time when many tourists often choose resort tours combined with sightseeing in Ha Long Bay, and this is also the time when students have summer vacation, so many tourists often choose tourist attractions.

According to Vietlook Travel’s experience of traveling to Ha Long, you should choose Ha Long tours combined with daily sightseeing in the fall from August to October. This is the time when the sea is calm and there are no storms. In addition, the best time to travel to Ha Long is in the summer from April to May. This is the peak season of Ha Long.

Especially if you plan to travel Ha Long in June or July, you should check the weather forecast before coming here, to have the most perfect tour. If you go on a day with bad weather, it will affect your tour, you may not even be able to experience the Ha Long cruise or participate in sea games.

 

2. Means of transport to Ha Long Bay

From Hanoi, you can easily travel to Ha Long Bay by means of transport such as motorbike or car with a travel time of 3-5 hours.

In addition, you can also travel to Ha Long Bay by public transport such as passenger cars, tourist buses. From Ho Chi Minh City or the southern provinces, you can travel to Ha Long Bay by train, passenger car or plane…

3. What to do in a day when coming to Ha Long Bay?

Ha Long Bay is one of the natural wonders of the world that has been recognized by UNESCO many times. This is one of the destinations chosen by many tourists, and is a destination not to be missed in the summer. Especially foreign tourists when they have the opportunity to set foot in Vietnam.

Ha Long is proud to be a place with beautiful natural scenery with thousands of islands with unique shapes that will amaze visitors. In addition, Ha Long also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes and cruise experiences to explore the wonders of each island in the bay.

To explore the beauty of Ha Long Bay with a daily general tour, visitors can buy cruise tickets or wooden boat tours.

SunWorld Ha Long Park

SunWorld Ha Long Park is a complex of entertainment, recreation, resort, shopping located right on the coast of Bai Chay, adjacent to Ha Long Bay. Sun Group has brought a completely new color to Ha Long tourism, and is an indispensable destination when traveling to Ha Long in the summer

SunWorld Ha Long Park – Ha Long Bay daily tour, you will have the opportunity to experience unlimited fun in 5 main areas, including: Ha Long Water Park – Tornado Park, Ha Long Long Park, Sun World Ha Long Beach, Ba Deo Amusement Park and Food & Shopping Area.

 

Quang Ninh Museum

Quang Ninh Museum is a unique architectural work of Quang Ninh province, built on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the establishment of Quang Ninh province, a place to preserve many cultural, historical, traditional labor values, typical images associated with the spiritual life of the people here.

Quang Ninh Museum is now in operation, becoming one of the attractive destinations of Ha Long Bay with daily general tours. Quang Ninh Museum is open every day of the week from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, except the last Monday of the month.

Reu Island

Reu Island is located about 300m from Bai Chay beach, is a pristine island and was bought by Vingroup and developed into the most luxurious and classy resort in Ha Long city.

If you are planning to visit Reu Island, choose Vinpearl resort to enjoy the most relaxing moments, outside the peak season Vinpearl still provides free services for tourists visiting Ha Long Bay with daily sightseeing and swimming tours.

Bai Chay, Quang Ninh

Bai Chay, Quang Ninh is an ideal destination for all tourists when they have the opportunity to set foot in Ha Long. In addition, Bai Chay also has many extremely chill cafes designed in an impressive and unique style, so don’t forget to visit with your friends to enjoy the most complete Ha Long tour during your trip.

In addition, Bai Chay, Quang Ninh is also known for its delicious and attractive dishes such as: Sa Sung porridge, stir-fried snails, cu ky, sea cucumber, fried squid eggs with fish sauce,… when you come here, you can visit any restaurant to enjoy and don’t forget to buy squid cakes as a gift.

Tho Mountain

Coming to Tho Mountain, you will have the opportunity to admire the panoramic view of Ha Long Bay with the vast ocean and the islands on the bay. The mountain with a poetic name has urged travelers to come to Ha Long.

Although not the highest mountain in Ha Long, Tho Mountain offers a spectacular view of the beautiful bay, giving visitors a feeling of excitement and dispelling all the fatigue of daily work. Standing on the top of the mountain, admiring the scenery and taking beautiful souvenir photos will bring visitors the most unforgettable memories in Ha Long.

4. Suggested 1-day Ha Long tour itinerary

To fully enjoy the beauty of Ha Long Bay with a daily group tour, please refer to the following suggested itinerary:

Morning

To save time and money when traveling to Ha Long Bay from Hanoi, you should depart early in the morning, and arrive at Ha Long Bay around 11am.

Afternoon

Tourists explore Ha Long Bay. If you travel in a large group, you can rent a private boat to explore the beauty of the Bay. However, if you travel alone or in a small group, you can buy a separate ticket to join a group on a boat to visit the bay.

The journey will take you to famous places such as Sung Sot Cave, which is a destination not to be missed on your Ha Long Bay tour.

Cua Van fishing village, a unique fishing village that still preserves traditional cultural features with ancient stilt houses. Then return to the hotel to check out.

Evening

Dinner at a famous seafood restaurant in Ha Long Bay. Then, take the bus back to Hanoi, ending a fun day tour of Ha Long Bay.

5. Exciting experiences to try when Ha Long Bay with daily shared tour

  • Kayaking for about 30 minutes to 1 hour, this is an interesting activity when the boat glides through the scenic spots, from the sea surface, visitors will fully admire the beauty of the islands.
  • Visiting the caves in Ha Long Bay, visitors will encounter majestic natural scenery such as: Sung Sot Cave, Thien Cung Cave, Trinh Nu Cave, Thien Canh Son Cave. You will climb to the island and enter the caves, admiring many amazing landscapes that nature has bestowed.
  • Visiting Ha Long Bay by cruise: If you do not want to kayak, you can choose to go by bamboo boat, rowed by local people and take you to visit Luon Cave and other “lagoon” areas with beautiful scenery.
  • Beach sightseeing and mountain climbing: The beaches on the bay are not large but very beautiful, you can relax on the beach or climb to the top of the mountain to see the whole view of Ha Long Bay and take pictures with a beautiful view.
  • Sunset party and cooking class are new experiences for tourists, while enjoying or sipping a cup of coffee, tea or a glass of wine while waiting for the sunset to fall on Ha Long Bay, a beautiful backdrop of the sea and islands.
  • Overnight on a Ha Long Bay cruise. If you love romantic natural scenery, try sleeping overnight on a cruise. With the price of a Ha Long Bay cruise you have to pay, you will be greeted by the sunrise with a 360-degree view of the sea, a quiet space away from the noise of the city.
  • Admiring Ha Long Bay from a seaplane: This is a new form of experience. On a seaplane, you will be able to see the whole view from above, flying high and wide, embracing the majestic beauty of Ha Long Bay.

6. Ha Long Bay Hotel you should choose for a day tour of Ha Long.

Heritage Ha Long Hotel

Located in the center of Ha Long city, Heritage Ha Long Hotel is the first 4-star international standard hotel in Quang Ninh. With luxurious and modern architecture, Heritage Ha Long Hotel will bring visitors a comfortable feeling when staying in their rooms.

Coming to the Restaurant, you will be served by a team of enthusiastic and attentive staff, always satisfying all visitors, even the most demanding customers.

Ha Long Palace Hotel

Located right in the center of Bai Chay ward, a bustling tourist area in Ha Long city. Ha Long Palace Hotel consists of 17 floors, 119 rooms with three different types of rooms, from Deluxe to Premium, Suite and Palace Suite, ensuring visitors have luxurious amenities and perfect service quality. With a harmonious combination of modern and traditional architecture, it will be a great place to stay for visitors.

7. What to eat when traveling to Ha Long Bay?

Ha Long Golden Crab Restaurant

Address: No. 32 Phan Chu Trinh, Bai Chay Ward, Ha Long City

Ha Long Golden Crab Restaurant specializes in famous seafood dishes in Ha Long City. The restaurant is located right next to Bai Chay, with a view of the sea. Coming here, the restaurant can experience cuisine in a spacious, airy space on the poetic beach, while enjoying interesting music programs with Vietnamese instruments right on the restaurant premises.

Phuong Nam Ha Long Restaurant

Address: Do Sy Hoa Street, Cai Dam Urban Area, Bai Chay, Ha Long, Quang Ninh

Phuong Nam Ha Long Restaurant is located in a prime location, right in the center of Ha Long City, with three sides facing the sea. With a spacious space, beautiful like paradise, it has become a dining destination chosen by many tourists.

All dining tables at Phuong Nam restaurant have a sea view, and are fully equipped with sound systems, lighting, projection screens, etc. to serve all individual and group guests. In addition, this is also a place to organize parties, conferences, birthdays, or meetings.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Ha Long, especially the day tours that Vietlook Travel has just shared with you, hopefully it will be helpful for your tour, wish you the happiest vacation in Ha Long.

posts.title: Catholic Churches Tours In Vietnam | The Top Churches Worth Visiting
posts.excerpt: Alongside the majestic natural landscapes, Vietnam also possesses many notable spiritual destinations. Catholic churches tours in Vietnam will take you to unique places, from ancient and historical ch
posts.contentHtml:
Alongside the majestic natural landscapes, Vietnam also possesses many notable spiritual destinations. Catholic churches tours in Vietnam will take you to unique places, from ancient and historical churches in Hanoi and Nam Dinh to contemporary architectural masterpieces.

Embark on a tour of a Catholic Church in Vietnam and discover beautiful and profound religious sites. With each step, you will find peace and connection with the spiritual realm through these Catholic churches.

Overview of Catholic churches tours in Vietnam

Catholicism is one of the major religions in Vietnam. It has a long history and profound influence on the religious and cultural life of the people. Introduced to Vietnam in the 16th century, Catholicism has become an integral part of the faithful community, contributing to the country’s cultural development.

Catholicism in Vietnam has unique cultural characteristics, combining Catholic beliefs with traditional cultural values. Religious festivals such as Easter and Christmas are essential occasions in the year. The ceremonies attract many people to participate and share joy and gratitude for their faith.

In recent years, as tourism has developed further, Catholic church tours have expanded with many attractive tours for believers. Besides visiting beautiful churches, visitors will also have the opportunity to interact with the Catholic population in Vietnam.

Catholic church travel will provide you with a deep understanding of the history of Catholicism in Vietnam and the religious practices of the Catholic community. You will learn about the development and influence of Catholicism in Vietnamese society over time.

Catholic church tours in Vietnam offer a unique experience for travelers who want to explore the architectural beauty of churches and the country’s religious history.

Top Catholic Churches Tours in Vietnam

Explore the list of Catholic churches in Vietnam below to have wonderful destinations in Catholic churches tours in Vietnam.

Catholic Church in Hanoi, Vietnam

Touring Catholic churches in Hanoi will also give you a profound insight into Vietnam’s capital city’s religious life and spirituality. You can participate in spiritual activities such as attending prayer services, listening to scripture, and learning about the Catholic faith and practices.

  • St. Joseph’s Cathedral, Hanoi (Cathedral of St. Joseph): This church is one of the city’s famous architectural landmarks and symbols, built in 1882. The church carries historical and religious significance with its French architecture reminiscent of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris.
  • Hanoi Church: This long-standing church is known for its harmonious and beautiful architecture. Located in the city center, Hanoi Church attracts many tourists and Catholic faithful who come to visit and pray.
  • Hoa Binh Church: Situated on Ba Trieu Street, Hoa Binh Church has unique architecture combining Indochinese and Classical styles. This church is one of the religious attractions that attract tourists and the Catholic faithful for prayer and visitation.
  • Holy Family Church: Located on Nui Truc Street, Holy Family Church features modern and exquisite architecture. Built-in 2010, this church is a new and captivating religious destination that attracts visitors.

Catholic churches tours in Vietnam also provide an opportunity to learn about the interplay and intersection of Catholicism with traditional Vietnamese culture. You can witness the fusion of local and international elements in these churches’ rituals and religious activities.

Catholic church in Sapa, Vietnam

In addition to focusing on churches, Catholic church tours in Sapa offer the magnificent natural beauty of the highlands. You can explore terraced fields, waterfalls, traditional villages, and trekking activities.

Sapa Church (also known as St. Rosa of Lima Church) is an important religious structure and symbol in the town of Sapa. The church was inaugurated in 1895, several years after construction began in the late 19th century. The architecture of Sapa Church bears French influences and is constructed with stone and wood.

Perched on a hill, Sapa Church offers a breathtaking panoramic view of Sapa and the surrounding terraced fields. With its stunning location, Sapa Church has become a favorite destination for tourists and Catholic faithful to visit and pray.

Sapa Church is a sacred place where the local Catholic community gathers for religious ceremonies and prayer. Visitors can explore the church, learn about its history and religious significance, and experience this spiritual space’s solemn and tranquil atmosphere.

This Catholic churches tours in Vietnam will surely not disappoint. Catholic devotees can embark on a spiritual pilgrimage while traveling to the churches.

Catholic church in Hue, Vietnam

Hue, the renowned city of history and culture in Vietnam, also boasts noteworthy Catholic churches. The city showcases the beauty of impressive natural landscapes and carries unique spiritual characteristics from ancient times.

Here are some Catholic church tourist spots in Hue that you can explore:

  • Hue Cathedral (Our Lady of Perpetual Help Cathedral): Built-in 1895, Hue Cathedral is an architectural masterpiece with a distinctive Gothic style. The cathedral is located in the heart of Hue and is considered one of the city’s important landmarks.
  • Phuoc Hung Church: This church is the most beautiful in Hue. The church’s harmonious architecture and elegant interior attract visitors with its serene and peaceful ambiance.

When participating in Catholic church tours in Hue, you will discover many interesting aspects of spiritual sites. Your prayer sessions will also follow the unique practices of Vietnamese Catholics.

Catholic church in Da Nang, Vietnam

Catholic churches tours in Vietnam in Da Nang provide a great opportunity to explore special religious sites in the city. Da Nang is a dynamic and developed city, home to beautiful and meaningful Catholic churches.

Here are some famous Catholic churches in Da Nang that you can visit:

  • Da Nang Chicken Church: This church stands out with its distinctive chicken-shaped structure and high dome on the roof. Built-in 1923, Da Nang Chicken Church holds special historical value and is one of the famous architectural landmarks in the city.
  • Phu Thuong Church: The church features modern architecture with characteristics of the Central Vietnamese region. Built with meticulous arrangements of bricks, the church is constructed with sturdy columns. Phu Thuong Church serves as the focal point of the local Catholic community, organizing religious activities and prayer sessions.
  • Evangelical Church: Its open space and emphasis on tranquility provides a space for prayer and worship. It is one of the important Evangelical religious facilities in Da Nang, serving the local Evangelical community and their religious and social activities.
  • Thanh Duc Church: Built in a European architectural style with tall columns and vaults, Thanh Duc Church creates a solemn and peaceful atmosphere. It is one of the significant religious sites in Da Nang and attracts the interest of the Catholic community.

In addition to religious activities, Da Nang is famous for its stunning landscapes, long beaches, and diverse cuisine. You can combine your Catholic church tour with other tourist attractions.

You can participate in prayer services, listen to scripture, or even engage in social activities of the parish. This allows you to interact with the local Catholic community, gain a deeper understanding of faith, and observe the religious practices of the people of Da Nang.

Whether you are a devoted Catholic or simply curious to explore and learn more about Catholicism, this tour will offer you a unique spiritual experience.

Catholic church in Saigon Vietnam

Touring Catholic churches in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) is an exciting experience to discover this vibrant city. Here are three prominent Catholic churches that you can explore in Catholic church tours in Vietnam:

  • Saigon Notre-Dame Cathedral: The most important destination when visiting Catholic churches in Saigon. With its unique Gothic-style architecture, Saigon Notre-Dame Cathedral is the city’s cultural and religious icon.
  • Tan Dinh Church: Built-in 1870, Tan Dinh Church features magnificent and distinctive architecture. The predominant pink color of the church makes it eye-catching and attractive to visitors.
  • Huyen Sy Church: With classical French architecture, Huyen Sy Church is a noteworthy tourist spot. Located in the city center, this church hosts many important religious activities.

Touring Catholic churches in Saigon will provide you with a deep understanding of this city’s culture, architecture, and Catholic practices. You can also enjoy the peaceful ambiance and learn more about the faith and religious lifestyle of the local people.

What should you notice about Catholic church tours in Vietnam?

When participating in Catholic church tours in Vietnam, there are a few things you should keep in mind for the best experience:

  • Visiting hours: Make sure you know the schedule and visiting hours of the tour to plan your time accordingly and avoid rushing.
  • Dress code: When visiting churches, dress modestly and respectfully. Avoid wearing too short or revealing clothes. It’s recommended to carry a covering scarf when needed.
  • Respect the ceremonies: During the tour, respect ongoing religious ceremonies and festivals. Avoid making noise or disturbing others.
  • Photography: Before taking photos, check if photography is prohibited. If allowed, be mindful not to inconvenience others and adhere to the guidelines for photography in the religious space.
  • Follow the tour guide: Listen to and follow the tour guide’s instructions. They will provide detailed information about the attractions, history, and religious practices at the churches.
  • Respect beliefs and locals: Respect the beliefs and religious pray of the local people. Follow the rules of the places you visit.

Remember that Catholic church tours are not only about exploring architecture and history but also an opportunity to understand and respect the faith and religious culture of the local people.

F&Q

What percentage of Vietnam is Catholic?

According to the 2019 General Census, 16 recognized religions are operating in Vietnam. The total number of religious followers is 13.2 million, accounting for 13.7% of the population. Among them, the Catholic religion has the largest number of followers, with 5.9 million, accounting for 44.6% of the total religious followers and 6.1% of the total population.

Where is the Queen of Vietnam Catholic Church?

The Mary Queen of Vietnam Church, also known as M.Q.V. Church, is a famous Catholic church located in New Orleans, Louisiana, USA. It is like a cultural and spiritual center for the Vietnamese Catholic community in the Greater New Orleans area.

The church was established in 1985 to meet the increasing number of Vietnamese immigrants settling in the area after the Vietnam War. It was built as a symbol of faith, community, and cultural preservation.

The church’s architecture reflects the traditional design elements of Vietnam, with vibrant colors and intricate details. It serves as a gathering place for the Vietnamese Catholic community, providing spiritual guidance, religious education, and support to its members.

The Mary Queen of Vietnam Church is an emblem of resilience, faith, and cultural identity of the Vietnamese Catholic community in New Orleans. It continues to be a cherished place of worship and a symbol of unity and strength for the Vietnamese community there.

How to find 9 am Catholic Mass near me?

Finding Vietnamese Catholic churches near you is not difficult. You can find a Catholic church for your Catholic church tours in several ways. To find a 9 am Catholic Mass near your location, here are some helpful tips for you:

  • Use online search tools: Use search engines like Google or location-based search websites to find churches near you. Type keywords such as “church” or “Catholic church” along with your area name or address into the search tool. The results will list the churches in that area.
  • Use mobile apps: Many mobile apps like Google Maps, Apple Maps, or other location-based search apps can help you search and locate nearby churches. Enter keywords such as “church” or “Catholic church” and activate the location feature for the app to display results near you.
  • Contact the local diocese: If you can’t find information online, you can contact the local diocese or local Catholic organizations to inquire about churches in your area. They can provide you with a list of churches, contact information, and liturgical schedules.
  • Ask local residents: You can also ask local residents or friends and family members who know the area’s churches. They may provide specific information and directions to the nearest church.

posts.title: Philippine golf tour: Discover The Best Of The Greens
posts.excerpt: With over 100 beautiful and modern golf courses, the Philippine golf tour is a must-experience for enthusiasts. From golf courses in Manila to those on stunning islands like Palawan and Boracay. The P
posts.contentHtml:
With over 100 beautiful and modern golf courses, the Philippine golf tour is a must-experience for enthusiasts. From golf courses in Manila to those on stunning islands like Palawan and Boracay. The Philippines offers a variety of golf courses to cater to every preference and skill level.

The Philippine golf tour is sure to provide exciting experiences for golfers; combining breathtaking natural landscapes with professional golf courses. Let’s learn more about some famous golf courses in the Philippines and prepare for an exceptional golf experience there.

Top 5 Philippine Golf Tour Courses

To have a perfect Philippine golf tour, you should seek out the most suitable golf courses in the country. Here is a list of the most renowned local golf courses for you:

Manila Southwoods Golf And Country Club

Topping the Philippine golf tour list, you can consider the Manila Southwoods Golf. It is a famous golf course in the Philippines and is ranked number one in the Southeast Asian region.

Located in Carmona City, Cavite province, approximately a 30-minute drive from Manila city center; this golf course covers 140 hectares with 36 challenging holes. You cannot miss this Manila golf club with countless exciting features.

Jack Nicklaus is the designer of the Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club, one of the world’s legendary golf stars. The golf course is divided into the West and the East Course. 

The West Course consists of 18 holes and is considered the more challenging part, with various hazards and hilly terrains. On the other hand, the East Course has another 18 holes and is more suitable for beginners.

Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club feature two main golf courses: the Legends Course and the Master’s Course.

The Legends Course is the original golf course of Manila Southwoods, built-in 1992. Designed by Jack Nicklaus, it is considered the most challenging golf course in the Philippines. 

This golf course has the largest area within Manila Southwoods, spanning 66 hectares. The Legends Course offers varying slopes and obstacles, such as water hazards and forests.

The Masters Course was built later in 1996 and also consisted of 18 holes. Designed by Jack Nicklaus, it provides a different golfing experience compared to the Legends Course. The Masters Course has longer and narrower fairways than the Legends Course, with challenging water hazards and grassy areas.

In addition, Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club offer modern facilities; such as practice areas, restaurants, a gym, a spa area, and conference centers to cater to customers’ needs.

With picturesque golf courses, stunning landscapes, and challenging designs; Manila Southwoods Golf and Country Club have captured the attention of many top golfers worldwide. It is undoubtedly a destination to be noticed for golf enthusiasts on the Philippine golf tour.

The Orchard Golf And Country Club

Arnold Palmer and Gary Player, golf legends, have designed two world-class 18-hole, par-72 golf courses at The Orchard Golf. It is located in the affluent Dasmariñas urban site on Metro Manila’s outskirts.

In 2020, Golf Digest USA voted The Orchard Golf, the second-best golf club in the Philippines.

The Orchard Golf Club is renowned for its breathtaking scenery and is located about an hour and a half south of Manila. It is a premier golf course in the Philippines, with two championship courses: Arnold Palmer and Gary Player.

These two golf courses have hosted many national and international competitions. Some featured contests:

  • Johnnie Walker Classic 1995
  • The World Golf Tour 1996

The golf courses here are also divided into different sections for players to choose from on their golf tours:

  • The East Course features long fairways and narrow flat fairways, with water hazards and forested areas posing various challenges.
  • The West Course is the most difficult section, with hilly terrain and challenging fairways, providing a true challenge for golfers.
  • The South Course is the easiest section, suitable for beginners. Those who want to practice their golf skills can also practice here.

The Orchard Golf and Country Club also offers modern facilities; such as practice areas, performance areas, restaurants, fitness gyms, and spas. Visitors on a Philippine golf tour will enjoy numerous excellent amenities. It is currently attracting top golfers from around the world.

Wack Wack Golf

Wack Wack Golf is one of the top golf course choices when visiting the Philippines. This course is the most famous and oldest golf course in the Philippines.

Located in Mandaluyong City, Metro Manila; the golf course was established in 1930 and has hosted international golf tournaments.

Wack Wack Golf features two main golf courses: the East and West. The East Course is the original golf course, designed by renowned golf architect William J. Shaw.

With 18 holes and hilly terrain, the East Course is famous for its picturesque fairways and challenging hazards. Many international tournaments have been held here, including the 2008 Philippine Open.

The West Course is the second golf course at Wack Wack, designed by Robbie McFarland. With 18 holes and relatively flat fairways, the West Course offers a different golfing experience than the East Course. This golf course has also hosted various national and international golf tournaments.

Wack Wack Golf and Country Club is a destination for golfers and a premier club with additional amenities; such as swimming pools, fitness gyms, tennis courts, and restaurants. The club is also famous for its distinctive clubhouse architecture, creating an elegant and sophisticated ambiance.

With its long-standing history, beautiful design, and quality fairways, Wack Wack Golf and Country Club will provide you an exciting Philippine golf tour experience.

Mount Malarayat Golf

Mount Malarayat Golf and Country Club is a renowned golf course in the Philippines, located in Lipa City, Batangas province. Built on a large plot of land and situated in a hilly area; Mount Malarayat Golf offers a scenic and enjoyable golf experience.

Mount Malarayat Golf features a main course with 27 holes. The course is divided into three sections: The Mount, The Lagoon, and The Plains, each with its characteristics and challenges.

The Mount is the highest part of Mount Malarayat Golf. Located on the hill, this section offers breathtaking scenery and winding fairways on hilly terrain. With the hilly landscape, golfers will face changing slopes and directions, creating an interesting challenge.

The Lagoon features a water lagoon and lush green grass areas. The golf course runs along the water; golfers will feel peaceful and relaxed when playing here. The hazards in this section include water ponds and challenging grassy areas. 

Golfers can make shots that require technique and precision. Participants in the Philippine golf tour here can enjoy the refreshing natural surroundings while playing golf.

The Plains is the largest and flattest part of Mount Malarayat Golf. The fairways here are spacious and free of narrow paths, providing favorable conditions for strong and confident shots.

This section is considered the easiest to play on the golf course and a popular choice for beginners or those looking to hone their skills.

Mount Malarayat Golf is famous for its beautiful natural landscapes and the unique architecture of its clubhouse. It offers additional amenities like restaurants, swimming pools, and fitness areas.

With its stunning natural scenery, exciting golf courses, and top-notch facilities, Mount Malarayat Golf will provide you with a perfect Philippine golf tour.

The Riviera Golf Club

The Riviera Golf Club is a renowned golf course in the Philippines in Silang City, Cavite province. Established in 1988, the golf course has become a popular destination for golfers, both local and international.

The Riviera Golf Club features two main golf courses: The Langer Course and The Couples Course.

  • The Langer Course: This course is designed by Bernhard Langer, one of the world’s top golfers and a two-time Masters Tournament champion. The Langer Course offers a world-class golf experience. With 18 holes and hilly terrain, this golf course demands accuracy and high-level shooting skills. It features natural hazards such as water ponds, streams, and forests.
  • The Couples Course: Designed by Fred Couples, a renowned golfer and Major Tournament champion, The Couples Course provides a unique golfing experience. With 18 holes, this golf course has relatively flat and spacious fairways, providing favorable conditions for golfers. Natural and strategically placed artificial hazards add to the challenge.

These courses will provide golfers with an exceptional Philippine golf tour experience. With world-class design and breathtaking scenery, The Riviera Golf Club is a fantastic destination for your pro golf events.

5 Major Golf Tournaments in the Philippines in

Golf in the Philippines is truly exciting, with many captivating tournaments. Here are some prominent golf tournaments in the country:

TCC Invitational

The TCC Invitational golf tournament in the Philippines is a significant event in the country’s golf calendar. TCC stands for “The Country Club,” a renowned golf club in the Philippines.

The TCC Invitational attracts top golfers from both domestic and international scenes. It is an opportunity for professional and amateur golfers to compete against each other in a competitive and prestigious environment.

Detailed information about the TCC Invitational, including schedules, regulations, and winners, is usually provided on The Country Club’s website. You can also find updates through reliable golf news sources. 

It is an opportunity for golfers to explore beautiful golf courses and challenge their skills in a professional setting.

PGT Qualifying School

The PGT (Philippine Golf Tour) Qualifying School is a significant event in the Philippine golf calendar. It is a qualifying tournament for golfers seeking opportunities to join the professional circuit of the PGT.

The PGT Qualifying School takes place annually and serves as a platform for golfers to compete to earn a PGT professional card. This card lets them participate in official tournaments and compete with top golfers in the Philippines.

In the PGT Qualifying School, golfers go through a series of rounds and are assessed based on their skills and performance. Based on the results, a limited number of PGT professional cards are awarded to the most outstanding golfers.

Participating in the PGT Qualifying School allows golfers to showcase their talents and abilities. It is also the first step to embark on a professional journey in the golf industry in the Philippines.

ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic

Furthermore, the ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic is a professional golf tournament within the Philippine Golf Tour (PGT) circuit in the Philippines. This tournament takes place annually and is held in the province of Negros Occidental; located in the western part of the Negros Island.

The ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic attracts top professional golfers from both domestic and international scenes. The tournament allows golfers to compete and experience a professional golfing environment. You can compete against other golfers on the golf course to vie for victory and prizes.

This tournament brings joy and excitement to participating golfers and contributes to developing and enhancing golf quality in the Philippines.

ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge

The ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge is a professional golf tournament held in the Philippines. It is organized by ICTSI (International Container Terminal Services, Inc.); a leading transportation and port services conglomerate in the Philippines. The tournament attracts top professional golfers from worldwide.

ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge takes place in Iloilo City, a location in the Visayas region of the Philippines. This tournament allows golfers to compete and vie for victory and prizes on the golf course.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship is a professional golf tournament organized in the Philippines. It is sponsored by ICTSI (International Container Terminal Services, Inc.); a leading transportation and port services conglomerate in the Philippines.

This tournament attracts participation from numerous golfers worldwide. You can also register to participate.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship occurs at Caliraya Springs Golf and Country Club; a venue on Caliraya Lake in Laguna province, Philippines. This golf course has many interesting natural scenes and unique architecture.

ICTSI Caliraya Springs Championship brings joy and excitement to participating golfers. It contributes to developing the sport of golf in the Philippines and raises awareness of Caliraya Springs Golf Course.

These are the five major renowned golf tournaments in the Philippines that we would like to introduce to you. We hope you will have a satisfying choice for your upcoming Philippine golf tour.

Who Can Help You Get The Best Philippine Golf Tour?

Philippine golf leaves a lasting impression on enthusiasts of this sport with its hundreds of high-quality golf courses. However, to have the perfect Philippine golf tour, we should consult the list of the best golf courses.

If you are unfamiliar with the Philippine Golf Association in this country, it is recommended to seek reputable service providers. They will assist you in creating excellent itineraries and provide useful advice.

posts.title: Explore traditional markets in Vietnam
posts.excerpt: Explore traditional markets in Vietnam, visitors will encounter the scene of exchange and trading, which is a place to show the unique and sophisticated culture of each region. Coming to the market, v
posts.contentHtml:
Explore traditional markets in Vietnam, visitors will encounter the scene of exchange and trading, which is a place to show the unique and sophisticated culture of each region. Coming to the market, visitors not only visit but also buy souvenirs as gifts. Join Vietook Travel to explore the markets to help experience the unique culture that Vietnam brings to visitors.

1. Traditional Markets in Vietnam

A traditional Vietnamese market is a place where buying and selling activities, exchanging goods, between sellers and buyers or traders, can be said to be a place for trading, introducing, advertising, marketing local products to buyers and tourists.

The market has various types of businesses held in densely populated areas with items that meet the needs of buying and selling, exchanging goods, services and consumption needs of local people.

The market is held in the most densely populated residential area, is a familiar shopping place for local people in each different area, there are flea markets or large markets depending on each area.

If you are looking for traditional markets in Vietnam, join Vietlook to visit famous places and traditional markets and experience the culture of each region with diverse products.

Each traditional market is bustling and preserves traditional cultural features. Here, you will not only learn about Vietnamese culture and people but also immerse yourself and enjoy a culinary tour Vietnam. You will certainly never forget these valuable experiences.

2. Visit the traditional market

The market was completed in 1914, and has existed and developed for more than 100 years. It is not only the largest commercial center in the South but also a witness to the ups and downs in the city’s history.

Ben Thanh Market is a place where many items are concentrated, from clothes, shoes, fabrics, handicrafts, souvenirs, jewelry to specialty dishes. The market operates day and night, especially when night falls, small night markets gather around, creating a bustling and vibrant night market scene that makes Saigon always colorful.

Dong Xuan Market

One of the famous markets in Hanoi. Located right in the center of the old town, this place gathers a variety of goods such as fabrics, household items, clothes, … In addition, the market also has a famous street food area of ​​Hanoi.

It can be said that this is not only a bustling trading place but also a cultural and historical symbol of Hanoi, existing from the Nguyen Dynasty to the present day. Coming to Dong Xuan Market, you can freely shop for beautiful, unique items and enjoy Hanoi’s specialty street foods such as vermicelli with grilled pork, pork rib porridge, vermicelli with bamboo shoots, … will bring visitors unforgettable memories.

Dong Ba Market

Initially, the market was built outside the East Gate of the city. Around 1885, during the period when the capital Hue was besieged by the French colonialists, the market was also burned down by the French colonialists.

During the reign of King Thanh Thai (1899), the market was moved near the intersection of the Hang Be River and the Huong River, and to this day, after many times of destruction and repair, this market has become splendid and bustling with buyers and sellers.

Dong Ba Market has ancient architecture in the Hue style, including a bell tower in the middle and nine surrounding rows of houses with four new commercial areas such as a service area, a self-produced goods area, a fish market and other areas.

Around 1885, during the period when the capital Hue fell, the market was also burned down by the French colonialists. After many times of destruction and repair, up to now, this market has become more spacious and bustling. The market has service areas, self-produced goods areas, a fish market, …

Dalat Market

The market was built in 1958 on the site of an old market called Cho Cay. In 1960, the market was completed according to the idea and design of architect Nguyen Duy Duc. As Dalat grew and the need for trade increased, in 1993, a three-story B area was added. To date, the market is among the top multi-story markets in Vietnam.

Dam Market

One of the traditional markets in Vietnam, the market is located on an old pond of about 7 hectares, flowing into the Nha Trang River under Ha Ra Bridge.

The market currently sells a variety of household products, souvenirs, seafood, etc. At the entrance and exit, the parking lot is located near the market, on both sides of the market’s dome, seafood, dried foods, grilled spring rolls, souvenirs and essential items to serve the daily needs of the people here.

3. Mekong Delta Floating Market

Nga Bay Floating Market

Surrounded by rivers and canals – the Mekong Delta is famous for its floating markets. Built in 1915, Nga Bay Floating Market is not only a place for trading goods between buyers and sellers but also attracts tourists to visit.

The market is located at the confluence of seven large rivers such as: Xeo Vong, Lai Hieu, Xeo Mon, Soc Trang, Bung Tau, Mang Ca and Cai Mon… This convergence has created a unique feature for Nga Bay Floating Market, which is increasingly crowded with visitors, especially foreign tourists when traveling to Vietnam all visit the floating market.

The market sells a variety of colorful items, especially fruits, vegetables and street vendors sold by people on the floating market on the water, on boats.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Vietnam, visit the market and experience the unique culture with the local people, or buy souvenirs as gifts. In addition, visitors can enjoy a cup of coffee, enjoy fish noodles, listen to folk songs of girls in charming Ao Ba Ba. It will definitely bring visitors many interesting experiences when visiting the floating market.

Cai Rang Floating Market

The market usually opens from early morning until about 9 am every day. To visit the market, visitors should visit around 6-7 am to experience the bustling atmosphere of the market.

Cai Rang Floating Market specializes in trading agricultural products, local fruits and local specialties such as: Vinh Long grapefruit, Tra Vinh coconut, Lai Vung pink grapefruit, Cai Mon durian. In addition, there are many other services such as cafes, floating bars…

This is a traditional market in Vietnam. Visitors can come here to sightsee and enjoy local specialties on boats in the morning. This is a typical culture in the Mekong Delta that attracts visitors, especially foreign visitors.

Cai Be Floating Market

Cai Be Floating Market is located in Tien Giang, Vinh Long and Ben Tre provinces. The market opens from 2am to 8am. The market sells a variety of products, from fabrics, household items to food and drinks.

The market is famous as a major fruit trading center in Tien Giang province with many famous fruits such as green-skinned grapefruit, Lo Ren star apple, oranges, grapefruit and Cai Be tangerines…

In addition, when visiting the market, visitors will encounter floating boats selling hu tieu, pho, and vermicelli, which are very bustling and attractive, leaving visitors with the most unforgettable impressions.

Tra On Floating Market

Tra On Floating Market is located right at the end of Hau River with a length of more than 300 meters, right between the confluence of Hau River and Mang Thit River, is one of the central markets and sells many items such as lard, sweet potatoes, cucumbers, grapefruit, Tan Thanh tangerines, Luc Si Thanh durian. Or popular dishes such as: Beef noodle soup with banana flower…

Long Xuyen Floating Market

The market is located right on the Hau River in My Phuoc Ward, Long Xuyen City, An Giang Province. The items here are sold on boats every day.

The most crowded time of Long Xuyen Floating Market is in the morning, mainly flowers, vegetables, squash, colorful cabbage, and local specialties of An Giang such as: Fish noodles, pork skin cakes, silkworm cakes…

The special thing about this market is that all items are sold at very cheap prices, so buyers do not need to bargain, with items almost sold at the right price, with the gentle hospitality of the Western people.

4. Notes when visiting floating markets in Vietnam

You should monitor the weather before visiting, and you should choose markets that suit your preferences, at traditional markets, enjoy typical dishes of different regions.

Refer to the Vietnamese floating markets shared in advance to avoid buying expensive but poor quality specialties.

In addition, visitors should also combine visiting famous places in addition to floating markets, which are also dream destinations of many tourists such as: My Khanh tourist village or famous fruit gardens in Can Tho, experience on a cruise to admire the immense scenery.

Each market has its own unique features that represent the cultural beauty of each region. Take your time and visit traditional Vietnamese markets with Vietlook Travel to enjoy the most interesting moments and learn more about Vietnamese life, people and culture.
